messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FINAL_BREATH: If your HP is above 80% and you receive an attack that would reduce it to 0, you survive with 1 HP.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_DEEP_FREEZE: Freezes the opponent’s cassette player, inflicting them with the Tape Jam status effect.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_TRAP_JAW: Automatically used after Bite. Inflicts the target with Evasion Nullified.
messages.STATUS_STAT_EVASION_NULLIFIED_DESCRIPTIO: Characters inflicted with Evasion Nullified have their Evasion stat reduced to 1%.
messages.STATUS_TAPE_JAM_DESCRIPTION: Characters inflicted with Tape Jam are prevented from switching out their current tape until either Tape Jam is removed, or their tape breaks.
messages.CONFIRM_LOAD_MODS3: Any mods you choose to use are at your own risk.
messages.CONFIRM_LOAD_MODS2: Note that malicious mods can access your file system, and run arbitrary commands on your computer.
messages.CONFIRM_LOAD_SAVE_WITH_NEW_MODS1: This save file hasn’t been saved with your current set of mods before. If you proceed with loading it, uninstalling any mods in future could cause it to become unusable.
messages.CONFIRM_LOAD_MODS4: Are you sure you want to load these mods?
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_TRIPWIRE: Chance to automatically use the next move in the list, for 0 AP, when an opponent uses a melee attack. The chance is reduced in proportion to the move’s normal AP cost.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_TREASURE_DIG: Digs up a random item. The winner of the battle gets to keep the item.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_COLD_FUSION: Activates whenever anyone fuses. Reduces the fusion’s HP by 20% of its Max HP, and causes it to flinch.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_MAGIC_TOME: Hits one target. Lowers the target’s Ranged Defence.
messages.UI_SAVE_REQUIRE_DLC: This save file can’t be loaded because it was created with DLC or mods that aren’t installed.
messages.STATUS_GEMSTONE_WALL_DESCRIPTION: Walls absorb a certain number of incoming hits. Type-advantaged attacks immediately break walls. In addition to standard Wall behavior, Gemstone Wall provides its owner with 1 extra AP each turn.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_GEMSTONE_WALL: Sacrifice 20% of HP to create a wall that will absorb up to 3 hits for up to 3 turns. This wall will also provide its owner with 1 extra AP each turn.
messages.CONFIRM_LOAD_SAVE_WITH_NEW_MODS2: Are you sure you want to load this file?
messages.BOLTAM_EVOLUTION_SPECIALIZATION_QUESTION: What aspect of lightning do you embody?
messages.DIVEBERG_DESCRIPTION: an iceberg creature with a diving helmet
messages.DIVEBERG_LORE_2: The lowest natural temperature ever recorded on Earth is -89.2 Celsius, and was recorded in Antarctica in 1983.
messages.PINBOLT_LORE_2: While the first modern-style pinball machine was invented in the 1940s, their origins lie in the game bagatelle, which was played across wooden boards. It also shares a common history and development with the game pachinko.
messages.AURICLAW_LORE_1: To reach maturity, Ferriclaws undergo a state of alchemical metamorphosis during which the iron plating and decorations on their bodies transform into a gold alloy. These Auriclaws act as front-line defenders of their vast territories.
messages.AURICLAW_LORE_2: Death masks were often made of famous figures and leaders. Arguably the most famous in modern history is the Mask of Tutankhamun, which was created in approximately 1323 BC.
messages.ADEPTILE_LORE_2: One of the ancient tenets of alchemical belief is that all things are composed of the four classical elements – earth, fire, water and air.
messages.PINBOLT_DESCRIPTION: a spring-shaped creature with a floating orb head
messages.DIVEBERG_LORE_1: If exposed to sub-zero conditions for long enough, the Diveal will adapt into its “Diveberg” form. It is theorised that it developing a bipedal skeleton helps the Diveberg traverse hostile, snowy terrain easier.
messages.PICKSIE_LORE_2: Dwarves are creatures of Germanic mythology that are often described as short humanoid beings. They are commonly associated with mines, blacksmithing and caves.
messages.OVERWORLD_SPIDERCAVE_FELIX: I don’t think we’ve stumbled upon giant spider webs before now. That strikes me as the kind of detail I’d remember if we had.
messages.OVERWORLD_SPIDERCAVE_EUGENE: Big webs? [pause]That must mean big bugs. I’m itching for a fight, alright.
messages.ADEPTILE_DESCRIPTION: a reptile in a scholar’s robe
messages.TRAPWURM_LORE_2: The lindworm is a European folkloric creature similar to a dragon. It is often depicted as a giant serpentine beast with fish-like dorsal fins along its back.
messages.PICKSIE_LORE_1: Picksies are avid miners, and will spend years of their lives excavating caves and tombs for gemstones and treasures. They often adorn themselves with the treasures they uncover, and equip themselves with armour or weapons they find, too.
messages.PICKSIE_DESCRIPTION: a masked goblin with a pick axe
messages.OVERWORLD_SPIDERCAVE_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]What are these strange webs…?[/wave]
messages.PICKSIE_ENCOUNTER_KAYLEIGH_1: Oh, did we startle that monster? It looks like it escaped into the ground. Next time we find it somewhere, let’s try to sneak up on it without it seeing us.
messages.RUMOR_PASSIVE_QUEST_PICKSIE_1: A ranger pal of mine posted {location_0_phrase} was just telling me about a strange creature he spotted: a skittish little goblin fellow.
messages.RUMOR_SPIDER_CAVE_3: It’s weird, right? We’ve never done any mining in the marsh.
messages.TRAPWURM_DESCRIPTION: a serpent with a huge jaw and legs
messages.PICKSIE_ENCOUNTER_SUNNY_1.n: [wave amp=20 freq=5]That monster fled when it saw us… perhaps if we see it again, we should approach it without being spotted…?[/wave]
messages.PICKSIE_ENCOUNTER_SUNNY_1.f: [wave amp=20 freq=5]That monster fled when it saw us… perhaps if we see it again, we should approach it without being spotted…?[/wave]
messages.ADEPTILE_LORE_1: The Adeptile has devoted everything to the pursuit of arcane knowledge. Little more than a head, it wears a long scholarly robe to hide its lack of a body.
messages.FERRICLAW_LORE_2: Death masks are replicas of a person’s face made after death. The methods and materials vary, and death masks appear across many cultures and eras of human history.
messages.RUMOR_SPIDER_CAVE_2: On one of his walks through the marsh he found a caved-in mine entrance.
messages.RUMOR_SPIDER_CAVE_1: You know Edward, right? He runs the farm with his wife, just over Piper Creek…
messages.FERRICLAW_DESCRIPTION: a spider wearing a rusted mask
messages.TRAPWURM_LORE_1: Trapwurms can hold their breath for days at a time as they wait beneath mud and dirt for prey to step overhead. Their jaws have an incredible strength that make them almost impossible to pry apart.
messages.FERRICLAW_LORE_1: Ferriclaws have only recently been discovered on New Wirral due to their habitats being deep underground cave networks. They adorn themselves with ancient death masks they unearth from the tombs of ancient civilisations.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOK_6: The scribbled notes say: “...this reptilian student of the arcane arts can reach its maximum potential if given a tome of magic to study.”
messages.PICKSIE_ENCOUNTER_EUGENE_1: Aw man, it bailed on us! Maybe if we see it again somewhere, we should try and sneak up behind it so it doesn’t see us and flee again.
messages.PICKSIE_ENCOUNTER_MEREDITH_1: Did that monster just bury into the ground? If we see it again somewhere, maybe we should try and sneak up on it without it seeing us.
messages.WYRMAW_LORE_1: Now too big to hide underground for prey, the Wyrmaw must instead lure potential victims with an inviting waving of its flag and a pleasant jingle-jangle of the bells that adorn its collar.
messages.WYRMAW_LORE_2: Lindworms appear in many European stories. One of these is the legend of the “Lambton Worm”, a lindworm-like creature that terrorirsed the locals near the River Wear where it was said to have lived.
messages.WYRMAW_DESCRIPTION: a big serpent with a flag on its head
messages.RUMOR_PASSIVE_QUEST_PICKSIE_2: Apparently it was digging away in the dirt for something with a pickaxe. It fled as soon as he got close though…
messages.PICKSIE_ENCOUNTER_VIOLA_1: It seems we caught this spirit unawares. If we cross paths with it again in our travels, perhaps we would be wise to approach it unseen?
messages.PICKSIE_ENCOUNTER_FELIX_1: Did it just… bury into the ground? Maybe it’s skittish around humans. If we see it again somewhere, maybe we should try and approach it without being seen.
messages.OVERWORLD_SPIDERCAVE_KAYLEIGH: Are these… spider webs? They’re a [wave amp=30 freq=10]little big[/wave], don’t you think?
messages.OVERWORLD_SPIDERCAVE_MEREDITH: Are you seeing the [shake rate=30 level=10]size[/shake] of these webs?! [pause]Nah. [pause]NO way. [pause]Let’s swerve this.
messages.OVERWORLD_SPIDERCAVE_VIOLA: Do the spiders of this land often weave webs of such… grand scale?
messages.PICKSIE_ENCOUNTER_SUNNY_1.m: [wave amp=20 freq=5]That monster fled when it saw us… perhaps if we see it again, we should approach it without being spotted…?[/wave]
messages.PINBOLT_LORE_1: The Pinbolt’s metal head floats separately from its body, suspended by a magnetic field generated by the two “flippers” on its body. It can channel this magnetic field to launch bolts of energy from its singular hand.
messages.AURICLAW_DESCRIPTION: a spider wearing a gold mask
messages.GAME_OVER_EUGENE1.m: ... And he’s up! C’mon {player}, let’s go.
messages.GAME_OVER_KAYLEIGH1: Are you OK? You had me worried there for a moment!
messages.GAME_OVER_FIRST_PENSBY4: I’ll trade you restoratives for any resources you have on hand – [pause]and so will Clémence at the Gramophone Café.
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_viola.v2: This place instills a slight concern within me. I fear that we have strayed into dangerous lands, friend.
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART1_KAYLEIGH4: So, well, I’ve been given an errand and need a helping hand. Do you think you’ll be able to help me out?
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART1_KAYLEIGH3.f: You know, you held your own the last time we fought together!
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART1_KAYLEIGH3.n: You know, you held your own the last time we fought together!
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH9: If a form loses all of its health in a fight, its tape will break and need repairing.
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH8: The green bar represents your monster form’s health, and the red is yours.
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH10: Not only that, but any extra damage from the attack that broke it will apply to YOUR health – the red bar.
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH11.f: If both of us lose all our health then we’ll have to retreat back to Harbourtown.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH14: What do you think?[pause] Pretty quaint, right?
messages.INTRO_PENSBY24: I don’t think it’s anything serious. Transforming for the first time is quite a shock to the psyche.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH23: You had me scared for a moment, {player}!
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART1_KAYLEIGH2.n: These bonfire pits mark areas you’re safe to set up camp.
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART2_KAYLEIGH2: There must be a way to get it to come over here…
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART2_KAYLEIGH1: There – do you see that monster?
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART3_KAYLEIGH2: There’s something about the monsters on New Wirral…
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART3_KAYLEIGH3: When weakened, their essence can be,[pause] well,[pause] recorded to cassette tapes.
messages.GAME_OVER_FIRST_PENSBY3.n: If you two are travelling across New Wirral, you’d be wise to stock up on healing supplies before you go.
messages.GAME_OVER_FIRST_PENSBY3.f: If you two are travelling across New Wirral, you’d be wise to stock up on healing supplies before you go.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH37: If you’d like to join me, meet me by the gate! The one just over the bridge we crossed to come into town.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH40: We also fetched some clothes for you, though they might be a bit… out of fashion for your era, but it’s all we have!
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH39.m: I’m pretty sure word has already gotten round that there’s a new lad in town.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH39.f: I’m pretty sure word has already gotten round that there’s a new lass in town.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH39.n: I’m pretty sure word has already gotten round that there’s a new face in town.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO5_KAYLEIGH1.m: Spending time in the great outdoors with my cute boyfriend...
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO5_KAYLEIGH1.n: Spending time in the great outdoors with my cute partner...
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO5_KAYLEIGH2: Things really could be worse, couldn’t they?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO6_KAYLEIGH1: I used to go camping a lot when I was a kid. Ireland has a bunch of great places to camp out!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO6_KAYLEIGH2: My da would drive the two of us to the countryside and we’d stargaze together.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO6_KAYLEIGH3: Camping with you makes me nostalgic for that time.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO7_KAYLEIGH3: When I lived in Mourningtown, Dorian had all these grand plans for the community…
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO7_KAYLEIGH4: And it felt exciting to be a part of that. [pause]To feel like lots of things were happening, and that I got to be a part of it all.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO7_KAYLEIGH6: It was excitement. [pause]And it’s easy to mix the two up, I think.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO7_KAYLEIGH5: I think at the time I thought that this was making me happy. [pause]But… [pause]I don’t think that feeling was happiness.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO9_KAYLEIGH1: Who knew that being in a relationship would involve so many coffee breaks?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO7_KAYLEIGH7: I guess there’s a difference between something being fun and something being fulfilling.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO8_KAYLEIGH1: I do wonder how the whole [pause]”cassette tape monster transforming” thing works.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO8_KAYLEIGH2: It doesn’t make sense on the surface right? [pause]I mean, these are just normal cassette players.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO8_KAYLEIGH4: But maybe I have the wrong attitude. [pause]Maybe focusing too much on the limitations is the wrong way to think about it.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO8_KAYLEIGH5: Maybe by accepting that the impossible can still happen, [pause]we enable it to happen, [pause]y’know?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO10_KAYLEIGH1: I wonder what life is like for the citizens of Harbourtown who were born here.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO10_KAYLEIGH2: I mean, this whole world is all they’ve ever known.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO10_KAYLEIGH3: And yet… people like us keep describing whole worlds of people and places.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO10_KAYLEIGH4: They probably find it hard to comprehend what we’re talking about!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO10_KAYLEIGH6: I guess it is very much a town of two halves.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO10_KAYLEIGH5: But then on the other hand, [pause]they’re much more used to the everpresent monster population.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO11_KAYLEIGH1: “The arrow of time only moves forward, Kayleigh.”
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO11_KAYLEIGH2: Oh, it’s just something my dad used to say.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO11_KAYLEIGH3: I guess it means that time marches on - we can’t turn back the clock and change our mistakes, so we shouldn’t dwell on the past.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO11_KAYLEIGH6: I guess that means we should be thinking about the next step in our adventure! After all, the arrow of time only moves forward, {player}!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO12_KAYLEIGH5: A word of advice between friends, though -[pause] maybe you [wave amp=30 freq=10]shouldn’t[/wave] tell her she’s not the only girl on this island that you’ve kissed.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO12_KAYLEIGH2: I guess after we [wave amp=30 freq=10]kissed[/wave], maybe I just had the wrong impression of what “we” were.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO12_KAYLEIGH3.n: It’s OK! It’s not like you promised me anything, {player}. We had a cute moment or two together. [pause]That’s all.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO12_KAYLEIGH3.f: It’s OK! It’s not like you promised me anything, {player}. We had a cute moment or two together. [pause]That’s all.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO12_KAYLEIGH3.m: It’s OK! It’s not like you promised me anything, {player}. We had a cute moment or two together. [pause]That’s all.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_9_DIALOGUE2: For a while now the rangers have been delivering clothes to us from the abandoned mall in the north. [pause]I just clean and repair them.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_10_DIALOGUE1: Ianthe is my hero. [pause]Did you know she was the first person on the island to record a monster with a cassette player?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_10_DIALOGUE2: Ianthe is my favourite of the ranger captains, [pause]but the others are neat too.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_10_DIALOGUE3: Someone told me that there’s a robot ranger captain… [pause]I don’t believe it.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_10_DIALOGUE4: Cybil has the coolest fashion sense of [wave amp=30 freq=10]all[/wave] the rangers.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_12_DIALOGUE8: Apparently the bridge that connects Harbourtown to Piper Farm has been lowered again. That’s [wave amp=30 freq=10]great[/wave] news for everyone here who, [pause]well, [pause]needs food to live.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_11_DIALOGUE1: With the way people in this town go on about “monsters” and “cassette tapes”, [pause]you’d think everyone was having fun here.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_10_DIALOGUE5: I wonder if I’ll get to be a ranger captain one day? [pause]Nah.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_11_DIALOGUE2: Well [shake rate=30 level=10]not me[/shake]! [pause][pause]I find all this monster business weird and uncomfortable!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_12_DIALOGUE1: You know what I miss? [pause]Sports. [pause]Why can’t Harbourtown start a football team?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_11_DIALOGUE3: Why couldn’t I be marooned somewhere more [wave amp=30 freq=10]normal[/wave]?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_27_DIALOGUE1: I was approached by a strange man trying to sell me a house recently. How would I even buy a house? There’s no such thing as [wave amp=30 freq=10]money[/wave] on this island!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_12_DIALOGUE3: Some weird pale skinned folks were skulking around here recently, muttering under their breaths. That’s unusual, even for this place.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_12_DIALOGUE4: Have you seen those cloaked weirdos around the park? Are they part of a [wave amp=30 freq=10]theatre troupe[/wave] or something?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_12_DIALOGUE5: Apparently Harbourtown and that other town in the east have made amends. I wonder what happened?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_12_DIALOGUE7: I haven’t seen those creepy pale folks in the black suits recently. What happened to them?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_12_DIALOGUE6: Folks around town claim that the abandoned mall is [wave amp=30 freq=10]haunted[/wave]. Monsters are one thing, but I draw the line at believing in ghosts!
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_kayleigh.v2.m: This place looks pretty dangerous – maybe we should come back when we’re stronger!
messages.GAME_OVER_PENSBY2: Take it easy out there, {player}. I don’t want you undoing all my hard work again so soon.
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_kayleigh.v3: I have a feeling the monsters here might be stronger than we are right now...
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_kayleigh.v2.n: This place looks pretty dangerous – maybe we should come back when we’re stronger!
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH29: Not to infodump on you, but you’re on an island called New Wirral.
messages.INTRO_PENSBY44: This all must be a lot to take in, but we all went through the same thing once.
messages.INTRO_MONOLOGUE45: I should probably put on some proper clothes first...
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART1_KAYLEIGH3.m: You know, you held your own the last time we fought together!
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART1_KAYLEIGH1: Hey again, {player}. [pause]Are you feeling a little better?
messages.CLEMENCE_ARRIVAL1: I fell. [pause]Landed in the ocean. [pause]Washed up here.[pause] About ten years ago now. It is what it is.
messages.CLEMENCE_CAFE4: I said to them, “shush!” And I fixed the Gramophone and now we can play the records. Now my café is stylish, and it has music. Everyone is happy. The end.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH25: Anyway, Harbourtown happened to have a spare home available for you, so this is your place now!
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH25_OPTION1: Where on earth is this place?
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH30_OPTION1: Is there a way back home?
messages.INTRO_PENSBY32: Castaways have been trying to get back to their worlds for a century, and none have succeeded.
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_meredith.v1: We might be in over our heads in this area, mate. [pause]The monsters here are pretty scary.
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_kayleigh.v2.f: This place looks pretty dangerous – maybe we should come back when we’re stronger!
messages.PARTNER_LEVELUP_MEREDITH1: I’ve, uh, been training since we last hung out. You don’t have to worry about me falling behind.
messages.SWAP_PARTNER_VIOLA1: Very well! Let us travel with haste.
messages.PARTNER_LEVELUP_EUGENE1: I’ve been working out recently – trust me, I’m [shake rate=30 level=10]way stronger[/shake] than I was last time we fought together!
messages.INTRO_PENSBY22: Ah, wonderful. You’re awake. Kayleigh gave me quite a fright when she came knocking at my door.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_KAYLEIGH5B: This isn’t like the other monsters. [pause][shake rate=30 level=10]We are not safe here[/shake].
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_MORGANTE3: NO, NO, YOU ARE NOT MY KIN.\n\nYOU COME FOR ME ONCE AGAIN, SWORD IN HAND?!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_KAYLEIGH8: Do you hear me, {player}? This isn’t the end for us! It can’t be!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_KAYLEIGH7: I am not gonna die here, not like this.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_KAYLEIGH10.m: We’re gonna fight this thing and we’re gonna do it TOGETHER!
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH6: Alright, now just pop that in your cassette player, [pause]put on the headphones [pause]and press play!
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH5: Yeah, I can see that! In that case, take this.
messages.GAME_OVER_FIRST_PENSBY5: Stay safe out there, {player}! If you’re careful, you won’t end up back here anytime soon!
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH1: Hey stranger – [pause]don’t make any sudden moves!
messages.GAME_OVER_FIRST_PENSBY1.m: Ah, you’re awake. You’re lucky you had a friend to get you back to my clinic in one piece!
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_eugene.v2: The monsters here look tougher than us – maybe we should do a bit more training before coming here…
messages.PARTNER_LEVELUP_KAYLEIGH1: I’ve been practicing my [wave amp=30 freq=10]monster fighting skills[/wave] since we last caught up. I think you’ll be pretty impressed!
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH18: I’m not very good at this part...
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH19: I don’t know how best to break the news.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH2: “Fusion” is a rare phenomenon known by the rangers. There are fused monsters in the wild, and supposedly the leader of the rangers can do it too.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3B_KAYLEIGH7: Supposedly, when the first unlucky sods washed up on the shores of New Wirral, they thought the monsters here were angels.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3B_KAYLEIGH10: Of course, when people learned they could fight and defeat the regular monsters, they lost their [wave amp=30 freq=10]“angelic allure”[/wave].
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3B_KAYLEIGH9: Logically, they called these other creatures “Archangels” – [pause]the highest ranking among the order of angels.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3B_KAYLEIGH8: And, [pause]and some of them wrote of other entities too, greater than the others… [pause]Creatures that look and feel “wrong”.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3B_KAYLEIGH12: We just call them monsters now. It’s a good catch-all term.
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART3_KAYLEIGH5: Now try switching to the tape you just recorded!
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART3_KAYLEIGH4: We don’t entirely know [wave amp=30 freq=10]how[/wave] it works, but it does – [pause]and that’s good enough for us.
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART3_KAYLEIGH6: That’s how you get yourself new monster forms!
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART3_KAYLEIGH8: Now, let’s finish this bug off!
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART3_KAYLEIGH7: However, if a monster takes too much damage it’ll flee. So you won’t be able to record it... [pause]you with me so far?
messages.GAME_OVER_FIRST_PENSBY3.m: If you two are travelling across New Wirral, you’d be wise to stock up on healing supplies before you go.
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_dog.v3: Barkley seems to be scared of something. Perhaps the monsters in this area look too tough?
messages.SWAP_PARTNER_MEREDITH1: Oh, are we travelling again so soon?
messages.PARTNER_LEVELUP_FELIX1: I’ve been training in monster form recently. I gotta catch up to you, after all.
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART1_KAYLEIGH5: I’ll explain in just a moment!
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART1_KAYLEIGH8: There was some kind of quake or monster activity last night – You can see the cracks in the ground.
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART1_KAYLEIGH6: Glad to hear you’re up to the task!
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART1_KAYLEIGH7: Do you see that path there?
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART1_KAYLEIGH9: We’re gonna check the path and make sure it’s safe for crossing.
messages.CLEMENCE_CAFE2: The town had a Gramophone, an old machine for playing musical records. So I took this machine and I made it the centerpiece of this new establishment. But the people, they cried out to me, “Clémence! You have a Gramophone but no music!”
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH33: B-but you’ll be OK! There’s community in Harbourtown, and we help each other out.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH35: A-and it’s safe! Well, apart from the monsters…
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH35_OPTION1: Like the one we fought before?
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART1_KAYLEIGH10: Here, take the key to the gate.
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH1.m: Right, uh, there’s some basics I gotta show you first. I hope you’re ready to turn into a monster again!
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH1.f: Right, uh, there’s some basics I gotta show you first. I hope you’re ready to turn into a monster again!
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH1.n: Right, uh, there’s some basics I gotta show you first. I hope you’re ready to turn into a monster again!
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH2: You’ll adjust in no time – [pause]It’s like riding a bike!
messages.CLEMENCE_COFFEE2: It is a good arrangement, oui?
messages.CLEMENCE_METAL_TAPES2: Ranger Wilma came from the Town Hall to provide my establishment with new stock.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH2: Traffikrabs don’t take kindly to strangers. [pause]Or anyone, [pause]for that matter.
messages.CLEMENCE_METAL_TAPES3: These Chrome Tapes are more effective than the basic ones. Interesting, non?
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_meredith.v3: The monsters here are, uh, scarier than we are. Maybe we should come back here another time, [pause]mate.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH30: It’s not… [pause]strictly on Earth. At least that’s what we think.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3_KAYLEIGH18: We’re all from different worlds, after all.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3B_KAYLEIGH17: Oh! Sorry, [pause]I’m making some assumptions there!
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3B_KAYLEIGH19: You might not know what movies are!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE1.f: Are you new here on the island? [pause]The look on your face gives it away!
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3B_KAYLEIGH20: Phew, [pause]OK, [pause]grand! I’ve been in New Wirral for three years and I’ve still not completely learned to adjust my... [pause]cultural references when I talk to new folks.
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART4_KAYLEIGH1: Some monster forms give us…. extra abilities when we record them, beyond just being able to take their shapes.
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART4_KAYLEIGH3: Sorry, I should probably have warned you, but I thought it might be a little easier to show you.
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART4_KAYLEIGH4: We can use this glide to get across that gap right there.
messages.TUTORIAL3_PART1_KAYLEIGH1: What’s going on? If this is because of monster activity, we better stay sharp.
messages.GAME_OVER_EUGENE1.n: ... And they’re up! C’mon {player}, let’s go.
messages.GAME_OVER_EUGENE1.f: ... And she’s up! C’mon {player}, let’s go.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_4_DIALOGUE3: But it [wave amp=30 freq=10]does[/wave] work. [pause]So just go along with it.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_5_DIALOGUE1: Are you a recent arrival? [pause]I’ve been here 20 years.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_5_DIALOGUE2: Eventually the novelty and strangeness of it all will just become a part of everyday life.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_5_DIALOGUE3: Why, [pause]I barely even [wave amp=30 freq=10]think[/wave] about the fact that I live on an island populated by giant monsters.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_6_DIALOGUE1: There’s enough food to go round in Harbourtown, but options are limited.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_6_DIALOGUE2: I haven’t had a duck roll in forever…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_7_DIALOGUE1: Life in Harbourtown is peaceful, [pause]but I miss city life…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_7_DIALOGUE2: Commuting on hot trains, [pause]buying expensive lunch from a supermarket, [pause]losing most of my wages to rent…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_8_DIALOGUE1: Huff… [pause]Huff… [pause][pause]I need to get faster if I want to be able to outrun those crab monsters…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_8_DIALOGUE2: Huff… [pause]Huff… [pause][pause]My best lap speed won’t be enough to outrun those bullet monsters…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_8_DIALOGUE4: Huff… [pause]Huff… [pause][pause]I’ll have to be faster than this if I want to outrun those masked snake beasts…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_8_DIALOGUE3: Huff… [pause]Huff… [pause][pause]I’ll need to improve my cardio if I want to avoid those boot-wearing imps…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_9_DIALOGUE1: I’d love to say that I make all the clothes in Harbourtown, [pause]but…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_8_DIALOGUE5: Huff… [pause]Huff… [pause][pause]I’ll have to be faster than this if I want to outpace those giant moth creatures…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_8_DIALOGUE6: You know… [pause]I think I’m improving at long-distance running. [pause]Hard work is paying off!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_12_DIALOGUE2: Well… [pause]I suppose there’d be no-one to play against. [pause]I don’t think the giant crabs on the beach have a competitive spirit.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_PLATONIC_1: Kayleigh engages you with an enthusiastic discussion on your favourite dog breeds.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_PLATONIC_2: You and Kayleigh casually discuss the mysteries of New Wirral.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_PLATONIC_3: Kayleigh tells you a funny anecdote about her life.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO1_KAYLEIGH1: I have a question for you, {player}. [pause]It’s a big one.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_PLATONIC_4: Kayleigh tells you about her various ventures helping out the people of Harbourtown.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_PLATONIC_5: The two of you have fun throwing twigs into the campfire.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO1_KAYLEIGH3: Are you… [pause][pause][pause]a dog person or a cat person?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO1_DOG_KAYLEIGH3: I do a lot of walking these days, so a dog would fit that nicely, don’t you think?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO7_KAYLEIGH2: Sometimes I think people mistake feeling “excited” for feeling “happy”.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO1_DOG_KAYLEIGH2: If I get to go back to my world, I think I’d want to adopt a dog.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO1_CAT_KAYLEIGH2: Maybe that means you’re someone who values independence and personal space…
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO1_CAT_KAYLEIGH3: Though it could also just mean you think they’re much cuter.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO1_FERRET_KAYLEIGH1: A ferret, aye? [pause]The choice of the fence-sitter!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO1_FERRET_KAYLEIGH2: It’s too small to be a dog, [pause]yet too pointy to be a cat…
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO1_FERRET_KAYLEIGH3: A real curveball of an answer, but I’ll accept it!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO3_KAYLEIGH1: Do you think… New Wirral can physically change us?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO2_KAYLEIGH2: I think I actually prefer the smell of coffee to the taste.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO2_KAYLEIGH3: Don’t get me wrong, I think coffee is brilliant!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO2_KAYLEIGH4: But the smell always implies something so much greater…
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO3_KAYLEIGH4: My body in New Wirral is not the same as it was in my “previous life”.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO3_KAYLEIGH3: It’s difficult for me to put it into words…
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO3_KAYLEIGH5: It’s like this is how I appear in my own dreams, like how I picture myself.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO4_KAYLEIGH2: Though in my experience, the chances of them spelling it correct were very low.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO3_KAYLEIGH7: I don’t know what will happen when I go back, [pause]either...
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO4_KAYLEIGH1: I do kinda miss the cafés where they’d write your name on a cup.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO4_KAYLEIGH3: I’d mostly end up with some variation of “Kay-lee”.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO5_KAYLEIGH1.f: Spending time in the great outdoors with my cute girlfriend...
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO4_KAYLEIGH5: That said, Cleménce makes a far better coffee than any chain store. [pause]I’m not sure I’ll be able to easily go back to regular coffee if I ever get to go back home.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO4_KAYLEIGH4: Once I got “Carol”. [pause][pause]That was way off the mark.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH9: Just breathe! You’ll adjust in just a moment!
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH11: You handled yourself pretty well there…. Uh, what’s your name?
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH12: I’m Kayleigh. Nice to make your acquaintance, {player}!
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH13: Anyway,[pause] we should probably get you warmed up before you freeze to death in your pyjamas.
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_viola.v1: We would be wise to leave this place – beasts of greater strength than us dwell here.
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_eugene.v1: This area looks pretty dangerous. Maybe we should retreat for now...
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_eugene.v3: I don’t know, man – the monsters here seem too tough for us right now...
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_kayleigh.v1: The monsters around here might be too tough for us… Maybe we should turn back.
messages.CLEMENCE_MENU_DIALOGUE: Bonjour! What can I do for you?
messages.CLEMENCE_INTRO3: Please, feel free to ask me any questions. I am in no rush.
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_felix.v3: I’m generally pretty confident in our chances, but I think this place might be too dangerous for us right now.
messages.INTRO_PENSBY43: My clinic is nearby. If you need a checkup, feel free to visit.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH42: We can talk more then, if you’d like!
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH41: Sorry, sorry, I’m infodumping! I’ll catch you soon, right?
messages.CLEMENCE_CAFE3: Well, one day the rangers find a place, it is filled with intact records. So they bring them to me. They lamented, “we have the records, but they are made for modern record players – our Gramophone cannot play them!”
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART1_KAYLEIGH1.m: Do you need a break, {player}? We can rest here if you’d like.
messages.TUTORIAL1_PASSIVE_KAYLEIGH1.m: There’ll be more monsters about, but we can take them!
messages.TUTORIAL1_PASSIVE_KAYLEIGH1.f: There’ll be more monsters about, but we can take them!
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART1_KAYLEIGH2.m: These bonfire pits mark areas you’re safe to set up camp.
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART1_KAYLEIGH3: It gives you a chance to repair your tapes and heal up!
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART1_KAYLEIGH2.f: These bonfire pits mark areas you’re safe to set up camp.
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART1_KAYLEIGH1.n: Do you need a break, {player}? We can rest here if you’d like.
messages.GAME_OVER_FIRST_PENSBY2: Why don’t you take these with you?
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_felix.v2: Maybe we should come back here later when we’re stronger. Just a thought.
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_felix.v1: I have a hunch that the monsters here are much stronger than us...
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH11.m: If both of us lose all our health then we’ll have to retreat back to Harbourtown.
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH11.n: If both of us lose all our health then we’ll have to retreat back to Harbourtown.
messages.TUTORIAL1_PASSIVE_KAYLEIGH1.n: There’ll be more monsters about, but we can take them!
messages.TUTORIAL2_PART1_KAYLEIGH1.f: Do you need a break, {player}? We can rest here if you’d like.
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH15: Hmm, that elevator should be functioning – there’ll be a switch around here to turn it back on.
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH16: Great! Let’s head on up, shall we? I’ll let you take the lead for any more fights, but don’t worry, I’ll be sticking with you from here on out!
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_viola.v3: The beasts that reside here pose some threat to us – perhaps we would be wise to depart from these lands?
messages.CLEMENCE_INTRO1.n: Bonjour! [pause]It is not too often we get a new face in here – especially not one as handsome as your own!
messages.PARTNER_LEVELUP_VIOLA1: You may find yourself newly impressed at my battle mastery: I have been privately honing my skills as of late.
messages.GAME_OVER_FIRST_PENSBY1.n: Ah, you’re awake. You’re lucky you had a friend to get you back to my clinic in one piece!
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH7: This might get a little weird, but follow my lead!
messages.CLEMENCE_COFFEE1: I have a… Special method. And the Pipers grow me coffee beans on their farm.
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_dog.v1: Barkley looks nervous. Perhaps the monsters in this area are too tough for him...
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_meredith.v2: The monsters here look stronger than us. [pause]Maybe we should turn back, mate.
messages.PARTNER_LEVELUP_DOG1: The glint in his eye suggests that Barkley has been training recently.
messages.PARTNER_LEVELUP_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I’ve been training on my own… let me show you how tough I’m getting, {player}![/wave]
messages.CLEMENCE_CAFE1: Oui. When I arrived in Harbourtown, the people here were crying out for a place to socialise, a place that must be stylish. I made that place – if not me, who else?
messages.RANGER_TRADER_NOT_JOINED2: She’ll be at the outpost in the park. If you go north from the Outskirts you won’t miss it!
messages.RANGER_TRADER_NOT_JOINED1.f: Hello sweetie, if you’re here to sign up with the rangers, you just missed Ianthe.
messages.RANGER_TRADER_JUST_JOINED1.m: Hello sweetie, I see you’ve got a brand new Trainee ID there. Let me explain how I can help!
messages.RANGER_TRADER_JUST_JOINED1.f: Hello sweetie, I see you’ve got a brand new Trainee ID there. Let me explain how I can help!
messages.RANGER_TRADER_JUST_JOINED2: I’m here to help distribute the organisation’s resources to rangers and trainees – to help them with their duties. I’ve got upgrades for backpacks and cassette players, passes for special training sessions...
messages.RANGER_TRADER_JUST_JOINED1.n: Hello sweetie, I see you’ve got a brand new Trainee ID there. Let me explain how I can help!
messages.RANGER_TRADER_JUST_JOINED3: But we only have limited quantities of these, so I have to make sure they don’t go to waste.
messages.RANGER_TRADER_JUST_JOINED4.f: In short, sweetie, the more captains you’ve completed your training with, the more I can give you. Oh, and I’ll need a bit of Fused Material from you as well.
messages.RANGER_TRADER_JUST_JOINED4.m: In short, sweetie, the more captains you’ve completed your training with, the more I can give you. Oh, and I’ll need a bit of Fused Material from you as well.
messages.RANGER_TRADER_MENU_ALT.n: Now, what are you after sweetie?
messages.RANGER_TRADER_MENU_ALT.m: Now, what are you after sweetie?
messages.RANGER_TRADER_MENU_HELLO.n: Hello sweetie, what are you after?
messages.RANGER_TRADER_JUST_JOINED4.n: In short, sweetie, the more captains you’ve completed your training with, the more I can give you. Oh, and I’ll need a bit of Fused Material from you as well.
messages.RANGER_TRADER_MENU_HELLO.f: Hello sweetie, what are you after?
messages.RANGER_TRADER_MENU_ALT.f: Now, what are you after sweetie?
messages.RANGER_TRADER_MENU_HELLO.m: Hello sweetie, what are you after?
messages.RANGER_TRADER_FUSED_MATERIAL1: Fused Material? I don’t really know what it is, but for some reason Ianthe seems to think we need to collect a lot of it.
messages.RANGER_TRADER_FUSED_MATERIAL2.m: All I know is that it smells really bad, and certain monsters leave it behind. Make of that what you will, dear!
messages.RANGER_TRADER_FUSED_MATERIAL2.n: All I know is that it smells really bad, and certain monsters leave it behind. Make of that what you will, dear!
messages.RANGER_TRADER_FUSED_MATERIAL2.f: All I know is that it smells really bad, and certain monsters leave it behind. Make of that what you will, dear!
messages.RANGER_TRADER_TRAINING_COMPLETE.f: Hello sweetie! Now you’re a full-time ranger I can let you have some really special items...[pause] Take a look!
messages.RANGER_TRADER_TRAINING_COMPLETE.n: Hello sweetie! Now you’re a full-time ranger I can let you have some really special items...[pause] Take a look!
messages.RANGER_TRADER_TRAINING_COMPLETE.m: Hello sweetie! Now you’re a full-time ranger I can let you have some really special items...[pause] Take a look!
messages.KAYLEIGH_STATION_REACTION1: Is this… [pause]a train station? It should be OK to take a look around, right?
messages.INTERDIMENSIONAL_POST_INTRO1: Hey there! Would you happen to be “{recipient}”?
messages.INTERDIMENSIONAL_POST_INTRO2: Don’t worry, I’m just here to deliver an interdimensional message. [pause]Everything will go back to normal when you wake up.
messages.INTERDIMENSIONAL_POST_REINTRO2: This one is addressed to “{recipient}”. That is you, right?
messages.INTERDIMENSIONAL_POST_REINTRO1: Hello again! I have another message for you here.
messages.INTERDIMENSIONAL_POST_NO_SENDER: This message doesn’t specify a sender. A secret admirer, perhaps?
messages.INTERDIMENSIONAL_POST_SENDER: This message was sent by a certain “{sender}”.
messages.INTERDIMENSIONAL_POST_BODY1: I’ll read it out to you.
messages.INTERDIMENSIONAL_POST_BYE1: That’s all. I hope that it made some sense to you.
messages.INTERDIMENSIONAL_POST_ITEMS: There’s a small package attached. Here you go!
messages.INTERDIMENSIONAL_POST_BODY_EMPTY: Oh, there doesn’t seem to be any text in this message...
messages.INTERDIMENSIONAL_POST_BYE2: You wouldn’t believe how many people I visit think they’re going crazy.
messages.POSTBOX_INTERACT1: It’s a letter box![pause] How strange that it’s indoors where nobody can deliver letters...
messages.POSTBOX_INTERACT2: Check it anyway? This will connect to the Internet.
messages.POSTBOX_KEYPAD: There’s a keypad at the back though... Will you enter a code?
messages.POSTBOX_MESSAGE_FOUND_SENDER: There’s a message for you from {sender}!
messages.PLANTER_INTERACT1: Plant a sapling here with the Gardening Kit?
messages.PLANTER_NO_QUEST: It’s a box planter! Nothing has been planted here yet.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_KAYLEIGH10.f: We’re gonna fight this thing and we’re gonna do it TOGETHER!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_KAYLEIGH10.n: We’re gonna fight this thing and we’re gonna do it TOGETHER!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_MORGANTE12: ENOUGH. MY TIME IS DRAWING TO AN END.\n\nWHY HAVE YOU COME TO THIS WRETCHED PLACE?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_MORGANTE12_OPTION2: I want a way off this island!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_MORGANTE14: I REQUIRE A VESSEL AND YOU REQUIRE A GUIDE.\n\nREBUILD MY STRENGTH AND IN TURN I SHALL LEAD YOU FROM THIS LAND.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH36: Yeah! I’m actually going on a patrol soon.
messages.INTRO_KAYLEIGH38: In the meantime, feel free to say hi to your new neighbours!
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH5: You see that creep with the boots? It’s a Springheel – and it’s gonna get aggressive with you if you get any closer.
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH6: So you’re gonna get closer, of course!
messages.TUTORIAL1_PART2_KAYLEIGH7: You’ve taken a bit of a beating – but your monster form can take it!
messages.STICKER_MERCHANT_NOTE1: The merchant who runs this stall has left a note.
messages.STICKER_MERCHANT_NOTE2: “I’ve gone to the cave in the park to find some inspiration. If I’m not back by noon, send help!”
messages.CAPTAIN_LODESTEIN_FIXING_ELEVATOR.f: Sorry, bud. [pause]You’ll have to come back later to use the elevator – I’m doing a few long overdue repairs.
messages.CAPTAIN_LODESTEIN_FIXING_ELEVATOR.m: Sorry, bud. [pause]You’ll have to come back later to use the elevator – I’m doing a few long overdue repairs.
messages.CAPTAIN_LODESTEIN_FIXING_ELEVATOR.n: Sorry, bud. [pause]You’ll have to come back later to use the elevator – I’m doing a few long overdue repairs.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE1.m: Are you new here on the island? [pause]The look on your face gives it away!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE5: Are you adjusting to life here? [pause]It took me… [pause] a long time to come to accept my circumstances when I first landed here.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE1.n: Are you new here on the island? [pause]The look on your face gives it away!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE2.m: Oh, [pause]right, you’re the newbie! [pause]Nice to see you again!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE3: Nice to see you again! [pause]How are you finding Harbourtown?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE2.n: Oh, [pause]right, you’re the newbie! [pause]Nice to see you again!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE2.f: Oh, [pause]right, you’re the newbie! [pause]Nice to see you again!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE6: Hey again! [pause]How are you finding the island? [pause]The people here try their best. I know it can feel lonely.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE4.f: Hey again, newbie. [pause]I hope you’re settling in OK.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE4.m: Hey again, newbie. [pause]I hope you’re settling in OK.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE4.n: Hey again, newbie. [pause]I hope you’re settling in OK.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE8: Hey! [pause]It’s me again, looking out across the “Mire Sea” as usual. [pause]There’s something about it that is soothing, I guess.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE7: Sometimes life throws something unexpected at you. [pause]Sometimes that unexpected thing is… [pause]well… [pause]all this.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_18_DIALOGUE1: My great-grandfather was one of the sailors who was shipwrecked on New Wirral over a hundred years ago!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_18_DIALOGUE2: I am sure he’d be proud to see what we’ve made of this place.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_19_DIALOGUE: If you ever get stuck, try asking around town. Sometimes a good rumour will put you back on the right path!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_20_DIALOGUE2: Man, I miss the weapons the Rangers used to fight with.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_20_DIALOGUE1: I know that transforming is way more effective in battle, but...
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_20_DIALOGUE3: Ianthe’s mechanical gear sword was, like, the most steampunk thing I’ve ever seen.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_24_DIALOGUE1: For 101 years this town has stood. Did you know that?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_21_DIALOGUE1: Have you been to the west side of Harbourtown yet?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_25_DIALOGUE1.m: Are you an offworlder? I haven’t seen you around before!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_22_DIALOGUE1: We [wave amp=30 freq=10]usually[/wave] cook food for the townsfolk here, but we haven’t received ingredients from the farm west of here for a while. I wonder what’s going on?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_21_DIALOGUE2: I’ve been meaning to visit the Heritage Center over there.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_23_DIALOGUE1: There’s no time to chat – I have an order of pastries to finish preparing!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_22_DIALOGUE2: The bridge to the farm has been lowered, so we’re able to receive fresh produce once again! That’s fortunate.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_24_DIALOGUE2: I remember what this place looked like as a little girl. The town changes so much, so fast…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_24_DIALOGUE3: But the foundations, [pause]they have always stayed the same.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_25_DIALOGUE1.n: Are you an offworlder? I haven’t seen you around before!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_25_DIALOGUE1.f: Are you an offworlder? I haven’t seen you around before!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_26_DIALOGUE1: Do you listen to [wave amp=30 freq=10]Radio Cybil[/wave]? I tune in every day – I’m her sixth biggest fan!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_29_DIALOGUE1: With all the free time I’ve had being stuck on this island, I’ve been able to work on my social skills… like talking to strangers such as yourself!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_30_DIALOGUE1: Is it true that one of the Rangers knows how to [wave amp=30 freq=10]hack[/wave] their monster tapes? I refuse to believe such a thing is possible!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_28_DIALOGUE1: I really want to go for a stroll in New Wirral Park, but I’m put off by the [wave amp=30 freq=10]local wildlife[/wave].
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE9: Sometimes I hope to see a ship sailing over the horizon, coming to rescue us. [pause]But I’ve been here a while now… I don’t think any rescue is coming.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_1_DIALOGUE10: Hey again! [pause]I hope you’re doing OK!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE1: I bet you’d never expect to see someone as famous as [wave amp=30 freq=10]me[/wave] here, [pause]did you? [pause][pause]Wait, don’t you recognise me…?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE4: Danny Kicks? [pause]I played sax in one of the most famous bands on earth? [pause]Are you sure that doesn’t ring a bell?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE2: Are you [shake rate=30 level=10]sure[/shake] you don’t recognise me? [pause]Not even a little bit?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE3: Come mate, you MUST know who I am. [pause]I’m Danny Kicks! [pause]Just picture me with a saxophone… [pause]still nothing?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE5: Me and the boys from Liverpool? [pause]”While my sax gently weeps”? [pause]I [shake rate=30 level=10]wrote[/shake] that song, you know!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE7.m: I guess you don’t recognise me, huh? [pause]Nevermind then, mate. [pause]It’s not the first time.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE6: You [wave amp=30 freq=10]must[/wave] have seen me and the lads on the telly singing on that rooftop. [pause]...You do believe me, right?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE8: Y’know, [pause]I don’t think a single person here has recognised me. [pause]Some of them even think I’m making it all up!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE7.n: I guess you don’t recognise me, huh? [pause]Nevermind then, mate. [pause]It’s not the first time.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE9.n: Y-you believe me, right, [pause]mate? [pause]Maybe I wasn’t famous on your world, but if you came from where I’m from, I’m sure you’d be my [wave amp=30 freq=10]biggest fan![/wave]
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE7.f: I guess you don’t recognise me, huh? [pause]Nevermind then, mate. [pause]It’s not the first time.
messages.PENSBY_INTERACT_CHECKUP_HEALTHY2: Was there something else you wanted?
messages.PENSBY_INTERACT_CHECKUP_HURT1: Let me take a look at you…
messages.PENSBY_INTERACT_CHECKUP_HURT3: I’m going to prescribe you some rest.[pause] Why don’t you head over to the Gramophone café and take it easy for a bit?
messages.PENSBY_INTERACT_CHECKUP_HURT2: It’s just a few bumps and scratches. Nothing serious.
messages.PENSBY_INTERACT_BYE: Try not to get yourself hurt too badly out there, OK?
messages.HERITAGE_CENTER_SIGN: “Harbourtown Heritage Center: Charting the history of our unlikely community”
messages.HERITAGE_CENTER_1: YEAR 001: The British naval vessel HMS Birkenhead sinks in a storm in the Earth year 1845. Much of the crew and wreckage wash ashore on an unknown island, later christened New Wirral.
messages.HERITAGE_CENTER_3: YEAR 006: The first child is born on New Wirral. The first attempt to leave New Wirral ends in disaster – a vessel built on the island is sunk by storms a mile from the coast.
messages.HERITAGE_CENTER_2: YEAR 002: New arrivals appear for the first time. Harbourtown is officially founded. The first recorded encounter with an unknown native creature, or “monster”, occurs.
messages.HERITAGE_CENTER_5: YEAR 050: Upon the 48th anniversary of its formation, Harbourtown dissolves its previously established mayoral position and becomes managed by a committee.
messages.HERITAGE_CENTER_4: YEAR 048: Following the arrival of multiple engineers, the first electrical grid is built in Harbourtown.
messages.HERITAGE_CENTER_6: YEAR 062: An attempt to form a second town, named “New London”, begin on New Wirral.
messages.HERITAGE_CENTER_8: YEAR 091: “Falldown Mall” is discovered, bringing a large supply of Earth goods to New Wirral. The phenomenon of “monster recording” is discovered for the first time.
messages.HERITAGE_CENTER_7: YEAR 089: After a terrible disaster, New London is destroyed. Only one resident survived, and was able to return to Harbourtown.
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-2_GIFTER_DIALOGUE1: Have you seen these red caches about? Us rangers leave supplies in them for each other when traversing the island.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_DIALOGUE3: Sshh! I’m invisible! Pretend I'm not here!
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-2_GIFTER_DIALOGUE2: In fact, I was just about to place something in this one – why don’t you take it instead?
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-2_GIFTER_AFTER_DIALOGUE: Respools can be used to repair broken tapes without having to rest. Pretty useful!
messages.TRAVELING_MERCHANT_INTRO2: Nope, I’m certain I’d remember a face like yours.
messages.TRAVELING_MERCHANT_INTRO4: Don’t let my lack of a shirt discomfort you - I traded it to a young woman who gave it to a bear a while back. Let no one tell you I ain’t dedicated to the cause of distribution!
messages.TRAVELING_MERCHANT_INTRO3: Well, if you’re looking for cheap goods, I’m your man! But I don’t like to stick around in places for very long.
messages.TRAVELING_MERCHANT_PRE_TRADE: Take a look at my catalog, why don’t you?
messages.TRAVELING_MERCHANT_POST_TRADE1: Hoo boy, the lack of money in these parts sure makes things difficult.
messages.OUTSKIRTS_3_-1_GIFTER1.n: I haven’t seen you around before. Let me guess – you washed up pretty recently, didn’t you?
messages.NWP_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]The value of property near the park is sky high![/wave]
messages.OUTSKIRTS_3_-1_GIFTER3: You can use those to rewind any monster tapes you have on the go. Stay safe out there, OK?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_MERCHANT_4.m: Thanks for stopping by! Come back tomorrow and I’ll have some brand new ones in store!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_MERCHANT_3: I’ve been designing some new support stickers! Do you wanna see what I’ve got?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_MERCHANT_2: Pleasure doin’ business! Come back tomorrow and I’ll have new stickers in stock!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_MERCHANT_1: Are you lookin’ for some new sticker to give your monster forms the upper hand in a fight? Look no further!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_MERCHANT_4.f: Thanks for stopping by! Come back tomorrow and I’ll have some brand new ones in store!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_MERCHANT_5.m: Don’t underestimate passive moves, my friend! Here, take a look at my sticker selection for the day!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_MERCHANT_5.n: Don’t underestimate passive moves, my friend! Here, take a look at my sticker selection for the day!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_MERCHANT_5.f: Don’t underestimate passive moves, my friend! Here, take a look at my sticker selection for the day!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_MERCHANT_6: Come back tomorrow and I’ll have some fresh new stickers!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_12_DIALOGUE9: I might be here forever, but at least things are never [wave amp=30 freq=10]boring[/wave].
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_13_DIALOGUE1: I was hoping to cross the bridge, but it’s been raised for a while now.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_13_DIALOGUE2: That’s fine… [pause]I can stay on this side of town, [pause]I guess.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_14_DIALOGUE1: You know… [pause]I worked so hard to move out of my home town. [pause]I really mean it.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_13_DIALOGUE4: I could cross it, [pause]but I have grown fond of just standing here instead.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_14_DIALOGUE2: I was ready for the next part of my life, [pause]only to get stuck in [wave amp=30 freq=10]another[/wave] small town.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_14_DIALOGUE3: I suppose this is just what fate wanted for me, [pause]huh?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_15_DIALOGUE1: Harbourtown has always had some sort of “community volunteer” group. [pause]How else would it have stayed in one piece so long?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_15_DIALOGUE2: Ianthe’s rangers are the latest iteration of it. [pause]Gathering resources, assisting people’s concerns, we do the whole list.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_15_DIALOGUE3: Keeping things in order has gotten even tougher since the discovery of the “cassette tape” phenomenon. [pause]But if anyone can do it, Ianthe can!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_16_DIALOGUE1: A lot of newcomers in town go through… [pause]a difficult period.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_16_DIALOGUE2: If I had any advice for you, [pause]it would be to embrace your new life here.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_16_DIALOGUE3.n: That doesn’t mean you should also forget the life you used to have, though. [pause]You’re as much your past as you are your future, [pause]y’know?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_16_DIALOGUE3.f: That doesn’t mean you should also forget the life you used to have, though. [pause]You’re as much your past as you are your future, [pause]y’know?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_17_DIALOGUE2: It’s important to look back on our history here if we want to see what our future needs of us.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_17_DIALOGUE1: Harbourtown has a more interesting history than you’d think!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_16_DIALOGUE3.m: That doesn’t mean you should also forget the life you used to have, though. [pause]You’re as much your past as you are your future, [pause]y’know?
messages.TUTORIAL3_PART2_KAYLEIGH1: OK, you felt that one, right?
messages.TUTORIAL3_PART2_KAYLEIGH4: I’ve never seen ANYTHING like this before!
messages.TUTORIAL3_PART2_KAYLEIGH5: Has this always been buried here?!
messages.CLEMENCE_INTRO2: I am Clémence, and this fine establishment is the Gramophone Café. What can I say? I own many records, and I brew the best coffee. Not that there is much competition.
messages.CLEMENCE_INTRO1.f: Bonjour! [pause]It is not too often we get a new face in here – especially not one as pretty as your own!
messages.CLEMENCE_INTRO1.m: Bonjour! [pause]It is not too often we get a new face in here – especially not one as handsome as your own!
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3B_KAYLEIGH11: They’ve had a bunch of names over the years – angels, demons, devils, ghouls…
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3B_KAYLEIGH14: We don’t know what they are. No one has really seen one for a long time.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3B_KAYLEIGH13: Those other creatures, though… [pause]Like the one we fought... [pause]They’re still Archangels to us.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3B_KAYLEIGH16: It felt like I wasn’t viewing it correctly – like trying to watch a movie through binoculars or something…
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3B_KAYLEIGH15: Looking at that thing we fought… It’s hard to explain…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_MORGANTE13: I SEE.\n\nTHERE IS A WAY. THERE ARE NONE WHO KNOW THE PATH BUT I.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_KAYLEIGH16: {player}, are you OK?! [pause]What happened?! [pause]You blanked out for a second there!
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3A_KAYLEIGH1: A [wave amp=30 freq=10]lot[/wave] happened at that train station… I guess we should probably talk about it.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_KAYLEIGH17: We should get out of here…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_32_DIALOGUE1: If there’s [wave amp=30 freq=10]anything[/wave] that’s in abundance here on New Wirral, it’s coffee. [pause]Coffee and brightly coloured creatures.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_31_DIALOGUE1: I’m currently in training to become a Ranger trainee. It’s like a job application, except with way more fighting.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_33_DIALOGUE1: Local legend says that there’s the ruins of a pier you can see just on the horizon of the Mire Sea… not that I’ve ever been able to see it, of course.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOK_2: The scribbled notes say: “...if given a toy, this elven monster will not stray from its path. Without one, it will eventually be consumed by rage.”
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOK_3: The scribbled notes say: “...this great masked snake can take a third path, if allowed to harness the zephyrs of wind.”
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOK_1: The scribbled notes say: “...this flying saucer creature will emerge from its shell if given the ability to remain close to its opponents.”
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOK_4: The scribbled notes say: “...the mysterious gears beneath this hill are the key to unlocking this dinosaur’s true potential.”
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOK_5: The scribbled notes say: “...I believe certain monsters will mature into different forms depending on whether it is day or night.”
messages.HARBOURTOWN_CHEMIST1_OPENING: Elemental chemistry is the key to success in combat.[pause] I design stickers that give you control of chemistry, and the advantage in battle!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_CHEMIST1_CLOSING: I’ll be right here if you need me.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_CHEMIST2_OPENING: I specialise in stickers that change type with the user – very handy if you’re also using my colleague’s coatings. And they’re all compatible with every tape to boot!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_ITEM_RECYCLER1: Do you recycle items you don’t need any more?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_TAPE_RECYCLER3: At a campsite, or in the cafe, open your tape storage, select a tape you don’t want, and then hit recycle!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_ITEM_RECYCLER4: Here, give it a go with this old book. I don’t need it any more.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_ITEM_RECYCLER2: Not only is it a good way to de-clutter your inventory, but it also gives back some of the resources that went into making the item.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_ITEM_RECYCLER3: Then you can trade those resources with someone else for new items!
messages.GAME_OVER_FIRST_PENSBY1.f: Ah, you’re awake. You’re lucky you had a friend to get you back to my clinic in one piece!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_TAPE_RECYCLER1: Holding onto any old tapes in storage that you don’t need any more?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_TAPE_RECYCLER2: Next time you’re taking a break from your travels, why not recycle one?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_TAPE_RECYCLER4: It’s a good way to get some extra resources that you can trade with merchants, and it can net you some extra stickers from that monster’s pool.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOTLEG_NPC1: Don’t worry about the Traffikrab, that’s just my son. He loves playing with his bootleg tape.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOTLEG_NPC2: Yeah.[pause] Have you ever seen a monster in your travels that isn’t its normal colour? That’s a bootleg.[pause] But don’t confuse it with a coating!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOTLEG_NPC3: Bootleg monsters [wave amp=30 freq=10]permanently[/wave] have different colours, different elemental types, and different moves from usual.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOTLEG_NPC4: And when you record them, they keep those attributes.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOTLEG_NPC6: Here, why don’t you take this and see for yourself. Captain Codey gives me his spares, so I have plenty already.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOTLEG_NPC5: Recorded bootlegs have a higher rate of producing uncommon and rare moves, so they can be very useful.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOTLEG_NPC7: Bootleg monsters can appear anywhere at random, but apparently they’re more often seen in fusions.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_BOOTLEG_NPC8: I’ve heard that some very rare bootleg monsters sparkle and shine like as if they’re covered in glitter.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_ASTROLOGER_NPC1: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Welcome, enquiring souls![/wave] Are you here to learn about the astral arts?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_ASTROLOGER_NPC3: Excellent… [pause]you would be wise to heed my words!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_ASTROLOGER_NPC4: You see, beasts of the astral type draw their power from the four basic elements of nature: [pause]earth, [pause]water, [pause]fire, [pause] and air.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_ASTROLOGER_NPC6: However, their internal harmony can be thrown into [wave amp=30 freq=10]disarray[/wave] by exposure to impure elements: plastic, poison and metal.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_ASTROLOGER_NPC5: An astral creature exposed to any of these four elements will be [wave amp=30 freq=10]empowered[/wave]!
messages.PENSBY_INTERACT_MENU: Hey {player}, what can I do for you?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_ASTROLOGER_NPC7: If you wish to take the form of an astral beast, remember this!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO19_KAYLEIGH4: Like I said after we first fought Morgante - we’re in this together, you and I!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO21_KAYLEIGH6: It takes some time getting used to how each monster form changes how your own body feels. It seems to me that you’re doing a cracking job at learning the ropes, though!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO20_KAYLEIGH2: Brilliant! [pause]You’re in luck then - New Wirral doesn’t exactly have any hotels, so you’ll probably be doing a lot of your sleeping in a tent.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO20_KAYLEIGH1_OPTIO: I’m more of an inside person…
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO20_KAYLEIGH3: That’s… [pause]unfortunate. You might have to get used to sleeping in a tent if you’re going to be exploring the island - New Wirral doesn't exactly have a local hotel franchise, or anything.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO21_KAYLEIGH1.f: Hey! I never asked you how you’re finding that first monster form I gave you back on the beach when we first met.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO21_KAYLEIGH1.m: Hey! I never asked you how you’re finding that first monster form I gave you back on the beach when we first met.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO21_KAYLEIGH1.n: Hey! I never asked you how you’re finding that first monster form I gave you back on the beach when we first met.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO21_KAYLEIGH2: It was “Candevil”, right? That’s a pretty fun monster form! When I’ve used it in the past, I felt like I was on a permanent sugar rush.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO21_KAYLEIGH4: It was “Bansheep”, right? That’s a pretty cute monster form! When I’ve used it in the past, I had to get used to the weird sensation of floating.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO21_KAYLEIGH3: I got the feeling that ranged attacks were more effective in that form. Maybe Candevils have a naturally good aim?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO21_KAYLEIGH5: But when I had those big hooves? I felt like I could smack monsters [wave amp=30 freq=10]pretty[/wave] well with those.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO22_KAYLEIGH2.m: We didn’t really defeat her alone, did we? Someone had already wounded her when we found her.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO22_KAYLEIGH2.n: We didn’t really defeat her alone, did we? Someone had already wounded her when we found her.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO22_KAYLEIGH2.f: We didn’t really defeat her alone, did we? Someone had already wounded her when we found her.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO22_KAYLEIGH3: Even in her weakened state, she seemed so dangerous. Whoever wounded her must have been absolutely [wave amp=30 freq=10]savage[/wave].
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO22_KAYLEIGH4: It makes me feel like us humans are [wave amp=30 freq=10]pretty[/wave] puny in comparison…
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_LANDKEEPER5: [wave amp=30 freq=5]We shall leave for now….[/wave]
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE1: ...Don’t make me tell you [shake rate=30 level=10]again[/shake]! [pause][pause]Harbourtown won’t fall to you [shake rate=30 level=10]blood suckers[/shake]!
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE3: Crawl back to the darkness you came from – [pause]or you’ll have to go through [shake rate=30 level=10]me[/shake]!
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE4: I’ve fought [shake rate=30 level=10]your kind[/shake] before and won. [pause]Do you want a demonstration?
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_LANDKEEPER6: [wave amp=30 freq=5]But in time you shall understand that we know what is best for you all.[/wave]
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE8: Let me know if those creeps bother you again, ma’am.
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE7: Tell the rest of your kind that this town is protected by [shake rate=30 level=10]Eugene![/shake]
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE9: And whatever you do, DON’T invite them into your house. [pause]That’s what they want.
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_WOMAN10: I will keep that in mind. Thank you for intervening, young man!
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE12: The name’s Eugene… [pause]Which I guess you know, [pause]‘cause I just yelled it at those guys.
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE11: Oh, hey. Sorry you had to see that.
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE13: Always nice to meet a new face around here, {player}.
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE14: I won’t trouble you with the details – [pause]but they don’t [wave amp=30 freq=10]belong[/wave] in this world.
messages.LEVEL_WARNING_dog.v2: Barkley is acting a bit sheepish. Perhaps the monsters nearby look too tough for him?
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE16: Anyway, I gotta go stake out those guys. [pause]I can’t risk them [shake rate=30 level=10]sinking their teeth[/shake] into the good people of Harbourtown.
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE15: Let’s just say that not all the monsters in New Wirral look like cereal mascots.
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_INITIAL_RANGER2: Y’see, I told Ianthe I’d put up a town sign here. [pause]Something that could make the place a little more cozy, [pause]y’know?
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE18: Meet me at this location. [pause]I’ll give you the full low-down when you’re there.
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE17.n: If you’re willing to get your hands dirty, I’d be glad to have you assist!
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE17.f: If you’re willing to get your hands dirty, I’d be glad to have you assist!
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE17.m: If you’re willing to get your hands dirty, I’d be glad to have you assist!
messages.EUGENE_INTRO_EUGENE19: Just… [pause]prepare yourself for a throwdown. [pause]Things might get kinda ugly.
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_INITIAL_RANGER1: Hey, [pause]any chance you could lend a hand?
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_INITIAL_RANGER3: Only I’ve miscalculated how much wood it would take. Any chance you could source me some spare wood? [pause]That would be a real lifesaver!
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_INITIAL_RANGER4: Really? Thanks! [pause]Come say hi when you’ve got the materials.
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_ACTIVE_RANGER1: Hey, again. Did you manage to find that wood?
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_ACTIVE_RANGER_NO: Don’t worry about it. I ain’t leaving here anytime soon.
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_COMPLETE_RANGER3: Hmm... [pause][pause]since you helped me out, [pause]why don’t you decide on the design?
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_COMPLETE_RANGER2: You did it! [pause]Thanks for your help – I was dreading the thought of collecting all those materials myself.
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_COMPLETE_RANGER4.m: The sign should feature an emblem that really sums up Harbourtown. [pause][pause]What do you think, [pause]bud?
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_COMPLETE_RANGER4.n: The sign should feature an emblem that really sums up Harbourtown. [pause][pause]What do you think, [pause]bud?
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_COMPLETE_RANGER4.f: The sign should feature an emblem that really sums up Harbourtown. [pause][pause]What do you think, [pause]bud?
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_COMPLETE_RANGER8: I’ve lived my whole life here, [pause]but a lot of folks come from different places and get stuck here.
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_COMPLETE_RANGER9: If this makes them feel even a little bit better when they see it, [pause]then it was worth the effort, [pause]I think.
messages.WORKING_OVERTIME_COMPLETE_VIOLA7: I can see that you have worked diligently on this piece.
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_INTRO: Hey there, champ. Are you here to work out?
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_NOT_JOINED1.m: And you’re not even a ranger?
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_NO_PASS1: Oh, this won’t do. Where’s your Gym Pass, champ?
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_NO_PASS2: Go get a Gym Pass from Wilma over there, and then I’ll give you a custom-targeted workout!
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_NOT_JOINED1.n: And you’re not even a ranger?
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_NOT_JOINED1.f: And you’re not even a ranger?
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_NOT_JOINED2: The first thing you’re gonna need to do, champ, is jog on over to the outpost in the park north of the Outskirts, and sign up.
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_EXPLANATION1: Sometimes it’s not enough just to be good at transforming – sometimes you need simply to be stronger!
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_EXPLANATION2: That’s where I come in. I can give you a custom workout designed to adjust the ‘base stats’ of your human form. That’ll affect the strength of your transformations too!
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_EXPLANATION4: And as you advance through your training with the rangers, you’ll no doubt find yourself with a few extra points to put towards these base stats.
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_EXPLANATION5.m: So what do you say, champ? Are you ready to work out?
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_EXPLANATION3: If you decide for instance that you need your melee attacks to hit harder, but don’t rely on ranged attacks much, we can move some points from Ranged Attack to Melee Attack to do just that.
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_EXPLANATION5.f: So what do you say, champ? Are you ready to work out?
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_AFTER_WORKOUT: Whew, what a workout! I can feel my muscles burning!
messages.RANGER_TRADER_NOT_JOINED1.m: Hello sweetie, if you’re here to sign up with the rangers, you just missed Ianthe.
messages.RANGER_TRADER_NOT_JOINED1.n: Hello sweetie, if you’re here to sign up with the rangers, you just missed Ianthe.
messages.RANGER_BODYBUILDER_EXPLANATION5.n: So what do you say, champ? Are you ready to work out?
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH3: In the right circumstances, two people in monster form are able to unite and form one [wave amp=30 freq=10]powerful being[/wave].
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH4: (I guess “the right circumstances” include nearly being killed by an [shake rate=30 level=10]Archangel[/shake]...)
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH5.m: It felt strange. In that moment, I was sharing a body with you, and the thing we [wave amp=30 freq=10]became[/wave] was both us and not us at the same time…
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH3: And she knows a way to leave New Wirral?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_MERCHANT_4.n: Thanks for stopping by! Come back tomorrow and I’ll have some brand new ones in store!
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH6: I-[pause]I’ve never fused with anyone before. I certainly wasn’t expecting to fuse with someone I [wave amp=30 freq=10]barely[/wave] know…
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH5.f: It felt strange. In that moment, I was sharing a body with you, and the thing we [wave amp=30 freq=10]became[/wave] was both us and not us at the same time…
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH5.n: It felt strange. In that moment, I was sharing a body with you, and the thing we [wave amp=30 freq=10]became[/wave] was both us and not us at the same time…
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH8_OPTION1.m: It helped us defeat the Archangel!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE9.m: Y-you believe me, right, [pause]mate? [pause]Maybe I wasn’t famous on your world, but if you came from where I’m from, I’m sure you’d be my [wave amp=30 freq=10]biggest fan![/wave]
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE10.n: How’s my [wave amp=30 freq=10]number one[/wave] fan doing today?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE9.f: Y-you believe me, right, [pause]mate? [pause]Maybe I wasn’t famous on your world, but if you came from where I’m from, I’m sure you’d be my [wave amp=30 freq=10]biggest fan![/wave]
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE10.f: How’s my [wave amp=30 freq=10]number one[/wave] fan doing today?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_2_DIALOGUE10.m: How’s my [wave amp=30 freq=10]number one[/wave] fan doing today?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_3_DIALOGUE4: Um, [pause]I think you might be mistaking me for someone else. [pause]I don’t believe we’re acquaintances.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_3_DIALOGUE8: It can be hard to make friends here. [pause]I don’t have much in common with, [pause]well, [pause]anyone. [pause]That’s just the nature of this place.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_3_DIALOGUE7: I’m sorry if I was rude to you previously. [pause]I get a little hesitant with strangers. [pause]But I don’t think we’re strangers to each other anymore, are we?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_3_DIALOGUE6: ...[pause]Hi again. [pause]It’s nice of you to come and see me.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_4_DIALOGUE1: You’re new to the whole “cassette tape transforming” thing, huh? [pause]A little piece of advice for you.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_4_DIALOGUE2: The key is not to think about how it works. [pause]By all accounts, it doesn’t make sense.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_NPC_3_DIALOGUE9: I, um, [pause]never asked you your name. [pause]{player}? [pause]I hope you’re having a nice day, {player}.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH25: What do you say? Are we in this together?
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH26: If an Archangel gave you that vision, then...
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH25_OPTION2: We don’t have any other option!
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH27.m: You need to find another one, and you need to be strong enough to stand against it when you do.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH28.m: The Rangers have a training programme that will help you become strong enough. Let’s begin by getting you a meeting with the Ranger Leader!
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH27.f: You need to find another one, and you need to be strong enough to stand against it when you do.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH27.n: You need to find another one, and you need to be strong enough to stand against it when you do.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH28.n: The Rangers have a training programme that will help you become strong enough. Let’s begin by getting you a meeting with the Ranger Leader!
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH28.f: The Rangers have a training programme that will help you become strong enough. Let’s begin by getting you a meeting with the Ranger Leader!
messages.OUTSKIRTS_3_-1_GIFTER1.m: I haven’t seen you around before. Let me guess – you washed up pretty recently, didn’t you?
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH29: She’ll be at the outpost in the park right about now.
messages.NWP_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Oof. The crime rate is also sky high…[/wave]
messages.OUTSKIRTS_3_-1_GIFTER2: Oh! Is that a cassette player you’re holding? Here, take these.
messages.OUTSKIRTS_3_-1_GIFTER1.f: I haven’t seen you around before. Let me guess – you washed up pretty recently, didn’t you?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_MORGANTE1: IS THAT YOU, MORDREAD?\n\nCOME CLOSER, CHILD... SO THAT I MAY SEE YOU ONE LAST TIME.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_KAYLEIGH2: {player}, can you feel something in the air..?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_KAYLEIGH1: This place smells like… Burning metal. I can’t explain it…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_MORGANTE2: THE LONG CONFLICT HAS DRAWN TO AN END… I AM AFRAID HE HAS DEFEATED ME TRULY THIS TIME.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_KAYLEIGH4: {player}, I think this is an [shake rate=30 level=10]Archangel[/shake]…
messages.HARBOURTOWN_STATION_KAYLEIGH5: We need to leave. [wave amp=30 freq=10]Now.[/wave]
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH7: It just kind of happened in the heat of the moment, right?
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH8_OPTION1.f: It helped us defeat the Archangel!
