messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH8: Sorry, [pause]talking about it is a little awkward!
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH8_OPTION1.n: It helped us defeat the Archangel!
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH8_OPTION2: We wouldn’t have survived without it!
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH10: Now that we’ve done it, I have this weird feeling inside me. Like… a door has been opened that I didn’t even know was there before.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH1: So let me get this straight…
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3C_KAYLEIGH11: I feel like I’d be able to fuse with you again, if we ever needed to.
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH2: That Archangel, “Morgante”, her memory is [wave amp=30 freq=10]inside[/wave] you now…?
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH23: We owe it to everyone on New Wirral to find out!
messages.TUTORIAL4_PART3D_KAYLEIGH22: If there is even a chance that this can lead to a way off this island and return people to their homes and their families…
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO12_KAYLEIGH4: You and Meredith get on well, though. I can totally see you two together.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO13_KAYLEIGH1: If that gateway [wave amp=30 freq=10]does[/wave] take us back to our old worlds, will we all have to say goodbye?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO20_KAYLEIGH1: So tell me - how do you feel about sleeping in the [wave amp=30 freq=10]great outdoors[/wave]?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO13_KAYLEIGH3: Fortunately, we still have stuff to do here on New Wirral. I’ll worry about all that later!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO13_KAYLEIGH4.f: We began this path together, so we’ll end it together. [pause]I’m not leaving ‘til you’re ready, {player}.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO14_KAYLEIGH2: I’m sure this news is gonna be a big deal to the rangers. They’re gonna have their work cut out for them!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO13_KAYLEIGH4.m: We began this path together, so we’ll end it together. [pause]I’m not leaving ‘til you’re ready, {player}.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO13_KAYLEIGH4.n: We began this path together, so we’ll end it together. [pause]I’m not leaving ‘til you’re ready, {player}.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO14_KAYLEIGH1: So I guess Ianthe knows about the gateway now, too!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO15_KAYLEIGH1: When we fought Aleph on the train… [pause]the force we summoned by fusing…
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO15_KAYLEIGH2: That looked kind of like Morgante, right? [pause]The first Archangel you and I fought together.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO15_KAYLEIGH3: I don’t quite fully understand it, but it felt like we embodied something that aligned with her goals in that moment. It wasn’t just us in that form - [wave amp=30 freq=10]she[/wave] fused with us as well.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO15_KAYLEIGH4: But then you had her essence within you since our first encounter with her already, didn’t you?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO15_KAYLEIGH5: She gave you the clues to find that gateway, and she helped us defeat Aleph. I wonder if that was her intention all along - using us to defeat him, I mean…
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO16_KAYLEIGH1: Hey, I forgot to ask! How are you feeling about taking on the [wave amp=30 freq=10]ranger training[/wave], {player}?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO16_KAYLEIGH2: Of course you are! You’ll do fine!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO19_KAYLEIGH1: I am glad we still get to still do our camping trips together, {player}.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO16_KAYLEIGH3: The rangers tailor their challenges to the strengths of each trainee - my training involved doing community work around town for each ranger captain.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO16_KAYLEIGH4: Your combat challenge seems… [pause]a little more intense than mine.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO17_KAYLEIGH1: The thing with the rangers is that each one has a special role they play in maintaining the town.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO17_KAYLEIGH2: Lodestein keeps the electrical grid running. Wallace maintains the buildings and walls. Zedd does… [pause]something.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO17_KAYLEIGH3: But these also reflect how they battle! Each of them has a unique tactic they’ll use.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO17_KAYLEIGH4: I’m sure you’ll be able to beat them, {player}!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO18_KAYLEIGH1: I think… if I do get to go back home, I’ll need to put all my ranger skills into action.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO18_KAYLEIGH2: It would be a waste of everything I’ve learned here to go back to how I was living before.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO18_KAYLEIGH2_OPTIO: What was your life like before?
What did you do before you ended up here?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO18_KAYLEIGH3: Uhh… [pause]I wasn’t living what you’d call an [wave amp=30 freq=10]exciting[/wave] life.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO18_KAYLEIGH5: It was pleasant, [pause]but after everything I’ve been through on this island? I’m not sure that would satisfy me anymore.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO18_KAYLEIGH4: I dropped out of college and worked in a shop in my hometown.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO19_KAYLEIGH5: That feels like so long ago now, doesn’t it?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO19_KAYLEIGH3: I don’t know why I thought that might change, but I’m glad it didn’t.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_CONVO19_KAYLEIGH2: Now we’re [wave amp=30 freq=10]together[/wave], I mean.
messages.CAPTAIN_WALLACE_PRE_REMATCH3: My walls aren’t going to fall so easily this time!
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE12_LANDKEEPER: [wave amp=30 freq=5]If you buy in now, you can make a significant profit from any future arrivals who will need housing.[/wave]
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE13_LANDKEEPER: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Since New Wirral has no currency, we even have a promising repossession scheme in development.[/wave]
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE14_EUGENE: I’ve heard enough! [pause]Harbourtown will [shake rate=30 level=10]never[/shake] be bought out by your kind!
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE17_PLAYER_OPTION1: Let’s show them what we’re made of!
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE19_EUGENE: A small victory, but there’s more work to be done.
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE18_LANDKEEPER: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Market growth is inevitable. WE are inevitable.[/wave]
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE20_PLAYER_OPTION1: Are you sure they’re really that bad?
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE21_EUGENE: These “Landkeepers” seek to profit off of our collective misery!
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE23_EUGENE: But I intend to stop them, as the [wave amp=30 freq=10]defender of Harbourtown[/wave]!
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE22_EUGENE: I don’t know how they got here…
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE27_EUGENE: Keep your eyes peeled for the other strongholds, and listen up for rumours when you're in town.
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE24_PLAYER: Do you want some help with that, “defender of Harbourtown”?
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE26_EUGENE: Some help would be appreciated, yeah.
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE29_EUGENE.m: You can open the roof windows on your own now.
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE29_EUGENE.n: You can open the roof windows on your own now.
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE29_EUGENE.f: You can open the roof windows on your own now.
messages.KUNEKOS_RETURN_EVOLUTION: [shake rate=30 level=10]Huh?![/shake] I won’t be defeated so easily, y’know!
messages.KUNEKOS_RETURN_PRE_BATTLE.m: Creator Felix’s friend! I’ve been training – let me show you [shake rate=30 level=10]just how strong I am![/shake]
messages.KUNEKOS_RETURN_PRE_BATTLE.f: Creator Felix’s friend! I’ve been training – let me show you [shake rate=30 level=10]just how strong I am![/shake]
messages.KUNEKOS_RETURN_PRE_BATTLE.n: Creator Felix’s friend! I’ve been training – let me show you [shake rate=30 level=10]just how strong I am![/shake]
messages.KUNEKOS_RETURN_EVOLUTION_FELIX: Go on, Kuneko! I know you’ve got it in you!
messages.KUNEKOS_RETURN_POST_BATTLE: [shake rate=30 level=10]Waaaah![/shake] I’ll beat you next time!
messages.POSTGAME_MORGANTE_PRE_BATTLE1:
AH, {player.to_upper} AND {partner.to_upper}.

HOW FORTUNATE YOU SHOULD APPEAR JUST AS I HAVE NEED OF A SACRIFICE.

TRULY THE MER-LINE SMILES ON US TODAY.
messages.POSTGAME_MORGANTE_PRE_BATTLE2: DON’T LOOK SO SURPRISED.\n\nIT IS ONLY NATURAL THAT I, THE SPIRIT OF REBELLION, SHOULD TURN AGAINST THE ONES WHO INVOKED ME.
messages.POSTGAME_MORGANTE_POST_BATTLE: A SACRIFICE IS A SACRIFICE. THE RITUAL IS COMPLETE.\n\nARCHANGELS HAVE RETURNED TO NEW WIRRAL.
messages.FARM_PUMPKIN_SPREAD_JELLY_QUESTION: It’s a cute pumpkin! Spread your Skelly Jelly on it?
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_GRAVE_meredith: “Meredith\n1967 – XXXX AD\nShould have stayed in bed that morning.”
messages.DUNGEON_MEADOW_NOTE_1: “To my esteemed guests, please enjoy this food I’ve prepared for you. I’ll be arriving to greet you [wave amp=30 freq=10]shortly[/wave], so don’t go anywhere, hehe!\n- Alice ♡”
messages.DUNGEON_MEADOW_NOTE_2: “I said not to go anywhere! Honestly, where are your manners? You ought to be ashamed of yourselves! The hatter won’t appreciate his tea party being interrupted, so stay put, I say!\n- Alice ♡♡”
messages.DUNGEON_MEADOW_NOTE_3: “I’m saving this for later – it’s to be a surprise for you! A courteous guest will leave it alone. [wave amp=30 freq=10]Use your head, don’t lose it[/wave]!\n- Alice ♡♡♡”
messages.DUNGEON_MEADOW_DRINK_ME: Drink from the bottle labelled ‘Drink Me’?
messages.DUNGEON_MEADOW_EAT_ME_MAX_SIZE: Getting any bigger is probably inadvisable.
messages.DUNGEON_MEADOW_DRINK_ME_MIN_SIZE: Getting any smaller is probably inadvisable.
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_GRAVE_PLAYER.m: “Here lies {player}.\nDied this year AD, age unknown.\nRest In Peace”
messages.DUNGEON_MEADOW_MAD_HATTER: You’ve disturbed a monster’s tea party!
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_GRAVE_PLAYER.f: “Here lies {player}.\nDied this year AD, age unknown.\nRest In Peace”
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_GRAVE_kayleigh.m: “Kayleigh, 1983 – ????\nFollowed a fool to her doom, not even for the first time.\nR.I.P.”
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_GRAVE_kayleigh.f: “Kayleigh, 1983 – ????\nFollowed a fool to her doom, not even for the first time.\nR.I.P.”
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_GRAVE_PLAYER.n: “Here lies {player}.\nDied this year AD, age unknown.\nRest In Peace”
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_GRAVE_felix: “Felix\nRest in peace knowing that your friends have carried out your wishes and destroyed your most embarrassing drawings. They only giggled a little bit.\n1991 – Now”
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_GRAVE_kayleigh.n: “Kayleigh, 1983 – ????\nFollowed a fool to her doom, not even for the first time.\nR.I.P.”
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_GRAVE_viola: “Here sleepeth Viola.\nBorn 1575. Died whenever today is.\nSorely missed by her brother.”
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_GRAVE_eugene: “Eugene, Protector of Harbourtown.\n2076 – NaN AD\nAll talk and no action.”
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_GRAVE_dog: “Here lies A Very Good Boy.\nHe would be happy knowing that in death he has finally become that which he loved most: bones.\nBorn 14140 AD. Died whatever this year is in dog years.”
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_LM_1: WHAT AN UNFORTUNATE END FOR YOU. \n\nA DEAD END, YOU MIGHT SAY.
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_LM_2: A WRONG TURN DOWN HERE WILL SEND YOU TO YOUR GRAVE!\nAHAHAHAHAHAHA
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_LM_4: A REWARD FOR YOUR  EFFORTS. REST UP, WEARY ONES.
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_LM_3: SHOW ME HOW MUCH YOU WISH TO SURVIVE.\n\nFIGHT FOR YOUR VERY LIVES!
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_LM_KILL: AMUSING. I WISH TO SEE MORE.
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_LM_5: I’VE CHANGED MY MIND. \n\nYOU’LL REST WHEN YOU’RE SIX FEET UNDER.
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]There’ll be demand for land to bury the dead on for as long as people keep dying.[/wave]
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]It’s a guaranteed revenue stream![/wave]
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Maybe I should quit being a landkeeper and become a gravekeeper instead.[/wave]
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_LM_6: THIS DROP LOOKS RATHER DEADLY, DOESN’T IT? BE CAREFUL NOT TO FALL!
messages.DUNGEON_GRAVEYARD_LM_8: THE CLOCK STRIKES MIDNIGHT. YOU HUMANS ALL MUST FACE DEATH EVENTUALLY...\n\nSO DO NOT KEEP ME WAITING!
messages.CULTIST_ENCOUNTER_KAYLEIGH2: Let’s… [pause]talk about it another time, OK?
messages.CULTIST_ENCOUNTER_KAYLEIGH1_OPTION2: What was that person talking about…?
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH2: A-and, you’ll probably think worse of me when I’m finished. Sorry.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH1: I need to tell you some stuff.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH3: You see, when I first came to New Wirral, I didn’t live in Harbourtown.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH4: There’s another settlement at the top of Autumn Hill, [pause]on the east coast.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH5: Mourningtown. [pause]It’s a community of people living off the land, sharing possessions, all that cute stuff.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH6: You’ve seen the folks walking around in the hooded robes, right?
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH8: Things didn’t used to be that [wave amp=30 freq=30]weird[/wave] there, but...
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH7: That’s them. And I guess… [pause]I was one of them once.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN7: Listen, [pause]guys, [pause][wave amp=30 freq=10]mournchildren[/wave] or whatever, you’ve all been doing such a great job with the digging.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH10: Mourningtown was founded with the intent of helping everyone, [pause]but it soon just became about what [wave amp=30 freq=30]he[/wave] wanted.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH11: It reached a point where I didn’t feel at home anymore. [pause]It was too late for me to be able to fix anything… so I ran.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH12: That’s how I ended up in Harbourtown a year ago. I want so desperately to do right by everyone, because I have let so many down in the past.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH15: But they should still remember me – I think I’ll be able to get us inside.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH14: Th-they don’t let outsiders into the commune…
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH13: But... [pause]if Dorian knows about the locations of other Archangels, I need to put my fears aside and find out what he knows.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH17A: That’s the spirit! I hope some good can come out of all this.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH16_OPTION2: Are you sure you want to do this?
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH17B: I am. I know it’ll be hard, but… I want some good to come out of everything I went through.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH19: Remember: they’ll only let you in if I’m with you.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH18: OK, [pause]right, [pause]I’ll mark the entrance to the commune on your map.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART2_DOORMAN1.m: You are not welcome here. Please leave.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART2_DOORMAN1.f: You are not welcome here. Please leave.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART2_DOORMAN1.n: You are not welcome here. Please leave.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART2_KAYLEIGH1: Greetings. I am here to speak to Dorian.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART2_DOORMAN3: Come, come, you’re just in time.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART3_KAYLEIGH2: Where is everyone? Is something happening?
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST1_PART3_KAYLEIGH1: “Just in time”? In time for what?
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART1_KAYLEIGH1: It feels weird being back here...
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_KAYLEIGH2: Who is she? Is she… my replacement? Creepy.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_JACQUELINE1: May we have quiet in the audience!
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN11: And sure, [pause]we’ve had ups and downs...
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN6: Man, what a great crowd you always are!
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN8: I mean seriously, this is a [wave amp=30 freq=10]primo[/wave] quality hole!
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN9: This pit is as [wave amp=30 freq=10]deep[/wave] as your devotion to the cause. [pause]It’s like a [wave amp=30 freq=10]metaphor[/wave]!
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN10: When I first heard the [wave amp=30 freq=10]whispers in my head[/wave] guiding me beneath the earth, I knew I couldn’t do this alone.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN12: But we’ve done it! [pause]Pull the curtain!
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN13: [shake rate=30 level=10]THE SERPENT GOD AWAITS US, BABY![/shake]
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN14: Soon I will enter the chamber and bargain with him for a share of his [wave amp=30 freq=10]divine power![/wave]
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN15: And to accompany me, [pause]our prodigal daughter returns to us!
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN18: Kayleigh, [pause]honey, [pause]you look like a deer in the headlights! [pause]Of course I got word you were joining us for our big party!
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN19.m: Didn’t you tell your friend here that you helped [wave amp=30 freq=10]run this place[/wave] alongside me?
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN19.f: Didn’t you tell your friend here that you helped [wave amp=30 freq=10]run this place[/wave] alongside me?
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN19.n: Didn’t you tell your friend here that you helped [wave amp=30 freq=10]run this place[/wave] alongside me?
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN23: You didn’t believe in me, did you? Well it looks like I was [wave amp=30 freq=10]right all along, baby![/wave]
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_KAYLEIGH22: I’ll explain later. We need to put a stop to this for now.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN24: There’s a [shake rate=30 level=10]real damn Archangel[/shake] right under our feet!
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_KAYLEIGH26: If you go in there, you’ll get yourself killed!
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN27.m: If you and your friend have so much experience, why not come and [wave amp=30 freq=10]join in the fun?[/wave]
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN27.f: If you and your friend have so much experience, why not come and [wave amp=30 freq=10]join in the fun?[/wave]
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN27.n: If you and your friend have so much experience, why not come and [wave amp=30 freq=10]join in the fun?[/wave]
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN28: C’mon, watch me [wave amp=30 freq=10]ascend to godhood[/wave] with my new Archangel buddy!
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_DORIAN29: Jacqueline – the platform, if you please.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART2_KAYLEIGH33: C’mon, let’s go stop this idiot from whatever he thinks he’s doing.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART3_DORIAN2: I have made the tactical decision to [wave amp=30 freq=10]amend the plan![/wave]
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART3_DORIAN4.m: Kayleigh and friend will go ahead first, [pause]and if they aren’t [wave amp=30 freq=10]instantly killed[/wave] by the Archangel, then I’ll go in and do my sweet-talking.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART3_DORIAN4.f: Kayleigh and friend will go ahead first, [pause]and if they aren’t [wave amp=30 freq=10]instantly killed[/wave] by the Archangel, then I’ll go in and do my sweet-talking.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART3_DORIAN4.n: Kayleigh and friend will go ahead first, [pause]and if they aren’t [wave amp=30 freq=10]instantly killed[/wave] by the Archangel, then I’ll go in and do my sweet-talking.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART3_KAYLEIGH5: You’re a fool and you’re going to get yourself killed.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART4_MOURNINGSTAR1:
HAVE YOU HEARD MY CALL?

ARE YOU HERE TO PAY TRIBUTE?

ARE YOU HERE TO BURN FOR ME?
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART4_DORIAN5: [wave amp=30 rate=10]FOR MY LOYALTY, I ASK ONLY FOR A SHARE OF YOUR DIVINE STRENGTH![/wave]
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART4_DORIAN4: [wave amp=30 rate=10]I HAVE HEEDED YOUR CALL AND TRAVELLED TO YOUR ABODE![/wave]
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART4_MOURNINGSTAR6: YOU DO NOT TAKE FROM ME. YOU ONLY GIVE.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART4_ALEPH10: BOY DO I HAVE A JOB OPPORTUNITY FOR YOU!
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART4_KAYLEIGH8: C’mon {player}, let’s stop this thing before it kills [wave amp=30 rate=10]anyone[/wave] else!
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART4_KAYLEIGH7: [wave amp=30 rate=10]I told him this would happen![/wave]
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART4_KAYLEIGH13: I’m sorry, [pause]but it’s his own fault.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART4_KAYLEIGH14: We should all get out of here. [pause][pause]The air here tastes like death.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_JACQUELINE2: Will open its gates. We will try and find common ground with the rest of New Wirral.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH5: The people of this community aren’t bad people.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH6: You just have to be wary of those you put your faith into.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH9: I feel awful for helping Dorian for so long, but... [pause]I blame him more than I blame myself.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH10: I found the Mournchildren around the same time he did. [pause]I needed that sense of community and belonging.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH11: He and I became good friends, and I was something of an... [pause]assistant to him.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH12: I don’t know if things just slowly changed, or if things were never good, [pause]but Dorian’s hold over the people of Mourningtown became something sinister.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH15: No… [pause]I wasn’t his “assistant”—I was his fixer.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH13: It became about him, his wants, his dreams and delusions. It was no longer the community I desperately wished it was...
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH14: People were hurt, and I helped smooth things over for him.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH16: I felt for so long like I was doing good – [pause]helping to maintain a positive status quo, even if people would get hurt now and then.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH18: Heh… I’m glad you believe that.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH19: I hope they all do better with him gone now.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH20: Lost people look for guidance, [pause]and that’s what Dorian offered them.
messages.KAYLEIGH_QUEST2_PART5_KAYLEIGH21: Well, we’re another Archangel down. [pause]And... [pause]I’m gonna help you find the rest!
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_2_1: HMM. SOME HUMANS GOT IN HERE.
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_3_2: AND I REALLY DON’T KNOW HOW YOU FOUND YOURSELVES DOWN HERE.
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_4_2: WE SHOULD HAVE A PROPER TALK SOMETIME.
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_6_1.m: DO YOU EVEN UNDERSTAND THIS PLACE, HUMAN?
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_6_1.n: DO YOU EVEN UNDERSTAND THIS PLACE, HUMAN?
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_6_1.f: DO YOU EVEN UNDERSTAND THIS PLACE, HUMAN?
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_6_2: DO YOU EVEN FEEL THESE TUNNELS BREATHING?
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_7_1: YOU KNOW, YOU SHOULD SHOW ME A BIT MORE RESPECT.
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_7_2: YOUR WORLD HAS LEGENDS BASED ON ME!
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_8_1: WE GOTTA STOP MEETING LIKE THIS!
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_9_1: MY NEW RECRUITS REALLY ARE A ROWDY BUNCH.
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_10_1: YES, IT’S ME AGAIN, HERE TO RECRUIT THIS TALENTED INDIVIDUAL YOU’RE FIGHTING.
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_9_2: FORTUNATELY I’VE BEEN WORKING ON MY MANAGERIAL SKILLS.
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_9_3: WE’RE GOING FOSTER SUCH A POSITIVE WORKING ATMOSPHERE!
messages.ALEPH_DIALOGUE_10_2: DON’T YOU GET TIRED OF THIS?

messages.RESTING_VIOLA_DATING_2: The two of you exchange some cute pleasantries.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH1: So, I’ve been having a bit of a think recently.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH2: I’ve spent some time processing my feelings over my time in Mourningtown.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH4: In fact, I spent a LOT of time trying to please people. I think maybe I still do.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH3: So much of my time was spent trying to keep people happy...
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH10: Is that normal? [pause]I have no idea.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH7_OPTIO: Well, what things do you like to do in your own time?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH5: That’s all well and good, but maybe it’s good for me to think of what I like to do, as well.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH7: There’ll be nothing of [wave amp=30 freq=30]me[/wave] left.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH6: Otherwise I’ll just burn myself out.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH7_OPTIO: What hobbies would you like to take up?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH8: I… Will have to think about that!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH9: I feel like when I was younger, I used to have so much more [wave amp=30 freq=30]passion[/wave] for things than I do as an adult.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH11: Did you know I used to play guitar?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH12: Same as my dad. My earliest memories are of me, sitting on his lap, listening to him play.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH12_OPTI: How did he fit both you and a guitar on his lap at the same time?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH14: I bought my own guitar in my teens, but was never particularly good at it.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH16: And, well, if I wasn’t destined to become a professional musician, [pause]what was the point in doing it at all?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH15: I guess I gave it up, [pause]because I guess I felt like any hobby I had should probably amount to something eventually.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH18: It IS a shame that I gave it up.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH21: Maybe, if I want to sit in bed all day and read awful romance novels, I should do that too!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH20: A-and, [pause]I don’t even have to do productive stuff!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH23: It feels good to get this off my chest.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH25: I’m pretty much finished with my cup of tea. What do you say, shall we get back to it, then?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL1_KAYLEIGH24: After all, we’ve been fusing into a great big monster together, haven’t we? That’s something of a bonding experience, if anything!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL2_KAYLEIGH2: Clémence found this at the market earlier and acquired it for me!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL2_KAYLEIGH4: But to be honest so does half of the junk in Harbourtown.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL2_KAYLEIGH3: It… Has a bit of a seawater aroma to it…
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL2_KAYLEIGH8: Don’t worry, everyone in New Wirral is used to things being a bit broken. Nothing a bit of elbow grease can’t fix!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL2_KAYLEIGH10: You’ll be hearing me play this beauty in no time!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL2_KAYLEIGH9: And by elbow grease, I mean manual labour.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL2_KAYLEIGH11B: Cross your fingers and maybe it’ll come true.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL3_KAYLEIGH1: Hey, uh, do you wanna come on over to my place? I have something I wanted to show you.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL3_KAYLEIGH2B: No problem – I guess I have more time to practice then!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL3_KAYLEIGH3: I-I wanted to play you something. My dad used to sing this to me, and it was the first song I ever learned to play.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL3_KAYLEIGH4.m: You’ve been wonderful to me, and I wanted to do a little something for you.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL3_KAYLEIGH4.f: You’ve been wonderful to me, and I wanted to do a little something for you.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL3_KAYLEIGH4.n: You’ve been wonderful to me, and I wanted to do a little something for you.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL3_KAYLEIGH6_OPTIO: I think I want to kiss you right now.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL3_PLATONIC_KAYLEI: Aw, don’t go making me blush now!
I hope you keep playing.
So do I! Maybe we should write a song together, whilst out on our travels?
Sounds like a wee bit of fun, doesn’t it?
I’m game!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL3_ROMANTIC_KAYLEI: Aw, you sure it’s not just the [wave amp=30 freq=30]magical[/wave] effect of seeing a guitarist at work?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL3_PLATONIC_KAYLEI: Then it’s settled! Let’s do it!
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL3_ROMANTIC_KAYLEI: Aw, you sure it’s not just the [wave amp=30 freq=30]magical[/wave] effect of seeing a guitarist at work?
Aw, you sure it’s not just the [wave amp=30 freq=30]magical[/wave] effect of seeing a guitarist at work?
I got my first girl crush seeing a friend play drums in a band when we were in college. I think I just fall for musicians easily.
Joking aside, I do hope you continue to play!
No, I’m serious, I do like you.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH1.n: You’re quieter than usual, {player}! Is there something on your mind?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_SOCIAL3_ROMANTIC_KAYLEI: No, I’m serious, I do like you.
I…
No, I’m serious, I do like you.
If you want to kiss me…
I think now would be a good time.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH1.f: You’re quieter than usual, {player}! Is there something on your mind?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH1.m: You’re quieter than usual, {player}! Is there something on your mind?
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH7: I don’t know if I have a word to describe it.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH3: Truth be told, I don’t think I saw you in [wave amp=30 freq=30]that[/wave] way until we fused.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH4.n: For a start, [pause]I’ve only ever had a few short relationships, and they were all with boys, too.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH4.f: For a start, [pause]I’ve only ever had a few short relationships, and they were all with boys, too.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH4.m: I mean, I’ve had a few relationships with a few boys, [pause]but, [pause]I never really… felt anything from them.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH5: It may sound a wee bit silly, but when we fuse…
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH6: I feel like I [wave amp=30 freq=10]feel[/wave] your soul… [pause]And that maybe I know you in a way I don’t even know myself.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH8.m: I… I think you’re beautiful. Of course I want to be with you.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH8.f: I… I think you’re beautiful. Of course I want to be with you.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH9: And even if we one day have to part, it’ll have been worth it, [pause]I think.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH8.n: I… I think you’re beautiful. Of course I want to be with you.
messages.RESTING_KAYLEIGH_ROMANCE_KAYLEIGH12: Well, you have a girlfriend now! AND she’s a budding musician!
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_MEREDITH2: Hoylake was babbling on about you when he came by to pick up some parts from my shop.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_MEREDITH3: Have you met him? [pause]He’s the worst.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_MEREDITH4: Did you know he’s not even a real scientist? [pause]Before he landed on New Wirral, he was a DATA ANALYST.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_MEREDITH6.m: Anyway, I’m Meredith. [pause]Enjoy being trapped on this rock forever with the rest of us until you die.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_MEREDITH5: Someone needs to tell him that only wearing T-shirts that say “I love science” is NOT a personality.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_MEREDITH6.n: Anyway, I’m Meredith. [pause]Enjoy being trapped on this rock forever with the rest of us until you die.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_MEREDITH6.f: Anyway, I’m Meredith. [pause]Enjoy being trapped on this rock forever with the rest of us until you die.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_MEREDITH6_OPTION1: I’m going to find a way out!
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_A_MEREDITH2: There’s just weird nightmare creatures, and us. On an island.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_A_MEREDITH1.m: That’s cute. You’re new here. Sorry hun, but there isn’t a way out.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_A_MEREDITH1.n: That’s cute. You’re new here. Sorry hun, but there isn’t a way out.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_A_MEREDITH1.f: That’s cute. You’re new here. Sorry hun, but there isn’t a way out.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_END_MEREDITH1: Anyway, I just needed a breath of fresh air. Come meet me at my shop in town sometime. Yellow building on the boardwalk.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_B_MEREDITH2: You run out of things to talk about pretty quick. Trust me.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO_B_MEREDITH1: There’s like, what, a couple hundred people here max?
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH1: Oh. You again. I had something to ask you…
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH2: Are you really gonna be searching for a way off this island?
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH3: Huh. I almost admire your optimism.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH4: Well, if you are gonna be doing the whole “travel across the land” thing, could you look out for something for me?
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH4_OPTION1: Sure! What are you looking for?
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_NO_MEREDITH1: Sure. You’ve got stuff to do I’m sure. So have I.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH5: It’s a, um, music record. [pause]Do you know what that is?
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_NO_MEREDITH3: You reckon you’ve got the time to find something for me?
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH7: It’s, [pause]uh, [pause]hard to know who knows what around here. Not everyone comes from similar… worlds.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH9: Anyway, the record, [pause]it’s an album. [pause]“All I Ever Needed” by The Witch House. Maybe you’ve heard of it.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH8: It makes it pretty hard to talk to people. [pause]Harder than usual, even.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH10: I used to listen to it back in my previous life. It has… [pause]sentimental value, OK?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST1_QUERY_IANTHE6: It’s where we get all the clothes for the locals. [pause]Not to mention our cassette players and tapes.
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH11: There’s a few music nerds in Harbourtown – reckon you could ask around for me?
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH12_OPTION1: I’m still looking for your record!
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH13A: Oh, cool. It’s kind of a long shot, y’know. The math isn’t in my favour on this one. I appreciate it anyway.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST1_QUERY: ”All I Ever Needed” by The Witch House?
messages.MEREDITH_INTRO2_MEREDITH13B: Yeah, get used to that. Time doesn’t exactly fly by here. We’re a bit short on entertainment.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST1_QUERY_CLEMENCE2: No. You can ask the Rangers at the Town Hall.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST1_QUERY_IANTHE1: Meredith is looking for a music record? [pause]You must know your chances of finding this particular record are pretty close to zero, right?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST1_QUERY_CLEMENCE3: Or maybe the Rangers at the Ranger’s Outpost. [pause]Do you know it? [pause]It is north-east of Harbourtown.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST1_QUERY_IANTHE2: I really can’t emphasise that enough. The things that end up in New Wirral come from a [wave amp=30 freq=30]lot[/wave] of different worlds, you know.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST1_QUERY_IANTHE3: Nonetheless, [pause]you might have some luck in Falldown Mall.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST1_QUERY_IANTHE5: There’s a shopping complex on the northside of New Wirral. [pause]Totally abandoned – just popped into being around fifteen years ago.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST1_QUERY_IANTHE7: There’s a music shop in the mall, filled with records and cassette tapes, but we keep it locked up for security.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST1_QUERY_IANTHE8: Cassette supplies are pretty important, after all. It’s a good idea to keep them safe.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST1_QUERY_IANTHE9: If the record is there, Meredith might be risking her life just to get it. [pause]The rational part of me wants to formally forbid her from trying...
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST1_QUERY_IANTHE10: But if you go with her, maybe that’s a little safer. Here, take this.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST3_MEREDITH3: It’s a note from Ianthe. She says my record might be at Falldown Mall, and I have permission to go…
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST3_MEREDITH4: But only if you accompany me. She also included the keys to get in.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST3_MEREDITH6: Don’t worry, I can defend myself – you didn’t think I wouldn’t have my own cassette player, did you?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST3_MEREDITH7: Sitting around here all day is killing me. [pause]Finding that album is just something to strive for, I guess.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST3_MEREDITH8: It’s like – [pause]if you don’t have something to keep you going, you may as well be dead, [pause]right?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST3_MEREDITH9: Do you… [pause]Do you know what’s driving you right now?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST3_MEREDITH9_OPTION1: I want to find a way back home.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART1_MEREDITH3: That shop up there looks like the kind of place you’d find music, right?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST3_MEREDITH10: Like I said to you before, that’s impossible.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST3_MEREDITH12: If you help me find my record, I’ll help you find your way home.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST3_MEREDITH13: Why not, right? I’ll need something new to strive for, after all.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART1_MEREDITH1: If I’m being honest? I bet this place looked way tackier before all the… [pause]Structural decay.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART1_MEREDITH4: Let’s find a way to reach it.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PASSIVE2_MEREDITH: This place must have looked so different filled with people...
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PASSIVE1_MEREDITH: This would be a great place to film a movie. Maybe the monsters could be extras?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PASSIVE3_MEREDITH: I really hope that was water I just stepped in.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART2_MEREDITH1: “Vinyl Beat”. I guess this is the place. Should we go inside?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART3_MEREDITH1: It must be around here somewhere… I’m so close...
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_VINYL_DESCRIPTION1: “Mac and the Awesome 5 – Mac to the Future”. This isn’t it.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_VINYL_DESCRIPTION3: “Treeman – Legacy of the Treeman” There are some weird records here.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_VINYL_DESCRIPTION2: “Procgen – Dreamer of Electric Sheep”. Sounds cool... Not the right record, though.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART4_DESCRIPTION: This record has “The Witch House” written on it in big red letters.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART4_MEREDITH1A: That album art – you’ve found it!
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART4_MEREDITH1B: That album art – I’ve found it!
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART4_MEREDITH4: And this cover art is [wave amp=30 freq=30]slightly[/wave] different too…
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART4_MEREDITH3: “Timeless and Strange”? [pause]That’s not the name of the album…
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART4_MEREDITH7: It’s some [wave amp=30 freq=30]alternate universe[/wave] version. [pause]The one I wanted isn’t here.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART4_MEREDITH8: I knew I shouldn’t have expected anything good to happen to me.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_MONARCH4:
I KNEW I FELT IT!

AN EMPTINESS. A HOLE WHERE A HEART SHOULD BE. IT EMPOWERS ME.

I WISH TO CONSUME IT WHOLE.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_MONARCH6: YOUR KIND COULD LIVE SUCH RICH LIVES.\n\nBUT INSTEAD YOU TRADE IT FOR HOLLOW SYMBOLS AND ARTIFICE.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_MEREDITH3: The record – I dropped it. Can you see it?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_MEREDITH5: W-who are you? [pause]What are you talking about?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_MEREDITH9: This place is a ruin! Filled with trash!
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_MONARCH7: YOU EXCHANGE SOMETHING MEANINGFUL FOR NOTHING.\n\nMY CASTLE IS FILLED WITH ALL THE EMPTINESS YOU LEAVE BEHIND!
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_MONARCH11:
YES… IT IS NOTHING...

AND I AM THE KING OF NOTHING!

COME, LET ME CONSUME YOUR EMPTINESS!
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_FUSE_MEREDITH2: It’d be so easy to give up and just die…
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_POST_BATTLE_MEREDI: We did it… [pause]We’re alive… [pause]We [pause]fused..?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_FUSE_MEREDITH3: But that’s not me! I’m sick of letting myself down!
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_POST_BATTLE_MEREDI: Uh...
We did it… [pause]We’re alive…
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_POST_BATTLE_ALEPH2: NICE PLACE YOU HAVE HERE, PAL.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_POST_BATTLE_MEREDI: You didn’t have to do this. Thanks mate.
I realise that this was a really trivial thing to come all this way for.
I realise that this was a really trivial thing to come all this way for.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_POST_BATTLE_ALEPH3: BUT SOMEONE OF YOUR POTENTIAL COULD DO A LITTLE BETTER, DON’T YOU THINK?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART5_POST_BATTLE_MEREDI: I realise that this was a really trivial thing to come all this way for.
And a really stupid thing to nearly die over.
You didn’t have to do this. Thanks mate.
You didn’t have to do this. Thanks mate.
I think… I’ve had enough of abandoned malls and mortal peril for today.
C’mon, let’s go back to town and check this record out.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST5_PART6A_MEREDITH2: I felt like we should, uh, talk about it?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST5_PART6A_MEREDITH5: Afterwards, whilst I can remember it, it doesn’t feel like it’s something that I experienced.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST5_PART6A_MEREDITH4: It’s like our minds merge, and I am no longer me.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST5_PART6A_MEREDITH6: It’s like remembering a dream. Maybe our brains just aren’t equipped to process it…
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST5_PART6A_MEREDITH8: N-[pause]not that it’s a big deal if you have! [pause]I just wasn’t sure if that was your first time.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST5_PART6A_MEREDITH12.n: What makes you so sure that you have a way to return home?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST5_PART6A_MEREDITH12.f: What makes you so sure that you have a way to return home?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST5_PART6A_MEREDITH12.m: What makes you so sure that you have a way to return home?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST5_PART6A_MEREDITH13: Uh, you’re gonna have to tell me the full story here, mate.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST5_PART6A_MEREDITH15: I’ll uphold my end of the bargain. You helped me find a record, I’ll help you find a way off New Wirral.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST5_PART6A_MEREDITH16: Oh! I almost forgot about the record!
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART6B_MEREDITH4: I, uh, I spent my teen years being very miserable, and bad with people.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART6B_MEREDITH5: When I went to college, I wanted to change, for real.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART6B_MEREDITH3: I mean, It’s not the same album I used to have, but it’s familiar enough.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART6B_MEREDITH8: I know it’s me who’s the problem, but I want to keep trying.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART6B_MEREDITH11: You didn’t need to risk your life to help me.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART6B_MEREDITH6: The record was kind of the soundtrack to me, like, trying to change and get better…
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART6B_MEREDITH7: Not that I did. I almost made lifelong friends, but they don’t speak to me anymore.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO5_MEREDITH2: Did I ever mention my tolerance for bugs is pretty low?
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART6B_MEREDITH9: Maybe that’s what that Archangel meant. Maybe I’ve spent too much time distracting myself with stuff instead of trying to actually live.
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART6B_MEREDITH12: A lot sucks about New Wirral, but...
messages.MEREDITH_QUEST4_PART6B_MEREDITH10: But even if we didn’t find exactly what I was looking for, I’m... OK with this outcome.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO1_MEREDITH2: Campfires make for such easy conversation.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO1_MEREDITH3: No need for awkward pauses where you can’t think of anything to say:
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO1_MEREDITH4: You can always say something like “this is a great fire” and everyone will nod in agreement like you’ve said something valuable.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO1_MEREDITH6: Though that might be a fire hazard.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO1_MEREDITH5: I wish every conversation could have a campfire nearby…
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO2_MEREDITH1: Do you remember what you were doing right before you came here?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO2_MEREDITH2: Like, [pause]before you came to New Wirral.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO5_MEREDITH1: UGH. [pause][pause]I think something just crawled on my foot.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO2_MEREDITH3: Sometimes I try and remember the exact moment, [pause]but I can’t…
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO2_MEREDITH4: It’s like trying to remember the moment you fall asleep.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO2_MEREDITH5: I can remember what I was doing around that time, but the exact moment is lost to me.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO3_MEREDITH2: If we were to find our way back to our homes… [pause]Our real homes…
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO3_MEREDITH3: Would all this time have passed there?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO3_MEREDITH4: Or would we end up back at the moment we left, like all this had happened in the blink of an eye?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO4_MEREDITH1: The cool thing about The Witch House is that like, [pause]three other bands had to disband for them to form.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO4_MEREDITH2: Procgen fell apart when their bassist left to start his own religion, so vocalist Rob Handsome needed work...
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO4_MEREDITH3: Drummer Linda Steel had just left the punk trio Bad Horses after a record label dispute…
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO4_MEREDITH5: So the stars aligned, [pause]mostly through bad circumstances, [pause]and they were able to form The Witch House.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO4_MEREDITH4: And guitarist Daniel “Safety First” Buttercroft was the only survivor of a tour bus crash which killed the entirety of his band No Seatbelts.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO4_MEREDITH6: It makes me think how small the chances are of that even happening…
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO4_MEREDITH7.f: I wonder what the probability of the two of us being here, [pause]in this moment, [pause]must be?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO4_MEREDITH7.m: I wonder what the probability of the two of us being here, [pause]in this moment, [pause]must be?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO4_MEREDITH7.n: I wonder what the probability of the two of us being here, [pause]in this moment, [pause]must be?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO5_MEREDITH3: I’m just going to pretend it was a stray blade of grass and really not think about it.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO6_MEREDITH1: Coming here for our “couple time” is fine, but…
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO6_MEREDITH2: Imagine if there was a [wave amp=30 rate=10]second[/wave] café in Harbourtown.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO6_MEREDITH3: That would change the dating game entirely!
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO6_MEREDITH4: Maybe I should open one, just to keep up healthy competition.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO6_MEREDITH5: I would decorate it way more goth. [pause]Black walls, cool skulls on the wall…
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO7_MEREDITH1: So I’m, uh, not super good at expressing myself.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO7_MEREDITH2: Sometimes I feel like I react to people’s conversations in the wrong way…
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO7_MEREDITH4: And a lot of people DO bore me!
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO7_MEREDITH5: But you never do, [pause]so please don’t ever think I’m not paying attention or anything.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO7_MEREDITH3: Like I’ll say the wrong thing or make the wrong face, [pause]and then they’ll think I’m disinterested in what they’re talking about.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO8_MEREDITH1: Have you noticed how Harbourtown provides for everyone, no matter what they bring to the community?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO8_MEREDITH2: I mean, the locals still have their own problems, sure, but…
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO8_MEREDITH3.m: No-one is cast out. [pause]Everyone kinda contributes what they can, [pause]and if you can’t? [pause]No worries, mate.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO8_MEREDITH3.n: No-one is cast out. [pause]Everyone kinda contributes what they can, [pause]and if you can’t? [pause]No worries, mate.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO8_MEREDITH3.f: No-one is cast out. [pause]Everyone kinda contributes what they can, [pause]and if you can’t? [pause]No worries, mate.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO8_MEREDITH4: It’s a kind of lonely society, sure…. [pause]but it’s not a cruel one.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO8_MEREDITH5: I can’t, [pause]uh, [pause]exactly say the same for where I’m from.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO9_MEREDITH1: This might be a bit morbid, but I do sometimes wonder if people from my “previous life” ever think about me.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO9_MEREDITH2: I picture some old colleagues sitting in a dreary London pub one evening, asking each other: [pause]“Whatever happened to Meredith Chen, who disappeared off the face of the earth one day, never to be seen again?”
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO9_MEREDITH4: That actually sounds much more depressing when I say it out loud like that.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO10_MEREDITH1: If we do get to go back to our worlds, I’m gonna have so many movies to catch up on.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO10_MEREDITH1_OPTION2: What kind of movies do you like?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO10_MEREDITH3: I think my tastes split into two distinct categories: incredibly dumb american action movies, and vampire movies where you aren’t sure if you’re watching true art or serious trash.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO10_MEREDITH4: It’s good to know what appeals to you, I guess.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO11_MEREDITH1: So I heard Kayleigh is like, your girlfriend now…?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO11_MEREDITH6: Maybe I just got the wrong idea after that night we spent together… [pause]but it’s OK.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO11_MEREDITH2: What can I say? Word gets around.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO11_MEREDITH3: I mean I don’t blame you – [pause]I mean, Kayleigh is [wave amp=30 freq=10]Kayleigh[/wave].
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO11_MEREDITH5: (God, I’m such a [wave amp=30 freq=10]mess[/wave] when talking to women...)
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO11_MEREDITH4: She’s effortlessly perfect, and gorgeous too. [pause]Don’t tell her I said that.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO11_MEREDITH7: I’m not sure I’m ready for any long-term commitments anyway, mate.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO12_MEREDITH1: Remember when we fought the Archangel that lived under the mall? [pause]I was thinking about something it said.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO12_MEREDITH2: It told me I “exchanged something meaningful for nothing”. [pause]I think it was talking about my desire to find that music record?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO12_MEREDITH4: I guess it’s easy to get so fixated on that stuff that you neglect the things in life that [wave amp=30 freq=10]truly[/wave] matter.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO12_MEREDITH3: Because ultimately… [pause]the music record wasn’t important. It’s just [wave amp=30 freq=10]stuff[/wave] in my life. Like the books I read, and the movies I watch.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO12_MEREDITH6: And, uh, our friendship matters to me, [pause]so I’ll make sure to remember that.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO13_MEREDITH2: A lot of people have lived and died on this island. And many of them are people like us… [pause]people who washed up here from another world.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO13_MEREDITH1: Remember when we travelled through that graveyard? It got me thinking.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO13_MEREDITH3: That’s a lot of people who were lost, and never found, y’know? That’s pretty sad to think about.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO13_MEREDITH4: A lot of people must have lost hope on this island.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO13_MEREDITH5: I don’t want to be one of them, {player}.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO14_MEREDITH1: So… do you believe it’s true?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO14_MEREDITH2: That the big gateway you found can take us home?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO14_MEREDITH3: I… [pause]resigned myself to being here forever. It’s a little scary to have to start thinking of a future for myself.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO14_MEREDITH2_OPTION2: What other choice do I have?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO15_MEREDTH2: If the gateway does in fact work, it’s gonna cause a whole lot of work for the rangers.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO15_MEREDTH1: You spoke to Ianthe about the gateway, huh?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO15_MEREDTH5: The rangers are like the caretakers of this community, right? They’re gonna have to figure out how to manage this whole logistical change.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO15_MEREDTH3: People here are gonna have to shift their entire outlooks. New Wirral won’t be this place that traps you forever anymore. It'll be a place some people simply… end up, from time to time.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO15_MEREDTH4: That’s [wave amp=30 freq=10]assuming[/wave] that people will even continue to end up here to begin with.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO15_MEREDTH6: I’m glad I’m not one of them. Too much work.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO16_MEREDITH2: Like, transforming into monsters with cassette tapes is one thing. [pause]Fusing with you and becoming a bigger monster is another. [pause]But when we [wave amp=30 freq=10]all[/wave] fused together on top of that train?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO16_MEREDITH1: So much has happened recently, we haven’t even had a chance to talk about our big battle against Aleph.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO16_MEREDITH4: I’m not sure how to describe it… [pause]like with regular fusion, it felt like taking a backseat view to what my body was doing.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO18_MEREDITH1: I thought the monsters of New Wirral were creepy enough…
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO16_MEREDITH5: But it wasn’t just you and me this time. It was all of us, and I could [wave amp=30 freq=10]feel[/wave] our collective desire.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO16_MEREDITH6: You know what? [pause]Archangels are strong, but people are [wave amp=30 freq=10]WAY[/wave] stronger.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO17_MEREDITH2: I guess I picture myself as a very solitary person, and that if we became a couple then it might change everything I recognise about myself.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO17_MEREDITH1: I think I was worried at first that a relationship might fundamentally change me.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO17_MEREDITH4: But… it didn’t happen. I’m still [wave amp=30 freq=10]me[/wave], [pause]I just have [wave amp=30 freq=10]you[/wave] as well.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO17_MEREDITH3: It sounds dumb, [pause]and it probably is, [pause]but it’s how I felt.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO18_MEREDITH3: The way it spoke to us was like it was a [wave amp=30 freq=10]person[/wave]. Like, they’re as smart as us, right? Maybe [wave amp=30 freq=10]smarter[/wave].
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO18_MEREDITH2: But the “Archangels”? Like the one we fought? They’re in a league of their own.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO18_MEREDITH4: The fact that there’s just [wave amp=30 freq=10]giant reality-bending intelligent monsters[/wave] living in the railway system that apparently lies under the entire island we live on…
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO18_MEREDITH5: Well, I guess I won’t sleep easy tonight knowing that.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO19_MEREDITH3: Sorry, I know this is awkward. We don’t really know each other that well, so there’s not a huge amount for us to talk about.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO19_MEREDITH4: Oh. [pause]Maybe pointing it out is just making it worse.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO20_MEREDITH1: I’m not… [pause]super big on camping. I’m more of an “inside” person.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO20_MEREDITH2: I probably should have mentioned that before you agreed to go on this little [wave amp=30 freq=10]adventure[/wave] with me.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO20_MEREDITH3: I hope you’re not regretting your past decision to go searching for a vinyl record with a total stranger, mate.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO21_MEREDITH1: Back in the café once more… some things never change, do they?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO21_MEREDITH1_OPTION2: Have you been here a lot?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO21_MEREDITH2: This is Harbourtown. There’s literally [wave amp=30 freq=10]nowhere[/wave] else to hang out.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO21_MEREDITH3: That’s small town life for you. [pause]At least the coffee is good.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO22_MEREDITH1: So, uh, you do a lot of camping here on New Wirral, don’t you?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO22_MEREDITH2: Seems like it to me. Have you kissed all your [wave amp=30 freq=10]other[/wave] camping mates?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO22_MEREDITH3.f: D-don’t worry, I’m just winding you up, mate.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO22_MEREDITH3.m: D-don’t worry, I’m just winding you up, mate.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO22_MEREDITH3.n: D-don’t worry, I’m just winding you up, mate.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO23_MEREDITH2: I wanna know… [pause]what’s her whole [wave amp=30 freq=10]deal[/wave]?
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO23_MEREDITH3: She turned up in Harbourtown about a year ago, and went straight into training with the rangers. [pause]She didn’t seem to need [wave amp=30 freq=10]any[/wave] time to adjust to being stuck on this island.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO23_MEREDITH4: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Something[/wave] about it just didn’t add up for me.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO23_MEREDITH6.m: Uh, [pause]just to clarify, I’m not [wave amp=30 freq=10]usually[/wave] one to talk about people behind their backs. I just thought you should know, given that the [wave amp=30 freq=10]two of you[/wave] hang out and stuff.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO23_MEREDITH5: She puts on a [wave amp=30 freq=10]happy-go-lucky[/wave] face, but she’s got some skeletons in her closet. [pause]I’m sure of it.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO23_MEREDITH6.f: Uh, [pause]just to clarify, I’m not [wave amp=30 freq=10]usually[/wave] one to talk about people behind their backs. I just thought you should know, given that the [wave amp=30 freq=10]two of you[/wave] hang out and stuff.
messages.MEREDITH_CONVO23_MEREDITH6.n: Uh, [pause]just to clarify, I’m not [wave amp=30 freq=10]usually[/wave] one to talk about people behind their backs. I just thought you should know, given that the [wave amp=30 freq=10]two of you[/wave] hang out and stuff.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL1_MEREDITH1: With both the Archangels appearing and us fusing for the first time, things have suddenly gotten very strange in my life lately.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL1_MEREDITH3: I guess I wasn’t expecting this island to throw any more surprises at me. Not to mention your plan to find a way to [wave amp=30 freq=10]leave[/wave]...
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL1_MEREDITH2: Don’t take that the wrong way! Fusing with you is cool. But it’s [wave amp=30 freq=10]weird[/wave], right?
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL1_MEREDITH15: It’s been so long since I arrived here, I’ve barely thought about going back.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL1_MEREDITH17: I think that’s why I like distracting myself.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL1_MEREDITH16: I guess… [pause]I was never that close to anyone back home to begin with. I don’t like most people.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL1_MEREDITH18: When I arrived here, I kind of got obsessed with electronics. Making lights and stuff for the town.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL1_MEREDITH19: It gives me something to focus on so I don’t have to think about everything else I’m missing.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL1_MEREDITH20: I think it was the same with finding that album.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL1_MEREDITH21: Urgh. [pause]Sorry for being such a… [pause]Sorry for being me, I guess.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL1_MEREDITH22: Heh. [pause]Thanks. [pause]For a second, I sounded like Kayleigh there.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL1_MEREDITH23: Do you know what I mean? She always acts like she’s got something to apologise for.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH1: The Gramophone café always reminds me of my dad. [pause]He’d brew a pot of coffee every morning before heading into London for work, [pause]so that coffee smell is kind of seared into my brain.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH3: I can never tell if I miss my parents. [pause]We never had a huge amount in common. [pause]They grew up in a different time and a different place.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH4: I guess there was a big generational divide. [pause]It’s not my fault my parents listened to [shake rate=30 level=10]incredibly[/shake] bad music!
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH5: When I moved out to go to college, we didn’t really stay… [pause]in touch. [pause]That’s OK.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH7: Y’know, [pause]I don’t have many strong memories of growing up.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH8: I had friends, and life experiences, but thinking back on those memories…
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH9: It always feels like something that was just happening around me, not something I was participating in.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH10: Like I’ve never been fully in the pilot seat.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH11: I guess I was an uncool kid, then an uncool teenager. [pause]As for being an adult…
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH12: Well, there’s still time to see how I do at this.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH14: No-one [wave amp=30 rate=10]ever[/wave] tells you growing up that making friends as an adult is hard.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH13: Maybe I just need to make more friends whilst I’m here in New Wirral. [pause]Urgh.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH15: It’s easier with us – we have, [pause]like, [pause]a hobby together.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH16: Yeah, [pause]we’re looking for a magic world portal. [pause]That’s a hobby, right?
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH17.n: I mean, I hope we’d still hang out... [pause]even if we didn’t find your doorway.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH17.m: I mean, I hope we’d still hang out... [pause]even if we didn’t find your doorway.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH17.f: I mean, I hope we’d still hang out... [pause]even if we didn’t find your doorway.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH18B: Urgh, you [wave amp=30 freq=10]can’t[/wave] compliment me like that. [pause]I totally don’t handle it well.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH20: Huh, [pause]I’m more tired than I thought.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH19B: It makes my whole body feel like it’s folding in on itself.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH21: Do you think transforming and battling counts as exercise? [pause]I guess it’s pretty exhausting.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH22.m: Anyway, [pause]let’s go and hang out together and punch monsters and stuff.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH1: Y’know, all that stuff with the vinyl record I was looking for got me thinking.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH22.n: Anyway, [pause]let’s go and hang out together and punch monsters and stuff.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL2_MEREDITH22.f: Anyway, [pause]let’s go and hang out together and punch monsters and stuff.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH3: We found an album that had never been recorded in my world, right?
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH2: Well, let me put it this way:
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH4: And if there are infinite worlds, then this implies… [pause]Infinite albums.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH6: Every book he wrote wasn’t just a story, it was like peering into his mind. [pause]His aspirations, his beliefs, his philosophies…
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH5: So like, [pause]when I was a teenager, I was a big fan of this old fantasy author. [pause]I was a huge dork.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH7: I guess writing a book is like putting a bit of yourself out into the world, forever.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH8: Eventually I read everything he’d ever written when he was alive, and the finality of it stuck with me.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH9: I’d experienced everything he’d ever written. There would [shake rate=30 level=10]never[/shake] be any more.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH10: I guess that happens to all of us when we die… [pause]Eventually, we’ll have said everything we’ll ever say.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH11: But if there’s infinite worlds, then maybe there’s an endless list of different books he ended up writing.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH12: And maybe… [pause]there’s endless versions of us, having endless memories and experiences of their own.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH13: Maybe we never really die, [pause]in a sense.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL3_MEREDITH14: Just something that’s been on my mind, is all.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH1.f: OK, are you ready for this?
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH1.m: OK, are you ready for this?
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH3: Movie night. [pause]At my place. [pause]Are you in?
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH1.n: OK, are you ready for this?
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_MEREDITH4.m: It kinda puts me in your head a bit, y’know? [pause]And, [pause]like, [pause]of course I think you’re cute.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH4: Boo. Give me a shout when you’re up for it. It should be a laugh.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH6: So check this out – the only working movie projector on New Wirral.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH8: It’s time I tell you about New Wirral’s unspoken curse.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH7: It’s been one of my many side-hobbies.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH10: It’s a video tape. [pause]But not just any video tape...
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH11: It’s a video tape for the 1981 action movie “Blood Puncher”.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH12: Hundreds of video tapes have washed up on New Wirral’s shores in the time I’ve been here.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH17: [shake rate=30 level=10]Every single tape is Blood Puncher.[/shake]
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH18: [shake rate=30 level=10]It’s the only film you can watch in New Wirral.[/shake]
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH19_OPTION2.f: I’m ready to enjoy this ironically!
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH19_OPTION1: Sounds like my kind of movie!
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH19_OPTION2.m: I’m ready to enjoy this ironically!
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH19_OPTION2.n: I’m ready to enjoy this ironically!
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH21: I wanted to say, [pause]thanks for hanging out with me.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH22: I’ve been pretty miserable on New Wirral, but this is, like, the most fun I’ve had.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_MEREDITH22_OPTION2: Maybe this should be a date?
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_MEREDITH3.m: We have an awful movie to watch. I hope you’re ready.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_MEREDITH3.n: We have an awful movie to watch. I hope you’re ready.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_MEREDITH3.f: We have an awful movie to watch. I hope you’re ready.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_MEREDITH2: Took you long enough to ask.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_MEREDITH8: I want to hang out with you still…
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_MEREDITH3: C’mon, we’ve [wave amp=30 freq=30]literally[/wave] fused together.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_MEREDITH4.n: It kinda puts me in your head a bit, y’know? [pause]And, [pause]like, [pause]of course I think you’re cute.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_MEREDITH4.f: It kinda puts me in your head a bit, y’know? [pause]And, [pause]like, [pause]of course I think you’re cute.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_MEREDITH5: Why not? Date night. With a bad movie.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_MEREDITH7: I’ve, [pause]uh, [pause]only ever been with guys before – [pause]so this is also kinda new to me.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_MEREDITH9: But I also want to make out with you sometimes.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_MEREDITH10: Anyway, [pause]I’ve seen this movie a million times.
messages.MEREDITH_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_MEREDITH11: So… we don’t have to do much watching.
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH1.m: You haven’t said anything for a while, {player}. [pause]Is something bothering you?
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH1.f: You haven’t said anything for a while, {player}. [pause]Is something bothering you?
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH1.n: You haven’t said anything for a while, {player}. [pause]Is something bothering you?
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH3: I mean, of course I [wave amp=30 freq=30]like[/wave] you.

messages.CAPTAIN_ZEDD_POST_REMATCH1: I lost again? This is why I don’t trust the waking world...

messages.CAPTAIN_ZEDD_PRE_REMATCH1.m: Hey, new guy! [pause]New captain, I mean. [pause]I heard that you’re one of us now.
messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_POST_REWARD2: I can’t imagine that kind of life!
messages.CAPTAIN_JUDAS_PRE_BATTLE1: Do you want a first-hand lesson in survival, then? [pause]I’ve already received intel that you’re a ranger trainee.
messages.CAPTAIN_JUDAS_NOT_TRAINEE1: I’d share more intel with you… but that’s classified information. [pause]If you signed up to be a ranger trainee, that’d be a different story.
messages.CAPTAIN_JUDAS_INTRO1.n: I heard you coming from at least 200 meters out. [pause]If you wanted the element of surprise, you’ve lost it.

messages.CAPTAIN_JUDAS_POST_REMATCH1: I thought I had covered every possible scenario this time…
messages.CAPTAIN_JUDAS_POST_REMATCH2: I lost again, [pause]but I won’t shed any tears over it. [pause]Crying is a waste of body moisture, and I’m running low on water rations.

messages.LEADER_IANTHE_PRE_BATTLE1_IANTHE1.f: I’ve been itching to see what you’re really made of. I hope you’re prepared to give us your all!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_PRE_BATTLE1_IANTHE1.m: I’ve been itching to see what you’re really made of. I hope you’re prepared to give us your all!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_PRE_BATTLE1_IANTHE1.n: I’ve been itching to see what you’re really made of. I hope you’re prepared to give us your all!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_PRE_BATTLE1_IANTHE2: Well, [pause]I think it’d only be reasonable that my wife gets to help me out on this one.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_PRE_BATTLE1_CYBIL5: This is really shaping up to be the [wave amp=30 freq=10]hottest fight of the year![/wave] Who will come out on top?

messages.LEADER_IANTHE_PRE_BATTLE1_SKIP7.f: C’mon, offworlder – show Ianthe who’s boss!
