messages.LEADER_IANTHE_IN_BATTLE_FUSION.m: [shake rate=30 level=10]What, you thought you were the only ones who could fuse?[/shake]
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_IN_BATTLE_FUSION.n: [shake rate=30 level=10]What, you thought you were the only ones who could fuse?[/shake]
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_IN_BATTLE_FUSION.f: [shake rate=30 level=10]What, you thought you were the only ones who could fuse?[/shake]
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_IANTHE1: Not bad! [pause]Not bad at all! [pause]You never fail to impress, do you?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_WILMA2: The stories were true! What a battle!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_IANTHE4.m: This means you’re officially a ranger captain. Folks will look to you to help train them just like the other captains trained you.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_IANTHE5: You might be aware that I was the first person in New Wirral to have transformed into a monster form with a cassette tape. [pause]Since then, folks have been asking me the same question…
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_IANTHE4.n: This means you’re officially a ranger captain. Folks will look to you to help train them just like the other captains trained you.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_IANTHE8: Humans create [wave amp=30 freq=10]art[/wave], such as music – [pause]art is an intangible and imaginary thing that exists entirely within our collective imagination.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_IANTHE4.f: This means you’re officially a ranger captain. Folks will look to you to help train them just like the other captains trained you.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_IANTHE6: “How does this cassette tape thing even work? [pause]It doesn’t make any sense!”
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL1: Rogue Fusions drop it. Maybe Archangels do too – I’m not sure.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_IANTHE7: You want to know what I think? [pause]I think it makes perfect sense with the right perspective.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_IANTHE9: Then, [pause]we seal that intangible music in physical forms – such the [wave amp=30 freq=10]cassette tape[/wave]. [pause]That makes it a perfect bridge between the physical world and the imaginary one.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_IANTHE11: You’ve seen the noticeboard outside the Town Hall, right? [pause]If there are any trainees who need to test their skills, I’ll leave you a message there.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_IANTHE10: I think that makes sense, in a way!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_IANTHE12: For now, I’m going to take a long overdue rest. [pause]If you’re going to continue your exploration across the island, why don’t you catch up with your fellow captains?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_POST_BATTLE_IANTHE13: I’m sure they’d like to congratulate you on your “promotion”!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL_NOT_CAPTAIN: As for why we’re asking rangers to collect it... Well, let the captains worry about that. Just focus on passing your training for now.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL2.f: Now that you’re a captain you ought to know why we’re gathering all this Fused Material.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL2.n: Now that you’re a captain you ought to know why we’re gathering all this Fused Material.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL2.m: Now that you’re a captain you ought to know why we’re gathering all this Fused Material.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL3: Have you noticed “Rogue Fusions” are becoming more plentiful across New Wirral?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL4A: That figures. That means you know they’re a lot tougher than the typical monsters found here on New Wirral, then.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL4B: You might have encountered them around the island in your travels – [pause]they’re wild monster fusions, often surrounded by black clouds? Can’t miss ‘em.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL5: It wasn’t always this way. Until a few years ago, fusions were an oddity.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL6: We don’t know where they’re coming from, or why.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL7: My concern is that if the incidence rate continues to grow, in a few years Harbourtown will be overrun.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL8: I don’t want to cause panic, so keep that to yourself.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL9: There is hope, though! The Fused Material we get from them gives off a faint radiation – not enough to be harmful, but...
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL11: Maybe…[pause] maybe we can even find out where they’re coming from, and stop their spread. That would be nice.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSED_MATERIAL10: With enough Fused Material, we can build devices to track and detect Rogue Fusions.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_ELEMENTAL_TYPES_IANTHE1: Have you been paying attention to the elemental types of your monster forms?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSION_IANTHE1: Fusion… [pause]it’s rarely been achieved. I have my theories on what allows two people to fuse, but I’m not certain.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_ELEMENTAL_TYPES_IANTHE2: Elemental moves can cause [wave amp=30 freq=10]chemical reactions[/wave] when used against monsters of certain types.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_ELEMENTAL_TYPES_IANTHE4: However, that same fire move, [pause]when used on a water monster, [pause]will surround them with a [wave amp=30 freq=10]healing steam[/wave]. Not so good, huh?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_ELEMENTAL_TYPES_IANTHE3: These reactions can be beneficial for you – for example, using a fire move on a poison element target will cause them to burn.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_ELEMENTAL_TYPES_IANTHE5: You can always see what status effects your attack is going to cause before you trigger it, so stay observant.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_ELEMENTAL_TYPES_IANTHE6: Oh, I almost forgot! [pause]A lot of moves, such as “Smack” and “Spit”, don’t have an innate element themselves – they will instead depend on whatever element their user is.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSION_IANTHE3: If you want to strengthen your fusion, then you have to grow that bond.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_FUSION_IANTHE2: I can say from experience that the strength of the bond between two people seems to directly enhance the strength and capabilities of their fused form.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_TURN_IN.m: Thanks for your efforts on the tasks I sent you, {player}!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_FR_IANTHE1: Anyway, with all this Fused Material you’ve gathered, I can have Captain Lodestein install Fusion Radar into a few of the magnetic pylons on the island.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_TURN_IN.n: Thanks for your efforts on the tasks I sent you, {player}!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_FR_IANTHE2: In the meantime, I want you to have this prototype.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_TURN_IN.f: Thanks for your efforts on the tasks I sent you, {player}!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_FR_IANTHE3: Check your map. It’ll show you where Rogue Fusions can be found.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_FR_IANTHE4: This version of Fusion Radar doesn’t penetrate very deep into the ground, and it’s not 100% reliable, but I’m sure that you’ll be able to make good use of it.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_FR_IANTHE5: Anyway, don’t forget to exchange your Fused Material with Ranger Wilma. It won’t be much use just sitting in your pockets!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_ANA_IANTHE1: The last batch you gave me proved extremely useful. Captain Lodestein tells me his [wave amp=30 freq=10]ground-penetrating Fusion Radar[/wave] is already picking up a signal deep under Dino Quarry, in the Deadlands.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_ANA_IANTHE2: I’ve assigned Captain Wallace to excavate it when he’s not busy with training and Rogue Fusion duty.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_ANA_IANTHE3: Speaking of fusions, there’s been a, uh, new development...
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_ANA_IANTHE4: Some kind of new, unstable fusion has been popping up all over. “Anathema” is what we’ve been calling it.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_ANA_IANTHE5: The rate these things replicate at is...[pause] troubling to say the least.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_ANA_IANTHE6: I’ll send a few your way via the noticeboard. Would you mind taking a look?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_HELIA_IANTHE2: Well, I had Captain Wallace excavate it, and it looks like another of those train stations that have been popping up everywhere.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_HELIA_IANTHE1: Do you remember the signal under Dino Quarry I told you Captain Lodestein’s Fusion Radar had picked up?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_ANA_IANTHE7: And of course, don’t forget to exchange your Fused Material with Ranger Wilma.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_HELIA_IANTHE3: Judging by the strength of the signal in this station, it could be the source of all the Anathema and Rogue Fusions!
{player}, as our ranger most experienced with these stations…[pause] and their strange inhabitants…[pause] could you take a look?
{player}, as our ranger most experienced with these stations…[pause] and their strange inhabitants…[pause] could you take a look?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_HELIA_IANTHE6: Huh, so the Mer-Line expects us to handle the Rogue Fusion situation ourselves?
{player}, as our ranger most experienced with these stations…[pause] and their strange inhabitants…[pause] could you take a look?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_HELIA_IANTHE7: At least we have Night’s Bridge Station to retreat to if things get bad – thanks to your hard work.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_HELIA_IANTHE8: {player}, I said before that if you left New Wirral I wouldn’t hold it against you, and I still stand by that.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_HELIA_IANTHE9: But if you decide to stick around a bit longer, the work I have for you is literally never-ending.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_HELIA_IANTHE10: I’m sure you know the drill by now.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_STARTER_IANTHE: I believe Kayleigh has something for you.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_STARTER_KAYLEI: Well, I recorded this tape a little while ago, and it reminded me of the day we first met.
I know it’s not much, but I wanted you to have it!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_EGG_IANTHE1: By the way, have you seen any…[pause] giant floating orbs recently?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_EGG_IANTHE2: It was a strange report from one of our new trainees. He [wave amp=30 freq=30]did[/wave] have a head injury though, so maybe it’s nothing.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_NOTICEBOARD_EGG_IANTHE3: Keep an eye on your Fusion Radar, just in case.
messages.OUTPOST_NPC_2_DIALOGUE1: I was ambushed by a Springheel hiding round a corner. [pause]Frankly, I’m lucky to have made it out in one piece!
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_PRE_BATTLE_AA1: YOU MEAT THINGS DREAM OF DEATH SO MUCH. YOU SPEND YOUR ENTIRE SHORT LIVES DREAMING OF IT. IS THAT WHAT BRINGS YOU TO ME?
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_PRE_BATTLE_KAYLEIGH2: Are you asking… if we came here to die? [pause]I don’t think we did, to be honest with you.
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_PRE_BATTLE_MEREDITH2: This guy looks pretty metal. [pause]I get the impression he might want to kill us, though.
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_PRE_BATTLE_EUGENE2: Nah, we came here to fight.
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_PRE_BATTLE_VIOLA2: I fear death not – [pause]a brave death outweighs a coward’s life!
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_PRE_BATTLE_FELIX2: I feel like this doesn’t bode well for us.
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_PRE_BATTLE_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Dying doesn’t scare me… and neither do you…[/wave]
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_PRE_BATTLE_AA3: LET ME FEAST ON YOUR FEAR, AS I SHOW YOU A TRUE DEATH.
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_POST_BATTLE_ALEPH2: OH NEAT, A BIG SKELETON GUY! EVERY TEAM NEEDS ONE OF THOSE.
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_POST_BATTLE_KAYLEIGH3: That was pretty creepy, huh? I wonder if what it said was true… [pause]Maybe people [wave amp=30 freq=10]do[/wave] spend their whole lives thinking about death.
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_POST_BATTLE_LM1: NOT EVEN OUR KIND CAN ESCAPE TRUE DEATH...
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_POST_BATTLE_MEREDITH3: The number of nightmare creatures that want to kill us on this island is just… [pause]way too high.
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_POST_BATTLE_EUGENE3: That was the biggest skeleton monster I’ve [wave amp=30 freq=10]ever[/wave] seen! Pretty creepy, huh?
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_POST_BATTLE_VIOLA3: Cowards die many times before their deaths, but the valiant never taste of death but once.
messages.AA_LAMENTO_MORI_POST_BATTLE_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]We did a pretty good job of showing that Archangel how fearless we are, I think…[/wave]
messages.AA_PUPPET_PRE_BATTLE_AA1: ARE YOU MORE TOYS FOR MY COLLECTION? I DESIRE MORE PLAYTHINGS...
messages.AA_PUPPET_PRE_BATTLE_MEREDITH2: Sorry, mate. We’re not here to play.
messages.AA_PUPPET_PRE_BATTLE_KAYLEIGH2: This Archangel’s eyes are creeping me out...
messages.AA_PUPPET_PRE_BATTLE_EUGENE2: Are people just toys to your kind, huh?!
messages.AA_PUPPET_PRE_BATTLE_VIOLA2: I sense no kindness in this spirit’s words.
messages.AA_PUPPET_PRE_BATTLE_FELIX2: I don’t know if this guy has our best interests at heart.
messages.AA_PUPPET_PRE_BATTLE_AA3: YES… YOU TWO WILL MAKE A FINE PAIR OF GLOVE PUPPETS! HAHAHAHA
messages.AA_PUPPET_PRE_BATTLE_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]We’re not here to play… we’re here on business.[/wave]
messages.AA_PUPPET_HINT_MEREDITH1: It keeps [shake rate=30 level=10]moving[/shake] before we can hit it! There’s gotta be [wave amp=30 freq=10]some way to tell[/wave] which direction it’s gonna move in.
messages.AA_PUPPET_HINT_KAYLEIGH1: It keeps moving before our attacks land! Keep an eye out  –  there must be [wave amp=30 freq=10]some way to tell[/wave] which direction it’s going to move...
messages.AA_PUPPET_HINT_EUGENE1: Dammit, it keeps moving right when we’re about to hit it! C’mon there’s gotta be [wave amp=30 freq=10]some way to tell[/wave] which way it’s gonna move next…
messages.AA_PUPPET_HINT_FELIX1: Huh. It moves before our attacks even hit it. We gotta think smart – there’s gotta be [wave amp=30 freq=10]some way to tell[/wave] which way it’s gonna move next…
messages.AA_PUPPET_HINT_VIOLA1: Our quarry is quick on its feet, and our strikes are missing their mark. Alas, I believe there must be [wave amp=30 freq=10]a way to discern[/wave] where it intends to leap to next…
messages.AA_PUPPET_HINT_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]There must be a way to figure out where it’s going to move…[/wave]
messages.AA_PUPPET_HINT_DOG1: Barkley seems unhappy that the Archangel keeps moving before either of you can attack it. Perhaps there is a way to figure out which direction it is going to move?
messages.AA_PUPPET_POST_BATTLE_PUPPET1: MY DOLLS! YOU HAVE KILLED MY DOLLS!
messages.AA_PUPPET_POST_BATTLE_ALEPH2: NICE TO MEET YOU, MY HATTED FRIEND! SAY, ARE YOU LOOKING FOR A NEW LINE OF WORK? LET’S TALK!
messages.AA_PUPPET_POST_BATTLE_KAYLEIGH3: The way that Archangel spoke about us, it was like we weren’t even real… like we were just toys. [pause]Maybe it’ll think differently now that we beat it.
messages.AA_PUPPET_POST_BATTLE_EUGENE3: There’s [wave amp=30 freq=10]always[/wave] some monster who thinks that people’s lives are their playthings. [pause]Archangel or man, they’re dangerous all the same.
messages.AA_PUPPET_POST_BATTLE_MEREDITH3: That Archangel better have learned that I am [wave amp=30 freq=10]no-one’s[/wave] plaything.
messages.AA_PUPPET_POST_BATTLE_FELIX3: Did he make… [pause]dolls of us? I don’t think I’ll sleep easy after that fight, that’s for sure.
messages.AA_PUPPET_POST_BATTLE_VIOLA3: That spirit saw us as mere toys. Let that be a lesson to us that their kind and ours are not alike, even in the slightest.
messages.AA_TOWER_PRE_BATTLE_AA1: TRUTH… LIES… YOUR FLEDGLING KIND CARE SO MUCH ABOUT SUCH TRIVIAL CONCEPTS. REALITY IS NOT TRUE! EMBRACE IGNORANCE!
messages.AA_PUPPET_POST_BATTLE_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I think we showed it that we aren’t playing around![/wave]
messages.AA_TOWER_PRE_BATTLE_MEREDITH2: This thing certainly has a questionable grip on “reality”.
messages.AA_TOWER_PRE_BATTLE_KAYLEIGH2: This thing certainly needs a reality check.
messages.AA_TOWER_PRE_BATTLE_EUGENE2: ...I don’t get it. What are you trying to say?
messages.AA_TOWER_PRE_BATTLE_FELIX2: As much as I’d love to “embrace ignorance”, I’ve got stuff to do.
messages.AA_TOWER_PRE_BATTLE_VIOLA2: Folly and ignorance are the common curses of mankind. Both are [wave amp=30 freq=10]already[/wave] plentiful, spirit.
messages.AA_TOWER_PRE_BATTLE_AA3: YOU DO NOT UNDERSTAND. LET ME AWAKEN YOU FROM YOUR FALSE PERCEPTIONS OF TRUTH AND LIES!
messages.AA_TOWER_PRE_BATTLE_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I am afraid I don’t know what you’re talking about…[/wave]
messages.AA_TOWER_POST_BATTLE_TOWER1: THERE IS ONE TRUTH NOW CLEAR TO ME… I HAVE BEEN BESTED…
messages.AA_TOWER_POST_BATTLE_KAYLEIGH3: I think we gave that Archangel a “reality check”, wouldn’t you say?
messages.AA_TOWER_POST_BATTLE_ALEPH2: HEY, BUDDY! LOOKS LIKE YOU’RE LOSING A FIGHT HERE. WHY DON’T YOU COME WITH ME?
messages.AA_TOWER_POST_BATTLE_EUGENE3: Archangels may be powerful, but that doesn’t mean that they’re smart.
messages.AA_TOWER_POST_BATTLE_MEREDITH3: I guess even the most [wave amp=30 freq=10]annoying[/wave] Archangel will shut up if you punch it enough times. We should take that lesson to heart.
messages.AA_TOWER_POST_BATTLE_FELIX3: That Archangel was a pretty big fan of talking nonsense, huh? At least we got it to shut up.
messages.AA_TOWER_POST_BATTLE_VIOLA3: That spirit had little sense left in its words. Perhaps its defeat at our hands shall humble it.
messages.AA_TOWER_POST_BATTLE_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Archangels are pretty strange, aren’t they…?[/wave]
messages.AA_ALICE_PRE_BATTLE_ALICE1: YOU IGNORED MY INSTRUCTIONS TO STAY PUT! DON’T YOU RESPECT ME? DON’T YOU REALISE JUST HOW IMPORTANT I AM?!
messages.AA_ALICE_PRE_BATTLE_KAYLEIGH2: You’ve got a pretty big ego, huh?
messages.AA_ALICE_PRE_BATTLE_MEREDITH2: No, you’re right. I totally don’t respect you.
messages.AA_ALICE_PRE_BATTLE_EUGENE2: Buddy, I have NO idea who you are.
messages.AA_ALICE_PRE_BATTLE_FELIX2: Are we supposed to know who you are…?
messages.AA_ALICE_PRE_BATTLE_VIOLA2: My respect is not so wantonly given, spirit.
messages.AA_ALICE_PRE_BATTLE_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I’m sorry, but I don’t know who you are…[/wave]
messages.AA_ALICE_PRE_BATTLE_ALICE3: SUCH RUDENESS, TOWARDS A MEMBER OF ROYALTY NO LESS! IF YOU REFUSE TO USE YOUR HEADS, I’LL JUST HAVE TO TAKE THEM FROM YOUR SHOULDERS!
messages.AA_ALICE_POST_BATTLE_ALICE1: YOU REALLY HAVE NO RESPECT, DO YOU? HOW INFURIATING!
messages.AA_ALICE_POST_BATTLE_KAYLEIGH3: I guess she saw herself as the queen of her own little world, huh?
messages.AA_ALICE_POST_BATTLE_ALEPH2: MISS ALICE, PLEASURE TO MEET YOU! I NEED SOMEONE WITH YOUR… PEOPLE SKILLS.
messages.AA_ALICE_POST_BATTLE_MEREDITH3: Do all Archangels think so highly of themselves, or was she just a [wave amp=30 freq=10]special[/wave] case?
messages.AA_ALICE_POST_BATTLE_EUGENE3: These Archangels are pretty rude, huh?
messages.AA_CUBE_PRE_BATTLE_CUBE1: 3RD DIMENSIONAL SPACE IS IMPERFECT. SCIENCE AND MATHEMATICS REMAIN TRUE. ALL THINGS HAVE 4 SIDES.
messages.AA_ALICE_POST_BATTLE_FELIX3: Do you think that Archangel really wanted our heads, or do you think it was a turn of phrase? Actually, don’t answer that. I don’t want to know.
messages.AA_ALICE_POST_BATTLE_VIOLA3: I will not bow to anyone who speaks so brazenly to me, royalty or otherwise.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_EUGENE9: Aleph loves to hear himself talk. How [wave amp=30 freq=10]does[/wave] he even talk, anyway? His head is, like, a giant triangle. What a creep.
messages.AA_CUBE_PRE_BATTLE_MEREDITH2: I’d say this thing hasn’t got its head screwed on right, [pause]but it seems to lack a head altogether.
messages.AA_CUBE_PRE_BATTLE_KAYLEIGH2: This Archangel seems a bit eccentric, but maybe it’s a friendly one!
messages.AA_CUBE_PRE_BATTLE_FELIX2: Perhaps this one won’t try to attack us. What do you think?
messages.AA_CUBE_PRE_BATTLE_EUGENE2: This thing is kind of hard to look at...
messages.AA_CUBE_PRE_BATTLE_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I am afraid I don’t know what you’re talking about…[/wave]
messages.AA_CUBE_PRE_BATTLE_VIOLA2: Is this spirit a philosopher of sorts? Or is it simply in the grips of madness?
messages.AA_CUBE_PRE_BATTLE_CUBE3: NO. I SEE INCONSISTENCY WITHIN YOU. YOU ARE IMPERFECT BEINGS. LET ME RIGHT ALL YOUR WRONG ANGLES!
messages.AA_CUBE_POST_BATTLE_CUBE1: ARE MY ANGLES IMPERFECT ALSO? THE CALCULATIONS WERE CORRECT... I HAVE FAILED IN 3 SIMULTANEOUS DIMENSIONS.
messages.AA_CUBE_POST_BATTLE_ALEPH2: WHAT GOOD TIMING! I WAS JUST THINKING HOW I NEEDED TO RECRUIT SOMEONE WHO’S GOOD WITH NUMBERS. HOW’D YOU LIKE A JOB, MY NEW CUBOID FRIEND?
messages.AA_CUBE_POST_BATTLE_KAYLEIGH3: It turned out that wasn’t a friendly Archangel after all. Just our luck!
messages.AA_CUBE_POST_BATTLE_MEREDITH3.n: I guess that was another addition to my list of “weird things on this island that tried to kill me”. [pause]Great stuff, mate.
messages.AA_CUBE_POST_BATTLE_MEREDITH3.f: I guess that was another addition to my list of “weird things on this island that tried to kill me”. [pause]Great stuff, mate.
messages.AA_CUBE_POST_BATTLE_EUGENE3: That Archangel was strange. It felt like no matter what angle I saw it from, it looked the same.
messages.AA_CUBE_POST_BATTLE_MEREDITH3.m: I guess that was another addition to my list of “weird things on this island that tried to kill me”. [pause]Great stuff, mate.
messages.AA_CUBE_POST_BATTLE_FELIX3: Next time we meet an Archangel, I’ll just assume it wants to kill us straight away.
messages.AA_CUBE_POST_BATTLE_VIOLA3: If there was method in that spirit’s madness, I did not see it.
messages.AA_CUBE_POST_BATTLE_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Archangels are pretty strange, aren’t they…?[/wave]
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KAYLEIGH1: So, now there’s a mysterious man with a [wave amp=30 freq=10]triangle for a head[/wave] intervening in the hunt for the Archangels? I don’t know what to make of that…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KAYLEIGH3: That triangle man appeared again. What do you think he wants with the Archangels?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KAYLEIGH2: Another Archangel battle that ended with an appearance from the [wave amp=30 freq=10]triangle man[/wave]. I’m picking up on a pattern here…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KAYLEIGH4: The triangle man said he wanted to have a “proper talk” with you. What did he mean…?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KAYLEIGH6: Once again, the Archangel was magicked away by the triangle man. It feels like a cause for concern, doesn’t it?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KAYLEIGH5: I’m beginning to think that the triangle man is up to no good. We should keep an eye out for him.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KAYLEIGH7: How many times have you seen the triangle man at this point, {player}? It sounds to me like he keeps popping up wherever you go, doesn’t it?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KAYLEIGH8: Once again, the triangle man turned up to whisk away the Archangel we were fighting…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_KAYLEIGH5: Once again we beat an Archangel, only for Aleph to appear and recruit them… What is he doing, exactly? Is he stuck on this island, just like us?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KAYLEIGH9: If the triangle man wants to keep turning up out of the blue to recruit the Archangel we just beat, he could at least stop being rude and introduce himself, don’t you think?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_KAYLEIGH6: We won the fight, but Aleph was there to warp out the Archangel again…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_KAYLEIGH7: Aleph said that our worlds have “legends” based on him. Could that be true, {player}?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_KAYLEIGH8: Do you think every fight we win with an Archangel is just a recruiting opportunity for Aleph? I wonder…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_KAYLEIGH9: Another Archangel down, another recruit for Aleph. What is he planning, exactly?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_MEREDITH1: So, uh, what was with that triangle-headed man? Did he… [pause][wave amp=30 freq=10]warp[/wave] the Archangel away? I don’t know what to make of that…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_MEREDITH2: This isn’t the first time that triangle bloke has appeared to nab an Archangel, is it? That doesn’t seem good…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_MEREDITH3: What do you think the deal is with the triangle bloke, then? I don’t trust anyone with a geometric shape for a head.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_MEREDITH5: Maybe next time you see the man with the triangle head, you could ask him what his whole deal is? It’s worth a shot…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_MEREDITH4: That triangle man said he wants to “have a proper talk” with you. He’s weirdly civil for a creepy floating guy.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_MEREDITH6: Are we assuming the bloke with a triangle head is plotting something grim? I’m assuming that.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_MEREDITH8: No matter who you’re with, every battle with an Archangel seems to end with the triangle man appearing, doesn’t it?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_MEREDITH7: Well, that ended with yet another unsurprising appearance from the triangle head man. Annoying as usual…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_MEREDITH6: That Aleph gets around, doesn’t he? It seems like he can get anywhere as long as it's within the underground railway station.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_MEREDITH9.m: Why does that triangle bloke talk like a small business owner? It’s weird, mate.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_MEREDITH5: That Aleph bloke made another appearance.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_MEREDITH9.n: Why does that triangle bloke talk like a small business owner? It’s weird, mate.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_MEREDITH9.f: Why does that triangle bloke talk like a small business owner? It’s weird, mate.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_MEREDITH7: Well, that ended with yet another unsurprising appearance from Aleph. Annoying as usual…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_MEREDITH8: No matter who you’re with, every battle with an Archangel seems to end with an unwanted appearance from Aleph, doesn’t it?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_MEREDITH9.m: Why does that Aleph bloke talk like a small business owner? It’s weird, mate.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_MEREDITH9.f: Why does that Aleph bloke talk like a small business owner? It’s weird, mate.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_MEREDITH9.n: Why does that Aleph bloke talk like a small business owner? It’s weird, mate.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_EUGENE1: So, just so we’re on the same page – you also saw the floating guy with the red coat suck up the Archangel with his triangle head, right? [pause]Just making sure.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_EUGENE2: OK, so that’s the second time the man in the red coat has appeared to make an Archangel disappear, am I correct?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_EUGENE3: The floating man in the red coat – that’s the third time he’s appeared and made an Archangel [wave amp=30 freq=10]vanish[/wave], am I right?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_EUGENE5: That was a pretty awesome fight, but right now I’m thinking more about the floating man who turned up at the end. If he’s a threat to Harbourtown, I should keep an eye out for him…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_EUGENE4: The man in the red coat said he wanted to have a “proper talk” with you. That seemed a bit menacing, huh…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_EUGENE6: That man with the triangle head... do you think he’s an Archangel as well? He seems pretty powerful. I don’t trust him one bit.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_EUGENE7: What did that triangle guy mean when he said that there’s “legends” based on him?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_EUGENE8: That triangle man was there again. No surprises there. He seems to appear whenever you find an Archangel, doesn’t he?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_EUGENE9.m: That Archangel talks like he’s an office manager. That weirds me out, buddy.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_FELIX4: What did the triangle guy mean when he said he wanted to have a “proper talk” with you? He sounds civil but I don’t trust him one bit.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_EUGENE9.f: That Archangel talks like he’s an office manager. That weirds me out, buddy.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_EUGENE9.n: That Archangel talks like he’s an office manager. That weirds me out, buddy.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_EUGENE5: That was a pretty [shake rate=30 level=10]momentous[/shake] fight, but right now I’m just thinking about Aleph. What’s his deal, huh?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_EUGENE7: What did Aleph mean when he said that there’s “legends” based on him?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_EUGENE6: Aleph doesn’t seem to want to fight himself, does he? He always seems to make an appearance AFTER the fighting has stopped.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_EUGENE8: Aleph turned up [wave amp=30 freq=10]again[/wave] after that fight. No surprises there. He seems to appear whenever you find an Archangel, doesn’t he?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_FELIX1: Have you ever seen that guy with the triangle head before? Because I certainly haven’t. Pretty weird, huh?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_FELIX2: So that’s twice now that the triangle head guy has appeared, right? There’s something going on there, but I don’t know what.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_FELIX3: The triangle head guy seemed to remember you this time, {player}.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_FELIX6: That triangle guy… he’s an Archangel too, right? Or something like that…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_FELIX5: That triangle guy was back again to help bail out the Archangel. Is he recruiting them?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_VIOLA1: Have you ever seen a sight as curious as that figure who appeared to us earlier? Not the spirit we fought, but the man whose head was not there…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_FELIX7: That triangle guy said that our world has legends based on him. What did he mean, exactly?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_FELIX8: What do you make of that triangle guy, {player}? I’m working on some theories…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_FELIX5: So, Aleph appeared again to help bail out the Archangel we fought. What is he gathering them for? Is he trying to find a way to leave New Wirral?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_FELIX9: So that triangle guy IS recruiting Archangels. What is he going to do, put together a band?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_FELIX7: Aleph said that our world has legends based on him. I don’t trust a word he says, but I have the feeling he might be telling the truth this time…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_FELIX6: When Aleph appeared earlier, his tone of voice was very familiar. It was like he was giving the Archangel we fought a [wave amp=30 freq=10]job offer[/wave]...
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_FELIX8: We won the battle, but Aleph was there once again. We should be careful, {player}.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_FELIX9: Why is Aleph recruiting Archangels, anyway? What is he going to do, put together a band?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_VIOLA3: That spirit – the one who’s face reflects my own back at me – appeared to recognise you, {player}. What machinations could it be devising?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_VIOLA2: That spirit appeared again to you – the one whose face is that of a mirror. What could his untimely appearance mean?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_VIOLA4: That spirit with the mirror face seemed to wish to speak with you, {player}. I advise you to be wary of any words it might have to share with you.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_VIOLA6: What may that spirit with the mirrored face be planning? I do not trust the plans of spirits, {player}.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_VIOLA5: The spirit with the triangle head was there to intervene in our battle once again. A curious being it is…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_VIOLA7: That spirit who appeared to us – the one with the mirror face – what does he want?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_VIOLA8: Our foe once again escaped our grasp due to the untimely arrival of the mirror-faced spirit. How uncouth.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_VIOLA7: We may have bested the mighty spirit, but the spirit Aleph intervened to rescue it. I cannot help but notice a pattern…
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_VIOLA9: Surely the mirror-faced spirit should be courteous enough to introduce himself to us, no? His untimely appearances are not welcomed at all.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_VIOLA6: What agenda may our foe “Aleph” be devising? I do not trust the plans of spirits, {player}.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_ALEPH_KNOWN_VIOLA5: The spirit “Aleph” was there to intervene in our battle once again. Perhaps he wishes to leave this country also?

messages.RETROSPECTIVE_MIRROR_POSTINT_FELIX1: Hey, remember when you told me about how you left the “Amber Lodge” by stepping into a mirror? Have you tried that with that lone mirror you discovered?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_MIRROR_ENTERED_KAYLEIGH1.m: Anyway, when we’re all prepared, we should probably explore that [wave amp=30 freq=10]mysterious world[/wave] hidden in the mirror again.

messages.RETROSPECTIVE_NEXT_KAYLEIGH1: Right, let’s crack on! Where are we off to next? Didn’t you hear some rumours about something happening {location_phrase}? We could see what’s happening there, if you want!
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_NEXT_KAYLEIGH2: Shall we get back to it? If you don’t have any rumours to go off, why not ask around town?
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_NEXT_MEREDITH1: Uh, I guess we better get back to [wave amp=30 freq=10]adventuring[/wave]. Didn’t you hear some rumours about something happening {location_phrase}? That might be a good place to check out.
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_NEXT_EUGENE1.m: Shall we hit the road again, buddy? You heard some rumours about something going down {location_phrase}, right? We could try going there!
messages.RETROSPECTIVE_NEXT_MEREDITH2: I guess we should head out again. We could speak to people around town if you’re looking for some leads.

messages.RETROSPECTIVE_NEXT_VIOLA2: Perhaps we would do well to speak to the people of this town, in order to gather information on where we should travel to next. What say you?
messages.NWP_SIGNPOST_DESCRIPTION_2: Please exercise appropriate caution around the monsters here.
messages.NWP_3_-3_RUNNER_NPC1: Know what’s faster than running?[pause] Fast travel!
messages.NWP_3_-3_RUNNER_NPC3.m: You can also fast travel to escape a battle you’re too slow to flee.[pause] You’ll have to abandon some items to get away quickly, but it might just save your life!
messages.NWP_3_-3_RUNNER_NPC3.f: You can also fast travel to escape a battle you’re too slow to flee.[pause] You’ll have to abandon some items to get away quickly, but it might just save your life!
messages.NWP_3_-3_RUNNER_NPC2: To do it, you just press {control.map_menu} to open your map. Then move your cursor to one of the squares that can be traveled to and press {control.ui_accept}.

messages.NWP_RANGER_WANNABE_2_-4_POST_BATTLE: The rangers will never employ me. I’m ‘elpless.
messages.NWP_RANGER_WANNABE_2_-4_PRE_BATTLE: Go back home! The rangers’ job opening is mine!
messages.NWP_RANGER_RECRUITER_2_-4_PRE_BATTLE: Are you good enough to join the rangers?
messages.NWP_RANGER_RECRUITER_2_-4_POST_BATTLE: You show promise! You should head inside!
messages.NWP_RANGER_WANNABE_3_-4_PRE_BATTLE: Just what we were looking for! Someone to beat to prove our worth to the rangers!
messages.NWP_RANGER_WANNABE_3_-4_POST_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Who am I kidding? I’m not… good enough for the rangers...[/wave]
messages.NWP_RANGER_WANNABE_4_-3_PRE_BATTLE1: It’s always been my dream to join the rangers.
messages.NWP_MADMAN_3_-4_PRE_BATTLE: I have the world record for time spent in Springheel form!
messages.NWP_MADMAN_3_-4_POST_BATTLE: I still have much to learn about Springheel.
messages.NWP_RANGER_WANNABE_4_-3_PRE_BATTLE2: I can’t let that dream end now!
messages.NWP_RANGER_WANNABE_4_-3_POST_BATTLE: Don’t let your dreams be dreams!
messages.NWP_CULTIST_4_-4_PRE_BATTLE: May the guiding light of Leader Dorian show you the way!
messages.NWP_CULTIST_5_-4_PRE_BATTLE.m: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Newcomer![/wave] Heed not the heathens of Harbourtown!
messages.NWP_CULTIST_4_-4_POST_BATTLE: The way has been lit… go forth…
messages.NWP_CULTIST_5_-4_PRE_BATTLE.f: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Newcomer![/wave] Heed not the heathens of Harbourtown!
messages.NWP_CULTIST_5_-4_POST_BATTLE: Heretics control Harbourtown… beware their [wave amp=30 freq=10]false salvation[/wave]…
messages.NWP_5_-4_HINT_NPC_BEFORE1: The ground around here trembles at times, as if a huge beast rushes through a tunnel below our feet.
messages.NWP_CULTIST_5_-4_PRE_BATTLE.n: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Newcomer![/wave] Heed not the heathens of Harbourtown!
messages.NWP_5_-4_HINT_NPC_AFTER1: Is this another train station, like the one that appeared in Upper Path recently?
messages.NWP_5_-4_HINT_NPC_BEFORE2: Say,[pause] these rocks are arranged in a strange pattern, huh?
messages.NWP_5_-4_HINT_NPC_AFTER3: I wonder where the train goes...
messages.NWP_5_-4_HINT_NPC_AFTER2: I guess that makes sense. The ‘huge beast’ I heard underground must have been a train.
messages.NWP_5_-3_HINT_NPC_DIALOGUE1: I’ve seen some Bulletinos near here that move fast enough to break large rocks.
messages.NWP_5_-3_HINT_NPC_DIALOGUE2: That’d be a neat skill to have, huh?
messages.PARK_CAVE2_MERCHANT2: Oh no, they’ve fused! [wave amp=30 freq=30]HELP![/wave]
messages.PARK_CAVE2_MERCHANT1: Hey, you over there! These monsters have me cornered. Could you give me a hand here?
messages.PARK_CAVE2_MERCHANT6: Come see me at the market back in town. I’ll have some special stickers for you!
messages.PARK_CAVE2_MERCHANT4: Say... Did you notice Southpaw’s move ‘Magnet’ activates automatically at the start of battle?
messages.PARK_CAVE2_MERCHANT3: Whew, thanks for that. I came in here looking for some sticker ideas, but I ended up getting more than I bargained for.
messages.PARK_CAVE2_MERCHANT5: I think I got my inspiration after all!
messages.WATERLOOP_BEWARE_LYING_CHESTS: Only one locker tells the truth.
messages.OVERWORLD_5_0_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE2.n: I was floating above my body in bed and then – whoosh! – sucked down a vortex.
messages.WATERLOOP_LYING_CHEST_LEFTMOST: A note on this locker says, “the key is in this box”. Open it?
messages.WATERLOOP_LYING_CHEST_RIGHTMOST: A note on this locker says, “the key is not in this box”. Open it?
messages.WATERLOOP_LYING_CHEST_MIDDLE: A note on this locker says, “the key is not in the leftmost box”. Open it?
messages.SD_NEVERMORT_TRAINER_PRE_BATTLE1: I have a special bond with the Nevermorts around here.
messages.OVERWORLD_5_0_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.m: How did you arrive in New Wirral?
messages.SD_NEVERMORT_TRAINER_PRE_BATTLE2: You’d better not get in our way!
messages.AUTUMN_HILL_NW_SIGNPOST_1: “You are not lost here in New Wirral, my children, you are simply waiting to find yourself.”
messages.OVERWORLD_5_0_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.n: How did you arrive in New Wirral?
messages.OVERWORLD_5_0_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE1: I remember having an out of body experience.
messages.OVERWORLD_5_0_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.f: How did you arrive in New Wirral?
messages.OVERWORLD_5_0_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE2.m: I was floating above my body in bed and then – whoosh! – sucked down a vortex.
messages.OVERWORLD_5_0_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE2.f: I was floating above my body in bed and then – whoosh! – sucked down a vortex.
messages.OVERWORLD_5_0_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE3: Next thing I knew, here I was!
messages.OVERWORLD_6_0_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE1: Ships often get wrecked just off the coast of New Wirral.
messages.OVERWORLD_6_0_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE2: Scouring the beaches for washed up treasure is a pretty good way to make a living here!
messages.OVERWORLD_7_0_HINT_NPC: I wonder how much treasure is lost on the sea floor…
messages.OVERWORLD_8_0_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE1: Hey, I see your tape player!
messages.OVERWORLD_8_0_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: Looks like I have my work cut out for me…
messages.OVERWORLD_8_0_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE2: Are you also trying to join the rangers? I guess that makes us rivals!
messages.OVERWORLD_5_-1_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE: I'll tell you a secret if you can beat me.
messages.OVERWORLD_5_-1_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE1: Legend has it this island holds the Font of Youth.
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-1_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE: Hey, do you like history? What was your favourite event of the 20th century?
messages.OVERWORLD_5_-1_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE2: Do you think it's Comic Sans or Times New Roman?
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-1_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: My favourite 20th century event was the Human-Elf peace deal brokered by the United Nations in 1948. Without that, things would have gone very differently!
messages.EPICURUS_POST_BATTLE: The art of battling well and the art of taking defeat well are one.
messages.EPICURUS_PRE_BATTLE: The greater the difficulty, the more the glory in surmounting it!
messages.OVERWORLD_5_-2_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE1: I've been honing my monster skills out here for months, now.
messages.OVERWORLD_5_-2_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: I guess I still have a lot more training to do…
messages.OVERWORLD_5_-2_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE2: C'mon, let me show you the results of my training!
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-2_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]STOP! I know why you're here…[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-2_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]There will be more opportunities for me, I'm sure…[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-2_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]This land is a perfect urban development opportunity! But I found it first![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-2_HISTORIAN_PRE_BATTLE1: Nobody in New Wirral can seem to agree on basic historical facts. Some choose to accept the idea of a 'multiverse,\' but I think this island is just full of liars!
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-2_HISTORIAN_PRE_BATTLE2: For instance, a lot of people here deny that the 1969 Mars landing happened! Conspiracy freaks, the lot of them!
messages.OVERWORLD_8_-2_HISTORIAN_PRE_BATTLE: Ah, I need a break from digging. If you can beat me in a quick battle, I'll tell you a little about this place.
messages.OVERWORLD_8_-2_HISTORIAN_POST_BATTLE1: We know from Captain Dreadful that people used to mine this area for metals. But not all the explosions that happened here seem to have been controlled...
messages.OVERWORLD_8_-2_HISTORIAN_POST_BATTLE2: And I can't find any traces of mining tools or artificial explosives. It\'s possible this whole area was excavated by Bulletinos over several centuries.
messages.OVERWORLD_8_-2_HISTORIAN_POST_BATTLE3: So either the Captain is wrong, or Bulletinos have destroyed all the evidence. Or, hmm... Maybe the evidence [wave amp=30 freq=5]became[/wave] the Bulletinos. What do you think?
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-3_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE: I dreamed about this island when I was little!
messages.OVERWORLD_5_-3_BATTLER_PAIR_PRE_BATTLE: My husband and I have been stuck here since 2160!
messages.OVERWORLD_5_-3_BATTLER_PAIR_POST_BATTLE: Nobody here seems to know about the three seashells. How barbaric!
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-3_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE: You landkeepers will do anything for the people of New Wirral but get off their backs!
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-3_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]No money? No problem! We're offering financing at a mere 10,000% per annum![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-3_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: Ah, I was mistaken; you fight FOR the people, not against them.
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-4_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE1: All of us in New Wirral have taken a step into the unknown. Why not take one more? Place your trust in [wave amp=30 freq=10]Brother Cooper[/wave]!
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-3_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]New Wirral doesn't have a currency, so there\'s no way to pay it off yet. Interest continues to compound in the meantime, however. It\'s a perfect scheme![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-4_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE2: Brother Cooper has found a [wave amp=30 freq=10]way off[/wave] this island of demons and angels, and now prepares us to rejoin our families on the other side!
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-5_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE1.m: Stop! I can sense the pain within you, my friend.
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-5_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE1.f: Stop! I can sense the pain within you, my friend.
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-5_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE1.n: Stop! I can sense the pain within you, my friend.
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-6_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE.f: You will go no farther until you repent for your shins.
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-5_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE2: You suffer because you desire to be home.
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-5_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE3: Allow me to end your pain – become our tribute to the angels!
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-6_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE.m: You will go no farther until you repent for your shins.
messages.OVERWORLD_8_-6_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE: Brother Cooper has called down the UFOs to bestow boons upon us. Allow me to show you!
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-6_CULTIST_POST_BATTLE: Wait, it's meant to be \'repent for your sins?\' I can\'t believe I had it wrong all this time…
messages.OVERWORLD_6_-6_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE.n: You will go no farther until you repent for your shins.
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-6_CULTIST_PAIR_POST_BATTLE: “Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one’s tapes for one’s friends.” – Dorian 15:13
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-6_CULTIST_PAIR_PARTNER.m: When your soul is weighed by the archangels, will they judge you worthy of eternity?
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-6_CULTIST_PAIR_PARTNER.f: When your soul is weighed by the archangels, will they judge you worthy of eternity?
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-6_CULTIST_PAIR_PARTNER.n: When your soul is weighed by the archangels, will they judge you worthy of eternity?
messages.OVERWORLD_8_-6_CULTIST_POST_BATTLE: The intergalactic council of UFOs and Archangels won't stand for such mistreatment of their messengers…
messages.OVERWORLD_8_-5_CULTIST_POST_BATTLE: In all honesty, I only joined the Mournchildren for the food.
messages.OVERWORLD_8_-3_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE: Beat me, and I'll tell you the secret of the Mournchild.
messages.OVERWORLD_8_-3_CULTIST_POST_BATTLE1: In 1988 two English rock bands, Iron Gaiden and Shields of the Nephilim – [pause]without knowledge of each other – [pause]simultaneously released songs titled 'Mournchild.\'
messages.OVERWORLD_8_-3_CULTIST_POST_BATTLE3: Or so I've heard. [pause]Neither track is available here in New Wirral, so I\'ve got no way to tell if I\'m having my leg pulled…
messages.OVERWORLD_8_-3_CULTIST_POST_BATTLE2: If you listen to them in reverse, and at the same time so that the words interweave, it summons the original Mournchild: a being so powerful that it can open a gateway between worlds!
messages.OVERWORLD_8_-3_CULTIST_POST_BATTLE4: Brother Cooper has found a different way out of New Wirral, anyway, [shake rate=30 level=10]that's for sure[/shake]!
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-4_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE: Go easy on me, OK? I'm still new to this Mournchild cult thing and don\'t want to look bad in front of the others.
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-4_CULTIST_POST_BATTLE: Hold on, lemme check what my book says I'm supposed to do when I\'m defeated.
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-3_CULTIST_POST_BATTLE: Maybe I'm not cult out for this after all…
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-3_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE: Haha, I always wanted to join an evil cult! Now I finally can!
messages.OVERWORLD_2_-5_RANGER_POST_BATTLE: Somehow I think you'll be alright…
messages.OVERWORLD_2_-5_RANGER_PRE_BATTLE: Hey! You! This place isn’t safe!
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-5_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE2: I guess, when you think about it, quadrillions had to die for humans to evolve and survive. Nature is a relentless, blood-thirsty beast.
messages.OVERWORLD_4_-5_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE1: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Whoa,[/wave] [pause]sorry about that! I totally lost myself in the Pombomb tape.
messages.OVERWORLD_4_-5_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE2: Now where did I bury that bone...?
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-2_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE: I heard this used to be a river, so I came over to fill it back up!
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-5_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE: The earth will take care of us all if we just let it.
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-5_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.m: My favorite bands are The Why, Schroedinger's Martyr, and Flesh Cage. Get ready for some [shake rate=30 level=10]heavy metal![/shake]
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-2_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: Uhh my throat is so dry... Sorry ecosystem, you'll have to wait until I\'ve refilled.
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-5_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.f: My favorite bands are The Why, Schroedinger's Martyr, and Flesh Cage. Get ready for some [shake rate=30 level=10]heavy metal![/shake]
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-5_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.n: My favorite bands are The Why, Schroedinger's Martyr, and Flesh Cage. Get ready for some [shake rate=30 level=10]heavy metal![/shake]
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-5_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: Dude, you really kicked my [wave amp=30 freq=10]bass...[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-5_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE1: I thought the earth would help me win…
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-5_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE3: We can't rely on an outside force to save us – least of all a temperamental, impersonal and indifferent planet.
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-5_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE4: We humans must look out for each other, because nobody else will!
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-5_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.n: There's a campsite not far from here, but first, let\'s see how good you are!
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-5_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.f: There's a campsite not far from here, but first, let\'s see how good you are!
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-5_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.m: There's a campsite not far from here, but first, let\'s see how good you are!
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-5_DUNGEON_HINT_NPC1: Hey![pause] Could you stand on this button for a moment?
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-5_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: You'll run into the campsite if you keep heading west. Can\'t miss it!
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-5_DUNGEON_HINT_NPC3: Some speculate that if you stand on the buttons in the right order, and follow all the signposts, it’ll lead you to treasure.
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-5_DUNGEON_HINT_NPC2: This is the first of what the rangers have been calling the “Moving Signposts”.
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-5_DUNGEON_HINT_NPC4: Others say it just takes you in a big loop.
messages.DIOGENES_POST_BATTLE: If only that great idiot Plato could see this island. \"Man is a featherless biped\", my bare bottom!
messages.OVERWORLD_-1_-6_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: I need to work on that pounce…
messages.OVERWORLD_-1_-6_BATTLER2_PRE_BATTLE: Did you know that Clocksley and Ratcousel are natural enemies?
messages.DIVEAL_KEEPER_POST_BATTLE2: Well, since you're here, why not record one of my Diveal? You can use their abilities to swim!
messages.OVERWORLD_-1_-6_BATTLER2_POST_BATTLE: The fact that Clocksley and Ratcousel are natural enemies must be why they don't work so well together.
messages.ZHUANGZI_POST_BATTLE2: Now I don't know whether I was a man dreaming I was a Dominoth, or whether I am now a Dominoth, dreaming I am a man.
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-7_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.m: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Ice[/wave] to meet you! Care for a duel?
messages.DIVEAL_KEEPER_POST_BATTLE1: Ah, I'm out of my depth…
messages.DIVEAL_KEEPER_PRE_BATTLE1: My Diveal have really taken a liking to you.
messages.DIVEAL_KEEPER_PRE_BATTLE2: Now I must fight you to preserve my status as their alpha!
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-7_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Ouch, now my assets are thaw.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_7_-7_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]If you miss a payment on your home, we'll freeze your assets![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-1_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]I came here because I heard there was a bank, but all I see is a river.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-6_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]We're holding a fire sale! For a limited time only, it\'s 100% off... your health bar![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-1_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Well, maybe I'll at least find a revenue stream.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-6_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE.m: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Ouch. Thank you for your... custom.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-6_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE.f: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Ouch. Thank you for your... custom.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-7_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.n: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Ice[/wave] to meet you! Care for a duel?
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-6_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE.n: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Ouch. Thank you for your... custom.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-7_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.f: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Ice[/wave] to meet you! Care for a duel?
messages.DARWIN_POST_BATTLE1: I used to think we stopped looking for monsters under the bed when we realised they were inside us.
messages.DARWIN_PRE_BATTLE1: This island has taught me that it is not the strongest of the species that survives, nor the most intelligent. It is the one most adaptable to change.
messages.DARWIN_POST_BATTLE2: But what would that say about this island? Are these the monsters inside God, or are we simply under His bed, out of sight and long-forgotten?
messages.OVERWORLD_5_-7_BATTLER_PAIR_POST_BATTLE: We're the same, but from different worlds. As far as we can tell, our lives were identical until we arrived here.
messages.OVERWORLD_5_-7_BATTLER_PAIR_PRE_BATTLE: We might look the same, but we're not twins!
messages.OVERWORLD_5_-7_BATTLER_PAIR_PARTNER: We might look the same, but we're not twins!
messages.OVERWORLD_5_-6_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE: Do you know the way back to Rendlesham Forest?
messages.OVERWORLD_5_-6_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: I guess I'm stuck here then.
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-6_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.f: Halt! State your name and affiliation, soldier!
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-6_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.m: Halt! State your name and affiliation, soldier!
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-6_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE.n: Halt! State your name and affiliation, soldier!
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-6_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: I've lost my unit. We were combing the woods near our base in Suffolk. I got separated while on autopilot, and found myself here. I don\'t know how it happened.
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-7_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE: Want to know where your cassette tapes come from? You'll have to beat me first!
messages.DECARTES_POST_BATTLE: I made every mistake that could be made. But I just kept pushing.
messages.DECARTES_PRE_BATTLE: It is not enough to have a good tape; the main thing is to use it well.
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-7_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Not since Nyxon took us off the ghoul standard have we seen such a rush to purchase property![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-7_LANDKEEPER2_POST_BATTLE1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]New Wirral's favour and barter economy is quaint but it\'s not going to last.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-7_LANDKEEPER2_PRE_BATTLE1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]The Landkeepers are here to help New Wirral grow into a developed nation. The first step is establishing a currency.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-7_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]The population of New Wirral keeps growing, but nobody has thought to build new homes. It's a perfect setup.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-7_LANDKEEPER2_PRE_BATTLE2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]The most popular option among Landkeepers right now is to peg it to the value of the soul – an extremely scarce resource where we're from.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-7_LANDKEEPER2_PRE_BATTLE3: [wave amp=30 freq=5]If you like, you can deposit your soul with us for legal tender.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-7_LANDKEEPER2_POST_BATTLE2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]After all, what's the point of it all if the upper class can\'t print quadrillions of favours out of nothing?[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_2_-7_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Everything starts with capital. Every sentence. Every name. Every investment. Buy now![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_2_-7_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]You won't put a full stop to us![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-7_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE1: The mall up ahead is where the tapes and cassette players come from. It just popped into existence a few years back! Rangers have been raiding it for supplies since then, so you won't find many left in there.
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-7_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE2: I've heard it\'s haunted though... What do you think?
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-6_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE1.m: Oh gosh, there's something really wrong with your aura. Are you sick?
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-6_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE1.f: Oh gosh, there's something really wrong with your aura. Are you sick?
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-6_CULTIST_POST_BATTLE: Maybe it wasn't your aura after all. Maybe it was just my poor eyesight…
messages.OVERWORLD_3_-6_CULTIST_PRE_BATTLE1.n: Oh gosh, there's something really wrong with your aura. Are you sick?
messages.OVERWORLD_4_-7_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]What's your problem? It\'s perfectly legal! They\'re only tenants, after all… [pause]We own them.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_4_-7_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]There's a family living in it at the moment, but we can kick them out for you… [pause]Why are you making that face?[/wave]
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_1_POST_BATTLE_KAYLEIGH1: I don’t even remember this man, but he seems to remember me…
messages.ARISTOTLE_PRE_BATTLE: Happiness lies in virtuous activity, and perfect happiness lies in the best activity, which is battle!
messages.ARISTOTLE_POST_BATTLE: Ouch! The aim of the wise is not to secure pleasure, but to avoid pain.
messages.OVERWORLD_4_-7_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE1.m: [wave amp=30 freq=5]I think we have the perfect home for you, first-time buyer![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_4_-7_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE1.f: [wave amp=30 freq=5]I think we have the perfect home for you, first-time buyer![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_4_-7_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE1.n: [wave amp=30 freq=5]I think we have the perfect home for you, first-time buyer![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-1_-3_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]We can also help provide liquidity for your home purchase![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-1_-3_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=5]We Landkeepers enjoy a good swim too! As long as it's not holy water, that is…[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-4_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: Don't you think these Traffikrab statues look a bit strange?
messages.OVERWORLD_1_-4_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE: I'm doing important research here, get out of my way!
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-4_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE: Don't ask me where I keep my tapes!
messages.OVERWORLD_0_-4_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: I keep my tapes in my waterproof backpack, of course!
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-3_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE1: I love hearing stories about the black swan events people experienced in their home worlds.
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-3_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE3: I've heard all sorts of stories: fascist uprisings, pandemics, global war, runaway climate change, ecological microplastic catastrophes…
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-3_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE4: Heh, imagine a world in which they had all of those things at once. How doomed they would be!
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-3_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE2: Black swan events are major historical events that come by surprise and change everything.
messages.OVERWORLD_-2_-3_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: My favorite black swan event is the Shark-Man War of 2023. They really should have seen that one coming!
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_1_PRE_BATTLE1: What are you doing here, why aren’t you at…
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_1_PRE_BATTLE2: Wait, [pause]is that you Kayleigh?! You’re a deserter!
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_1_FRIENDLY3: You know how these things can get out of hand!
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_1_FRIENDLY2: It’s nothing personal, we were just pretty deep into attempting to ascend to divinity.
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_2_POST_BATTLE_KAYLEIGH: What is Dorian up to? I’m worried…
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_2_PRE_BATTLE: Dorian was expecting some trouble before the ceremony, so I’ve been keeping watch!
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_2_FRIENDLY1: So Brother Cooper’s “serpent god” was just some messed-up monster?
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_3_PRE_BATTLE1: You there! You aren’t wearing your robes!
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_3_PRE_BATTLE2: Are you outsiders, here to sabotage the ceremony?!
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_3_FRIENDLY2: Maybe I’ll get into something new… like woodwork…
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_3_FRIENDLY1: The path of the mournchild has proven to be kind of a dead-end, huh?
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_4_PRE_BATTLE2: Dorian will be super mad at me if I fail to stop you!
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_4_FRIENDLY1: So these “Archangels” live beneath the island… And harbour no love for mankind…
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_4_FRIENDLY2: This scares me even more than Dorian did!
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_5_PRE_BATTLE2: Unfortunately, it is the will of the [wave amp=30 freq=5]serpent god[/wave] that I defend our commune from outsiders.
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_5_FRIENDLY1: I guess now that we’re trying to integrate with the rest of the island more…
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_5_FRIENDLY2: I should start working on making more meaningful personal connections with folks!
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_6_PRE_BATTLE1: [b][shake rate=30 level=10]IT IS THE DUTY OF THE MOURNCHILDREN TO REPEL OUTSIDERS![/shake][/b]
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_6_PRE_BATTLE2: [b][shake rate=30 level=10]YOU DO NOT WEAR THE GARB OF THE MOURNCHILD…[/shake][/b]
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_6_PRE_BATTLE3.m: [b][shake rate=30 level=10]THEREFORE YOU MUST BE VANQUISHED![/shake][/b]
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_6_PRE_BATTLE3.f: [b][shake rate=30 level=10]THEREFORE YOU MUST BE VANQUISHED![/shake][/b]
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_6_FRIENDLY1.m: [b][shake rate=30 level=10]I’M SORRY WE WERE SO HOSTILE TO YOUR KIND, OUTSIDER![/shake][/b]
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_6_PRE_BATTLE3.n: [b][shake rate=30 level=10]THEREFORE YOU MUST BE VANQUISHED![/shake][/b]
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_6_FRIENDLY1.n: [b][shake rate=30 level=10]I’M SORRY WE WERE SO HOSTILE TO YOUR KIND, OUTSIDER![/shake][/b]
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_6_FRIENDLY1.f: [b][shake rate=30 level=10]I’M SORRY WE WERE SO HOSTILE TO YOUR KIND, OUTSIDER![/shake][/b]
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_7_PRE_BATTLE1: You know… there is a lot of symbolic significance to the transformative power of the cassette tape.
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_6_FRIENDLY2: [b][shake rate=30 level=10]WE JUST GOT A BIT CARRIED AWAY![/shake][/b]
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_7_PRE_BATTLE2: The four sides of its rectangular shape align with the four sides of man…
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_7_PRE_BATTLE4: Anyway, I should probably be trying to stop you right now.
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_7_FRIENDLY1: Cassette tapes have an A-side and a B-side…
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_7_FRIENDLY2: Just like the duality of man….
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_8_PRE_BATTLE1: Man, all the digging has been making me so hungry.
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_8_POST_BATTLE: All I want… is a sandwich…
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_8_PRE_BATTLE2: And now I gotta fight you on an empty stomach! Urgh!
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_8_FRIENDLY: Does Harbourtown have good food? I’m asking on behalf of my stomach.
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_9_PRE_BATTLE3: Maybe beating you will prove my worth to him!
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_9_PRE_BATTLE2: After all that [wave amp=30 freq=5]digging[/wave] I did! I’m the [wave amp=30 freq=5]most devoted[/wave] mournchild!
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_9_PRE_BATTLE1: I can’t believe Brother Cooper stuck me on guard duty.
messages.OFFICE_2_FELIX: I’m appreciating the aesthetic here. Very “soul-crushing salary job”.
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_9_FRIENDLY1: I can’t believe I put all my faith in Brother Cooper only for him to get vaporised.
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_MERCHANT_DIALOGUE1: As part of a cultural outreach plan proposed by Sister Jacqueline…
messages.COMMUNE_CULTIST_MERCHANT_DIALOGUE2: We are now officially trading with outsiders. Please take a look at our inventory.
messages.OFFICE_2_MEREDITH: Huh… Where did these creeps get all this [wave amp=30 freq=20]stuff[/wave], anyway?
messages.OFFICE_2_KAYLEIGH: We won’t allow you to buy out New Wirral!
messages.OFFICE_2_VIOLA: Your foul machinations end here, fiends!
messages.OFFICE_2_EUGENE: Excuse us for [wave amp=30 freq=20]dropping in[/wave]!
messages.OFFICE_2_LANDKEEPER: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Such short-sightedness you young people possess... Can’t you appreciate the investment opportunities we could open up for you?[/wave]
messages.OFFICE_4_LANDKEEPER2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]You wouldn’t want to be cast out of your homes, would you?[/wave]
messages.OFFICE_4_LANDKEEPER1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]As prospective tenants, it is in your best interests to remain on good terms with the Landkeeper’s Association.[/wave]
messages.OFFICE_3_LANDKEEPER: [wave amp=30 freq=5]If you don’t vacate immediately, we’ll be forced to evict you ourselves...[/wave]
messages.OFFICE_4_KAYLEIGH: That sounds like a threat to me…
messages.OFFICE_4_MEREDITH: That’s a pretty dark thing to say.
messages.OFFICE_4_VIOLA: Your blood must run cold if you could dispense such threats without hesitation.
messages.OFFICE_4_EUGENE: If you think you’re taking [wave amp=30 freq=20]anything[/wave] from us, you [wave amp=30 freq=20]might[/wave] want to re-evaluate!
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_KAYLEIGH3: Eugene will be happy to hear we sent these clowns packing!
messages.OFFICE_4_FELIX: We’re going all out with the veiled threats, I see.
messages.OFFICE_5_LANDKEEPER2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]There is no need to fight progress![/wave]
messages.OFFICE_5_LANDKEEPER1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]New Wirral would experience such growth with a regulated housing market in place![/wave]
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_KAYLEIGH1: We really showed those agents, huh? Eugene will be pleased!
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_KAYLEIGH2: Another office cleared out! [wave amp=30 freq=10]Nice teamwork[/wave], {player}!
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_KAYLEIGH4: Was that the last office cleared out? Let’s hope they [wave amp=30 freq=10]don’t come back[/wave]!
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_MEREDITH1: Those guys are [wave amp=30 freq=10]seriously[/wave] trying to buy out New Wirral? I certainly don’t feel bad about beating them up, that’s for sure.
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_MEREDITH3: Another office sorted out! I’m sure Eugene will appreciate us doing his job for him.
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_MEREDITH2: I am glad that [wave amp=30 freq=10]punching those guys really hard[/wave] is considered a public service.
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_MEREDITH4: Oh, was this the last office that needed sorting out? [pause]Is this [wave amp=30 freq=10]whole thing[/wave] over, then?
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_EUGENE1: [shake rate=30 level=10]Alright, nice work![/shake] Maybe these [shake rate=30 level=10]parasites[/shake] will start to realise who they’re messin’ with!
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_EUGENE2: Another office liberated from those creeps! Nice work, {player}!
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_FELIX4: C’mon, let’s get out of here! This was the last office building you needed to sort out, right?
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_FELIX3: They ran out of here pretty quickly, huh? Maybe they realised they were totally outmatched.
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_FELIX1: Those guys are definitely bad news. Let’s hope they don’t come back here anytime soon.
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_EUGENE3: They didn’t stand a [shake rate=30 level=10]chance[/shake]!
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_FELIX2: How did those creepy estate agent guys even [wave amp=30 freq=10]build[/wave] a place like this?
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_VIOLA2: They truly are [wave amp=30 freq=10]unearthly[/wave] types, are they not?
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_VIOLA1: Those fiends spoke quickly, but fled quicker.
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_VIOLA3: I am glad to see those fiends gone.
messages.OFFICE_POSTBATTLE_VIOLA4: I care not for those fiends. [pause]I am sure they will live to regret treating us with such hostility.
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE3_LANDKEEPER: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Why don’t you… [pause][pause]listen to our sales pitch?[/wave]
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE2_LANDKEEPER: [wave amp=30 freq=5]You are being very uncooperative, young man.[/wave]
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE1_EUGENE: [shake rate=30 level=10]We’re taking down your operation, you leeches![/shake]
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE4_PLAYER_OPTION1: Sales pitch? Wait, what is this…?
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE11_LANDKEEPER: [wave amp=30 freq=5]The Landkeeper’s Association simply wants to formulate a long-term housing market within New Wirral.[/wave]
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE6_PLAYER_OPTION2: Didn’t you heavily imply that they’re vampires?
messages.OFFICE_1_LINE9_EUGENE: I’d say they’re WORSE than vampires…
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_INTRO6: The only thing here for me to hack are these [wave amp=30 freq=10]monster tapes[/wave]. [pause]It turns out I’m pretty good at that too, which is why I’m a ranger captain.
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_PRE_BATTLE1.m: C’mon, I bet you’re [wave amp=30 freq=10]desperate[/wave] to see my modded cassette tapes! [pause]Are you gonna take my ranger captain challenge or what?
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_NOT_TRAINEE1.n: Unfortunately I can’t show you my work if you’re not signed up as a ranger trainee. [pause]Too bad for you, huh?
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_PRE_BATTLE2.f: I hope you’re prepared to go head-to-head with a combat [wave amp=30 freq=10]master[/wave]!
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_PRE_BATTLE1.f: C’mon, I bet you’re [wave amp=30 freq=10]desperate[/wave] to see my modded cassette tapes! [pause]Are you gonna take my ranger captain challenge or what?
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_PRE_BATTLE2.m: I hope you’re prepared to go head-to-head with a combat [wave amp=30 freq=10]master[/wave]!

messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_PRE_BATTLE_NO: I don’t blame you – I wouldn’t want to fight [wave amp=30 freq=10]me[/wave] either!

messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_LAST_LEGS1: Not bad – you’ve forced me to use [shake rate=30 level=10]100% of my power![/shake]
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_POST_BATTLE1: [shake rate=30 level=10]What?![/shake] How did I lose?
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_POST_BATTLE2: I mean… [pause]I intended to lose. Th-this was just a test for you, after all.
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_DEFEATED_INTERACT1: These monsters have elemental “types” associated with them. [pause]When you change those types, things start to get [wave amp=30 freq=10]real[/wave] interesting.
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_PRE_REMATCH1.m: So, [wave amp=30 freq=10]ranger captain[/wave], you’ve returned to battle your most challenging opponent ever, am I right?
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_PRE_REMATCH2.f: Now you’re not a newbie, I don’t have to limit the power of my super hacked monster tapes!

messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_PRE_REMATCH_NO: I don’t blame you – I wouldn’t want to fight [wave amp=30 freq=10]me[/wave] either!
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_POST_REMATCH2: ...That’s what I would say if I was mad. [pause]Which I’m not. [pause]I’m not mad about it at all.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_EXT_IANTHE1: Hey, you! [pause]You boys aren’t normally [wave amp=30 freq=10]bold[/wave] enough to venture this close to our outpost. Why don’t you get on out of here while this conversation remains civil?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_EXT_KAYLEIGH3: She’s in charge for a reason, [pause]huh...
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_EXT_IANTHE2: You ain’t moving, huh? [pause]Guess I gotta get my hands dirty, then.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_K_KAYLEIGH5: Well, [pause]maybe we should find more! [pause]Ianthe, I think {player} should apply to be a ranger!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_EXT_VIOLA3: She holds herself with a confidence I have rarely seen before.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE2: Well, [pause]what do you think of this outpost? [pause]This place was abandoned for the longest time. With a bit of work, we turned it into a rest stop for weary rangers.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE3: I’d like to tell you we defend the people of New Wirral from a relentless horde of monsters…
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE4: But most of the time we’re doing odd jobs for the community. It’s really not that exciting.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_K_IANTHE4: We’re pretty sure Archangels [wave amp=30 freq=10]exist[/wave], but our interactions with them have been… [pause]fleeting.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_K_KAYLEIGH2: [shake rate=30 level=10]W-well, {player} and I just fought an Archangel![/shake]
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_K_IANTHE1: Kayleigh can attest to that, [pause]as one of our more recent recruits!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_K_IANTHE3: ...[pause]Is that so? We’ll have to look into this.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_NK_EUGENE4.m: {player} can hold his own in a fight. [pause]I can vouch for that!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_NK_IANTHE1.m: ...Except Ranger Kayleigh insists the two of you fought an [wave amp=30 freq=10]Archangel[/wave] together.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_NK_IANTHE1.f: ...Except Ranger Kayleigh insists the two of you fought an [wave amp=30 freq=10]Archangel[/wave] together.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_NK_IANTHE2: We’re pretty sure Archangels [wave amp=30 freq=10]exist[/wave], but our interactions with them have been… [pause]fleeting.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_NK_IANTHE1.n: ...Except Ranger Kayleigh insists the two of you fought an [wave amp=30 freq=10]Archangel[/wave] together.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_NK_EUGENE4.n: {player} can hold their own in a fight. [pause]I can vouch for that!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_NK_IANTHE3: To even survive an encounter with something like that would show some real fortitude...
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_NK_EUGENE4.f: {player} can hold her own in a fight. [pause]I can vouch for that!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE5: Well, [pause]what do you think, {player}? Do you wanna apply to join the rangers?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE5_OPTION2: What do I have to do?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE6: Trainees are tasked with meeting up with each of the ranger captains here in New Wirral, and overcoming their challenges.
messages.CAPTAIN_ZEDD_POST_BATTLE1: Wow, I think that final blow woke me up a bit. [pause]Here’s your reward.
messages.CAPTAIN_ZEDD_DEFEATED_INTERACT1: It’s important to get enough sleep… but how much sleep IS enough? [pause]Mankind has been searching for that answer since the dawn of history.
messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_PRE_REMATCH1.f: Greetings! [pause]I was told that you’re one of the captains now? [pause]That’s wonderful!
messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_PRE_REMATCH1.m: Greetings! [pause]I was told that you’re one of the captains now? [pause]That’s wonderful!
messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_DEFEATED_INTERACT1: Greetings! [pause]Are you here to sort through some junk with me?
messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_INTRO3: I gather and sort all the [wave amp=30 freq=10]stuff[/wave] you offworlders make that ends up here.
messages.CAPTAIN_WALLACE_PRE_BATTLE1.m: Ianthe said you’re a promising fighter. I suppose you’ll be wanting to take my ranger challenge?
messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_PRE_REMATCH_NO: No worries! [pause]I have plenty of junk to sort through, anyway!
messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_PRE_REMATCH2.n: Perhaps we should celebrate with another fight – what do you say, [wave amp=30 freq=10]captain[/wave]?
messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_PRE_REMATCH2.f: Perhaps we should celebrate with another fight – what do you say, [wave amp=30 freq=10]captain[/wave]?
messages.CAPTAIN_WALLACE_POST_REWARD1: I stumbled across that rare material while surveying the park for a building project. You can swap it at the town hall for some neat stuff.
messages.CAPTAIN_WALLACE_INTRO4: I’m Wallace, one of Harbourtown’s ranger captains. [pause]I oversee any building work on New Wirral.
messages.CAPTAIN_CLEEO_INTRO5.f: [color=#e3affe][wave amp=30 freq=2]Welcome, [pause]patron, [pause]to the Neo Vegas 'Pharaoh\'s Emporium\'![/wave][/color]
messages.CAPTAIN_CLEEO_INTRO5.m: [color=#e3affe][wave amp=30 freq=2]Welcome, [pause]patron, [pause]to the Neo Vegas 'Pharaoh\'s Emporium\'![/wave][/color]
messages.CAPTAIN_ZEDD_INTRO_KAYLEIGH: Oh! [pause]I TOTALLY forgot you’re a ranger captain!
messages.CAPTAIN_ZEDD_INTRO5: Thanks for that. Man, it shouldn’t be this hard for a [wave amp=30 freq=10]ranger captain[/wave] to get a bit of shut-eye around here!
messages.CAPTAIN_CLEEO_DEFEATED_INTERACT1.m: [color=#e3affe]Hey, human. Did you know I respect all your kind with equal measure? I also hold no negative emotions towards any of your kind. [pause]It’s true.[/color]
messages.CAPTAIN_CLEEO_POST_REWARD2: [color=#e3affe]Sorry, [pause]I did not intend to direct my ire towards mankind again. [pause]Please ignore my remark.[/color]
messages.CAPTAIN_CLEEO_DEFEATED_INTERACT1.n: [color=#e3affe]Hey, human. Did you know I respect all your kind with equal measure? I also hold no negative emotions towards any of your kind. [pause]It’s true.[/color]
