messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_INTRO1: Boy, the offworlders really make a lot of [wave amp=30 freq=10]stuff[/wave], don’t they?
messages.CAPTAIN_WALLACE_POST_REMATCH2: Once again, you have shown that your strategy is built on a strong foundation!
messages.CAPTAIN_CLEEO_POST_REWARD1: [color=#e3affe]You can cash that material in at Harbourtown’s town hall. [pause]You humans love to trade your meaningless little trinkets, don’t you…[/color]
messages.CAPTAIN_CLEEO_PRE_REMATCH2.m: [color=#e3affe]I have patched all the weaknesses in my combat algorithms. [pause]Your defeat is a statistical certainty, “captain”![/color]
messages.CAPTAIN_LODESTEIN_INTRO1.m: I’ll be with you in a second, bud. I’ve just got some final repairs to make…
messages.CAPTAIN_WALLACE_NOT_TRAINEE1.f: Say, you look like you can handle yourself pretty well. Why don’t you sign up to become a trainee ranger?
messages.CAPTAIN_WALLACE_NOT_TRAINEE1.m: Say, you look like you can handle yourself pretty well. Why don’t you sign up to become a trainee ranger?
messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_INTRO4: Electronics, furniture, you name it! [pause]It all gets washed up here and put to good use!
messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_POST_BATTLE1.m: Wow, you really trashed me pretty good, huh? [pause]Maybe I underestimated you, outsider!
messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_PRE_BATTLE_NO: No worries! [pause]I have plenty of junk to sort through, anyway!
messages.CAPTAIN_WALLACE_PRE_BATTLE1.n: Ianthe said you’re a promising fighter. I suppose you’ll be wanting to take my ranger challenge?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE7: Since you’re such a [wave amp=30 freq=10]hotshot[/wave] in monster combat, [pause]I’m pretty sure the captains are gonna want to test your fighting abilities.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE8.m: You really [wave amp=30 freq=10]are[/wave] new here.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE8.f: You really [wave amp=30 freq=10]are[/wave] new here.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE9: Trainees who pass the trial become full-time rangers, like Kayleigh. Rangers have a lot of responsibilities, but nothing that would put them in significant danger.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE8.n: You really [wave amp=30 freq=10]are[/wave] new here.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE7: Honestly, I never thought this day would come.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE10: The captains, [pause]like myself, [pause]run the whole operation. We try to maintain the community in Harbourtown, and the most dangerous situations fall on us to resolve.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE10_OPTION1: So captains are the top rangers...
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE12: Everytime you overcome a captain’s challenge, they’ll stamp this card. [pause]When you’ve filled it all in, come see me and I can sign you off as an official ranger.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE16: Anyway, I gotta head back into town. If you need me, come swing by our headquarters.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE11_OPTION2: Does this give me free coffee?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE13: Each captain has perfected their own strategy in battle – [pause]it ain’t just about raw strength. [pause]You’re gonna have to learn to adapt your approach as you go.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE14: You think you can handle it, [pause]{player}?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_INTRO_IANTHE17: The building with half a ship wedged on top of it? [pause]You can’t miss it.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_MENU_BATTLE_IANTHE.m: I’m ready to become a captain!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_MENU_BATTLE_IANTHE.n: I’m ready to become a captain!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_MENU_BATTLE_IANTHE.f: I’m ready to become a captain!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE2: I see. So there's a train station called Night\'s Bridge that houses a magic mirror portal. The stations themselves are part of one giant Archangel...
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE1: Is that so? Tell me everything.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_KAYLEIGH4: That's about the gist of it.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE3: Also there's a building that wears the avatar of a woman, and a talking Traffikrab who will help us find our way down there...
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_VIOLA4: Yes. I am glad you understand.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE6: But since it's you, I take this seriously. I\'ll have someone sent down there right away.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE5: {player}, {partner}, if it was anyone else telling me this I'd be very worried!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE8: Of course, I've discussed this possibility with my captains before. We have fully-formed plans for all kinds of chance events...
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE10: Most new arrivals will want to leave immediately. The rangers will guide them to ‘Night's Bridge’, of course.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE9: But now we can finally start to put them into motion.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE12: There won't be a mass exodus anytime soon. There\'ll always be work for the rangers to do in New Wirral.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE_A_1: I and the captains have already committed to staying in New Wirral to protect anyone who chooses to remain.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE11: Much of Harbourtown has been here for a long time, though. People have found partners, settled down, started families...
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE_A_2: {player}, I know you're training to be a ranger, but I won\'t hold it against you if you choose to abandon your training and leave.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE_A_3.m: You've worked harder for this than anyone I\'ve ever known.

messages.LEADER_IANTHE_WAY_HOME_IANTHE13: Whatever you decide, you have my full support.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_CAPTAINS_FINISHED_IANTHE1: Do you have a completed stamp card to show me, perhaps?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_CAPTAINS_UNFINISHED_IANTHE: We station the captains all around the island so that there’s always [wave amp=30 freq=10]somebody[/wave] nearby if there’s a sudden emergency.
If you need help finding them, try some of the other rangers around here. I’m a little busy at the moment.
Congratulations, {player} – you’re officially a ranger!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_CAPTAINS_FINISHED_IANTHE2: So the chatter was correct! You haven’t been here long, but you’ve already shown a real knack for traversing the island and overcoming any obstacle.
Congratulations, {player} – you’re officially a ranger!
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_CAPTAINS_FINISHED_IANTHE5: I’m afraid we don’t have any special ceremonies to mark the occasion. [pause]We’re too busy training new recruits so that we can deal with those rogue fusions.
Congratulations, {player} – you’re officially a ranger!
We could use more people like you helping with the training. Have you ever thought about becoming a captain?
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_CAPTAINS_FINISHED_MEREDITH: Cool. I’m happy for you, mate.
Cool. I’m happy for you, mate.
Cool. I’m happy for you, mate.
messages.LEADER_IANTHE_CAPTAINS_FINISHED_VIOLA4.m: Your efforts have proven true, friend.

messages.CAPTAIN_LODESTEIN_POST_REMATCH1.m: Well, once again you showed me up good and proper. Well fought, bud.
messages.CAPTAIN_WALLACE_PRE_REMATCH2: Ain’t that a perfect time for a rematch! What do you say?
messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_INTRO5: One world’s trash is another world’s treasure, [pause]after all!
messages.CAPTAIN_SKIP_POST_REMATCH5: I never know what I’ll stumble across next!
messages.CAPTAIN_ZEDD_INTRO4: It’s getting real difficult to “meditate” around here, what with all these Bulletinos zooming around. Any chance you could [wave amp=30 freq=10]sort that out for me?[/wave]
messages.CAPTAIN_ZEDD_INTRO2: What’s that…? [pause]Sleeping? [pause]No, not at all! I was, uh, meditating. I’m Zedd, by the way.
messages.CAPTAIN_BUFFY_POST_REMATCH1.f: You’ve been working out, haven’t you? It shows – you’re even stronger than last time!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_INTRO1: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Hey-hey[/wave], [pause]you’re listening to Cybil Radio: 24/7 coverage across [wave amp=30 freq=10]allllll[/wave] of New Wirral!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_NOT_TRAINEE1.f: Whilst we would love to do an on-air interview with our guest, they haven’t yet signed the [wave amp=30 freq=10]necessary paperwork[/wave]! [pause]That’s too bad for all you listeners out there!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_NOT_TRAINEE1.n: Whilst we would love to do an on-air interview with our guest, they haven’t yet signed the [wave amp=30 freq=10]necessary paperwork[/wave]! [pause]That’s too bad for all you listeners out there!

messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_PRE_BATTLE3.f: What do you say, newbie? [pause]Shall we treat our dear listeners to an [wave amp=30 freq=10]aural battlefield experience[/wave]?

messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_PRE_BATTLE4: Oh yeah! [pause]Fasten your proverbial seatbelts, listeners! [wave amp=30 freq=10]Here’s an exclusive live performance![/wave]
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_LAST_LEGS1.f: The battle is heating up! [pause]Will your beloved host prevail, or will victory go to our plucky underdog? [pause]Time for the crescendo!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_BATTLE1: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Wow, what a performance – our listeners loved it![/wave] [pause]Here’s your payment, of course!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_LAST_LEGS1.n: The battle is heating up! [pause]Will your beloved host prevail, or will victory go to our plucky underdog? [pause]Time for the crescendo!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_REWARD2: I used to be a real rising star in radio. [pause]It’s not been the same since I ended up here.
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_REWARD4: And maybe then they’ll come and rescue us all.
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_REWARD5.f: ...Enough melancholy! [pause]You did fantastic in our battle – I see a promising future ahead of you!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_REWARD5.m: ...Enough melancholy! [pause]You did fantastic in our battle – I see a promising future ahead of you!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_REWARD3: I’m sticking with it, though. [pause]Every day I broadcast across New Wirral and hope that,[pause] somehow,[pause] someone from beyond this island will receive the signal.
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_REWARD5.n: ...Enough melancholy! [pause]You did fantastic in our battle – I see a promising future ahead of you!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_DEFEATED_INTERACT1.m: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Hey-hey[/wave], [pause]it’s nice to see our hit guest star once again!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_DEFEATED_INTERACT1.f: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Hey-hey[/wave], [pause]it’s nice to see our hit guest star once again!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_PRE_REMATCH1: Wow, [pause]we have a breaking story for you listeners out there!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_DEFEATED_INTERACT1.n: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Hey-hey[/wave], [pause]it’s nice to see our hit guest star once again!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_REMATCH2.m: …[pause]Thanks for coming by. [pause]It means a lot to me.
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_REMATCH1.n: What a great show! [pause]You really put 120% into that one.
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_PRE_REMATCH2.m: The recently appointed Captain {player} has arrived at the studio for a surprise appearance!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_PRE_REMATCH2.f: The recently appointed Captain {player} has arrived at the studio for a surprise appearance!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_PRE_REMATCH3.m: The listeners are figuratively [wave amp=30 freq=10]dying[/wave] for a second performance from you! [pause]Are you game for another battle?

messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_PRE_REMATCH4: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Yeah![/wave] For all you listeners out there – fasten your seatbelts, put your tray tables up and adjust your seats to an upright position! [pause]We’re live and we’re recording!
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_PRE_REMATCH3.f: The listeners are figuratively [wave amp=30 freq=10]dying[/wave] for a second performance from you! [pause]Are you game for another battle?
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_REMATCH1.m: What a great show! [pause]You really put 120% into that one.
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_REMATCH2.n: …[pause]Thanks for coming by. [pause]It means a lot to me.
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_REMATCH2.f: …[pause]Thanks for coming by. [pause]It means a lot to me.
messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_REMATCH3.m: [wave amp=30 freq=10]See you next time, captain![/wave]

messages.CAPTAIN_CYBIL_POST_REMATCH3.f: [wave amp=30 freq=10]See you next time, captain![/wave]
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_INTRO2: They call me Codey. [pause]Because I used to code. Well, I used to [wave amp=30 freq=10]break[/wave] code.
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_INTRO1: You came a long way just to see me, huh?
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_INTRO3: Anything in the information space can be cracked if you’re smart enough. [pause]Websites, video games, government servers…
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_INTRO4: I got in a little trouble for that last one.
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_INTRO5: But here on New Wirral? [pause]There’s no internet here. What a joke.
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_NOT_TRAINEE1.f: Unfortunately I can’t show you my work if you’re not signed up as a ranger trainee. [pause]Too bad for you, huh?
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_NOT_TRAINEE1.m: Unfortunately I can’t show you my work if you’re not signed up as a ranger trainee. [pause]Too bad for you, huh?
messages.CAPTAIN_LODESTEIN_POST_BATTLE2: Forgive me for the puns – it’s a force of habit.
messages.CAPTAIN_JUDAS_PRE_REMATCH2: Alright. [pause]I’ve made some tactical observations that will maximise my chances of victory this time.
messages.CAPTAIN_JUDAS_PRE_REMATCH1.m: An intel drop has informed me that you’re now one of us ranger captains. [pause]Impressive work. [pause]Are you here for a rematch?
messages.CAPTAIN_CLEEO_INTRO14: [color=#e3affe]Betcha didn’t expect a tin can like me to be able to use cassette tapes, huh? [pause]It turns out all the gambling data in my memory banks makes me quite the strategist, too.[/color]
messages.CAPTAIN_CLEEO_INTRO13: [color=#e3affe]Anyway, I’m Clee-O. [pause]One of the ranger captains here on New Wirral.[/color]
messages.CAPTAIN_CLEEO_POST_BATTLE2: [color=#e3affe]I am reluctantly adding you to my internal database of humans I truly respect. [pause]It is a very small database.[/color]
messages.CAPTAIN_CLEEO_POST_BATTLE1: [color=#e3affe]You called my bluff. [pause]I’m impressed, and [wave amp=30 freq=10]definitely[/wave] not resentful.[/color]
messages.CAPTAIN_CLEEO_INTRO12: [color=#e3affe]Sorry, I didn’t mean to get hostile. [pause]Ianthe has been encouraging me to work through my past resentment for mankind in a healthier manner.[/color]
messages.CAPTAIN_DREADFUL_INTRO4: Of course, [pause]when the town burned down, all those stories were lost. [pause]Everyone and everything here went up in flames too, [pause]except little ol’ me.
messages.CAPTAIN_DREADFUL_INTRO3_OPTION2.f: I don’t know if those were all true stories…
messages.CAPTAIN_DREADFUL_INTRO6: The blighters in Harbourtown have a lot of different beliefs, but all agree on one thing – we’re [wave amp=30 freq=10]all[/wave] gonna kick the bucket eventually.
messages.CAPTAIN_DREADFUL_INTRO7: I think they simply lack imagination. [pause]Death isn’t the end… not if you know the [wave amp=30 freq=10]esoteric ways[/wave].
messages.CAPTAIN_DREADFUL_POST_REWARD1: Remember, trainee – [pause]if life is what you make of it, then death is too!
messages.CAPTAIN_DREADFUL_NOT_TRAINEE1: I could give you a demonstration, but I only scrap with registered rangers or trainees. [pause]Personal policy, sorry mate.
messages.CAPTAIN_DREADFUL_PRE_BATTLE1.m: I could give you a demonstration, if you think you’re ready for it. [pause]You’re the latest ranger trainee, right? You lookin’ for a scrap to prove your worth?
messages.CAPTAIN_DREADFUL_PRE_BATTLE2: Let’s crack on, then! [pause]If you expect me to go soft on you because I’m a ranger captain, you’re in for a [shake rate=30 level=10]proper fright![/shake]
messages.CAPTAIN_DREADFUL_PRE_BATTLE1.f: I could give you a demonstration, if you think you’re ready for it. [pause]You’re the latest ranger trainee, right? You lookin’ for a scrap to prove your worth?
messages.CAPTAIN_DREADFUL_PRE_BATTLE_NO: Not up to scratch, are we? [pause]I won’t hold it against you!
messages.CAPTAIN_DREADFUL_PRE_BATTLE1.n: I could give you a demonstration, if you think you’re ready for it. [pause]You’re the latest ranger trainee, right? You lookin’ for a scrap to prove your worth?
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_INTRO4: In this world, the shadows have claws. My job is to [wave amp=30 freq=10]scratch them back.[/wave]
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_INTRO4_OPTION1: That doesn’t make it any clearer…
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_NOT_TRAINEE1: I am forbidden from saying any more to non-rangers, however. [pause]If you ever sign up, perhaps we should talk once more.
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_PRE_BATTLE1.m: Tell me – are you here for my ranger captain challenge? [pause]You’re welcome to try and face my blades, if you think you can handle it.
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_PRE_BATTLE1.f: Tell me – are you here for my ranger captain challenge? [pause]You’re welcome to try and face my blades, if you think you can handle it.
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_PRE_BATTLE1.n: Tell me – are you here for my ranger captain challenge? [pause]You’re welcome to try and face my blades, if you think you can handle it.
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_PRE_BATTLE2: Let’s hope you don’t cut that pretty face of yours.
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_POST_BATTLE1.m: Impressive. [pause]I didn’t think you had it in you, but you’re sharper than you look. Your victory is well-earned.
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_LAST_LEGS1: You won’t cut me down so easily!
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_POST_REWARD1: It’s time I resume my mission. [pause]I am sworn to secrecy on the nature of my investigations, of course. Don’t take it personally.
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_POST_BATTLE1.f: Impressive. [pause]I didn’t think you had it in you, but you’re sharper than you look. Your victory is well-earned.
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_POST_BATTLE1.n: Impressive. [pause]I didn’t think you had it in you, but you’re sharper than you look. Your victory is well-earned.
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_PRE_REMATCH1.m: They are saying you’re the new ranger captain. Perhaps you wish to sharpen your skills with me once more?
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_DEFEATED_INTERACT1: The exact nature of my work with the rangers must remain classified. You’re better off not knowing.
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_POST_REMATCH1.m: You remain as swift as ever. I must commend your efforts, captain.
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_PRE_REMATCH1.f: They are saying you’re the new ranger captain. Perhaps you wish to sharpen your skills with me once more?
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_PRE_REMATCH1.n: They are saying you’re the new ranger captain. Perhaps you wish to sharpen your skills with me once more?
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_POST_REMATCH1.f: You remain as swift as ever. I must commend your efforts, captain.
messages.CAPTAIN_GLADIOLA_POST_REMATCH1.n: You remain as swift as ever. I must commend your efforts, captain.
messages.CAPTAIN_HEATHER_INTRO2: Humidity: fluctuating! [pause]Chance of precipitation: who knows!
messages.CAPTAIN_HEATHER_INTRO3: For a meteorologist like myself, the climate of New Wirral is an unending puzzle!
messages.CAPTAIN_HEATHER_LAST_LEGS1: The winds are shifting in my favour – you best believe it!
messages.CAPTAIN_HEATHER_PRE_BATTLE1: You’re a ranger trainee, correct? [pause]If you think you can brave the storm, then why not take my ranger challenge?
messages.CAPTAIN_HEATHER_PRE_BATTLE_NO.m: Oh well – maybe next time you’ll be ready to [wave amp=30 freq=10]face the storm[/wave]!
messages.CAPTAIN_HEATHER_PRE_BATTLE2: Fabulous! [pause]I’m updating my forecast: I now predict a [shake rate=30 level=10]storm of blows[/shake] and a [shake rate=30 level=10]whirlwind victory[/shake]!
messages.CAPTAIN_HEATHER_INTRO1: [wave amp=30 freq=10]This is Heather, with the weather![/wave] [pause]Today’s forecast: unpredictable as always!
messages.CAPTAIN_HEATHER_NOT_TRAINEE1: Uh, [pause]if you’re looking to take my ranger challenge then you’re gonna have to get registered first.
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH4: I don’t know why [wave amp=30 freq=30]you[/wave] like [wave amp=30 freq=30]me[/wave], [pause]but I like you.
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH5: But we’re working towards leaving this world...
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH6.m: If we succeed, we might not stay together. [pause]Are you… [pause]OK with that?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST1_PART1_EUGENE2.m: Are you ready to take on the forces of evil?
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH6.f: If we succeed, we might not stay together. [pause]Are you… [pause]OK with that?
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH6.n: If we succeed, we might not stay together. [pause]Are you… [pause]OK with that?
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH8.m: Me, with a serious boyfriend. [pause]Sounds weird. [pause]Feels right.
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH8.f: Me, with a serious girlfriend. [pause]Sounds weird. [pause]Feels right.
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH8.n: Me, with a serious partner. [pause]Sounds weird. [pause]Feels right.
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH9: It’s always been easier for me to tell myself that I need to be happier with myself before I get into a relationship with someone, [pause]but I think the truth is…
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH11: But you make me happy, [pause]and I'm more whole when I’m with you than I am without.
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH10: I might NEVER be truly confident in who I am. [pause]I’m not ever gonna be my perfect self.
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH12: Th-that’s enough sappiness from me. [pause]Oh, and I can’t do cute-talk.
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH13.m: If you’re expecting me to ever call you “honey” or “dear”, [pause]you’ve got another thing coming, mate.
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH13.n: If you’re expecting me to ever call you “honey” or “dear”, [pause]you’ve got another thing coming, mate.
messages.MEREDITH_ROMANCE_MEREDITH13.f: If you’re expecting me to ever call you “honey” or “dear”, [pause]you’ve got another thing coming, mate.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST2_PART1_EUGENE1: I nabbed the window key from one of those ghouls while they were patrolling.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST1_PART1_EUGENE2.f: Are you ready to take on the forces of evil?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST1_PART1_EUGENE2.n: Are you ready to take on the forces of evil?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST1_PART1_NO_EUGENE1.m: I understand. Let me know when you’re ready – I’ll keep assessing the situation until then.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST1_PART1_NO_EUGENE1.f: I understand. Let me know when you’re ready – I’ll keep assessing the situation until then.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST1_PART1_NO_EUGENE1.n: I understand. Let me know when you’re ready – I’ll keep assessing the situation until then.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST1_PART1_EUGENE4: Alright, [pause]do you see that building over there?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST1_PART1_EUGENE5: That’s a stronghold – [pause]it’s where these inhuman parasites form their dark plots to take over this world.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST1_PART1_EUGENE8: There are a few of these strongholds – you might have seen them around. They lock the front doors, but we can drop in through a window on the roof.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST1_PART1_EUGENE5_OPTION2: It looks a bit plain, doesn’t it?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST1_PART1_EUGENE7: Their kind once plagued the world I came from, but we fought back. [pause]We WON.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST1_PART1_EUGENE9: Try gliding over from here – I’ll be by your side, don’t worry about it.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST2_PART1_EUGENE2.m: We’re gonna drop right on in there and flush them out – you ready?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST2_PART1_EUGENE2.n: We’re gonna drop right on in there and flush them out – you ready?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST2_PART1_EUGENE2.f: We’re gonna drop right on in there and flush them out – you ready?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST3_END_LANDKEEPER1: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Perhaps you’d be interested in speaking to our manager at the Association Headquarters?[/wave]
messages.EUGENE_QUEST3_END_LANDKEEPER2: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Maybe we can reach a mutually beneficial agreement there. I shall give you the location.[/wave]
messages.EUGENE_QUEST4_PART1_EUGENE2: This is our chance to put a stop to them once and for all!
messages.EUGENE_QUEST4_PART1_EUGENE3: C’mon, we haven’t got a moment to waste!
messages.EUGENE_QUEST4_PART1_EUGENE1: The Landkeepers have a central base of operations?!
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART1_EUGENE1: This is supposedly the location of the Landkeeper’s headquarters…
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART1_EUGENE2: Alright – [pause]these creeps are no match for our [shake rate=30 level=10]burning resolve[/shake]!
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART1_EUGENE4: Where the hell is the entrance, anyway?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART1_EUGENE6: I think I found the entrance.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_MAMMON1: Thank you for arriving at our scheduled meeting. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_EUGENE3: So tell me: Why would an Archangel try to take over the [shake rate=30 level=10]property market?![/shake]
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_MAMMON4:
My kin are born of humanity’s ego. The strongest desires of your kind give us form.

I exist as tribute to mankind’s consumption.

I want order because you do. I crave structure because you do.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_EUGENE7: You don’t know a SINGLE thing about me.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_MAMMON6: I want what you want, Human Eugene. I can read your heart.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_MAMMON8: I sympathise with the Human Eugene.\n\nThe Human Eugene finds no value in themselves outside of their cause.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_MAMMON9: Without a cause, the Human Eugene is nothing.\n\nA hollow shell. Just like my agents.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_EUGENE14: You won’t crush my spirit! [pause]That’s all your kind knows how to do!
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_EUGENE15: Some bigwig comes along, tries to take everything from the little guy…
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_EUGENE16: And then when the little guy fights back, [pause]they’re told not to step out of line, [pause]right?!
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_EUGENE17: So they don’t do anything… [pause]And things just get worse!
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_EUGENE20: Wanna burn down this pile of junk?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_FUSE_EUGENE1: You’re not gonna crush my spirit…
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_FUSE_EUGENE2: And you won’t stop {player} so easily, either!
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_POST_BATTLE_EUGENE4: This place is falling apart. C’mon, we gotta go!
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_POST_BATTLE_ALEPH1: HO HO, QUITE THE OPERATION YOU HAVE HERE, MR. MAMMON!
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_FUSE_EUGENE3: We’ll take you on together, and [shake rate=30 level=10]we’ll WIN[/shake]!
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_POST_BATTLE_ALEPH2: IT LOOKS LIKE YOU CAN DELEGATE. THAT’S A VALUABLE SKILL!
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART2_POST_BATTLE_ALEPH3: LET ME HELP YOU GET OUT OF HERE.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE1: I guess all the Landkeeper agents fled... [pause]I wonder what they’ll do, now their operation has been shut down?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE2.f: Man, it was pretty cool when we [wave amp=30 freq=10]fused[/wave] in there.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE2.m: Man, it was pretty cool when we [wave amp=30 freq=10]fused[/wave] in there.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE2.n: Man, it was pretty cool when we [wave amp=30 freq=10]fused[/wave] in there.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE3: Yeah! [pause]It was like an adrenaline rush, except I could feel your will driving me as well as my own. Even an [wave amp=30 freq=10]Archangel[/wave] couldn’t stop us!
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE4: An Archangel was behind the Landkeepers all along, huh…
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE5: What it said there… [pause]What if it was true?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE6: Maybe without some cause to champion all the time, [pause]I am just a hollow person.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE10_OPTION1: I’ve discovered a way off the island.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE6_OPTION1: I don’t think you’re a loser.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE9: What motivates YOU to do what you do, [pause]anyway?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE10: Y’know, [pause]you journey around, [pause]help people out, [pause]fight monsters and all that?
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE15: I don’t know if I physically [wave amp=30 freq=30]can[/wave].
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE10_OPTION2: I’m going to find a way to return home.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE14: We’ve stopped the Landkeepers, but I don’t wanna just rest my feet.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE16: I need [wave amp=30 freq=30]something[/wave] to strive towards.
messages.EUGENE_QUEST5_PART3_EUGENE17: So let’s do it. [pause]A new cause to work towards.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO1_EUGENE1: Y’know, [pause]taking on the Landkeepers like we did…
messages.EUGENE_CONVO1_EUGENE3: But it was the right thing to do, [pause]’cause their “business plans” involved messing with people’s lives.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO1_EUGENE2: In other worlds that would probably be illegal, [pause]right?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO2_EUGENE1: I need to get back to my workout routine soon. [pause]I can’t save the world if I’m not at the top of my game, y’know!
messages.EUGENE_CONVO1_EUGENE4: I guess there’s a big difference between the “law” and “true justice”, [pause]huh?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO2_EUGENE2: Maybe one day some dumbbells will wash up on the beach...
messages.EUGENE_CONVO3_EUGENE1: At first I was kind of weirded out by how, [pause]uh, [pause]retro the clothes of New Wirral are.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO3_EUGENE2: Y’know, with them all coming from that old-fashioned mall?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO3_EUGENE3: But I’m starting to get attached to the look. [pause]I hope I can bring this pink jacket back to my world...
messages.EUGENE_CONVO4_EUGENE1.m: I… [pause]think you look really nice, lit by the fire like that.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO4_EUGENE2: If I had a camera, I’d take a picture of you. [pause]Too bad I don’t, [pause]right?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO4_EUGENE1.n: I… [pause]think you look really nice, lit by the fire like that.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO4_EUGENE1.f: I… [pause]think you look really nice, lit by the fire like that.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO5_EUGENE1: How are you finding your {first_tape_name} form?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO5_EUGENE3: Transforming into {first_tape_description} to defend the people of New Wirral!
messages.EUGENE_CONVO6_EUGENE1: This is in, [pause]like, [pause]the top ten campfires I’ve ever helped make.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO7_EUGENE4: I hope it’s not like a dream, [pause]where you forget it moments after you’re back in the real world.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO10_EUGENE4: I’m normally kinda hopeless with relationships. [pause]Fighting Archangels is easier than trying to work out what someone else is feeling.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO7_EUGENE1.n: Do you think much about what life will be like when you go back home?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO7_EUGENE1.m: Do you think much about what life will be like when you go back home?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO7_EUGENE3: That must have crossed your mind too, [pause]right?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO8_EUGENE1: People in the past really had to carry round these plastic cassettes just to listen to music, [pause]huh.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO7_EUGENE1.f: Do you think much about what life will be like when you go back home?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO7_EUGENE5: I don’t want to forget you, {player}.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO8_EUGENE2: They’re pretty ancient, so I imagine a single cassette tape could probably only store a few thousand songs on it.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO8_EUGENE4: Hey, [pause]why are you giving me that look?! [pause]Am I wrong, or something?!
messages.EUGENE_CONVO9_EUGENE2: Being able to transform into monsters could empower people in wider society in ways we haven’t even [wave amp=30 freq=10]dreamed[/wave] of!
messages.EUGENE_CONVO9_EUGENE1: I hope we can bring this cassette technology back with us if we leave this island.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO9_EUGENE3: Imagine being able to transform into a fast monster to deliver groceries… [pause]or becoming a water monster to put out wildfires.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO10_EUGENE1.n: I’m... [pause]glad I’ve been able to meet you, {player}.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO9_EUGENE4: I’m pumped just talking about it!
messages.EUGENE_CONVO10_EUGENE1.f: I’m... [pause]glad I’ve been able to meet you, {player}.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO10_EUGENE1.m: I’m... [pause]glad I’ve been able to meet you, {player}.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO10_EUGENE3.m: Man, [pause]no-one is gonna believe I had a cute boyfriend on this magical island, [pause]are they?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO10_EUGENE3.f: Man, [pause]no-one is gonna believe I had a cute girlfriend on this magical island, [pause]are they?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO10_EUGENE3.n: Man, [pause]no-one is gonna believe I had a cute partner on this magical island, [pause]are they?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO10_EUGENE5: Maybe I should work on that…
messages.EUGENE_CONVO11_EUGENE6: Well, [pause]that new world was built from the ashes of the old one.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO11_EUGENE1: Do you ever think about… [pause]not going back to your world, {player}?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO11_EUGENE2: It’s like this: [pause]we’re not from the same point in our world’s history, are we?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO11_EUGENE3: We’re not from the same world, but from worlds that are probably quite similar.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO11_EUGENE4: So your world’s future could well be like my world’s history. [pause]Which means life might not be such smooth sailing for you, long term.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO11_EUGENE4_OPTION2: What happened in your world’s past?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO11_EUGENE5: I told you about how the people of my world built a new and better world, right?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO11_EUGENE7: I was born after the smoke had cleared, but those that lived through it… [pause]I think it is a burden on all of them.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO11_EUGENE8: Not only the memories of what they lost, but also the memories of the kind of people that they had to become.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO11_EUGENE9: I know I can't stop you going back home, but I worry about the world you may one day live to see.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO12_EUGENE2: When we’re all done here on New Wirral, I mean.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO11_EUGENE10: You deserve a better life than that, {player}.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO12_EUGENE1: Do you really think that giant gateway can really take us home?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO13_EUGENE2: Think about it – [pause]this whole miniature society is [wave amp=30 freq=10]built[/wave] on the foundation of a shared experience. That being the experience of marooned here on this weird island.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO12_EUGENE4: I hope it’s true. I have a lot of cool plans for life, y’know!
messages.EUGENE_CONVO13_EUGENE1: Man, [pause]if that big gateway does actually let people leave New Wirral, that’s gonna change a [wave amp=30 freq=10]lot[/wave] here.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO13_EUGENE3: Heck, a lot of folks here were born and raised by people from different worlds. They haven’t KNOWN anything else!
messages.EUGENE_CONVO14_EUGENE1: Um, [pause]I think we should talk about what happened.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO13_EUGENE4: I hope Ianthe is ready for how this discovery might change everything.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO14_EUGENE3: When we all fused into a giant [shake rate=30 level=10]god monster[/shake] together and [shake rate=30 level=10]kicked Aleph’s ass![/shake]
messages.EUGENE_CONVO14_EUGENE5: I’m gonna be pretty honest with you, there’s a whole lot of “Archangel” business on the island that I’m not keeping up with at all.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO14_EUGENE6: Like there’s all this [wave amp=30 freq=10]ancient history[/wave] with Morgante and Aleph, or something? Maybe the railway station is involved? [pause]I don’t know, man.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO14_EUGENE7: But what I do know is that we banded together and took down a big bad guy. [pause]That’s something I can wrap my brain around.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO15_EUGENE1: I hope your plan to find a way off this island works, buddy.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO15_EUGENE2: I’m starting to worry that New Wirral’s limited supply of hair dye is going to run out.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO16_EUGENE1: Man, that ruined town we passed through really creeped me out.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO16_EUGENE2: It reminded me of some places I’d see back home. Towns where people used to live, until times got tough and they were left abandoned.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO16_EUGENE3: I used to see a lot of those, actually.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO16_EUGENE4: Maybe in time, the people of Harbourtown could go back and build it all back up again.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO16_EUGENE5: I’d like to see that happen.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO17_EUGENE1: Gathering around a campfire in the wilderness, knowing all the while that [wave amp=30 freq=10]giant beasts[/wave] might attack us at any moment… [pause]I think you’re thinking the same thing I am right now, {player}.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO17_EUGENE2: You’re thinking: [pause]“this is just what life was like for my caveman ancestors!”
messages.EUGENE_CONVO17_EUGENE2_OPTION2: I have literally never thought that, ever.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO18_EUGENE1: I need to work on my battle shouts.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO17_EUGENE3: I’m totally right. You were thinking it too, buddy.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO18_EUGENE2: Yeah! [pause]Like when I’m facing down some foes, and just before I transform I yell something like, “let’s do this!” or “transform!”
messages.EUGENE_CONVO18_EUGENE2_OPTION1: You can do better than those!
messages.EUGENE_CONVO18_EUGENE5: What if I shouted [wave amp=30 freq=10]”I’m going monster mode!”[/wave] – would that work? [pause]Do you think that sounds badass?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO18_EUGENE6: I’ll come back to this another time, then.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO19_EUGENE1: Sorry, [pause]I’m still getting used to the fact that we’re technically a couple now.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO19_EUGENE2: Oh, I didn’t mean that in a [shake rate=30 level=10]bad[/shake] way!
messages.EUGENE_CONVO19_EUGENE3: I just wasn’t expecting something like [wave amp=30 freq=10]this[/wave] to happen to me here on New Wirral. Of course I’m [wave amp=30 freq=10]pumped[/wave] that we’re together!
messages.EUGENE_CONVO20_EUGENE1: It would be so easy to stay here together, wouldn’t it?
messages.EUGENE_CONVO20_EUGENE2: You and I, living life in the quiet but [wave amp=30 freq=10]idyllic[/wave] Harbourtown. Nothing changing.
messages.EUGENE_CONVO20_EUGENE3: But… I just don’t think that’s us, is it? [pause]I think we’re both meant for more.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL1_EUGENE4: A real manifestation of our inner strength.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL1_EUGENE5: Like, in the heat of the moment, our aims align so closely that we can literally become one powerful force.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL1_EUGENE6: In that moment, it’s like we’re [wave amp=30 freq=20]unstoppable[/wave].
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL1_EUGENE6_OPTION2: You sound like an anime character right now.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL1_EUGENE7A: Man, I knew you’d get it!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL1_EUGENE7B: Man, I’m trying to be earnest here!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL1_EUGENE8: I think I spent too long living without giving back, y’know?
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL1_EUGENE9: Maybe I’m making up for lost time.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL1_EUGENE9_OPTION1: What’s the deal with your world?
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL1_EUGENE10: Eh, don’t worry about it. We can talk about it another time.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL1_EUGENE9_OPTION2: What was happening on your world?
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL1_EUGENE11: I’ll go back. [pause]To my world, I mean. [pause]Once you find your doorway outta here, of course.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL1_EUGENE12: I’ll bring my cassette tapes with me, [pause]and I’ll stand up for the people who need it the most.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL2_EUGENE1: I was thinking about how Clémence totally just... [pause]decided to run a café just because it helped make the town better.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL2_EUGENE2: Improving things, making myself useful… [pause]That’s the kinda stuff I should be doing!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL2_EUGENE2_OPTION1: You don’t need to think about helping people all the time.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL2_EUGENE4: Maybe it’s just a compulsion that comes from my world.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL2_EUGENE5: OK, [pause]on “my earth”, [pause]around halfway through the 21st century, there was a kind of… [pause]an upheaval.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL2_EUGENE7: It was like everyone woke up one day and realised that we could survive better by just helping each other instead.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL2_EUGENE6: Humanity’s greed and consumption reached a point where the world couldn’t handle it anymore.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL2_EUGENE8: That we didn’t NEED the institutions that ruled over us while killing the planet.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL2_EUGENE9: Being able to help the people in your community slowly became more important than being rich and famous, [pause]but I was never… [pause]very good at it.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL3_EUGENE4: I’ll make Harbourtown better – [pause]just you wait and see.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL2_EUGENE10: Me being here in New Wirral, [pause]it’s a chance for me to transform into my best self, [pause]so I can return home as someone who can do something with my life.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL2_EUGENE10_OPTION1: You don’t need to be a hero to have value!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL2_EUGENE10_OPTION2: You don’t need to beat yourself up over this!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL2_EUGENE12: I think I need that for myself.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL3_EUGENE3: I’m gonna stop talking about doing something, [pause]and just do it.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL3_EUGENE2: I have a project in mind.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL3_EUGENE5: I don’t know… [pause]Stopping something [wave amp=30 freq=10]bad[/wave] doesn’t feel the same as doing something [wave amp=30 freq=10]good[/wave], [pause]right?
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL3_EUGENE4_OPTION2: You’ve already done your bit to help Harbourtown!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL3_EUGENE6: Alright, I’m pumped! [pause]It’s gonna be awesome, [pause]just you wait.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL3_EUGENE7.m: Nah, [pause]you’re just gonna have to wait and see!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL3_EUGENE6_OPTION2: Can you tell me what “it” is?
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL3_EUGENE8: The “defender of Harbourtown” should be able to keep a secret, [pause]after all.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL3_EUGENE7.f: Nah, [pause]you’re just gonna have to wait and see!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL3_EUGENE7.n: Nah, [pause]you’re just gonna have to wait and see!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_EUGENE7: I realised that this ugly old building has been sitting here vacant since we cleared out the Landkeepers, [pause]so I thought I could put it to good use!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_EUGENE2: I finished my project. I think it’s time for the grand opening.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_EUGENE3: Do you wanna head over now?
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_EUGENE11: Hey, we don’t hang out [wave amp=30 freq=10]ALL[/wave] the time! [pause]I have my own free time away from our adventuring!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_EUGENE6: This is where we went on our first [wave amp=30 freq=10]team-up mission[/wave] together!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_EUGENE9: With the ceiling window, [pause]this abandoned office actually gets a lot of natural light during the day.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_EUGENE10: I figured it could make a nice community garden. [pause]Folks could come on over and grow plants and flowers here, and get out of town for a little bit.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_EUGENE10_OPTION1: When did you do all this?!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_EUGENE10_OPTION2: Where did you find the time for all this?!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_EUGENE14: I was convinced that this was a really dumb idea.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_EUGENE2.f: You’re the one trying to find a way off this island! [pause]The limits of time and space don’t even hold you back!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_EUGENE2.m: You’re the one trying to find a way off this island! [pause]The limits of time and space don’t even hold you back!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_EUGENE15_OPTION2: This is pretty romantic of you.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_EUGENE1: Heh, [pause]c’mon. [pause]Between the two of us, you’re the one with the grand aspirations.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_EUGENE3: I’m looking forward to going back to my real home. [pause]I think I’ve become my best, badass self here.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_EUGENE2.n: You’re the one trying to find a way off this island! [pause]The limits of time and space don’t even hold you back!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_EUGENE1: Well I guess it was time New Wirral had a new date spot.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_EUGENE1_OPTION1: I’d say your project was a success!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_EUGENE1_OPTION2: So… that makes this a date?
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_EUGENE3: If [pause]you want it to be, [pause]of course.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_EUGENE3_OPTION1: Not so confident with romance, huh?
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_EUGENE3_OPTION2: I’ve never seen you so nervous!
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_EUGENE5: It’s pretty embarrassing that I can take down an evil cabal of office ghouls no problem…
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_EUGENE6.m: But struggle to tell my partner-in-crime how I really feel about him.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_EUGENE6.f: But struggle to tell my partner-in-crime how I really feel about her.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_EUGENE6.n: But struggle to tell my partner-in-crime how I really feel about them.
messages.EUGENE_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_EUGENE7: Yeah, [pause]I guess this is a date.
messages.EUGENE_ROMANCE_EUGENE1.m: You’re pretty quiet. [pause]Is everything all good, [pause]buddy?
messages.EUGENE_ROMANCE_EUGENE1.f: You’re pretty quiet. [pause]Is everything all good, [pause]buddy?
messages.EUGENE_ROMANCE_EUGENE1.n: You’re pretty quiet. [pause]Is everything all good, [pause]buddy?
messages.EUGENE_ROMANCE_EUGENE8: But while we’re together, let’s have fun!
messages.EUGENE_ROMANCE_EUGENE3: I know. [pause]I mean, I do too. [pause]I’m just nervous.
messages.EUGENE_ROMANCE_EUGENE5: Together we’re greater than the sum of our parts. [pause]It’s like when we fuse!
messages.EUGENE_ROMANCE_EUGENE4: I think both of us help each other become our best selves.
messages.EUGENE_ROMANCE_EUGENE7: You mean a lot to me, [pause]but I have my old life that’s waiting for me to return back to. [pause]And you do too.
messages.EUGENE_ROMANCE_EUGENE6: That said… [pause]we might have to break up if we find our way off the island.
messages.EUGENE_ROMANCE_EUGENE9: There are people to help, and giant monsters to punch really hard in the face.
messages.EUGENE_ROMANCE_EUGENE10: The same as always – [pause]Harbourtown’s unstoppable power couple!
messages.EUGENE_ROMANCE_EUGENE11: Though maybe we can pause the adventuring, [pause]at least for tonight...
messages.FELIX_INTRO_FELIX1: Watch your feet. [pause]You don’t wanna trip up on all the junk lying around here.
messages.FELIX_INTRO_FELIX3: Not me. I dropped in here with all my stuff.
messages.FELIX_INTRO_FELIX1_OPTION1: Where did this room come from?
messages.FELIX_INTRO_FELIX4: This was once my apartment… [pause]Give or take a couple of walls.
messages.FELIX_INTRO_FELIX2: Most people fall out of the sky and land in the ocean here, right?
messages.FELIX_INTRO_FELIX5: Beats me! [pause]It does mean I’ve got all my old sketchbooks and artwork, [pause]though.
messages.FELIX_INTRO_FELIX4_OPTION2: How did your whole apartment travel to New Wirral?
messages.FELIX_INTRO_MEREDITH7: Been a while since I saw you, Felix. What are you, uh, doing here, anyway?
messages.FELIX_INTRO_FELIX9: A lot of this stuff was wrecked when this whole place dropped out of the sky with me in it, [pause]and then the rain damage didn’t help...
messages.FELIX_INTRO_KAYLEIGH7: Hey, Felix! [pause]What’re you doing out here?
messages.FELIX_INTRO_VIOLA7: And I am Viola of Messaline. [pause]Pray, what task has you toiling out here alone?
messages.FELIX_INTRO_EUGENE7: Hey man! Is this where you’ve been hanging out? [pause]What are you doing out here?
messages.FELIX_INTRO_SUNNY7: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Nice to meet you, Felix…[/wave]
messages.FELIX_INTRO_FELIX10: But there’s something around here that I’m confident will be intact…
messages.FELIX_INTRO_FELIX12: The seal is still intact, so hopefully no water got in.
messages.FELIX_INTRO_FELIX13: It might be hard to explain...
messages.FELIX_INTRO_FELIX14: Come swing by my place in West Harbourtown. [pause]Then I’ll show you.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX1.m: Oh hey. [pause]You came to hang out.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX2: You wanna see what I rescued from the sad remains of my old place?
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX1.n: Oh hey. [pause]You came to hang out.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX1.f: Oh hey. [pause]You came to hang out.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX3: So, in my regular life I was a zote artist.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX2_NO: No worries. Come say hi if you change your mind.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX4: It’s easier to show. Check this out:
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX5: So this is a zote reel. You slot it into this zoetrope right here, then look through the slot.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX6: The Zoetrope has a motor in it, so when I hit this button, it spins.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX8: When spun round, it animates and comes to life, [pause]right?
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX7: The row of the zote strip has the same image drawn over and over with variations.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX9: Then you can pull the lever to switch to the next row, [pause]for the next part of the story.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX12: They used to be very popular, [pause]though they’ve kind of fallen out of fashion.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX11: I’ve been obsessed with zotes ever since I was a kid.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX10: You can tell a whole story, [pause]and bring it to life, [pause]just with drawings.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX14: Most zote stories are about heroes in the French Revolution, [pause]like the Scarlet Pimpernel, [pause]but ever since the big budget movie adaptations really took off there’s been less interest in the source material.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX13: It’s more of a niche medium now. [pause]At least, [pause]where I am from, [pause]I mean.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX15: I got into these stories as a kid, [pause]and couldn’t shake my love for them.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX16: I guess that’s why I’m an artist now.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX18: And it turns out, an island full of weird monsters is the perfect place to find inspiration!
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX17: Right now I’m trying to come up with some new characters…
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX19: Which means… you might be able to help me out.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX20: I’m searching for a particular creature, and wanna get a good look at one.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX21: I know you can find it in the Cherry Meadow. It’s a [wave amp=30 freq=10]warrior with a wooden sword.[/wave]
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX22: Can you help me out here?
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX22_NO: No worries. If your schedule frees up, swing by here and we can go on this little venture.
messages.FELIX_INTRO2_FELIX23: Cool! I’ll mark it on your map for you.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART1_FELIX1: That’s it! OK, you fight it and I’ll sketch it.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PASSIVE_FELIX1: The rangers have talked about this creature – they say it stands with a perfect warrior pose.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PASSIVE_FELIX2: This place is pretty beautiful, huh?
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART3_FELIX4: It was in my apartment with me when I landed here, so I still have it.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART2_FELIX12: Let’s go back to my place. Everything will become clear, I promise.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART2_FELIX11: I think my past is coming back to haunt me.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART3_FELIX1: It has to be in here somewhere, [pause]I…
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART3_FELIX3: Here. This is my old sketchbook from when I was 12 years old.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART3_FELIX7: She was a character I made up as a kid.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART3_FELIX7_OPTION2: How come she has cat ears?
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART3_FELIX8: She’s like, [pause]the daughter of an angel and a demon who was lost on earth and adopted by a mystical ninja clan....
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART3_FELIX9: When she became 21, [pause]she left her home on an epic quest to battle at four elemental altars and prove her worth as the greatest warrior in the land.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART3_FELIX9_OPTION3: Your art has definitely improved since then…
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART3_FELIX10: I was going through an anime phase in middle school. [pause]Don’t judge me!
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART3_FELIX12: I have NO idea how my [wave amp=30 freq=10]low quality childhood drawing[/wave] has become real.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART3_FELIX11: I am FULLY aware of how lame this whole situation is!
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART3_FELIX13: But if Kuneko really is here in this world… [pause]I need to find her.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART3_FELIX14: I need to get to the bottom of this.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_FELIX3: You saved me earlier… [pause]Do you know me?
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_KUNEKO4: I-I have never met you, but I feel a strong connection to you…
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_FELIX6: I mean, I did create you.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_FELIX12: You really don’t have to keep calling me “creator”.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_KUNEKO9: I am [wave amp=30 freq=10]so sorry[/wave] for not recognising you, creator!
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_KUNEKO10: Some time ago, I woke up in the meadow where we first met, [pause]with nothing but my name on my lips and my quest in my heart.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_KUNEKO11: I have no other memories, creator.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_KUNEKO20: I must find the four elemental shrines across this land, and defeat the beasts that guard them.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_KUNEKO21: Only THEN will I prove my strength!
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_FELIX23: Kuneko, you probably shouldn’t go on this “quest”. It’s not real... [pause]I [wave amp=30 freq=10]made it up[/wave] for your backstory.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_FELIX22: Man, I really couldn’t have come up with a better storyline, could I?
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_FELIX24: Not to mention, the creatures in New Wirral are pretty dangerous.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_KUNEKO25: I know you don’t think I have what it takes, creator…
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_KUNEKO26: Which is why I have [wave amp=30 freq=10]no choice[/wave] but to prove myself!
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_FELIX25: This is all… [pause]really weird. [pause]It’s not just me, [pause]right?
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_FELIX25_OPTION2: About as weird as everything else on this island.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_FELIX26: I’ve created much less embarrassing characters since I was a kid. [pause]Why HER?
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_FELIX27: Either way, [pause]if she’s only here because I invented her, I guess I feel somewhat responsible for her.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_FELIX28: We should find these four “elemental altars” and make sure she’s not putting herself in harm’s way.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR1_FELIX1: I guess these altars really are real. [pause]That figures.
messages.FELIX_QUEST1_PART4_FELIX29: We could look around the island, or maybe ask around town. [pause]Your call, {player}.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR1_KUNEKO3: I must prove my strength, creator…
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR1_KUNEKO4: By my pointy blade… [shake rate=30 level=10]show yourself, guardian![/shake]
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR1_FELIX5: C’mon, we should help her out.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR1_KUNEKO6: Thank you for your assistance, creator...
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR1_KUNEKO7: But I won’t need [wave amp=30 freq=10]any[/wave] help on the next battle!
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR1_FELIX8: She’s still committed to this, huh?
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR2_KUNEKO1: By the powers of the sun and the moon conveniently shining at the same time...
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR2_FELIX3: She’s really getting into the role, here.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR2_FELIX6: Honestly, it’s really no big deal…
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR2_FELIX7: And… she’s gone. [pause]We should try and find the next shrine.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR3_KUNEKO2: By the power of fire and ice, [pause]making my passion for justice hot and cold at the same time…
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR3_FELIX6: I don’t want you to hurt yourself!
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR3_FELIX8: You don’t have to do this to impress me.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR3_KUNEKO10: I know what you really think of me, [pause]creator.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR3_KUNEKO11: I know you’re [shake rate=30 level=10]embarrassed[/shake] you made me.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR3_KUNEKO14: My quest [shake rate=30 level=10]isn’t[/shake] to impress you.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR3_KUNEKO13: I can tell by the way you look at me!
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR3_KUNEKO15: I know there’s nothing I could [shake rate=30 level=10]ever[/shake] do to make you proud of me!
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR3_FELIX18: I should find her and apologise.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR3_FELIX17_OPTION3: I know you didn’t mean it.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR3_FELIX19: She’ll be at the final shrine, right?
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO2: The deck of cards is shuffled! I’ve drawn my final hand… [pause]Straight flush!
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO6: I am just a forgotten thought, [pause]aren’t I, [pause][shake rate=30 level=10]creator?[/shake]
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX4: OK, [pause]let’s help and THEN I can apologise.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX12: I’m sorry… [pause]this is all my fault, [pause]{player}...
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO7: An idea you had fun with once, [pause]before being [shake rate=30 level=10]discarded?[/shake]
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO_NOT_ENOUGH_TA: Come back and face me when you’re ready!
Come back and face me when you’re ready!
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO8: By the shining powers of earth, water, fire and air…
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO_NOT_ENOUGH_TA: Come back and face me when you’re ready!
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO9: [shake rate=30 level=10]MY TRUE POTENTIAL IS REVEALED![/shake]
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX10: She… [pause][pause]united the four elements within herself...
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX13: I want to survive, so I can make things right… [pause]That’s all I want…
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX14: C’mon, [pause]I know together we can make things right!
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX16: I viewed you and all my other adolescent creations as embarrassing.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX17: But we all start somewhere. If I hadn't imagined you, hadn’t [wave amp=30 freq=10]drawn[/wave] you…
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX18: I wouldn’t be the artist I am today.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX19: I shouldn’t pretend you don’t exist, I should embrace you, and what you mean to me as an artist.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX21: I do. [pause]Besides, you looked pretty cool to me just now.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX23: OK, OK, [pause]calm it down a bit.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO25: I mean, [pause]sorry for trying to kill you, [pause]“Felix”.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO24: Sorry for trying to kill you just now, creator...
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX27: Kuneko, there’s something I need to know…
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX28: How are you [wave amp=30 freq=10]real[/wave]? I don’t get it.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO31: Perhaps once you create something, it no longer belongs to you. [pause]Ideas change and grow of their own accord.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO30: But if you were to ask what I [wave amp=30 freq=10]believe[/wave], then I would say…
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO32: [wave amp=30 freq=10]You[/wave] are the artist, Creator Felix. [pause]You should know this more than I.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX33_OPTION1: What are you going to do now?
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO34: I don’t think I can join you both in your humble town… [pause]That is not my path.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO35: Naw, I need to become my own person! [pause]I must follow my crystal heart wherever it leads me.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO35_OPTION3: Is your heart actually crystal or is that a figure of speech?
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO40: Here – [pause]my power, gifted to you. [pause]I hope it reminds you of our times battling together.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX36: Well if this is where our paths diverge....
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX37: I’m thankful that I met you, Kuneko!
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO39.m: And farewell also, [pause]Creator Felix’s quieter friend.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO39.f: And farewell also, [pause]Creator Felix’s quieter friend.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO39.n: And farewell also, [pause]Creator Felix’s quieter friend.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX42: …[pause]She really needs to work on her dramatic metaphors.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX43: Well. This has been an interesting experience.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_KUNEKO41: M-may our memories burn like beacons that illuminate our [shake rate=30 level=10]true paths forward![/shake]
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX44: And I’m not just talking about us [wave amp=30 freq=10]combining[/wave] into one big monster. That was, um, new.
messages.FELIX_CONVO1_FELIX5: Will it come back if I get to go back home? It makes me wonder.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX45: It made me feel a bit motion sick if I’m honest, but maybe next time I’ll be ready for it!
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_ALTAR4_FELIX46: C’mon – let’s go back to my place so we can catch up. [pause]Besides, I have inspiration for a new sketch.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_EPILOGUE_FELIX2: I want to draw more than ever. [pause]I want to create new characters...
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_EPILOGUE_FELIX1: I think that whole adventure really lit a fire in me.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_EPILOGUE_FELIX3: I want to make a real good living with my art and work on my own terms, too.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_EPILOGUE_FELIX4: So… [pause]I think I’m ready to go home.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_EPILOGUE_FELIX5: That’s what you’re searching for, isn’t it? [pause]A way back?
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_EPILOGUE_FELIX8: But so are your childhood characters coming to life, y’know?
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_EPILOGUE_FELIX7: Folks in town say it’s impossible…
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_EPILOGUE_FELIX9: If you think there’s a way, then I trust you.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_EPILOGUE_FELIX10: You can count me in, no worries.
messages.FELIX_QUEST2_EPILOGUE_FELIX12: Here’s the sketch I told you I wanted to draw.
messages.FELIX_CONVO1_FELIX1: You wanna hear something kinda weird?
messages.FELIX_CONVO1_FELIX2: I used to have a scar on my upper arm right here. I fell into a chain fence as a kid and cut my arm real bad.
messages.FELIX_CONVO1_FELIX3: It’s not there anymore. [pause]Ever since I arrived here in New Wirral.
messages.FELIX_CONVO1_FELIX4: I… [pause]I don’t know what that means... [pause]I just thought it was interesting.
messages.FELIX_CONVO2_FELIX1: Hey, have you ever eaten butter tarts?
messages.FELIX_CONVO2_FELIX2: I should totally make you some! [pause]I’m pretty sure I could source all the ingredients here…
messages.FELIX_CONVO2_FELIX3: Well, [pause]raisins might be a bit hard to come by, but if you ask me? [pause]That’s for the best.
messages.FELIX_CONVO3_FELIX1: I don’t know if you’ve noticed, [pause]but a lot of folks in New Wirral aren’t outsiders like you and me.
messages.FELIX_CONVO3_FELIX2: Their parents and grandparents washed up here, [pause]sure, [pause]but this island is all they’ve known.
messages.FELIX_CONVO3_FELIX3: I wonder how that must feel, [pause]to be surrounded by people who are lost in the only place you’ve ever known home… [pause]and to then grow up hearing about worlds you’ll never get to visit.
messages.FELIX_CONVO3_FELIX4: Maybe they feel just as stuck here as we do.
messages.FELIX_CONVO4_FELIX2: Is that weird? [pause]I mean, [pause]there weren’t any monsters where I grew up.
messages.FELIX_CONVO4_FELIX1: Being here on this island reminds me of being in my hometown.
messages.FELIX_CONVO4_FELIX3: But that sense of longing to move on and escape, [pause]but not being able to...
messages.FELIX_CONVO4_FELIX4: Not to say that I don’t love hanging out with you and the others, but…
messages.FELIX_CONVO4_FELIX5: There’s a big world out there. [pause]Many different worlds, [pause]it turns out. [pause]I want to see as much as I can.
messages.FELIX_CONVO5_FELIX2: It must be weird to be told that your whole life was a creation of some dorky artist.
messages.FELIX_CONVO5_FELIX1: I hope Kuneko is doing OK.
messages.FELIX_CONVO5_FELIX3: Wait! [pause]What if we’re [wave amp=30 freq=10]all[/wave] just created by someone else in the same way?
messages.FELIX_CONVO6_FELIX1: Before I came here, [pause]I never would have guessed that my next relationship would involve so many campfires.
messages.FELIX_CONVO7_FELIX6: It’s… [pause]pretty impressive when you think about it.
messages.FELIX_CONVO6_FELIX2: Life can really throw something unexpected at you now and then, [pause]huh?
messages.FELIX_CONVO6_FELIX3: I’m not complaining. [pause]I like camping out here with you.
messages.FELIX_CONVO7_FELIX1: Maybe there are some good lessons to be learned from life in Harbourtown.
messages.FELIX_CONVO7_FELIX2: I mean, [pause]there’s not exactly a bustling nightlife, but…
messages.FELIX_CONVO7_FELIX3: The whole town relies on each other, so no one is really left behind.
messages.FELIX_CONVO7_FELIX4: There’s enough food to go round, but not so much that anything goes to waste.
messages.FELIX_CONVO7_FELIX5: It’s cut off from human civilisation, [pause]but still manages to get by.
messages.FELIX_CONVO8_FELIX1: You know, [pause]being stranded on an island covered in monsters, away from my friends and family…
messages.FELIX_CONVO8_FELIX2: It should be an unimaginable situation... [pause]but I’m finding myself adjusting pretty well.
messages.FELIX_CONVO9_FELIX1: The new zote story I’m cooking up… [pause]I think I’ve really landed on something that works for it.
messages.FELIX_CONVO8_FELIX3: I guess even if the world was ending, we’d still find ways to get through the day, [pause]wouldn’t we?
messages.FELIX_CONVO8_FELIX4: People are weird like that. [pause]Myself included.
messages.FELIX_CONVO9_FELIX2: However, I need to be sure it’s the best story I can do. I don’t know for sure I’ll get another chance, after all.
messages.FELIX_CONVO9_FELIX3: Who knows! [pause]Maybe I’ll lose my touch. [pause]Maybe I’ll get trapped on another island. [pause]Maybe the world will end.
messages.FELIX_CONVO9_FELIX2_OPTION2: Why wouldn’t you get another chance?
messages.FELIX_CONVO9_FELIX4: I always try to treat the project I’m working on like it could be the last thing I ever create. That making it might be my lasting legacy on the world.
messages.FELIX_CONVO9_FELIX5: I can’t be sure it [wave amp=30 freq=10]won’t[/wave] be, after all.
messages.FELIX_CONVO10_FELIX1: I think I'm on a pretty good creative streak at the moment. I’m pretty happy about it!
messages.FELIX_CONVO19_FELIX2: You don’t have “zote strips” where you’re from? [pause]But you DO have something called “comic books”, which you think are stylistically similar?
messages.FELIX_CONVO10_FELIX1_OPTION2: You’re always in a good mood!
messages.FELIX_CONVO10_FELIX3: I [wave amp=30 freq=10]try[/wave] to have a good perspective on things.
messages.FELIX_CONVO10_FELIX5: Spite can only motivate you for so long, though. [pause]I’m trying to have a more positive outlook on life.
messages.FELIX_CONVO10_FELIX4: After I quit my job, I was pretty angry. It’s easy to let a bad experience like that turn you bitter.
messages.FELIX_CONVO10_FELIX6: Besides, this island is too weird to take seriously. What’s the point in letting it get you down?
messages.FELIX_CONVO11_FELIX2: Can I take all my sketches back with me? Will they travel? I hope so!
messages.FELIX_CONVO11_FELIX1: If that big gateway does actually lead us off New Wirral, maybe I need to start thinking about packing my stuff.
messages.FELIX_CONVO12_FELIX1: That big fight on top of the train was pretty rad, huh?
messages.FELIX_CONVO12_FELIX2: I’m slowly trying to parse all the information we have around the “Archangels”.
messages.FELIX_CONVO12_FELIX3: The one with the triangle head – Aleph – he said something that stood out to me as [wave amp=30 freq=10]crucial[/wave] information.
messages.FELIX_CONVO12_FELIX4: He said that we humans “manifest” them from our most prevalent thoughts, and that in turn they’d travel to our worlds to act out our fantasies.
messages.FELIX_CONVO12_FELIX5: Do you think it’s true? Do you think Aleph [wave amp=30 freq=10]visited[/wave] our worlds in the ancient past? We’re not even [wave amp=30 freq=10]from[/wave] the same worlds, so how does that work?
messages.FELIX_CONVO12_FELIX6: Is the true role of mankind to develop ideas and imagine things that then become [wave amp=30 freq=10]real[/wave] in other worlds? Or am I just overthinking all of this?
messages.FELIX_CONVO12_FELIX7: It starts to make your head spin, doesn’t it?
messages.FELIX_CONVO12_FELIX7_OPTION1: I didn’t know you were such a detective!
messages.FELIX_CONVO12_FELIX8: It just seemed pretty important to keep track of all this stuff, I guess.
messages.FELIX_CONVO12_FELIX7_OPTION2: I didn’t realise you were paying attention to all of this!
messages.FELIX_CONVO13_FELIX1.n: Hey – congrats on becoming a ranger captain, {player}!
messages.FELIX_CONVO13_FELIX1.m: Hey – congrats on becoming a ranger captain, {player}!
messages.FELIX_CONVO12_FELIX9: You never know – I might get to use all these concepts in a story one day!
messages.FELIX_CONVO13_FELIX2: You’re gonna have a lot of jobs to do, now. I hope you’re still gonna have free time to hang out!
messages.FELIX_CONVO13_FELIX1.f: Hey – congrats on becoming a ranger captain, {player}!
messages.FELIX_CONVO14_FELIX1: Oh, [pause]I heard about what happened with you, Kayleigh and those weird cultist guys.
messages.FELIX_CONVO14_FELIX2: They had some charismatic leader who wanted to gain an Archangel’s power, or something, right?
messages.FELIX_CONVO14_FELIX3: I hope they’re all OK. It can’t be easy to go through all that, [wave amp=30 freq=10]especially[/wave] on New Wirral.
messages.FELIX_CONVO15_FELIX1: Do you think the monsters round here are afraid of fire? I’ve noticed that they don’t seem to attack us whilst we’re camping out.
messages.FELIX_CONVO15_FELIX3: Maybe it’s just bad monster etiquette to attack humans when they’re resting!
messages.FELIX_CONVO16_FELIX2: They were born and raised on this island and haven’t known anywhere else. Their parents met after washing up here.
messages.FELIX_CONVO16_FELIX1: One of the ranger captains was recently asking me about what life was like for me before I “landed here”.
messages.FELIX_CONVO16_FELIX3: They wanted to know about things like trains, shopping malls, and sports teams…
messages.FELIX_CONVO16_FELIX4: A whole bunch of basic stuff that I guess I never considered someone here might grow up not knowing about.
messages.FELIX_CONVO17_FELIX1: Being out here with only a fire to warm us… it reminds me of summer camp!
messages.FELIX_CONVO16_FELIX5: I suppose life isn’t complicated here, but at least people can still grow up happy.
messages.FELIX_CONVO17_FELIX2: …Or it would, if I ever went to summer camp. [pause]Which I didn’t.
messages.FELIX_CONVO18_FELIX1: Hey, you should let me draw you sometime! Figure drawing is an important skill for artists to master.
messages.FELIX_CONVO17_FELIX3: But this is pretty close to how I [wave amp=30 freq=10]imagined[/wave] summer camp would be like as a kid… so I’m happy.
messages.FELIX_CONVO18_FELIX2: Human anatomy is really hard to get right.
messages.FELIX_CONVO18_FELIX3: Especially hands. I still struggle with drawing hands.
messages.FELIX_CONVO19_FELIX1: So let me get this straight…
messages.FELIX_CONVO19_FELIX3: But these “comic books” of yours don’t [wave amp=30 freq=10]animate[/wave] at all? They’re just printed on paper, and you just [wave amp=30 freq=10]look[/wave] at them?
messages.FELIX_CONVO19_FELIX4: That sounds pretty weird to me, but I’ll take your word for it!
messages.FELIX_CONVO20_FELIX1: Maybe I should start documenting more of the monsters on this island in my notebook.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX2: About how this adventure lit a fire in me. Do you remember?
messages.FELIX_CONVO20_FELIX2: Maybe if I get to go home, I can use my notes as proof that I really WAS on an island populated by monsters.
messages.FELIX_CONVO20_FELIX3: Though I suspect my chances of [wave amp=30 freq=10]anyone[/wave] believing me are slim to none.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX1: So, something I said after we said goodbye to Kuneko…
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX3: I was kind of in a creative rut before I was, like, dropped here.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX5: I wasn’t in charge but, [pause]like, [pause]it was my baby, [pause]you know? [pause]It wouldn’t have happened without the blood and sweat I’d put in.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX4: For a long time I worked at a company making zote stories. [pause]Art, writing, the whole package.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX6: I waited for so long for my superiors to recognise my contribution, but they never did.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX7: Instead they shuffled me around in the company, and distanced me from the stories and characters I’d been working on for so long.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX8: They also made damn sure not to pay me what I was worth, either.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX9: So… Eventually I quit and tried to strike it out on my own.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX11: All the bitterness from my previous work made it hard to get into the mindset I needed to create art again.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX4: As far as I can tell, these cassette players are just regular old-fashioned cassette players. My old man used to have one that looked similar.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX12: So that’s why I feel like I’m here in New Wirral for a reason.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX14: I think I have an easier time talking to you about it on account of us having fused into a super monster.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX14_OPTION1: That’s right, we have indeed done that!
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX14_OPTION2: I suppose that does bring people together!
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX17: Shall we get back to the grindstone, then?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL1_FELIX16: Anyway, I can’t go back until we find your doorway out.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX2: Like, OK. The cassette tapes that record monsters… How do you think that works, exactly?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX1: Do you think that different worlds can have different… [pause]logics?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX2_OPTION1: The cassette players are advanced scientific inventions.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX2_OPTION2: The cassette players are enchanted with magic.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX3A: I have thought of that… [pause]Which is why I asked Meredith to take a look inside one. [pause]Apparently they look totally normal.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX3B: I mean, is magic real here? [pause]I don’t exactly see wizards flying around shooting spells at each other.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX5.n: This character is the Outsider – [pause]they’re a knight who’s travelled from their distant land to seek the challenge of the Jade Swordsman.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX5: From what I’ve been told, the rangers found a bunch of them in the abandoned mall a few years back, and that’s where the island’s supply comes from.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX6: So I guess that’s why I ask if you think a world can have its own logic.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX8: What a concept! I’m definitely using that in my story…
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX7: Maybe mundane items from our worlds can have different “rules” in this one.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX9: It’s no big deal right now… Just some ideas I’m playing round with.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX11: Maybe we should get back to adventuring – it’ll give me some more ideas, that’s for sure.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL2_FELIX10: If it becomes something more substantial, I’ll let you know.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL3_FELIX1: I’ve been thinking about what Kuneko said.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL3_FELIX3: All the monsters of New Wirral have been on my mind for a reason I haven’t been able to really express until now.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL3_FELIX2: About how ideas grow on their own. It got me thinking…
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL3_FELIX6: If this process IS real, then maybe it’s also not an exact science. [pause]Maybe it’s chaotic, and unpredictable.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL3_FELIX4: The monsters here have traffic cones on their backs, trash cans for bodies and televisions for heads...
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL3_FELIX5: Do you think images and myths we have can become so widespread that they can physically manifest as beings in other worlds like this one?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL3_FELIX7: Maybe images and concepts can combine to create unusual results, or maybe sometimes the ideas that manifest into reality don’t have to be widespread.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL3_FELIX9: Maybe I’m starting to understand this world a bit more.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL3_FELIX8: Maybe sometimes all it takes is a pencil sketch that a dork in Canada drew when he was a kid.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX12.f: I can’t force an ending onto them. The decisions the Outsider makes is down to them.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX2: I have something to show you – you want to come hang at my place for a bit?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX4.m: OK, are you ready for this?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX5.m: This character is the Outsider – [pause]he’s a knight who’s travelled from his distant land to seek the challenge of the Jade Swordsman.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX4.n: OK, are you ready for this?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX4.f: OK, are you ready for this?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX6.m: You see, the Jade Swordsman is an immortal machine from a long-dead civilisation who challenged the Outsider to a battle and won.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX5.f: This character is the Outsider – [pause]she’s a knight who’s travelled from her distant land to seek the challenge of the Jade Swordsman.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX7.m: The Outsider now must stick to his word to journey to the Swordsman’s fortress and submit to execution, lest the Swordsman bring ruin to the Outsider’s homeland.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX6.f: You see, the Jade Swordsman is an immortal machine from a long-dead civilisation who challenged the Outsider to a battle and won.
