messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX7.n: The Outsider now must stick to their word to journey to the Swordsman’s fortress and submit to execution, lest the Swordsman bring ruin to the Outsider’s homeland.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX7_OPTION2.m: Is there nothing the Outsider can do?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX8.m: The Outsider is quiet, but he’s resourceful and determined. I don’t think the Outsider intends to bow down to their fate so easily.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX7_OPTION2.f: Is there nothing the Outsider can do?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX7_OPTION2.n: Is there nothing the Outsider can do?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX8.f: The Outsider is quiet, but she’s resourceful and determined. I don’t think the Outsider intends to bow down to their fate so easily.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX8.n: The Outsider is quiet, but they’re resourceful and determined. I don’t think the Outsider intends to bow down to their fate so easily.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX9: It’s a loose adaptation of Sir Gawain and the Green Knight, which is a medieval story about a knight of King Arthur’s court who makes a similar journey.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX10: I don’t know how my version will end just yet – [pause]I’ll have to see where the story takes me.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX11: Well, I create the characters, but who [wave amp=30 freq=10]they[/wave] are determines where the story goes.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX10_OPTION2: Aren’t you in control of the story?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_FELIX1_OPTION1: Asking me out on a date would have been easier.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX12.m: I can’t force an ending onto them. The decisions the Outsider makes is down to them.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX13: And down to you of course. You’re my inspiration after all.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX12.n: I can’t force an ending onto them. The decisions the Outsider makes is down to them.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX15.f: The travelling hero from far away who’s determined to fight their dead-end fate?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX15.n: The travelling hero from far away who’s determined to fight their dead-end fate?
messages.RESTING_DOG_7: You try to play fetch with Barkley, but he’s more interested in the scents of nearby monsters.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX15.m: The travelling hero from far away who’s determined to fight their dead-end fate?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_FELIX1: I try my best. How did I do?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_FELIX16_OPTION2: You’re such a hopeless romantic, Felix.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_FELIX2.f: You’re a cool warrior with a quest. [pause]They say write what you know, so of course I’m gonna write my cool adventuring buddy.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_FELIX2.n: You’re a cool warrior with a quest. [pause]They say write what you know, so of course I’m gonna write my cool adventuring buddy.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_FELIX2.m: You’re a cool warrior with a quest. [pause]They say write what you know, so of course I’m gonna write my cool adventuring buddy.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_FELIX3: I have loads more sketches and character designs in mind for this story. [pause]You want to see them?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_FELIX2: I mean, the zote story wasn’t a ploy just to get you to spend time with me.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_FELIX1_OPTION2: I see you as a friend.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_FELIX3: I [wave amp=30 freq=10]am[/wave] actually going to write more of it.
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_FELIX4: But can you blame me for going all out? [pause]I like to put in effort where it matters.
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX1.m: You’re quieter than usual, {player}! Is there something on your mind?
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX1.f: You’re quieter than usual, {player}! Is there something on your mind?
messages.FELIX_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_FELIX5: Like I said, I try my best.
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX_NO: My bad. I should appreciate when someone is just having time to themselves.
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX1.n: You’re quieter than usual, {player}! Is there something on your mind?
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX13: But even if we are eventually gonna have to say goodbye…
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX5: I’ve never been the one asked out before. [pause]This is unorthodox.
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX3: I’ve had a couple relationships before, [pause]but honestly?
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX4: I’m normally the one making the big moves.
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX9.f: A mysterious girl wanders into my life one day, [pause]fights alongside me, [pause]literally [wave amp=30 freq=10]merges[/wave] with me in battle, [pause]and also she’s hot?
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX9.m: A mysterious guy wanders into my life one day, [pause]fights alongside me, [pause]literally [wave amp=30 freq=10]merges[/wave] with me in battle, [pause]and also he’s hot?
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX9.n: A mysterious person wanders into my life one day, [pause]fights alongside me, [pause]literally [wave amp=30 freq=10]merges[/wave] with me in battle, [pause]and also they’re hot?
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX11: There’s a high chance that if we do find a way back, [pause]we don’t actually come from the same world.
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX10: I’d have to be a damn fool to say no.
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX12: You’ve never heard of “zotes”, [pause]and I’ve never heard of your “comic books.”
messages.FELIX_ROMANCE_FELIX14: I want to share this story with you. [pause]For as long as it lasts.
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_MEREDITH1: Ugh, typical. There’s always something trying to kill us, isn’t there?
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_EUGENE1: The more opponents, the better the workout, [pause]right?
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_KAYLEIGH1: I’m a little concerned about this…
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_FELIX1: ...Oh. I guess this was an ambush.
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_VIOLA2: This country shows no kindness, strangers.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST2_PART1_VIOLA6: If it is not too great a task, [pause]could you take me to the place you saw him?
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_VIOLA3: Come – [pause]let us match these beasts in number!
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_VIOLA6: You surely have no reason to remain in such a place as this.
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_VIOLA5: You would do well to leave before those fiends return...
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_KAYLEIGH7: At least let us thank you! Who are you?
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_MEREDITH7: Nice hat. Who are you, anyway?
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_EUGENE7: C’mon, [pause]we’re battle buddies! [pause]At least tell us your name.
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_SUNNY7: [wave amp=20 freq=5]That was very brave of you to help us! Who are you…?[/wave]
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_FELIX7: That was a pretty dramatic fight. [pause]Can you at least tell us your name?
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_VIOLA9: I am no fighter, but this land has thrust such a role upon me.
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_VIOLA10: I do not wish to trouble you with my burdens.
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_VIOLA12: My brother and I were both cast to the seas.
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_VIOLA13: If I have not drowned, perhaps he too came to rest upon these shores...
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_VIOLA14: I have been searching for some weeks now. A kind soul gifted to me this curious device, with which I may protect myself.
messages.VIOLA_INTRO1_VIOLA15: If you hear word of my brother Sebastian, my camp is just east from here.
messages.VIOLA_INTRO2_VIOLA1: We meet again. How fares thee?
messages.VIOLA_INTRO2_VIOLA1_OPTION3: Why do you talk like that?
messages.VIOLA_INTRO2_VIOLA3: He is resourceful. If he dwells in this country also, then I believe he too will be searching for me.
messages.VIOLA_INTRO2_VIOLA4: I do not know this country, nor do I know its customs.
messages.VIOLA_INTRO2_VIOLA5: Its people are strange to me. For my safety, I make this journey alone.
messages.VIOLA_INTRO2_VIOLA7: Perhaps I am further now from my own land than I would have first assumed.
messages.VIOLA_INTRO2_VIOLA6: From my perspective, [pause]it is thee who speaks with a curious dialect.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST1_PART1_SEBASTIAN1: [wave amp=30 freq=10]TELL MY SISTER… SHE IS TO MEET ME HERE…[/wave]
messages.VIOLA_QUEST1_PART1_KAYLEIGH2: Was that Viola’s brother? We should tell her…
messages.VIOLA_QUEST1_PART1_MEREDITH2: I, uh, don’t know what to make of that. We should tell Viola I guess.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST1_PART1_FELIX2: This story is getting weirder. C’mon, we should go tell Viola we saw her brother.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST1_PART1_EUGENE2: That was pretty weird, huh? C’mon, let’s go tell Viola.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST2_PART1_VIOLA1: What’s that – you saw a vision of my brother?
messages.VIOLA_QUEST2_PART1_VIOLA4: My brother may still be among the living, [pause]or perhaps only his soul instead lingers…
messages.VIOLA_QUEST2_PART1_VIOLA8: You can rest your worries – [pause]the road will offer little danger with me at your side.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST2_PART1_VIOLA_NO: I understand. I shall remain here for now, then.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST3_PART1_VIOLA2: My brother, [pause]if you are in this place… [pause]Speak to me.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST3_PASSIVE1_VIOLA1: There is a stillness here that fills me with an unease… do you not feel it?
messages.VIOLA_QUEST3_PART1_VIOLA3: Let us search this place, and then be rid of it.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST3_PASSIVE2_VIOLA1: How unfortunate it is that my dear brother must find himself in such a place…
messages.VIOLA_QUEST3_PART2_SEBASTIAN2: I have waited many moons to meet you, [wave amp=30 freq=10]Viola of Messaline.[/wave]
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_VIOLA18: Does this “Robin Goodfellow” speak the truth, [pause]{player}?
messages.VIOLA_QUEST3_PART2_SEBASTIAN5: No? [pause]But the night’s festivities have not yet even begun!
messages.VIOLA_QUEST3_PART2_SEBASTIAN3: I have such delights to share with you.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST3_PART2_VIOLA4: …[pause] You do not deceive me, spirit. [pause]I shall not play your games.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST3_PART2_SEBASTIAN6:
COME, VIOLA OF MESSALINE.

YOU SHALL FIND YOUR FAMILY WITHIN.

FOR I AM YOUR BROTHER’S KEEPER.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST3_PART2_VIOLA8: I spare little faith in the words of this spirit. [pause]But if it knows of Sebastian, [pause]and my name…
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PASSIVE1_VIOLA1: This vessel must have once been a sight to behold...
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PASSIVE2_VIOLA1: This spirit that spoke to me… What it could want, I dare not ask.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PASSIVE3_VIOLA1: The water has drained! [pause]Come, time is precious!
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PART1_VIOLA1: No. [pause]You are not my kin, spirit.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PART2_VIOLA1: This must be the lair of the spirit who keeps my brother from me.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PART2_VIOLA1_OPTION2: I don’t think it’s a spirit that’s in there…
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN2: I MUST ASK FOR QUIET, PLEASE.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PART2_VIOLA2: Whatever spirit, fairy, or devil seeks an audience with me…
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN3: ALL THE WORLD’S A STAGE...\n\nAND THE SHOW IS ABOUT TO BEGIN.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_FUSE_VIOLA3: We shall not perish upon this day!
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN5: WHY, I AM BUT A MERRY WANDERER OF THE NIGHT…\n\nTHEY CALL ME HOBGOBLIN, AND PUCK...
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN7: AND YOU AND I, VIOLA OF MESSALINE, SHARE MUCH HISTORY.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN8: I DISCOVERED THIS BOOK AMONG THE REMAINS OF THE SHIP.\n\nA CURIOUS READ.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN10: THE COMEDY OF VIOLA OF MESSALINE, WHO IS SHIPWRECKED ON AN UNKNOWN COUNTRY.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN12: AH YES, HERE I AM:\n\nPAGE 365 – “A MIDSUMMER NIGHT’S DREAM”.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN16: YOU WILL ONLY FIND YOUR BROTHER WHEN YOUR TALE DEMANDS.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN13: A STORY OF FAIRIES: OF KING OBERON, QUEEN TITANIA, AND THE TRICKSTER ROBIN GOODFELLOW.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN14: MY DEAR VIOLA… YOU AND I?\n\nWE ARE MERELY INVENTIONS OF A MORTAL PLAYWRIGHT – A MR. WILLIAM SHAKESPEARE, IN PARTICULAR.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN15: OUR STORIES ARE NOT OUR OWN.\n\nSEBASTIAN IS NOT HERE. HE WILL NEVER BE HERE.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO13_VIOLA2.f: I am sorry, [pause]friend, [pause]for I have little conversation within me at this moment.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_VIOLA19: Are these stories he reads... [pause]known in your world?
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN21: YOU KNOW I SPEAK THE TRUTH.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN22: LET THE TRUTH OF IT WASH OVER YOU. LET IT PULL YOU INTO ITS DEPTHS UNTIL YOU CAN NO LONGER GASP FOR AIR.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_VIOLA25: It may be that in {player}’s land, [pause]I am but a story.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_VIOLA27: This future that has been written for me is but [shake rate=30 level=10]words on paper![/shake]
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_VIOLA26: Who is to say {player} is not a tale in mine?
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_FUSE_VIOLA2: The overwhelming hand of fate may push against us, [pause]but…
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_FUSE_VIOLA4: [shake rate=30 level=10]Our story does not end here![/shake]
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_PRE_BATTLE_ROBIN30: THIS PLAY IS EVEN GREATER THAN I COULD HAVE HOPED!\n\nCOME, LET US SEE THE FINAL ACT!
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_POST_BATTLE_ALEPH1: YOU SEEM TO BE IN A BIT OF A BIND, DON’T YOU MR. GOODFELLOW?
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_POST_BATTLE_ALEPH2: LET ME EXTEND A HELPING HAND. I HAVE A NEW ROLE FOR YOU.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_POST_BATTLE_VIOLA3: We would be wise to return to our place of safety…
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_EPILOGUE_VIOLA1: Thank you for accompanying me on this quest, [pause]{player}.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_EPILOGUE_VIOLA2: I believe Robin Goodfellow was wrong.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_EPILOGUE_VIOLA3: It may be that my life is but a story in other realms, but…
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_EPILOGUE_VIOLA5: I will find the end of my story on my own terms.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_EPILOGUE_VIOLA4: It matters not. My future is mine to write.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO2_VIOLA2: And yet, it occurs to me that many of the poor souls here have been stranded here far longer than I.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_EPILOGUE_VIOLA6: But from the moment we tied our hearts together in battle, [pause]you have become part of my story too.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_EPILOGUE_VIOLA7: I refer to our [wave amp=30 freq=10]moment of union[/wave] in our great battle. When we became of one body, I felt our [wave amp=30 freq=10]fates[/wave] intertwine also.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_EPILOGUE_VIOLA10: Perhaps if this is found, then I shall be reunited with my brother.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_EPILOGUE_VIOLA8: Whilst we may have since parted, I feel that the threads of fate are not so easily disentangled.
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_EPILOGUE_VIOLA9: You say that you know of a doorway to leave this land?
messages.VIOLA_CONVO1_VIOLA1: ...So you mean to tell me that in your realm, [pause]travelling from one country to another takes hours, [pause]and not days?
messages.VIOLA_QUEST4_EPILOGUE_VIOLA11: Very well! [pause]Let me repay my debt: I shall aid you in your own journey.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO1_VIOLA2: Could such a thing be possible? [pause]I daren’t even imagine it!
messages.VIOLA_CONVO2_VIOLA1: I have not been in this land for long, [pause]but find myself missing my home so dearly.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO2_VIOLA3: I do not think I could bear such a thing. [pause]The people here must hold such quiet sorrows upon their shoulders
messages.VIOLA_CONVO3_VIOLA1: I know that the sky above us is not the same one I would watch from my chamber window as a child…
messages.VIOLA_CONVO3_VIOLA2: But for a moment, I can pretend it is. [pause]I can pretend to myself that home is but a day’s ride from here, [pause]and I can just as quickly be among family and friends once more.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO4_VIOLA1: Tell me: [pause]what is the name of the monstrous form you wear in battle?
messages.VIOLA_CONVO3_VIOLA3: I am sure part of you must feel the same, [pause]{player}.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO5_VIOLA1: It has occurred to me that this island brings together unlikely bedfellows.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO4_VIOLA3: {first_tape_name}? [pause]It suits you, in a curious way.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO5_VIOLA2: People from countless walks of life, [pause]who may never have crossed paths otherwise, [pause]become compatriots when lost alongside each other on this lonely land.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO5_VIOLA3.m: You and I would certainly not have met under any other circumstance!
messages.VIOLA_CONVO5_VIOLA3.f: You and I would certainly not have met under any other circumstance!
messages.VIOLA_CONVO5_VIOLA3.n: You and I would certainly not have met under any other circumstance!
messages.VIOLA_CONVO6_VIOLA1: If I were to one day leave this place, I would be foolish to speak a word of my time here.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO6_VIOLA3: My friends would think me a mad woman!
messages.VIOLA_CONVO6_VIOLA2: An island beyond the countries of Earth, [pause]inhabited by spirits and fae creatures?
messages.VIOLA_CONVO7_VIOLA1.n: Come, dear {player}. [pause]I know we must return to our quest again shortly…
messages.VIOLA_CONVO7_VIOLA1.f: Come, dear {player}. [pause]I know we must return to our quest again shortly…
messages.VIOLA_CONVO7_VIOLA1.m: Come, dear {player}. [pause]I know we must return to our quest again shortly…
messages.VIOLA_CONVO11_VIOLA1.m: To fight alongside your lover in battle, [pause]wearing the form of a strange creature…
messages.VIOLA_CONVO7_VIOLA2: But we can afford some stolen minutes spent together.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO8_VIOLA1: I have visited many a tavern in my home country, yet none held such a quietness as this place.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO8_VIOLA2: It is enjoyable! [pause]I can envision many a happy time has been spent within these walls.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO9_VIOLA1: When the trees stand still for a moment, and a quiet briefly settles across this land…
messages.VIOLA_CONVO9_VIOLA2: There is a silence here that feels truer than any I could possibly experience elsewhere. [pause]It is a silence that cuts deep, that you can feel under your very skin.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO9_VIOLA3: The knowledge that nothing in this realm lies beyond this sole island…
messages.VIOLA_CONVO10_VIOLA1.m: Say, [pause]dear {player}, [pause]have I not regaled you with my tales as a travelling performer?
messages.VIOLA_CONVO9_VIOLA4: Such a solitary place could not be imagined by most men.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO10_VIOLA1.f: Say, [pause]dear {player}, [pause]have I not regaled you with my tales as a travelling performer?
messages.VIOLA_CONVO10_VIOLA1.n: Say, [pause]dear {player}, [pause]have I not regaled you with my tales as a travelling performer?
messages.VIOLA_CONVO10_VIOLA2: Yes! [pause]My brother and I would sing and act for friends and various audiences, on occasion.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO10_VIOLA3: We did not need the money, of course. [pause]Finances were of little worry for most of my life. The merriment was its own reward.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO10_VIOLA4: Tell me; you must have concealed talents of your own. [pause]I greatly wish to know more about you, if you’ll permit…
messages.VIOLA_CONVO11_VIOLA1.f: To fight alongside your lover in battle, [pause]wearing the form of a strange creature…
messages.VIOLA_CONVO11_VIOLA2: It is a kind of romance in itself, is it not? [pause]If action is eloquence, [pause]then our bouts are poetry.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO11_VIOLA1.n: To fight alongside your lover in battle, [pause]wearing the form of a strange creature…
messages.VIOLA_CONVO12_VIOLA2: I hope one day to regale my brother with stories of the devils I have overcome.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO12_VIOLA1: I hope we soon find our way home from the strange dream we find ourselves in.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO14_VIOLA4: Still, it is a [wave amp=30 freq=10]curious[/wave] thing for one’s own tale to exist betwixt the pages of a book in another land. Do all stories work in such a manner?
messages.VIOLA_CONVO13_VIOLA2.n: I am sorry, [pause]friend, [pause]for I have little conversation within me at this moment.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO13_VIOLA2.m: I am sorry, [pause]friend, [pause]for I have little conversation within me at this moment.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO13_VIOLA3: You and I have not known each other long. You may have offered me your help, but I have few words to offer in return.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO14_VIOLA2: He said that he and I are the creation of a playwright. That our stories were already written for us.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO14_VIOLA1: I am thinking once again of the words of the trickster Robin Goodfellow.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO14_VIOLA3: I did not let his words crush my spirit, of course. [pause]As I said – my story is mine to write and mine alone.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO14_VIOLA5: Perhaps in one realm, one may find the “Book of {player}”! [pause]I am sure it is a riveting read!
messages.VIOLA_CONVO15_VIOLA1: Tell me, [pause]{player}, [pause]do you not find this land’s methods of dueling in the guise of fae beasts to be a strange one?
messages.VIOLA_CONVO15_VIOLA2: So curious it is! And yet the kind people of this land do it without a moment’s hesitation or worry.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO16_VIOLA1: Do you believe it, {player}? [pause]Do you believe that the doorway you found will lead us back to where we once lived?
messages.VIOLA_CONVO16_VIOLA2: Wonderful! [pause]As much as I have come to admire this brave new world, I know that it is not any of our fates to remain here forever.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO16_VIOLA3: But if it is your wish to remain here but a while longer, I shall stay also. [pause]We are young, after all. Time does not beckon us to be gone from this place as of yet.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO17_VIOLA1: The battle with our foe Aleph was a grand one, was it not?
messages.VIOLA_CONVO17_VIOLA2: I am more of a fighter than I thought. Perhaps I should instead live the life of a soldier!
messages.VIOLA_CONVO17_VIOLA1_OPTION2: I guess you could say that!
messages.VIOLA_CONVO17_VIOLA3: Though as a woman, I would not be permitted to do so. [pause]Perhaps I should once again disguise myself as a man…
messages.VIOLA_CONVO18_VIOLA1.m: We have not journeyed together for long, dear {player}, but it feels like we have lived a lifetime of stories together already!
messages.VIOLA_CONVO17_VIOLA4: Does this surprise you? I am a performer at heart! Man and woman are merely costumes in my wardrobe, to wear as I will.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO18_VIOLA1.f: We have not journeyed together for long, dear {player}, but it feels like we have lived a lifetime of stories together already!
messages.VIOLA_CONVO18_VIOLA1.n: We have not journeyed together for long, dear {player}, but it feels like we have lived a lifetime of stories together already!
messages.VIOLA_CONVO18_VIOLA2: Perhaps that is the true purpose of this land: those who step foot upon its shores are fated to leave with many tales of their adventures.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO19_VIOLA1.n: Do you read poetry, my dear {player}?
messages.VIOLA_CONVO19_VIOLA1.m: Do you read poetry, my dear {player}?
messages.VIOLA_CONVO19_VIOLA1.f: Do you read poetry, my dear {player}?
messages.VIOLA_CONVO19_VIOLA4: As much as man needs the cook to nourish their stomach, so too do they need the poet to nourish their heart.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO19_VIOLA2: I am glad to hear it!
messages.VIOLA_CONVO19_VIOLA3: It is no matter – perhaps I shall teach you!
messages.VIOLA_CONVO19_VIOLA5: I believe it is a cruelty to oneself to starve one’s heart of such nourishment.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO19_VIOLA6: Given our present union, perhaps we would do well to enjoy the works of the Greek poet Sappho? I shall attempt to locate a book of her poetry in our travels.
messages.VIOLA_CONVO20_VIOLA1: Thank you – [pause]this moment of rest has not gone unappreciated, {player}.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA1: It has become apparent to me, [pause]as of late, [pause]that many elements of life in this town are foreign to me.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA3: And lamplights illuminate themselves with no lamplighter! [pause]There is much I do not understand.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA2: The good people of Harbourtown speak in ways I find peculiar.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA3_OPTION1: I suppose you do come from a Shakespearean past…
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA3_OPTION2: I guess this is like the future from your perspective!
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA5: And melding your spirits together with your allies. [pause]This is normal to you?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA4: Yes. And these “cassette players” you use to take the form of spirits and beasts.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA5_OPTION2: That’s just a New Wirral thing.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA8: It is true: I am indeed a long way from Messaline, both in time and place.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA7: So there are aspects of this land familiar to you, but some that even you find strange.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA9: If this realm has delights unfamiliar to me, I ask of you this:
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA10: Perhaps you may share some of these with me, in time?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA11: I wish to experience these new things, before I return to my home country.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA5: She insisted that it was a valuable read, [pause]this “Spooktales” book.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA13.m: I can see it in your eyes! [pause]Your heart is not so easily hidden from me, friend.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA12: Is it not your quest to find passage off this island?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA13.n: I can see it in your eyes! [pause]Your heart is not so easily hidden from me, friend.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA13.f: I can see it in your eyes! [pause]Your heart is not so easily hidden from me, friend.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA14: Do not worry – I shall aid you however I can.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA15: You shall always have in me an ally and a friend.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL1_VIOLA16: Very well! [pause]Let us dally no longer.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL2_VIOLA2: It does not sell ale, correct? [pause]But instead this “coffee”.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL2_VIOLA2_OPTION2.f: I’m pretty sure that’s the case.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL2_VIOLA2_OPTION2.m: I’m pretty sure that’s the case.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL2_VIOLA2_OPTION2.n: I’m pretty sure that’s the case.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL2_VIOLA3: And the people of your time consume this “coffee” in great quantities?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL2_VIOLA6: As such, I have acquired a flask of this beloved beverage. [pause]A gift from Clémence.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL2_VIOLA5: I wish to experience the coffee, [pause]as the good people of Harbourtown do.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL2_NARRATION7: Viola drinks a cup of coffee.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL2_VIOLA10: The appeal is clear to me.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL2_VIOLA11: And as for this sugared pastry she also gave me so kindly...
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL2_VIOLA12_OPTION2: Did Clémence give you a cinnamon roll, too?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL2_VIOLA14: And yet it is gone so quickly, [pause]a pure and fleeting joy.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL2_VIOLA15_OPTION2: So this was a success, then?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA1: In my efforts to learn about the many realms outside of Harbourtown, I have acquired some documents of great significance.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA2: Yes – [pause]my time here on New Wirral has shown me that my understanding of the world I lived in was but a grain of sand in an endless ocean...
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA3.m: Truly, there are many realms like the one I hail from – [pause]such as your own, dear {player}.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA4: I asked friend Meredith for her aid, [pause]and she provided me this tome.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA3.n: Truly, there are many realms like the one I hail from – [pause]such as your own, dear {player}.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA3.f: Truly, there are many realms like the one I hail from – [pause]such as your own, dear {player}.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA6: Indeed, I have concluded that the accounts within are imaginary.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA5_OPTION1: I think this is a horror fiction book…
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA5_OPTION2: I don’t think you’re going to learn anything from this book.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA7: However, I must draw your attention to Chapter 5 – [pause]much of which describes effective ways to slay the living dead.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA8: Do we not fight monsters on a regular basis? [pause]Perhaps there is more that can be learned from this document than you may have first assumed.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA9: Nevertheless, [pause]I think Meredith lent me this book simply out of a love of the macabre.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA10: It was an enjoyable read! [pause]Perhaps I shall request more books from her.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA1.f: There are matters I would wish to discuss with you, friend. [pause]Do you think we could leave this place for somewhere peaceful?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA1.m: There are matters I would wish to discuss with you, friend. [pause]Do you think we could leave this place for somewhere peaceful?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL3_VIOLA11: Come! I wish to put my newly acquired lessons to practice!
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA1.n: There are matters I would wish to discuss with you, friend. [pause]Do you think we could leave this place for somewhere peaceful?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA3: The people of Harbourtown live unburdened by expectation, do they not?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA4: No lords to please, [pause]no king to kneel before…
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA5: Free to find purpose in one’s own actions. [pause]I envy such a life.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA5_OPTION2: What were you doing before you came here?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA6: My family name is one of great repute and wealth, [pause]but ill fortune had fallen upon us.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA7: My brother and I were tasked with reaching out to a family friend in another country, so that they may aid us.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA8: But as you may surmise, [pause]my ship did not reach those shores. [pause]And the land I found myself on was this one, a dream land of spirits and beasts.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA9: How easy would it be to forget my kin, and remain here.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA10: It would be a happy life, one of the finest company.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA11.f: For this land has you, my dear {player}!
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA11.m: For this land has you, my dear {player}!
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA11_OPTION1.m: You’ll always have a friend in me!
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_VIOLA5: I wear my heart upon my sleeve. [pause]I cannot deny my feelings.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA11.n: For this land has you, my dear {player}!
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA11_OPTION1.n: You’ll always have a friend in me!
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA11_OPTION1.f: You’ll always have a friend in me!
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA11_OPTION2.m: Do you think we could be more than friends?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA11_OPTION2.f: Do you think we could be more than friends?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_VIOLA11_OPTION2.n: Do you think we could be more than friends?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_VIOLA2: We have many paths left to walk together.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_VIOLA3.m: Very well! [pause]Come, [pause]friend, [pause]let us drink of the “coffee”.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_VIOLA3.f: Very well! [pause]Come, [pause]friend, [pause]let us drink of the “coffee”.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_VIOLA3.n: Very well! [pause]Come, [pause]friend, [pause]let us drink of the “coffee”.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_PLATONIC_VIOLA4: And then we shall journey onward once more!
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_VIOLA2: Speak plainly: in what manner do you see me?
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_VIOLA4.n: You have a way with words when the occasion arises, friend.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_VIOLA2_OPTION1: I see you as a good friend.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_VIOLA4.f: You have a way with words when the occasion arises, friend.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_VIOLA4.m: You have a way with words when the occasion arises, friend.
messages.VIOLA_SOCIAL4_ROMANTIC_VIOLA6: Your beauty has always been clear as daylight to me.
messages.VIOLA_ROMANCE_VIOLA1.m: You have a curious look about you, {player}. [pause]Do you have something you wish to confess?
messages.VIOLA_ROMANCE_VIOLA1.n: You have a curious look about you, {player}. [pause]Do you have something you wish to confess?
messages.VIOLA_ROMANCE_VIOLA1.f: You have a curious look about you, {player}. [pause]Do you have something you wish to confess?
messages.VIOLA_ROMANCE_VIOLA3: Are you asking for my hand in marriage, [pause]{player}?
messages.VIOLA_ROMANCE_VIOLA5: I jest. [pause]We are time’s subjects, [pause]and one day time will bid us gone from each other’s company.
messages.VIOLA_ROMANCE_VIOLA6: It would be too much to bear to marry you, [pause]knowing that one day this waking dream will end and we shall return to our lives as they once were.
messages.VIOLA_ROMANCE_VIOLA7: Yet, [pause]there still remains many days and nights by each other’s side.
messages.VIOLA_ROMANCE_VIOLA8: I agree to your wish. [pause]Henceforth, we share a union of hearts.
messages.VIOLA_ROMANCE_VIOLA9: Perhaps, [pause]in another realm far beyond our imaginings, [pause]a humble playwright is telling our tale as we speak.
messages.DOG_QUEST1_PART1_NARRATION4: The dog’s name is Barkley, and there’s a miniature tape recorder attached to his collar. There’s no information about his owner here, other than a 22-digit telephone number.
messages.VIOLA_ROMANCE_VIOLA10: “Viola & {player}: the comedy of two lovers stranded together.”
messages.VIOLA_ROMANCE_VIOLA11: I believe it would make for a wonderful story, [pause]don’t you think?
messages.DOG_QUEST1_PART1_NARRATION3: After extending your hand to let the dog sniff you, you check his collar.
messages.DOG_QUEST1_PART1_NARRATION5: Barkley must be stuck in New Wirral too.
messages.DOG_QUEST1_PART1_NARRATION7: Barkley’s looking up the cliff and whining. He must want to go up.
messages.DOG_QUEST1_PART1_NARRATION8: You can get up there with your climbing ability. Will you go with him?
messages.DOG_QUEST1_PART2_NARRATION1: Barkley didn’t have any trouble getting up the cliff. It seems like he just wanted someone to accompany him.
messages.DOG_QUEST1_PART1_NARRATION9: He won’t move from this spot. Perhaps if you had some way to take him up the cliff…
messages.DOG_QUEST1_PART4_NARRATION2: Among the bones is a dog leash and some treats.
messages.DOG_QUEST1_PART4_NARRATION4: Afterwards, Barkley gives your hand a big wet lick!
messages.DOG_QUEST1_PART4_NARRATION3: Barkley digs a big hole and the pair of you bury the bones.
messages.RESTING_DOG_3: Barkley’s been a really good boy today, so you make sure he gets all the treats and belly rubs.
messages.RESTING_DOG_1: You and Barkley take a long nap together.
messages.RESTING_DOG_2: You and Barkley lazily roll a ball back and forth.
messages.RESTING_DOG_4: Barkley shares one of his treats with you. You try it, but it’s not very tasty.
messages.RESTING_DOG_6.m: Barkley scoffs your snacks while you’re not looking.
messages.RESTING_DOG_8: Barkley finds a good digging spot! The two of you get absolutely covered in mud.
messages.RESTING_DOG_6.n: Barkley scoffs your snacks while you’re not looking.
messages.RESTING_DOG_6.f: Barkley scoffs your snacks while you’re not looking.
messages.RESTING_DOG_9: Barkley brings you a stick he’s really proud of!
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH3: MAYBE THIS IS A LITTLE EASIER FOR YOU.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH4: I THOUGHT WE COULD PENCIL IN A QUICK MEETING.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_MEREDITH5: Is this the same bloke who keeps appearing in the stations? [pause]Who are you, anyway?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_KAYLEIGH5: The triangle man! Who are you, and what do you want?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_EUGENE5: You don’t scare me! Who are you?!
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_FELIX5: Hmm. [pause]This is a bit worrying. [pause]Who are you?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH6: AH - WHERE ARE MY MANNERS? [pause]I SHOULD INTRODUCE MYSELF.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH7: ARCHANGEL! [pause]IS THAT WHAT YOU CALL US? HOW DELIGHTFUL!
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH9: I’VE BEEN CALLED MANY THINGS BY YOUR KIND.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_MEREDITH13: He’s, uh, not what I expected.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH14: I’VE BEEN PREOCCUPIED FOR SOME TIME BY AN OLD FRIEND. [pause]FORTUNATELY THAT “SITUATION” HAS BEEN RESOLVED NOW.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_VIOLA13: You want something from us – [pause]speak plainly!
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH15: AND NOW I RETURN TO FIND OUT THIS WORLD HAS GATHERED MORE OF MY PEOPLE? [pause]MORE “ARCHANGELS”?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH18: SO I MUST ASK THAT YOU DON’T ATTEMPT TO INTERVENE IN MY TEAM-BUILDING EXERCISE.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH17: THE NEWCOMERS ARE WILD AND UNFOCUSED, [pause]BUT I SEE MUCH POTENTIAL IN THEM.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH19: IN FACT, [pause]I MUST REQUEST THAT YOU CEASE SEARCHING FOR MY PEERS ENTIRELY.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH19_OPTION1: But the Archangels are the key to leaving New Wirral!
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH19_OPTION2: I need to find them in order to leave this island!
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH22: YES, [pause]I CAN SEND YOU AWAY FROM HERE!
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_KAYLEIGH24: I don’t like the sound of this...
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH23: THE ONLY THING I CAN’T WARP IS ME! A MIRROR DOESN’T REFLECT ITSELF...
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_MEREDITH24: Uh, do you trust this triangle bloke?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_VIOLA24: What manner of a man is he...?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART1_ALEPH25: SO BE IT! [pause]I SHALL GRANT YOUR WISH.
messages.INTERMISSION_DEAD_WORLD_SIGNPOST: I can’t read this. I don’t even recognise the language.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART2_AMBER2: You need a place to stay?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER2: Call me Ms. Amber – [pause]I’m the face of the Amber Lodge.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER1.m: You’re lucky I found you when I did, sweetheart.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER1.f: You’re lucky I found you when I did, sweetheart.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER1.n: You’re lucky I found you when I did, sweetheart.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER4.m: Please, [pause]make yourself at home. [pause]Have yourself a look around.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER3.f: You’re mighty lucky – [pause]the Amber Lodge doesn’t pass through those dead worlds often.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER3.m: You’re mighty lucky – [pause]the Amber Lodge doesn’t pass through those dead worlds often.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER3.n: You’re mighty lucky – [pause]the Amber Lodge doesn’t pass through those dead worlds often.

messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER5: We’re travellin’ right now so there ain’t nowhere to go just yet.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER4.n: Please, [pause]make yourself at home. [pause]Have yourself a look around.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER6: Hey, sugar. How can I help?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER7: Like I said, I’m Ms. Amber. [pause]The face of this fine establishment.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER9: You ain’t the first soul to wander in here with that look on your face!
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER11: We tend to not stick around one place for too long. [pause]Sometimes folks like yourself need a helping hand, so we’ll hold out an olive branch.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER12: We’ve had some varied clientele over the years, [pause]no doubt about that.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER13.f: Aww, you’re [wave amp=30 freq=10]adorable[/wave] with that lost puppy dog look in your eyes!
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER13.m: Aww, you’re [wave amp=30 freq=10]adorable[/wave] with that lost puppy dog look in your eyes!
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER14.f: Don’t fret, [pause]none of this a big deal.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER14.m: Don’t fret, [pause]none of this a big deal.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER13.n: Aww, you’re [wave amp=30 freq=10]adorable[/wave] with that lost puppy dog look in your eyes!
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER14.n: Don’t fret, [pause]none of this a big deal.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER15.m: You got your little self stuck on a world that’s been dead for a thousand years.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART3_AMBER15.n: You got your little self stuck on a world that’s been dead for a thousand years.

messages.AMBER_LODGE_MIRROR_DESCRIPTION: This is a well-polished mirror. It doesn’t seem to reflect anything, though...
messages.AMBER_LODGE_NPC1_DIALOGUE: Ms. Amber sure knows how to run this joint!
messages.AMBER_LODGE_NPC2_DIALOGUE: Why, I’d stay here forever if I could!
messages.AMBER_LODGE_NPC3_DIALOGUE: Is this your first time at the Amber Lodge?
messages.AMBER_LODGE_NPC4_DIALOGUE: The Amber Lodge really is one of a kind…
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER2: He and I were like family once, [pause]back in the good old days.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER3: There was a whole gang of us, [pause]and we had some mighty fine times together, [pause]let me tell you.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER4: Aleph was like the leader. [pause]I mean, of COURSE he was. [pause]That’s his whole shtick, [pause]ain’t it?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER5: But me? [pause]I was the ride, [pause]and Morgante was the keeper of the door.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER6: But sometimes folks just grow apart. Sometimes it gets messy at the end.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER7: So I left all that behind.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER8: I’m sure Aleph’s still tryin’ to find his ticket off that island, [pause]even now.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER9: No way the ol’ witch will tell him how, [pause]of course.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER10: But I don’t want to bore you with this old girl’s tales of days gone by.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER13: I’m just the face of the establishment.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER15: Not to mention, you’d know all about walkin’ around wearin’ an avatar, wouldn’t you?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER14: The Amber Lodge is the real attraction.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER25.m: Step through it when you’re ready.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER18: And before that, [pause]you were on New Wirral?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER17.m: Now, [pause]I’m guessin’ you were stranded out on that rock because Aleph warped you away, [pause]right?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER17.f: Now, [pause]I’m guessin’ you were stranded out on that rock because Aleph warped you away, [pause]right?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER17.n: Now, [pause]I’m guessin’ you were stranded out on that rock because Aleph warped you away, [pause]right?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER19: That island is like a fly trap. [pause]Folks slip through the cracks and end up there. Mighty unlucky of you, sugar.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER20: But as for the business with our triangle-headed friend?
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER21.m: It ain’t your fault you got caught up in our old mess.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER21.n: It ain’t your fault you got caught up in our old mess.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER21.f: It ain’t your fault you got caught up in our old mess.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER22: So I’ll give you a ride, just this once. [pause]Follow me.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER23: This mirror will take you where you need to go.
messages.INTERMISSION_PART4_AMBER24: Where THAT is, [pause]however, [pause]well, [pause]that just ain’t up to me.

messages.END_PART12_AMBER3: Beyond it lies [wave amp=30 freq=10]the space between all things[/wave]. [pause]If you don’t use it right, you’ll end up goin’ nowhere.
messages.END_PART12_AMBER5: So I advise y’all start sayin’ your goodbyes, [pause]because it’s a one-way trip.
messages.END_PART12_AMBER8: New Wirral is an anomaly, [pause]and nothin’ more.
messages.END_PART12_AMBER9: You folks are only here by chance – getting back here ain’t on the cards.
messages.END_PART12_INSERT10_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I… knew we’d have to say goodbye to each other, {player}...[/wave]
messages.END_PART12_INSERT10_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Someday I might also leave New Wirral. But right now, this place is my home, it’s where I am ME…[/wave]
messages.END_PART12_INSERT10_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I won’t ever forget you - any of you. You helped me become who I really am, after all![/wave]
messages.END_PART12_INSERT10_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]{player}... promise me one thing…[/wave]
messages.END_PART12_INSERT10_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Never let the world change you… [pause]got it?[/wave]
messages.END_PART12_VIOLA10: It pains me to end our tales here, [pause]but I so greatly wish to see my brother again.
messages.END_PART12_INSERT10_SUNNY7: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Hold me in your heart, too.[/wave]
messages.END_PART12_VIOLA14: No wave nor storm could erode its memory.
messages.END_PART12_VIOLA13: {player}, what we shared in our brief time together...
messages.END_PART12_EUGENE18: There’s always communities of people who’re gonna need a helping hand, no matter when and where you are.
messages.END_PART12_EUGENE16: We’ve taken on godlike beings and won...
messages.END_PART12_EUGENE17: Man, I’m so pumped to go back home and kick some ass!
messages.END_PART12_EUGENE19: There’s so much I’m gonna do.
messages.END_PART12_EUGENE21: I guess this is our breakup, {player}.
messages.END_PART12_EUGENE22: I can’t exactly ask you to abandon your world for me. [pause]That’s too big an ask.
messages.END_PART12_EUGENE25.f: You’re gonna continue to be awesome. [pause]I can feel it.
messages.END_PART12_EUGENE25.m: You’re gonna continue to be awesome. [pause]I can feel it.
messages.END_PART12_FELIX35: I think part of me might always love you.
messages.END_PART12_EUGENE25.n: You’re gonna continue to be awesome. [pause]I can feel it.
messages.END_PART12_FELIX28: I think I’ve had enough creative inspiration to last me ten lifetimes.
messages.END_PART12_FELIX27: This has been a real trip, hasn’t it?
messages.END_PART12_FELIX29: Not to mention getting to meet one of my old characters.
messages.END_PART12_FELIX30: I’m gonna miss these good times, [pause]folks.
messages.END_PART12_FELIX32.m: Even if I don’t see you again, you won’t ever be gone.
messages.END_PART12_FELIX32.n: Even if I don’t see you again, you won’t ever be gone.
messages.END_PART12_FELIX32.f: Even if I don’t see you again, you won’t ever be gone.
messages.END_PART12_FELIX33.m: You’re the Outsider, remember? [pause]The protagonist of my future hit story.
messages.END_PART12_FELIX33.f: You’re the Outsider, remember? [pause]The protagonist of my future hit story.
messages.END_PART12_FELIX34: And I think... [pause]Kuneko was right: [pause]ideas live forever.
messages.END_PART12_FELIX33.n: You’re the Outsider, remember? [pause]The protagonist of my future hit story.
messages.END_PART12_KAYLEIGH49: I want to remember you, {player}. [pause]I want to remember everyone. [pause]I want to remember Harbourtown...
messages.END_PART12_MEREDITH37: I’m not ready for this to be over.
messages.END_PART12_MEREDITH38: I’m… [pause]I’m gonna go back stronger. [pause]Live life to its fullest.
messages.END_PART12_MEREDITH46.f: Ugh, I love you. [pause]See you around, mate.
messages.END_PART12_MEREDITH41.m: You’ve, [pause]uh, [pause]set the bar for a boyfriend pretty high for me.
messages.END_PART12_MEREDITH44: I kinda knew that things would have to end if we found our way out…
messages.END_PART12_MEREDITH41.n: You’ve, [pause]uh, [pause]set the bar for a partner pretty high for me.
messages.END_PART12_MEREDITH41.f: You’ve, [pause]uh, [pause]set the bar for a girlfriend pretty high for me.
messages.END_PART12_MEREDITH45: But I won’t give up on being happy. Not anymore.
messages.END_PART12_KAYLEIGH47: This really is it, isn’t it?
messages.END_PART12_MEREDITH46.n: Ugh, I love you. [pause]See you around, mate.
messages.END_PART12_MEREDITH46.m: Ugh, I love you. [pause]See you around, mate.
messages.END_PART12_KAYLEIGH48: I hope it isn’t like waking up from a dream.
messages.END_PART12_KAYLEIGH50: Even the bits that weren’t good. [pause]Because they’re all a part of me.
messages.END_PART12_KAYLEIGH51: Manifesting our will to change the world…
messages.END_PART12_KAYLEIGH52: I suppose we don’t need cassette tapes to do that really, do we?
messages.END_PART12_AMBER61: I think it’s your turn now, sugar.
messages.END_PART12_KAYLEIGH53: The future has always been ours for the taking.
messages.END_PART12_KAYLEIGH55: I won’t ever get to know anyone in the way I’ve known you… [pause]I mean, fusion isn’t exactly standard in relationships, right?
messages.END_PART12_KAYLEIGH56.m: I’m sad, but also happy. [pause]We’ll both be back where we truly belong, and better off having met each other.
messages.END_PART12_KAYLEIGH56.f: I’m sad, but also happy. [pause]We’ll both be back where we truly belong, and better off having met each other.
messages.END_PART12_KAYLEIGH57: That feels like a happy ending.
messages.END_PART12_KAYLEIGH56.n: I’m sad, but also happy. [pause]We’ll both be back where we truly belong, and better off having met each other.
messages.END_PART12_AMBER60: Oh! [pause]I think that one wants to go back with you. [pause]Ain’t that sweet!
messages.RANGER_GATEKEEPER_SNEAK1: Are you trying to sneak past me?
messages.RANGER_GATEKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE1: The monsters past here won’t hesitate to put you in hospital.
messages.RANGER_GATEKEEPER_SNEAK2: I’m here for your benefit, you know!
messages.RANGER_GATEKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE2.n: If you’re certain you’re ready for them, show me your moves!
messages.RANGER_GATEKEEPER_POST_BATTLE1.n: Sorry, you seem like you know what you’re doing.
messages.RANGER_GATEKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE2.m: If you’re certain you’re ready for them, show me your moves!
messages.RANGER_GATEKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE2.f: If you’re certain you’re ready for them, show me your moves!
messages.RANGER_GATEKEEPER_POST_BATTLE1.m: Sorry, you seem like you know what you’re doing.
messages.RANGER_GATEKEEPER_POST_BATTLE1.f: Sorry, you seem like you know what you’re doing.
messages.GRAVEYARD_GHOST_BOY_POST_BATTLE1: Oh, sorry! There’s a rumour of a ghost around here, and I thought it was you.
messages.OVERWORLD_-7_-7_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE: Pombomb are easy to tame if you know how!
messages.UNDYIN_LOVER_POST_BATTLE2: We were just enjoying each other’s company... It wasn’t anything weird, I promise!
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-4_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE1: Captain Buffy's been helping me out with a strength training regime.
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-4_DUNGEON_HINT_NPC2: The gossip points to this location, but so far I’ve only seen regular-sized Dominoth.
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-4_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE.f: Who trained you? I've gotta know!
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-4_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE.m: Who trained you? I've gotta know!
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-4_DUNGEON_HINT_NPC1: Are you here to research the pint-size Dominoth rumour too?
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-4_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE.n: Who trained you? I've gotta know!
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-4_DUNGEON_HINT_NPC3: Maybe it all has something to do with the train that passed by underground a moment ago?
messages.SOCRATES_PRE_BATTLE: The perfect human being is all human beings put together. It is a collective; it is all of us together that make perfection.
messages.PLATO_PRE_BATTLE: I exhort you also to take part in the great combat, which is the combat of life, and greater than every other earthly conflict!
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-3_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE: I make silly mistakes sometimes. Friends jokingly call me a dummy. Little do they know...
messages.SOCRATES_POST_BATTLE: Thank you. I thought that I could beat you. Now I am truly wise, because now I know that I know nothing.
messages.PLATO_POST_BATTLE: We are philosophers, Socrates, not fighters. Hardly any human being is capable of pursuing two professions or two arts rightly.
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-3_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Yep, I really am a dummy...[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-2_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE: Get out of my way! I want to be Cybil's interviewee today!
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-2_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Maybe I'll come back tomorrow instead...[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-3_0_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE1: Inside of every body is a skeleton struggling to get out.
messages.OVERWORLD_-3_0_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE2: I... I really was going to cut your bones out. Sorry.
messages.OVERWORLD_-3_0_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE2: Come here, let me liberate you from your fleshy prison...
messages.OVERWORLD_-3_0_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE1: Whew, thanks for that. I must have spent too long as a Jellyton.
messages.MISS_MIMIC_CHEST_MIMIC1.v2: [shake rate=30 level=10]OOH, DON’T YOU LOOK JUST DELICIOUS![/shake]
messages.OVERWORLD_-6_-3_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Landkeepers are being unfairly accused of racketeering![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-6_-3_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]We don't even like sports![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-6_-3_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Speaking of fencing, are you interested in buying a new home? [pause]No? [pause]Nevermind then.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-6_-3_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]I'll admit a certain pleasure in fencing. Now that\'s a sport! You buy stolen property and then sell it before anyone finds out.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-7_-2_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]If you're looking for an investment that will stand the test of time, try a clock – I mean, a parcel of land.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-6_-1_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]The existence of an endless cosmos of worlds poses a unique challenge to Landkeepers such as ourselves.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-7_-2_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Space? Time? It's all the same.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-6_-1_LANDKEEPER_PRE_BATTLE2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Land derives its value from its scarcity, but in an infinite multiverse there is no such thing![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-6_-1_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]However, New Wirral acts as a kind of cosmic trap. Nobody can leave, and thus land becomes precious.[/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-6_-1_LANDKEEPER_POST_BATTLE2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]So although we Landkeepers currently face challenges on this tiny island, over time it will become a paradise. A solid investment![/wave]
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-7_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE1: Hey! It’s a nice view from up here isn’t it?
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-7_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE2: I was going to try to get to the very top of the mountain, but... I can’t quite scale the cliffs up ahead, and the walkways in the cave have all collapsed.
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-7_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE3: If I could soar like an Averevoir maybe I could make it...
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-7_BATTLER_PRE_BATTLE4: Say, fancy a quick scrap before I glide down to the lake?
messages.OVERWORLD_-4_-7_BATTLER_POST_BATTLE1: Right! Time for me to get going then!
messages.MISS_MIMIC_CHEST_MIMIC1.v1: [shake rate=30 level=10]WANT TO KNOW WHAT SECRETS I HOLD, SWEETIE? JUST OPEN ME UP.[/shake]
messages.MISS_MIMIC_CHEST_MIMIC1.v3: [shake rate=30 level=10]WHY DON’T YOU TAKE A LOOK INSIDE ME, BABY. I PROMISE I WON’T BITE.[/shake]
messages.MISS_MIMIC_CHEST_FELIX1: I’ve got a bad feeling about this...
messages.MISS_MIMIC_CHEST_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I think the box is flirting with you, {player}…[/wave]
messages.MAGIKRAB_INTRO_KAYLEIGH2: Did... Did that Traffikrab just speak?
messages.MAGIKRAB_INTRO_KRAB1: Aha, {player}! And {partner}! I've been waiting for you.
messages.MAGIKRAB_INTRO_EUGENE2: I don't fear you Traffikrab! I\'ve fought many of your kind before!
messages.MAGIKRAB_INTRO_VIOLA2: This Traffikrab speaks? What manner of...
messages.MAGIKRAB_INTRO_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Oh, hey there! Are you a Traffikrab…?[/wave]
messages.MAGIKRAB_INTRO_KRAB3: Please, do not liken me to the mindless Traffikrabs out there.
messages.MAGIKRAB_INTRO_KRAB5: To dwell amongst Their hallowed halls is a privilege too grand for me to convey. To serve Their passengers is the least I can do.
messages.MAGIKRAB_INTRO_KRAB4: I am Magikrab, indentured servant to the infinite Mer-Line: long may Their trains run on time!
messages.MAGIKRAB_NEW_STATION.m: Welcome! I've taken the liberty of opening Platform A for you for travel.
messages.MAGIKRAB_INTRO_KRAB7: Many of the Mer-Line's stops are currently inaccessible. They will become available once their stations reopen.
messages.MAGIKRAB_INTRO_KRAB6: Which is to say: you tell me where you need to go, and I'll get the train at Platform A ready.
messages.MAGIKRAB_NEW_STATION.f: Welcome! I've taken the liberty of opening Platform A for you for travel.
messages.MAGIKRAB_NEW_STATION.n: Welcome! I've taken the liberty of opening Platform A for you for travel.
messages.MAGIKRAB_NEW_STATION_FINAL1.m: You've finally arrived! Welcome to Night’s Bridge Station.
messages.MAGIKRAB_NEW_STATION_FINAL1.f: You've finally arrived! Welcome to Night’s Bridge Station.
messages.MAGIKRAB_NEW_STATION_FINAL1.n: You've finally arrived! Welcome to Night’s Bridge Station.
messages.MAGIKRAB_NEW_STATION_FINAL2: The train arriving at Platform B is due to depart for other realities soon!
messages.MAGIKRAB_NEW_STATION_FINAL3: You should make sure you catch it in time!
messages.MAGIKRAB_MENU: Now, what can I do for you {player}?
messages.MAGIKRAB_MENU_OPTION_LEAVE: I want to leave New Wirral.
messages.MAGIKRAB_TRAVEL2: The train at Platform A is ready for departure, {player}.
messages.MAGIKRAB_TRAVEL1: Where do you want to go?
messages.MAGIKRAB_LEAVE2: However all departures through Platform B have been canceled for the next 642 years.
messages.MAGIKRAB_LEAVE1: Well, Platform B is what we use for interdimensional travel...
messages.MAGIKRAB_LEAVE3: The Mer-Line... tells me it's something about a psychic contagion. Or possibly a war?
messages.MAGIKRAB_LEAVE_FINAL_STATION1: Well, you’re in the right place! Please proceed to Platform B.
messages.MAGIKRAB_LEAVE4: I'm pleased to inform you that arrivals at Platform B are running on time though!
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_DEFEATED1: The next arrival at Platform B isn’t expected for quite some time.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_DEFEATED2.m: You're quite welcome to enter the platform, but as a mortal, flesh-based entity, you may not find it of much use.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_LAMENTO_MORI1: We have an arrival due at Platform B any minute now!
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_DEFEATED2.n: You're quite welcome to enter the platform, but as a mortal, flesh-based entity, you may not find it of much use.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_DEFEATED2.f: You're quite welcome to enter the platform, but as a mortal, flesh-based entity, you may not find it of much use.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_LAMENTO_MORI2: The guest arriving at Platform B transcends such concepts as mortality. Be mindful that not all such creatures will 'go away\' upon death.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_POPPETOX2.m: The guest arriving at Platform B thinks it is whispering, but its words pierce so loudly. Use your eyes, not your ears, human.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_POPPETOX1: We have an arrival due at Platform B any minute now!
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_MONARCH1: We have an arrival due at Platform B soon.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_MONARCH2: The guest arriving at Platform B seeks those with an emptiness inside. It may not show itself to you until you understand and experience that.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_POPPETOX2.n: The guest arriving at Platform B thinks it is whispering, but its words pierce so loudly. Use your eyes, not your ears, human.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_POPPETOX2.f: The guest arriving at Platform B thinks it is whispering, but its words pierce so loudly. Use your eyes, not your ears, human.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_ROBIN1: We had an arrival at Platform B a short while ago.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_BABELITH1: We have an arrival due at Platform B any minute now!
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_ROBIN2: The guest that arrived seems to have an interest in the theatrical. Did you get to meet him on the way in?
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_BABELITH2.m: The guest arriving at Platform B peddles many lies. Be wary of accepting anything as 'truth\' lest you become lost to yourself.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_BABELITH2.f: The guest arriving at Platform B peddles many lies. Be wary of accepting anything as 'truth\' lest you become lost to yourself.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_MOURNINGSTAR1: Platform B is... elsewhere. [pause]This station was destroyed by a landslide some time ago. But I believe there is an arrival due anytime now.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_BABELITH2.n: The guest arriving at Platform B peddles many lies. Be wary of accepting anything as 'truth\' lest you become lost to yourself.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_MOURNINGSTAR2: The guest arriving at Platform B is known to be quite judgemental, I must say.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_ALICE1: This station’s resident is due to return via Platform B any minute now!
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_ALICE2.m: I made sure to let her know you’d be coming. It seems she has a celebration in mind for you!
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_ALICE4.m: It seems she thought you would be... shorter.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_ALICE3: But quite how she expects you to fit through the platform gate, I’m not sure.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_ALICE2.n: I made sure to let her know you’d be coming. It seems she has a celebration in mind for you!
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_ALICE2.f: I made sure to let her know you’d be coming. It seems she has a celebration in mind for you!
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_ALICE4.f: It seems she thought you would be... shorter.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_ALICE4.n: It seems she thought you would be... shorter.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_CUBE1: The guest arriving at Platform B has many sharp edges. My advice would be to keep your distance.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_MORGANTE1: I see that Morgante has returned. She appears to be waiting for you on Platform B.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_MORGANTE4: Don't assume your companionship to them will last a moment longer than your usefulness.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_MORGANTE3: If there's anything I\'ve learned from dealing with the egregores you call ‘Archangels’...
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_MORGANTE6: Even now, the Mer-Line keeps me from giving you full access to Their rail network.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_MORGANTE5: We're like bugs to them. Or crabs.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_MORGANTE7: ‘Archangels’ always have an ulterior motive at work. Be mindful.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_ALEPH1: The train at Platform B will be departing soon.
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_ALEPH2: That’s right! There’s an active gateway in this station!
messages.MAGIKRAB_PLATFORMB_FINAL_STATION1: The gateway on Platform B is ready for you.
messages.MAGIKRAB_MERLINE2: The Mer-Line does not speak to mortals. They have chosen me to act as a go-between, to interface with you!
messages.MAGIKRAB_MERLINE1: That’s right! The Mer-Line is an underground network of railway stations all across New Wirral, and some distance beyond!
messages.MAGIKRAB_MAGIKRAB1: Indeed! I am Magikrab, indentured servant to the incomparable Mer-Line, in whose halls you now stand.
messages.MAGIKRAB_MAGIKRAB2: Like you, I'm not native to New Wirral. However, there have been many here who have known me.
messages.MAGIKRAB_MAGIKRAB3: The Mer-Line has assigned me to act as your guide to Their railway network.
messages.MAGIKRAB_ON_ARRIVAL_AUTUMN_HILL.m: Welcome to Mournington Crescent... What’s left of it, anyway!
messages.MAGIKRAB_ON_ARRIVAL_AUTUMN_HILL.f: Welcome to Mournington Crescent... What’s left of it, anyway!
messages.MAGIKRAB_ON_ARRIVAL_AUTUMN_HILL.n: Welcome to Mournington Crescent... What’s left of it, anyway!
messages.SUNNY_INTRO_EUGENE2: [shake rate=30 level=10]LANDKEEPER![/shake][pause][pause] Let me guess, you’re crawling back for revenge after we brought down your whole operation,[pause] huh?!
messages.SUNNY_INTRO_KAYLEIGH4: Eugene, [pause]I think there’s something wrong with her. [pause]I think she’s,[pause] uh, [pause]broken.
messages.SUNNY_INTRO_EUGENE12: She doesn’t exactly have a sunny disposition, does she?
messages.SUNNY_INTRO_EUGENE6: I… [pause]I think you might be right.
messages.SUNNY_INTRO_KAYLEIGH7: Sorry about the hostile reception. [pause]Why don’t you take a seat and we can get to know each other?
messages.SUNNY_INTRO_KAYLEIGH8: So, [pause]uh, [pause]are you feeling OK? Can you tell us about yourself?
messages.SUNNY_INTRO_EUGENE10: The Landkeepers were minions of an Archangel we defeated. [pause]Maybe when their boss fled, all their brains got fried? [pause]I still don’t trust her.
messages.SUNNY_INTRO_EUGENE17: Maybe the Landkeepers only exist to carry out their jobs, and now she doesn’t know what else there is to do. [pause]Like a machine without a purpose.
messages.SUNNY_INTRO_KAYLEIGH13: “Sunny”? [pause]Why don’t we call her Sunny? We have to call her something!
messages.SUNNY_INTRO_KAYLEIGH18: Oh, you poor thing! [pause]There’s still plenty of time for you to make a fresh start!
messages.SUNNY_INTRO_KAYLEIGH20: Maybe the first step is getting you some new clothes, Sunny. [pause]I’m sure wearing that office outfit all day is pretty miserable!
messages.SUNNY_INTRO_KAYLEIGH22: Then it’s agreed! [pause]{player}, [pause]let’s meet up at Harbourtown’s tailor. [pause]It’s on the upper level of Harbourtown, just north of here.
messages.SUNNY_PART2_EUGENE2: I’m still not sure we should be helping her out. [pause]Are you forgetting the time her former employer tried to take over the island?
messages.SUNNY_PART2_VIOLA3: I am curious! Perhaps this shall be entertaining?
messages.SUNNY_PART2_KAYLEIGH5: Right, [pause]Sunny, [pause]I’ll take you back here and you can pick out some new outfits.
messages.SUNNY_PART2_EUGENE8: I’m not sure about this, Kayleigh…
messages.SUNNY_PART2_MEREDITH9: I’m having a [wave amp=30 freq=10]great[/wave] time already.
messages.SUNNY_PART2_KAYLEIGH12: I’m not sure about this one, [pause]Sunny!
messages.SUNNY_PART2_VIOLA11: Hmm. [pause]Perhaps this maiden is even more unfamiliar with the styles and fashions of this land than I.
messages.SUNNY_PART2_EUGENE14: That’s not the direction I was expecting you to go.
messages.SUNNY_PART2_MEREDITH20: OK, [pause]it turns out Sunny is actually cool. [pause]Who knew?
messages.SUNNY_PART2_EUGENE18: Kayleigh, [pause]is it just me, [pause]or is Sunny…
messages.SUNNY_PART2_KAYLEIGH15: You don’t look super comfortable in that, Sunny… [pause]How about we try another?
messages.SUNNY_EUGENEDATE_EUGENE2: Is this because of my whole “campaign to take down the Landkeepers” thing? [pause]I know we’re an [wave amp=30 freq=10]unlikely pair[/wave] but I can’t stop thinking about you.
messages.SUNNY_PART2_KAYLEIGH19: Absolutely [wave amp=30 freq=10]gorgeous[/wave]? [pause]No, [pause]that’s not just you.
messages.SUNNY_PART2_FELIX20: I think Sunny’s found her look.
messages.SUNNY_PART2_SUNNY23: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Thanks for the help… [pause]all of you.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_PART2_EUGENE24: I have some VERY mixed emotions right now.
messages.SUNNY_PART2_KAYLEIGH26: Harbourtown lets everyone have a fresh start. [pause]It’s only fair that that includes “zombie estate agents”.
messages.SUNNY_PART2_KAYLEIGH25: We’re glad to be able to help you, Sunny.
messages.SUNNY_PART2_SUNNY27: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Landkeepers are not “zombies”. [pause]Landkeepers are vessels. [pause]Created to work.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_PART2_SUNNY28: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Not anymore… [pause]from now on… [pause]I will try to be “Sunny” instead.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_EUGENEDATE_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]…I just don’t think it’s… [pause]I think we should just be friends.[/wave]
messages.HOYLAKE_PART1_PARK_HELPER_NPC2: I’m sure I’ve seen something like that around here. I think it’s called {monster_name}.
messages.SUNNY_EUGENEDATE_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I haven’t been “Sunny” for long. [pause]I need more time to be me.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_EUGENEDATE_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]No, it’s not that. [pause]I’m not a Landkeeper now. [pause]I think…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_EUGENEDATE_SUNNY6: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I have enjoyed our “date”, though.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_EUGENEDATE_EUGENE7: I understand. [pause]Don’t worry about it, Sunny.
messages.FARM_INTRO_EDWARD1.f: Hello, friend! [pause]Have you come to sort out our jelly problem?
messages.FARM_INTRO_EDWARD1.m: Hello, friend! [pause]Have you come to sort out our jelly problem?
messages.FARM_INTRO_EDWARD1.n: Hello, friend! [pause]Have you come to sort out our jelly problem?
messages.FARM_EDWARD_INTERACT2.f: Hello, friend! [pause]Thank you once again for sorting out our jelly problem.
messages.FARM_INTRO_EDWARD2: Well, that bridge just over there connects us here on the farm to Harbourtown. [pause]We provide most of the fresh produce that the town consumes.
messages.FARM_INTRO_EDWARD3: Unfortunately the local jelly creatures have gotten a bit rowdy as of late and have, [pause]um, [pause]gummed up the bridge.
messages.FARM_INTRO_EDWARD4.m: It’s no bother, [pause]though! [pause]Why, I’m sure that they’ll clear off eventually! [pause]Feel free to rest here in the meantime!
messages.FARM_EDWARD_INTERACT1: If this bridge problem persists, Harbourtown’s food supply might start to run low…
messages.FARM_INTRO_EDWARD4.f: It’s no bother, [pause]though! [pause]Why, I’m sure that they’ll clear off eventually! [pause]Feel free to rest here in the meantime!
messages.FARM_INTRO_EDWARD4.n: It’s no bother, [pause]though! [pause]Why, I’m sure that they’ll clear off eventually! [pause]Feel free to rest here in the meantime!
messages.FARM_BRIDGE_LOWERED_EDWARD1.f: Thank you, friend! [pause]I was beginning to worry about that whole… [pause]situation.
messages.FARM_BRIDGE_CONFIRM: Try to shift the slime? It’s pretty gross...
messages.FARM_BRIDGE_LOWERED_EDWARD1.m: Thank you, friend! [pause]I was beginning to worry about that whole… [pause]situation.
messages.FARM_BRIDGE_LOWERED_EDWARD2: We use skelly jelly to fertilise our plants. [pause]I suppose it might have built up in the soil and formed that creature.
messages.FARM_BRIDGE_LOWERED_EDWARD1.n: Thank you, friend! [pause]I was beginning to worry about that whole… [pause]situation.
messages.FARM_EDWARD_INTERACT2.m: Hello, friend! [pause]Thank you once again for sorting out our jelly problem.
messages.FARM_BRIDGE_LOWERED_EDWARD3: Say, if you want to try using the jelly to make some crops [wave amp=30 freq=10]grow[/wave], [pause]be our guest!
messages.HOYLAKE_INTRO_HOYLAKE1.m: Greetings and salutations, newcomer! [pause]I am Professor Percival Hoylake, intrepid investigator into the unknown!
messages.FARM_MARIS_INTERACT: Hello! [pause]It is nice of you to visit us out here. [pause]Are you staying for a while, or just passing through?
messages.FARM_EDWARD_INTERACT2.n: Hello, friend! [pause]Thank you once again for sorting out our jelly problem.
messages.HOYLAKE_INTRO_HOYLAKE1.f: Greetings and salutations, newcomer! [pause]I am Professor Percival Hoylake, intrepid investigator into the unknown!
messages.HOYLAKE_INTRO_HOYLAKE1.n: Greetings and salutations, newcomer! [pause]I am Professor Percival Hoylake, intrepid investigator into the unknown!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART2_HOYLAKE6: A young ranger recently reported “{monster_description}, spotted {habitat_phrase}”. [pause]This sounds like a task for you, no doubt!
messages.HOYLAKE_INTRO_HOYLAKE3: I am talking of the scientific method! [pause]We must observe, analyse and form conclusions!
messages.HOYLAKE_INTRO_HOYLAKE2: Indeed! [pause]As we all find ourselves marooned in this curious realm, it falls upon a steadfast and [wave amp=30 freq=10]rational mind[/wave] to make sense of the chaos that surrounds us.
messages.HOYLAKE_INTRO_HOYLAKE4: The humble townsfolk describe many strange beasts on this island. [pause]If we were to catalogue them, [pause]then the unknown would cease to [wave amp=30 freq=10]BE[/wave] unknown.
messages.HOYLAKE_INTRO_HOYLAKE5.m: Say, [pause]you look like you appreciate the importance of this task. Would you be interested in helping me identify some monsters?
messages.HOYLAKE_INTRO_HOYLAKE5.n: Say, [pause]you look like you appreciate the importance of this task. Would you be interested in helping me identify some monsters?
messages.HOYLAKE_INTRO_HOYLAKE5.f: Say, [pause]you look like you appreciate the importance of this task. Would you be interested in helping me identify some monsters?
messages.HOYLAKE_INTRO_HOYLAKE_NO: Ah, [pause]that’s a shame. If you happen to change your mind, let me know! [pause]Science shall persevere regardless!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART1_HOYLAKE1: Excellent! [pause]Wonderful! [pause]I have some descriptions of monsters I’ve sourced from Harbourtown’s populace. If you can record these monster forms, I’ll be able to catalogue them.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART1_HOYLAKE3: Here are some blank tapes to assist you in your “research”!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART1_HOYLAKE2: The first account I have is “{monster_description}, spotted {habitat_phrase}”.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART1_HOYLAKE4.m: Come on by when you’ve recorded it and I shall catalogue it. Happy hunting, my eager assistant!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART1_HOYLAKE4.f: Come on by when you’ve recorded it and I shall catalogue it. Happy hunting, my eager assistant!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART1_HOYLAKE4.n: Come on by when you’ve recorded it and I shall catalogue it. Happy hunting, my eager assistant!
messages.HOYLAKE_INTERACT_HOYLAKE1.f: Greetings, my eager assistant! Have you recorded our mystery monster? We’re looking for “{monster_description}, spotted {habitat_phrase}”.
messages.HOYLAKE_INTERACT_HOYLAKE1.m: Greetings, my eager assistant! Have you recorded our mystery monster? We’re looking for “{monster_description}, spotted {habitat_phrase}”.
messages.HOYLAKE_INTERACT_HOYLAKE1.n: Greetings, my eager assistant! Have you recorded our mystery monster? We’re looking for “{monster_description}, spotted {habitat_phrase}”.
messages.HOYLAKE_INTERACT_HOYLAKE_NO: Worry not! [pause]I’m sure the enigmatic creature will reveal itself soon enough! [pause]Progress is inevitable, after all!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART2_HOYLAKE1: Excellent! The “Macabra”, is it? [pause]The fangs… the skull. [pause]Yes, this indeed matches up with my reports perfectly!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART2_HOYLAKE2: Recording monsters with cassette tapes to transform into them... [pause]it doesn’t make rational sense, and yet we see it happening before our eyes.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART2_HOYLAKE1_RAND: Excellent! The “{monster_name}”, is it? [pause]Yes, this indeed matches up with my reports perfectly!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART2_HOYLAKE3: If our understanding of science is proven to be limited, [pause]then it is our understanding that must change!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART2_HOYLAKE4: Thank you for your work! Here’s some compensation for your time!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART3_HOYLAKE1: My, my! [pause]The “Stardigrade” is indeed a disturbing beast! [pause]Why you would want to transform into this wretched thing, I do not know…
messages.HOYLAKE_PART3_HOYLAKE2: Truth be told, [pause]I don’t want to transform into ANY beast! [pause]I don’t understand how this technology works, and I’d rather not experiment on [wave amp=30 freq=10]myself[/wave].
messages.HOYLAKE_PART3_HOYLAKE1_RAND: My, my! [pause]The “{monster_name}”, is it? [pause]Why you would want to transform into this thing, I do not know…
messages.HOYLAKE_PART3_HOYLAKE3: I’m perfectly happy leaving the monster transforming to others… [pause]Which reminds me: here’s a reward for your efforts!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART3_HOYLAKE5: Surely someone is pulling my leg? [pause]Having a laugh? [pause]Maybe engaging in a jest of sorts?
messages.HOYLAKE_PART3_HOYLAKE4: The next rumour I’ve heard sounds too bizarre to be true. There are claims of “{monster_description}, spotted {habitat_phrase}”.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART3_HOYLAKE6.m: If you can get to the bottom of this one, you’ll be a better scientist than I.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART3_HOYLAKE6.f: If you can get to the bottom of this one, you’ll be a better scientist than I.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE1: Huh?! [pause]It was REAL?! [pause]I never would have guessed.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART3_HOYLAKE6.n: If you can get to the bottom of this one, you’ll be a better scientist than I.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE2: The “Thwackalope”, I see. [pause]On earth, well, my earth at least, [pause]there is a mythical creature known as a “jackalope” that is very similar.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE1: Oh, you managed to record it! [pause]An “Elfless”, aye? [pause]So enigmatic, that it covers its face. [pause]Now that I think about it, there are rather a lot of monsters on New Wirral wearing masks.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE3: It is curious how our myths and legends appear to influence the appearance of monsters here on New Wirral…
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE4: Say! [pause]Could I ask you some questions about your world, from before you came here? [pause]I am also trying to catalogue the various realities that Harbourtown’s residents hail from.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE5: Excellent! [pause]I will simply ask a series of questions relating to broad historical events and you can tell me if they seem familiar to you.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE6: Question one: [pause]Are you familiar with “the Roman empire”?
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE7: Question two: [pause]did the “industrial revolution” occur in your world’s past?
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE8: OK, question three: [pause]did mankind ever land on the moon?
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE9: Right! [pause]Last question: has “The Day of the Birds” happened yet?
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE11: Thank you for your assistance once again! [pause]Take this for your troubles.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE10.f: Uhh, don’t worry about that one. [pause]In fact, count yourself lucky you don’t know what I meant.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE10.m: Uhh, don’t worry about that one. [pause]In fact, count yourself lucky you don’t know what I meant.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE10.n: Uhh, don’t worry about that one. [pause]In fact, count yourself lucky you don’t know what I meant.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE12.m: Are you ready for another monster assignment? [pause]Of course you are!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE13: I recently heard Captain Penny Dreadful in here, murmuring about “{monster_description} {habitat_phrase}”.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE12.f: Are you ready for another monster assignment? [pause]Of course you are!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE12.n: Are you ready for another monster assignment? [pause]Of course you are!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART4_HOYLAKE14: If you manage to record one, don’t hesitate to let me know!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART5_HOYLAKE1.m: Excellent! [pause]Once again you prove to be a capable researcher.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART5_HOYLAKE2: “Nevermort”, is it? [pause]Quite a morbid appearance it has! [pause]It makes me think of a poem… [pause]though I can’t remember what poem, exactly.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART5_HOYLAKE1.n: Excellent! [pause]Once again you prove to be a capable researcher.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART5_HOYLAKE1.f: Excellent! [pause]Once again you prove to be a capable researcher.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART5_HOYLAKE3: Alas, we have but one monster left on my list of pressing investigations!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART5_HOYLAKE4: Ianthe herself has spoken of a creature that flees if it catches even a glimpse of a human being!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART5_HOYLAKE5: It is supposedly “{monster_description} {habitat_phrase}”. [pause]If this sounds like something you will be able to record, [pause]I wish you good fortune!
messages.FRANKIE_PART4_FRANKIE1.f: Hey, captain! [pause]I am thinking of attempting to become a real ranger.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE1_RAND: Oh, you managed to record it! [pause]The “{monster_name}”, aye?
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE3: It could also simply be that masks look rather [wave amp=30 freq=10]cool[/wave]...
