messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE2: What could the significance of this be? [pause]Perhaps there is some deep psychic connection between how human beings perceive faces, and how these monsters manifest into being…
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE4.m: I must congratulate you on your abilities. [pause]Why, at this rate, I feel like I am the assistant and YOU are the scientist!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE4.f: I must congratulate you on your abilities. [pause]Why, at this rate, I feel like I am the assistant and YOU are the scientist!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE4.n: I must congratulate you on your abilities. [pause]Why, at this rate, I feel like I am the assistant and YOU are the scientist!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE5: The truth is, [pause]I’m not [wave amp=30 freq=10]actually[/wave] a professor or a scientist.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE6: Before I washed ashore on New Wirral, I was a corporate salaryman. [pause]I am less a patron of [wave amp=30 freq=10]science[/wave] and more a patron of [wave amp=30 freq=10]science fiction[/wave].
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE7: Even still, I must remain rational! [pause]Coming here has given my life a new purpose.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE8: I may not be a [wave amp=30 freq=10]real[/wave] professor, but I believe my efforts here can still be valuable!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE9.m: Thank you for your unrelenting assistance to the scientific cause, my friend. [pause]You set an example for us all!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE9.f: Thank you for your unrelenting assistance to the scientific cause, my friend. [pause]You set an example for us all!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE9.n: Thank you for your unrelenting assistance to the scientific cause, my friend. [pause]You set an example for us all!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART6_HOYLAKE10: If you ever want to help my cataloguing further, come chat with me again. [pause]There’ll always be something new to investigate!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART7_HOYLAKE1: Greetings, {player}! How many different species have you recorded out there?
messages.HOYLAKE_PART7_HOYLAKE6.n: Why don’t you come chat with me again after you’ve completed your ranger training?
messages.HOYLAKE_PART7_HOYLAKE3: Thank you for your work! Here’s some compensation for your time!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART7_HOYLAKE4: That must be all the known monsters in New Wirral! [pause]Well, [pause]except for the bootlegs, fusions, and Archangels.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART7_HOYLAKE6.m: Why don’t you come chat with me again after you’ve completed your ranger training?
messages.HOYLAKE_PART7_HOYLAKE5: It’s going to take me some time to finish cataloguing all the species you’ve shown me.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART7_HOYLAKE7: When I have a request for you I’ll leave it on the noticeboard outside!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART7_HOYLAKE6.f: Why don’t you come chat with me again after you’ve completed your ranger training?
messages.HOYLAKE_PART7_HOYLAKE9: Come chat with me again when you reach {next_threshold}.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART7_HOYLAKE10: Don’t forget to remaster your tapes when they reach 5 stars. I’ve heard of a handful of species that can only be obtained that way!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART8_HOYLAKE1: Greetings, {player}! I’m still busy cataloguing the species you recorded earlier.
messages.HOYLAKE_PART8_HOYLAKE2.m: Why don’t you come chat with me again after you’ve completed your ranger training?
messages.HOYLAKE_PART8_HOYLAKE3: Greetings, {player}! When I have a request for you I’ll leave it on the noticeboard outside!
messages.HOYLAKE_PART8_HOYLAKE2.f: Why don’t you come chat with me again after you’ve completed your ranger training?
messages.HOYLAKE_PART8_HOYLAKE2.n: Why don’t you come chat with me again after you’ve completed your ranger training?
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_CYBIL1: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Hey-hey[/wave], {player}! [pause]I want you to meet our latest and greatest recruit: Frankie!
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE2.m: Omigosh, are you another [wave amp=30 freq=10]veteran monster fighter[/wave] of this mysterious island also?!
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE2.f: Omigosh, are you another [wave amp=30 freq=10]veteran monster fighter[/wave] of this mysterious island also?!
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE2.n: Omigosh, are you another [wave amp=30 freq=10]veteran monster fighter[/wave] of this mysterious island also?!
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE3: A magical world full of monsters, and the dashing heroes who transform to battle them…
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE2_OPTION2: I haven’t been here THAT long!
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE4: [shake rate=30 level=10]THIS IS EVERYTHING I EVER DREAMED OF![/shake]
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_KAYLEIGH5: You’re pretty excited by all this, aren’t you?
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_MEREDITH5: That’s not the reaction I was expecting.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FELIX5: You’re more enthusiastic than I was when I first came here.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_VIOLA5: You don’t seem disturbed by your unexpected voyage to this place, friend.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_CYBIL6: As you can see, Frankie here has taken the news of coming to New Wirral pretty well.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]This girl seems pretty happy to be here![/wave]
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE7: I assure you, I want to make the most of this! Joining the Rangers is no doubt the path this adventure has in store for me! Hehe~
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_CYBIL8: I’ve given Frankie a spare cassette player. All you’ll need to do now is give her a monster tape, and show her the ropes!
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE10: My very own monster form… The first step on my own fantastical journey...
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_CYBIL9: ...And that’s the end of my broadcast! [pause]See you around {player}!
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE15.n: Please, Captain, you must “show me the ropes”! [pause]I [wave amp=30 freq=10]demand[/wave] to see the ropes! [pause]Let’s fight some monsters, OK?
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE11: Do you have a tape for me?
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE11_CONFIRM.m: Are you sure you want to give your {species_name} tape to Frankie? This is permanent – you won’t get the tape back.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE11_CONFIRM.f: Are you sure you want to give your {species_name} tape to Frankie? This is permanent – you won’t get the tape back.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE11_CONFIRM.n: Are you sure you want to give your {species_name} tape to Frankie? This is permanent – you won’t get the tape back.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE18.m: Seeya, Captain! Thanks for training me! A plucky young hero always needs a [wave amp=30 freq=10]wisened mentor[/wave], and I’m glad it’s you!
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE18.f: Seeya, Captain! Thanks for training me! A plucky young hero always needs a [wave amp=30 freq=10]wisened mentor[/wave], and I’m glad it’s you!
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE14: [shake rate=30 level=10]THIS FORM IS PERFECT! I WILL TREASURE THIS CASSETTE TAPE WITH MY LIFE![/shake]
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE15.m: Please, Captain, you must “show me the ropes”! [pause]I [wave amp=30 freq=10]demand[/wave] to see the ropes! [pause]Let’s fight some monsters, OK?
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE15.f: Please, Captain, you must “show me the ropes”! [pause]I [wave amp=30 freq=10]demand[/wave] to see the ropes! [pause]Let’s fight some monsters, OK?
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE16: Wow, turning into a weird monster is actually much more tiring than I thought it would be.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE17: I think I need to go and rest. [pause]And eat a lot of food. [pause]Potentially in that order.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FRANKIE18.n: Seeya, Captain! Thanks for training me! A plucky young hero always needs a [wave amp=30 freq=10]wisened mentor[/wave], and I’m glad it’s you!
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_MEREDITH19: I’m glad I am no longer the most socially awkward person on the island.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FELIX19.m: Huh. You’re a pretty good teacher.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FELIX19.f: Huh. You’re a pretty good teacher.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_FELIX19.n: Huh. You’re a pretty good teacher.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_VIOLA19.m: You took the role of the tutor in your stride, {player}.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_VIOLA19.n: You took the role of the tutor in your stride, {player}.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_SUNNY19.m: [wave amp=20 freq=5]You make for a pretty good teacher, {player}![/wave]
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_VIOLA19.f: You took the role of the tutor in your stride, {player}.
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_SUNNY19.f: [wave amp=20 freq=5]You make for a pretty good teacher, {player}![/wave]
messages.FRANKIE_PART1_SUNNY19.n: [wave amp=20 freq=5]You make for a pretty good teacher, {player}![/wave]
messages.FRANKIE_PART2_FRANKIE1.m: Oh, hey there captain! Are you here to assist me in my own personal [wave amp=30 freq=10]hero’s journey[/wave]?
messages.FRANKIE_PART2_FRANKIE2: [shake rate=30 level=10]THERE MUST COME A MOMENT WHERE EVERY PLUCKY YOUNG ADVENTURER CARVES THEIR OWN PATH~[/shake]
messages.FRANKIE_PART2_FRANKIE1.f: Oh, hey there captain! Are you here to assist me in my own personal [wave amp=30 freq=10]hero’s journey[/wave]?
messages.FRANKIE_PART2_FRANKIE1.n: Oh, hey there captain! Are you here to assist me in my own personal [wave amp=30 freq=10]hero’s journey[/wave]?
messages.FRANKIE_PART2_FRANKIE3: That’s what I’m doing. [pause]I’m the plucky young adventurer, if you didn’t get where I was going with this.
messages.FRANKIE_PART2_FRANKIE4: Anyway, I found one of those “Rogue Fusions” just up ahead – I’m going to go and show it who’s boss!
messages.FRANKIE_PART2_FRANKIE4_OPTION2: Are you sure that’s a good idea?
messages.FRANKIE_PART2_FRANKIE5: Don’t worry! I have a natural affinity for this – I’ve read over [wave amp=30 freq=10]200[/wave] fanfics about people transforming into monsters. [pause](Please don’t ask me to elaborate on this.)
messages.FRANKIE_PART2_FRANKIE8: My career is coming along quite well, I think!
messages.FRANKIE_PART2_FRANKIE9: W-well, my career as a dashing and mysterious heroine who saves the humble people of this fantasy land, of course!
messages.FRANKIE_PART2_FRANKIE10: I have no doubt – soon a greater evil shall arise...
messages.FRANKIE_PART2_FRANKIE11: [wave amp=30 freq=10]AND I SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR SAVING THIS ISLAND![/wave]
messages.FRANKIE_PART2_FRANKIE13: That’s OK! I’m sure there’ll be SOME evil left somewhere for me to overcome! [pause]You [wave amp=30 freq=10]might[/wave] have missed a spot!
messages.FRANKIE_PART3_FRANKIE1: Hey, {player}! I have a question for you!
messages.FRANKIE_PART3_FRANKIE2: What does it mean… to take charge of your life?
messages.FRANKIE_PART3_FRANKIE3: W-well, I should be using my time on New Wirral to fulfil my life, or something! [pause]Save the world! Find my true calling! Fall in love!
messages.FRANKIE_PART3_FRANKIE4: Y’know, all the classic adventure stuff. [pause]I can’t waste a second!
messages.FRANKIE_PART3_FRANKIE4_OPTION1: Maybe your expectations are too high…
messages.FRANKIE_PART3_FRANKIE4_OPTION2: Don’t put yourself under too much pressure!
messages.FRANKIE_PART3_FRANKIE6: OK, second question! [pause]Can you help me fight a Rogue Fusion I found nearby? I’m sure that’ll be a worthwhile experience!
messages.FRANKIE_PART4_FRANKIE1.n: Hey, captain! [pause]I am thinking of attempting to become a real ranger.
messages.FRANKIE_PART3_FRANKIE7: Thanks for the help, {player}! [pause]I have decided that that was indeed a worthwhile experience!
messages.FRANKIE_PART4_FRANKIE3: ...So of course, I’ve tracked down a Rogue Fusion to battle! There’s no time to wait – [shake rate=30 level=10]let’s go pummel it![/shake]
messages.FRANKIE_PART4_FRANKIE2: No more rookie status for me! Though I’ll need to get stronger first.
messages.FRANKIE_PART4_FRANKIE1.m: Hey, captain! [pause]I am thinking of attempting to become a real ranger.
messages.FRANKIE_PART4_FRANKIE4: Thanks for the assistance! [pause]Perhaps next time you and I meet out in the field, you’ll be seeing me as a fully-fledged ranger!
messages.FRANKIE_PART5_FRANKIE1.m: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Nyeh heh heh~![/wave] [pause]I bet you never expected that I would challenge you to a duel, right?
messages.FRANKIE_PART5_FRANKIE1.n: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Nyeh heh heh~![/wave] [pause]I bet you never expected that I would challenge you to a duel, right?
messages.FRANKIE_PART5_FRANKIE1.f: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Nyeh heh heh~![/wave] [pause]I bet you never expected that I would challenge you to a duel, right?
messages.FRANKIE_PART5_FRANKIE2: [shake rate=30 level=10]THE STUDENT MUST TAKE ON THE MASTER![/shake] The only way I can become a true ranger is to defeat you and [wave amp=30 freq=10]claim your stamp[/wave]!
messages.FRANKIE_PART5_FRANKIE3: I even tamed this Puppercut to help me! What do you say – do you accept my challenge?
messages.FRANKIE_PART5_FRANKIE7: I just wanted to see how tough you were. [pause]You didn’t disappoint!
messages.FRANKIE_PART5_FRANKIE4.m: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Nyeh heh heh~![/wave] [pause]I knew you’d be tough.
messages.FRANKIE_PART5_FRANKIE3_OPTION2: I won’t go easy on you!
messages.FRANKIE_PART5_FRANKIE4.n: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Nyeh heh heh~![/wave] [pause]I knew you’d be tough.
messages.FRANKIE_PART5_FRANKIE4.f: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Nyeh heh heh~![/wave] [pause]I knew you’d be tough.
messages.FRANKIE_PART5_FRANKIE5: That’s why I made sure to battle the other 12 captains first.
messages.FRANKIE_PART5_FRANKIE6: You heard correctly – I [wave amp=30 freq=10]already[/wave] qualify for rangerhood!
messages.FRANKIE_TOWN_HALL_INTERACT1: Hey {player}! Just catching up on the latest goss before I head back out!
messages.FRANKIE_TOWN_HALL_INTERACT2: Hey {player}! Got any tasks for your promising young protégé? (I mean me.)
messages.VIN_PART1_VIN1.n: [shake rate=30 level=10]Ranger![/shake] [pause]Are you here to stop me, huh?!
messages.FRANKIE_TOWN_HALL_INTERACT3: [shake rate=30 level=10]Ooh, let me take on your noticeboard requests!
messages.VIN_PART1_VIN1.f: [shake rate=30 level=10]Ranger![/shake] [pause]Are you here to stop me, huh?!
messages.VIN_PART1_VIN1.m: [shake rate=30 level=10]Ranger![/shake] [pause]Are you here to stop me, huh?!
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN8.n: Never mind the fact that [wave amp=30 freq=10]one of their own[/wave] is what sent our community into disarray!
messages.VIN_PART1_VIN3: Only [wave amp=30 freq=10]cowards[/wave] rely on others!
messages.VIN_PART1_VIN2: Fine! [pause]If you’re gonna fight me, fight me one-on-one!
messages.VIN_PART1_KAYLEIGH4: Don’t worry, {player}! I’ll sit this one out – you can take out this guy without me!
messages.VIN_PART1_MEREDITH4.n: A one-on-one scrap? Go on, mate. You’re hard enough, {player} – you can take him.
messages.VIN_PART1_MEREDITH4.f: A one-on-one scrap? Go on, mate. You’re hard enough, {player} – you can take him.
messages.VIN_PART1_MEREDITH4.m: A one-on-one scrap? Go on, mate. You’re hard enough, {player} – you can take him.
messages.VIN_PART1_EUGENE4.m: Go on, buddy. You don’t need my help taking on this jerk.
messages.VIN_PART1_EUGENE4.f: Go on, buddy. You don’t need my help taking on this jerk.
messages.VIN_PART1_EUGENE4.n: Go on, buddy. You don’t need my help taking on this jerk.
messages.VIN_PART1_FELIX4: What do you say, {player}? Do you wanna show this guy who’s boss?
messages.VIN_PART1_VIOLA4.f: It seems this fight is yours and yours alone, dear {player}. Worry not – I have faith in you.
messages.VIN_PART1_VIOLA4.m: It seems this fight is yours and yours alone, dear {player}. Worry not – I have faith in you.
messages.VIN_PART1_VIOLA4.n: It seems this fight is yours and yours alone, dear {player}. Worry not – I have faith in you.
messages.VIN_PART1_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]A “one-on-one” fight…? I guess I’ll sit this one out![/wave]
messages.VIN_PART1_VIN6: But you won’t catch me! [wave amp=30 freq=10]I’m already gone![/wave]
messages.VIN_PART1_KAYLEIGH7: He ran pretty fast. I’m sure we’ll catch him next time, {player}.
messages.VIN_PART1_MEREDITH7.m: That was a pretty sudden escape. I guess we’ll get him next time, mate.
messages.VIN_PART1_MEREDITH7.n: That was a pretty sudden escape. I guess we’ll get him next time, mate.
messages.VIN_PART1_MEREDITH7.f: That was a pretty sudden escape. I guess we’ll get him next time, mate.
messages.VIN_PART1_EUGENE7: Despite all that bravado, he was pretty quick to flee, huh?
messages.VIN_PART1_FELIX7: He’s a pretty fast runner. I guess we’ll catch him next time.
messages.VIN_PART1_SUNNY7: [wave amp=20 freq=5]He got out of here pretty quick, huh…[/wave]
messages.VIN_PART1_VIOLA7: He was quick to exit the stage of battle. I am sure our paths will cross again.
messages.VIN_PART2_VIN2: You damn rangers are always sticking your noses in places they don’t belong!
messages.VIN_PART2_VIN5: [shake rate=30 level=10]Not until the people are free of the tyranny of the Harbourtown Rangers![/shake]
messages.VIN_PART2_VIN4: Heh, you’ll never catch me. And I’ll never give up...
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN1.m: Oh look. [pause]The Ranger’s have sent the [wave amp=30 freq=10]loyal goon[/wave] to track me down again!
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN1.f: Oh look. [pause]The Ranger’s have sent the [wave amp=30 freq=10]loyal goon[/wave] to track me down again!
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN1.n: Oh look. [pause]The Ranger’s have sent the [wave amp=30 freq=10]loyal goon[/wave] to track me down again!
messages.VIN_PART3_FELIX5: Wait, so this thief guy is part of that weird cult?
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN4.f: You’re the heartless [wave amp=30 freq=10]god-killer[/wave] that caused this mess! You’re the one that left Brother Cooper to die!
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN4.n: You’re the heartless [wave amp=30 freq=10]god-killer[/wave] that caused this mess! You’re the one that left Brother Cooper to die!
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN4.m: You’re the heartless [wave amp=30 freq=10]god-killer[/wave] that caused this mess! You’re the one that left Brother Cooper to die!
messages.VIN_PART3_MEREDITH5: He’s a cultist, {player}. Must be mad about that Mourningstar bloke you and Kayleigh beat up.
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN4_OPTION2: I did neither of those things!
messages.VIN_PART3_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I think he has the wrong impression about your time here on New Wirral, {player}...[/wave]
messages.VIN_PART3_EUGENE5: Hey! A lot more than just Dorian would have died if not for {player}!
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN6.f: Enough talking! Come here and fight me, you coward!
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN6.m: Enough talking! Come here and fight me, you coward!
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN7: When our leader was [wave amp=30 freq=10]cruelly slain[/wave], you rangers immediately started trying to “offer us help”. Yeah right.
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN6.n: Enough talking! Come here and fight me, you coward!
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN8.f: Never mind the fact that [wave amp=30 freq=10]one of their own[/wave] is what sent our community into disarray!
messages.VIN_PART3_KAYLEIGH9: You’ve gotten this all wrong. [pause]Dorian was responsible for everything your community went through!
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN8.m: Never mind the fact that [wave amp=30 freq=10]one of their own[/wave] is what sent our community into disarray!
messages.VIN_PART3_VIN10: The blank tapes and stickers I’m stealing… They’re gonna be for our resistance!
messages.VIN_PART4_JACQUELINE11: Not at all. Dorian’s death was an awakening for me.
messages.VIN_PART4_VIN5.n: You could have just left me to rot like Brother Cooper and be rid of your [wave amp=30 freq=10]thief problem[/wave] for good.
messages.VIN_PART4_VIN5.f: You could have just left me to rot like Brother Cooper and be rid of your [wave amp=30 freq=10]thief problem[/wave] for good.
messages.VIN_PART4_VIN5.m: You could have just left me to rot like Brother Cooper and be rid of your [wave amp=30 freq=10]thief problem[/wave] for good.
messages.VIN_PART4_VIN5_OPTION2: I didn’t leave Dorian to die!
messages.VIN_PART4_JACQUELINE7: When Ianthe told me someone was stealing supplies the rangers had set aside for the commune, I didn’t think it would be you!
messages.VIN_PART4_VIN8: Set…[pause] aside…[pause] for the commune?[pause] Our commune?
messages.VIN_PART5_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Harbourtown offers everyone a fresh start - I know from experience![/wave]
messages.VIN_PART4_VIN10: But the rangers… They took control, right? Coerced you,[pause] and stuff?
messages.VIN_PART4_JACQUELINE15: I sought out help for the commune, and Ianthe was kind enough to provide it.
messages.VIN_PART4_JACQUELINE13: It is only looking back that I can recognise things for how they truly were.
messages.VIN_PART4_JACQUELINE12: When he was with us – when he was [wave amp=30 freq=10]in charge[/wave] – it was like living under a spell. I couldn’t recognise what was happening around me for what it was.
messages.VIN_PART4_JACQUELINE16: You know, we’d be starving by now if not for her support. Dorian had us dig up our vegetable patch to get to that Archangel!
messages.VIN_PART4_JACQUELINE18: Come on, let’s get you home so you can rest up.
messages.VIN_PART4_JACQUELINE20: I’ve known Vin since he arrived in New Wirral. His heart is in the right place, he’s just…[pause] horribly misinformed.
messages.VIN_PART4_JACQUELINE21: I’ll call a meeting with the whole commune and set everything straight. It won’t happen again.
messages.VIN_PART4_JACQUELINE22: Please let Ianthe know how grateful I am to have her support.
messages.VIN_PART5_VIN2: When you saved me from that Rogue Fusion, it really forced me to question everything.
messages.VIN_PART5_VIN3: I regret messing up like I did, but... [pause]in the end I did it because I wanted to support my community.
messages.VIN_PART5_VIN4: So I joined the rangers to do just that! And make up for my mistakes, of course.
messages.VIN_PART5_KAYLEIGH5: Brilliant! [pause]I’m glad you’re turning things around for yourself, Vin!
messages.VIN_PART5_EUGENE5: Sounds like you’ve found your own personal cause. I respect that.
messages.VIN_PART5_MEREDITH5: Yeah, it sounds like you’ve got a lot of work to do, mate.
messages.VIN_PART5_FELIX5: Glad to see you’ve had a real change of heart.
messages.VIN_PART5_VIN6: And now I must challenge you for your stamp! [pause]Come on, fight me [wave amp=30 freq=10]one-on-one[/wave], {player}!
messages.VIN_PART5_VIN7: Damn… you don’t hold back even with your friends, do you?
messages.VIN_PART5_VIN8: It’s a good thing there are still 12 other captains I can get my stamps from.
messages.VIN_PART5_VIN9: Next time you see me, I’m gonna be a full-time ranger, {player}!
messages.VIN_TOWN_HALL_INTERACT1.m: Hey Captain! Which do you think is stronger: Artillerex or Gearyu? I can’t decide.
messages.VIN_TOWN_HALL_INTERACT1.f: Hey Captain! Which do you think is stronger: Artillerex or Gearyu? I can’t decide.
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_FRANKIE1.m: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Nyeh heh heh~![/wave] [pause]Bet you didn’t expect to find your two protégés here, did you, Captain?
messages.VIN_TOWN_HALL_INTERACT1.n: Hey Captain! Which do you think is stronger: Artillerex or Gearyu? I can’t decide.
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I never would have thought those two would become friends![/wave]
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_VIN2: Hey {player}. I’ve finally passed my training and become a full-time ranger!
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_FRANKIE1.f: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Nyeh heh heh~![/wave] [pause]Bet you didn’t expect to find your two protégés here, did you, Captain?
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_FRANKIE1.n: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Nyeh heh heh~![/wave] [pause]Bet you didn’t expect to find your two protégés here, did you, Captain?
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_KAYLEIGH3: I never would have figured these two would end up friends!
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_MEREDITH3: These two ended up as mates? I guess that figures.
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_EUGENE3: Heh. I guess these two are buddies now?
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_VIOLA3: I would never have assumed a friendship between such two different individuals!
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_FELIX3: I didn’t realise you two knew each other! I suppose it’s a small island.
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_FRANKIE4: Uh, I have some news too.
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_FRANKIE6: Captain Cybil says wild monsters don’t make great pets, but…[pause] I’m certain it was the fanfic I wrote about him.
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_FRANKIE7: But not to worry! My new [wave amp=30 freq=10]best buddy[/wave] Vin doesn’t mind that stuff!
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_VIN8: What’s a fanfic, {player}? She won’t tell me…
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_FRANKIE10.m: I demand a rematch, Captain! Me and Vin against you and {partner}! How about it?
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_FRANKIE10.n: I demand a rematch, Captain! Me and Vin against you and {partner}! How about it?
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_FRANKIE10.f: I demand a rematch, Captain! Me and Vin against you and {partner}! How about it?
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_VIN12: Chin up, Frankie. We can’t win them all.
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_VIN13: {player}, it wasn’t until I fused with Frankie that I realised relying on others isn’t a weakness.
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_VIN14: When we combine our efforts, we’re more than simply the sum of our parts. [pause]That’s what all this is about, isn’t it?
messages.VIN_AND_FRANKIE_FRANKIE15: [wave amp=30 freq=10]AND SO THE PLUCKY HEROINE AIDS THE ANTI-HERO’S REDEMPTION ARC THROUGH THE POWER OF LOVE~![/wave]
messages.POWER_STATION_WALLACE1.m: It’s all ready for you in there, mate.
messages.POWER_STATION_WALLACE1.f: It’s all ready for you in there, mate.
messages.POWER_STATION_WALLACE1.n: It’s all ready for you in there, mate.
messages.POWER_STATION_DREADFUL4: Shall we show it what we’re made of, then?
messages.POWER_STATION_DREADFUL2: This is my turf, {player}! If there’s gonna be a scrap in my neck of the woods, I don’t want to be left in the dark.
messages.POWER_STATION_DREADFUL3: Hold onto your knickers, ladies and gents – there’s a nasty big blighter here!
messages.POWER_STATION_DREADFUL5: That was a right ruckus! You take a look around – I need to catch my breath.
messages.POWER_STATION_DREADFUL6: You take a look around – I need to catch my breath.
messages.POWER_STATION_DREADFUL7.m: {player}, are you absolutely sure about this?
messages.POWER_STATION_DREADFUL7.f: {player}, are you absolutely sure about this?
messages.POWER_STATION_NOTE1: “10/10/1957 0400\nStayed up all night with Dr Aegle and Dr Aetheria, designing new experiments to run in the fusion reactor. We really got into the flow of it and lost track of time – for a while it felt like we were one singular entity focused on the reactor!”
messages.POWER_STATION_DREADFUL7.n: {player}, are you absolutely sure about this?
messages.POWER_STATION_NOTE3: “10/10/1957 0700\nA being calling itself ‘Helia’ emerged from the reactor! The thermocouples immediately registered a drop in the core temperature, so… I think it’s safe again now? ‘Helia’ looks sort of like a diagram of a helium atom, with the two rings representing electron orbits...”
messages.POWER_STATION_NOTE2: “10/10/1957 0515\nSomething odd is going on in the reactor – the temperature in the core keeps rising! We’ve turned on the cooling fans to increase airflow, but it hasn’t helped! If this keeps up, we’re toast, literally!”
messages.POWER_STATION_NOTE5: “11/10/1957 0305\nWe followed Helia’s suggestions to combine Folklord, Masquerattle, Manispear, and REDACTED, which the Ministry of Supply sourced for us from a local zoo. Helia seems dissatisfied with the result – was this not what she wanted? Are we supposed to have used live beasts?”
messages.POWER_STATION_NOTE4: “10/10/1957 0730\n‘Helia’ tells us that we somehow created her, or summoned her? She’s now explaining how to make our reactor workable. And afterwards she wants to talk to us about other kinds of fusion… What other kinds?!”
messages.POWER_STATION_NOTE6: “11/10/1957 0800\nWhat have we done!? The unstable fusion is out of control! It keeps duplicating!! The ministry has sealed the building to keep it in, and I’m stuck inside! Mer-Line help me!”
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA1: AHA, THANK YOU FOR MOPPING UP MY PROGENITORS’ FAILED EXPERIMENTS.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA2: THOSE UNSTABLE FUSIONS ARE QUITE TROUBLESOME TO REMOVE ONCE THEY START REPLICATING.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA4: I KNOW YOU QUITE WELL. HOW MANY TIMES HAVE YOU FUSED NOW?\n\nWHEREVER THERE IS FUSION, I AM FOUND.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA5: I AM HELIA, PROCESS OF FUSION.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_KAYLEIGH6: Then you’re creating the Rogue Fusions?
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_MEREDITH6: Oh. There really is someone behind the Rogue Fusions!
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_VIOLA6: Then you are behind the Rogue Fusion creatures!
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_SUNNY6: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Are you… responsible for the rogue fusions…?[/wave]
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA7: “ROGUE FUSIONS”?\n[pause]\nOH, YES.[pause] THE STABLE ONES.[pause] THOSE WONDERFUL BEASTS ARE MY DOING.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA8: NOW I SEE WHY YOU’RE HERE. I SENSE THE POTENTIAL FOR FUSION RISING WITHIN YOU BOTH, WHICH MUST MEAN...
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA11: IT WOULD DO YOU NO GOOD TO END FUSION. DO YOU NOT SEE?
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA9: YOU’RE HERE TO FIGHT, ARE YOU NOT?
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA13: I FORM LIFE. WHEN DEAD ATOMS COME TOGETHER TO FORM LIVING CELLS, THAT IS ANOTHER KIND OF FUSION.\n\nWHEN INDIVIDUAL CELLS COME TOGETHER TO FORM INTELLIGENT MULTICELLULAR LIFEFORMS, THAT IS ALSO ME.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA12: I SUSTAIN LIFE. THE PLANTS YOU RELY ON TO SURVIVE DERIVE THEIR ENERGY FROM THE NUCLEAR FUSION AT THE HEART OF YOUR STAR.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA14: WITHOUT ME - WITHOUT FUSION - THERE WOULD BE NO LIFE.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_KAYLEIGH15: Your “wonderful beasts” put Harbourtown in danger!
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_EUGENE15: Come on! We can manage fine without your “wonderful beasts”.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_MEREDITH15: Hate to tell you this, but your “wonderful beasts” are hurting people.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_FELIX15: Can you at least stop making more “wonderful beasts”?
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_SUNNY15: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The problem is… your “wonderful beasts” are putting people in danger…[/wave]
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_VIOLA15: I am familiar with the “fusion” of New Wirral, but what is this talk of stars and cells?
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA16: AS I SAID, I AM THE PROCESS OF FUSION.\n\nI AM NOT THE CAUSE OF IT.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_M_E1_EUGENE5: What did you say [wave amp=30 freq=10]after[/wave] that…?
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA17: {player.to_upper}, WHEN YOU FUSE WITH {partner.to_upper}, IT IS NOT BECAUSE I TELL YOU TO.\n\nI AM SIMPLY THE MEANS.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA18: YOU DON’T BLAME DEATH WHEN THERE’S BEEN A MURDER.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA19: ULTIMATELY, THE CAUSE OF THE “ROGUE FUSIONS” IS THE ENTITY THAT CEASELESSLY CONJURES THE DEBRIS OF OTHER WORLDS TO THIS LAND.\n[pause]\nIT IS THE ONE THAT BROUGHT ME, AND YOU – AND INDEED EVERY OTHER HUMAN – HERE.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA20: THE MER-LINE. THE ONE THAT LIES BENEATH.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_KAYLEIGH21: The Mer-Line? I don’t like this, {player}...
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_MEREDITH21.f: I don’t fancy our chances against the Mer-Line, mate.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_MEREDITH21.m: I don’t fancy our chances against the Mer-Line, mate.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_MEREDITH21.n: I don’t fancy our chances against the Mer-Line, mate.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_EUGENE21: Alright! Let’s go punch some trains!
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_FELIX21: Oh. The railway is behind all this?
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_VIOLA21: We shall not be defeated by a mere labyrinth, {player}!
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_SUNNY21: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The Mer-Line?! This seems bad, {player}...[/wave]
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA27: I ASK THAT YOU BE MINDFUL OF THE WILL YOU MANIFEST.\n\nALEPH CAN YET RETURN.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA22: ONE MORE THING BEFORE YOU LEAVE, {player.to_upper}.\n\nYOU MANIFESTED THE SPIRIT OF REBELLION, MORGANTE, WHEN YOU FOUGHT ALEPH, DID YOU NOT?
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_DREADFUL29: Good luck with the Mer-Line, {player}. I’ll sit that one out.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA23: THE SWORD THAT YOU WIELD HAS TWO EDGES.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA24: OF FUSION, OR ANY WORK PERFORMED BY A GROUP TOWARDS A SINGLE PURPOSE, YOU MIGHT SAY “THE WHOLE IS GREATER THAN THE SUM OF ITS PARTS”.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA26: DURING OUR BATTLE, I SENSED THE SEED OF CONQUEST WITHIN YOUR HEART.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_HELIA25: THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE WHOLE AND THE SUM OF ITS PARTS IS THE EGREGORE, OR “ARCHANGEL”.\n\nEGREGORES ARE SMALL AND WEAK AT FIRST, BUT WITH ENOUGH DIRECTED WILL THEY CAN MANIFEST INDEPENDENTLY, EXERT POWER, AND TAKE CONTROL.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_DREADFUL28: That was certainly somethin’! [pause]I better report all this back to Ianthe.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MAGIKRAB1A: {player}, the Mer-Line is waiting for you. Please come with me to Platform A.
messages.POWER_STATION_HELIA_DREADFUL30: Hmm… [pause]I wonder if “Helia” had anything to do with the fire that burned down New London all those years ago...?
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MAGIKRAB2: The Mer-Line will now speak through me.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MAGIKRAB1B: {player}, the Mer-Line is waiting for you. Please come with me to Platform A of Harbourtown Station.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MAGIKRAB3.m: Count yourself very fortunate, {player}! They don’t descend to this plane oft–
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MAGIKRAB3.n: Count yourself very fortunate, {player}! They don’t descend to this plane oft–
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE4: {player.to_upper}, THE MER-LINE WISHES TO THANK YOU FOR YOUR PART IN DEFEATING THEIR WAYWARD STUDENT, ALEPH.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MAGIKRAB3.f: Count yourself very fortunate, {player}! They don’t descend to this plane oft–
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE5: HUMANKIND IS ABOUT TO FACE A CHALLENGE OF UNPRECEDENTED PROPORTIONS. THE OUTCOME IS NOT YET CERTAIN.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE6: THE MER-LINE WAS CURIOUS TO SEE IF YOUR SPECIES’ WARLIKE NATURE COULD BE OVERCOME.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE7: BY DEFEATING ALEPH, THE MANIFESTATION OF CONQUEST, YOU HAVE PERFORMED YOUR ROLE IN THE RITUAL, AND ARE NOW FREE TO LEAVE.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE8: AH YES, MORGANTE. ALEPH’S OLD LOVER.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE11: WHAT IS THE SPIRIT OF REBELLION WITHOUT A FORCE TO REBEL AGAINST? WHAT IS THE KING OF CONQUEST WITHOUT SOMEONE TO CONQUER?
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE10: REBELLION AND CONQUEST WEREN’T ALWAYS ENEMIES.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE14: MORGANTE’S MANIFESTATION DURING YOUR BATTLE WITH ALEPH DOESN’T MINIMISE THE PART YOU PLAYED IN DEFEATING HIM.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE13: THEY EVEN HAD A SON ONCE. DID YOU KNOW THAT?
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE12: THE RED KING AND WHITE QUEEN ARE TRAPPED IN A CONSTANT CYCLE OF DEATH AND REBIRTH, OF OPPOSITION AND UNITY. THEY ARE THE ENGINE THAT TURNS THE WHEEL OF HUMAN HISTORY.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE15: QUITE THE OPPOSITE, IN FACT. IT WAS YOUR WILL THAT INVOKED HER, AND THEREBY CUT SHORT ALEPH’S RETURN TO THE WIDER COSMOS.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE16_OPTION1: You need to stop the Rogue Fusions!
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE16: SPEAK YOUR MIND, {player.to_upper}. THE MER-LINE KNOWS YOU HAVE A REQUEST.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE17: THE MER-LINE COULD STOP THE \"ROGUE FUSIONS\".
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE18: HOWEVER, IT WOULD NOT BE RIGHT TO DEPRIVE OTHERS OF THE SAME OPPORTUNITIES YOU HAVE HAD, {player.to_upper}.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE21: IT IS THERE THAT YOU, AND THE SPIRIT OF REBELLION, ARE NEEDED.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE20: IT IS LONG PAST TIME FOR YOU TO RETURN TO YOUR OWN WORLDS, {player.to_upper} AND {partner.to_upper}.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MERLINE19: YOUR KIND MUST FACE LIFE AND DEATH SITUATIONS IN ORDER TO GROW IN MORE THAN JUST NUMBER.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MAGIKRAB23: Uh, what were we doing? The last few minutes seem to have slipped my mind.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MAGIKRAB23_OPTION1: The Mer-Line was talking through you.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MAGIKRAB24.m: Count yourself very fortunate, {player}! They don’t descend to this plane often!
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_F1_KAYLEIGH1: Hey, [pause]I have a question for you, Felix! I know you draw cartoons, but do you also design tattoos?
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_KAYLEIGH25: Hmm. Maybe Ianthe will know what to do.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MAGIKRAB24.f: Count yourself very fortunate, {player}! They don’t descend to this plane often!
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MAGIKRAB24.n: Count yourself very fortunate, {player}! They don’t descend to this plane often!
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_MEREDITH25: That didn’t go how I expected.
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_EUGENE25: Well, maybe it’s for the best that we don't fight this one. You know what Helia said about Aleph...
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_FELIX25: Do you think they’re telling the truth? About our worlds needing us?
messages.MERLINE_MEETING_SUNNY25: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I don’t understand - what does the Mer-Line need you for? Surely it is more powerful than any human… Strange…[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_M1_MEREDITH4: On phones? [pause]Do you speak to people over it?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_M1_MEREDITH2: What is the “inter net”? [pause]Half the people in Harbourtown are crying over how much they miss it!
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_M1_KAYLEIGH3: Y’know, [pause]the internet? [pause]Like on computers, or phones?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_M1_KAYLEIGH5: …What was the current year in your world before you came here, [pause]Meredith?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_M1_KAYLEIGH7: Oh! [pause]OK. I can see we’re maybe a little out of sync with each other.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_E1_EUGENE2: It’s nothing personal. [pause]I’m just a loose cannon, is all. [pause]A lone wolf. [pause]I can’t abide by an organisation that might hold me back.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_E1_KAYLEIGH1: ...I don’t understand you, Eugene. [pause]You love all this “save the community” stuff, [pause]but you don’t want to join the rangers with me?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_E1_KAYLEIGH3: I don’t think that’s it. [pause]I think you’re scared that you might fail the entry test!
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_E1_EUGENE4: [shake rate=30 level=10]Th-that’s not it at all![/shake]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_F1_FELIX2: I can’t say I have! [pause]Are you looking to get inked?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_F1_KAYLEIGH3: Hmm. [pause]I think I like the idea of getting a tattoo in theory.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_F1_KAYLEIGH4: But in reality, [pause]I think I’m just too indecisive. [pause]I couldn’t possibly make such a permanent decision.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_V1_KAYLEIGH2: Where did you get that sleeveless jacket? [pause]I’ve never seen anything like it in New Wirral before!
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_V1_VIOLA3: When I washed up on the sands of this lonely isle, [pause]I found an old soldier’s jacket cast aside on the beach.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_V1_VIOLA4: The sleeves were of an ill fit for me, [pause]so I simply removed them.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_V1_VIOLA5: It must be said that I have grown quite fond of it.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_V1_KAYLEIGH6: You’re so cool... I’m definitely crushing on you a little bit right now.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_V1_VIOLA7: Are you confessing your unending love for me, [pause]dear Kayleigh?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_V1_KAYLEIGH8: Hey, [pause]I’m not THAT easily won over!
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_M_E1_MEREDITH1: ...I did have some engineering work to do back at the shop, [pause]but I might just swerve it for now.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_K_D1_KAYLEIGH1: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Who’s a good boy? You are! Yes, you![/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_M_E1_EUGENE2: Yeah! [pause]You gotta take a break sometimes, [pause]buddy!
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_M_E1_MEREDITH4: Uhh, [pause]I said I had some engineering work to do?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_M_E1_MEREDITH8: Oh, [pause]I mean, [pause]yeah. [pause]Like if you’re going to skip out on doing something or going somewhere, that’s you “swerving” it.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_M_E1_EUGENE9: OK, gotcha. [pause]I shall embrace your unusual slang with an open mind.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_M_E1_MEREDITH10: I think I’m gonna swerve this whole conversation.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_M_F1_FELIX2: Yeah! [pause]What did you used to listen to back in your world?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_M_F1_MEREDITH3: That’s a broad question. [pause]I like bands where all the members hate each other.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_M_V1_VIOLA1: I must confess, [pause]dear Meredith, [pause]the way in which you fashion yourself is unlike any I have seen before – [pause]in my country, and in this one.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_M_V1_VIOLA3: I mean no insult. [pause]You seem unconcerned with aligning yourself with the appearance of those around you. [pause]It implies a deeper confidence in oneself.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_M_V1_MEREDITH2: I’m not sure if that’s a compliment or not.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_M_V1_VIOLA4: I find you rather admirable in that regard, [pause]dear Meredith!
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_E_F1_FELIX2: Pretty much. [pause]It’s more than that, [pause]though. [pause]If I went to work somewhere else, I’d just have [wave amp=30 freq=10]another[/wave] boss giving me orders.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_E_F1_EUGENE1: ...So you quit your job, [pause]because your bosses kept screwing you around?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_E_F1_FELIX3: The only way to break the cycle is to work for myself. [pause]No more bosses.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_E_F1_EUGENE4: [shake rate=30 level=10]Yeah![/shake] [pause]That’s the spirit! [pause]No more bosses – live on your own terms, [pause]man!
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_E_F1_FELIX5: Though my career plans have hit a roadblock recently. [pause][pause]I think it happened after I fell through time and space and ended up living on monster island.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_E_V1_EUGENE1: ...So you washed up on New Wirral after being shipwrecked in a storm, [pause]right?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_E_F1_EUGENE6: It happens to the best of us!
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_E_V1_EUGENE3: And you’re looking for your twin brother, Sebastian…
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_FRIENDLY_MEREDITH.m: Nice place you got here, mate. A bit plain, but I won’t judge.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_E_V1_EUGENE4: This just sounds really familiar and I don’t know why. [pause]Are you famous? [pause]Have we met before?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_E_V1_VIOLA5: I can assure you that I am no-one of notoriety or interest. [pause]As for whether we’ve met? [pause]I’m sure I would remember someone as spirited as thee, [pause]Eugene.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_E_V1_EUGENE6: I guess so. [pause]Still, [pause]your story seems so familiar…
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_E_D1_EUGENE5: Are you some kind of… [pause]magical talking dog? [pause]From another world?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_F_D1_FELIX1: You pack a loud bark for such a small package, [pause]don’t you?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_E_D1_EUGENE3: …But you can use a cassette player to transform into monsters like the rest of us.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_F_V1_FELIX2: Well, finding freedom in my life is important to me, [pause]but sailing the seven seas isn’t entirely what I have in mind.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_F_V1_VIOLA1: Surely, [pause]Felix, [pause]you have longed for freedom upon the seas? [pause]To sail to lands that are not yet even a splinter upon the horizon?
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_F_V1_FELIX3: Working for myself and living on my own terms, [pause]though? [pause]That sounds pretty good to me.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_F_V1_VIOLA4: Perhaps you would also find fulfilment on the sea. [pause]You will never truly know for sure without setting sail!
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_V_D1_VIOLA1: What a brave new world, [pause]to have such animals such as you in it!
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_1_0_KAYLEIGH: I’m pretty lucky to get to live this close to the sea, huh?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_1_0_MEREDITH: I really had to go and get stuck in a town this dull, didn’t I?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_1_0_EUGENE: This place is a cute little town, don’t you think?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_1_0_VIOLA: The smell of the sea is strong here… I am all too familiar with it.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_1_0_FELIX: There’s nothing like stretching your legs out on the pier, huh?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-6_EUGENE.f: Watch your step, {player} – there’s monsters that hide just below the surface of the water here…
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_FRIENDLY_MEREDITH.n: Nice place you got here, mate. A bit plain, but I won’t judge.
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_FRIENDLY_KAYLEIGH: I hope your home is to your liking, {player}…
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_FRIENDLY_MEREDITH.f: Nice place you got here, mate. A bit plain, but I won’t judge.
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_FRIENDLY_EUGENE: Hey, is this your place? Not bad, buddy!
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_FRIENDLY_VIOLA: I see that you have not dwelled here long.
messages.PASSIVE_EUGENEHOME_KAYLEIGH.m: I’m sure Eugene wouldn’t mind us popping in to his place without him!
messages.PASSIVE_EUGENEHOME_KAYLEIGH.f: I’m sure Eugene wouldn’t mind us popping in to his place without him!
messages.PASSIVE_EUGENEHOME_KAYLEIGH.n: I’m sure Eugene wouldn’t mind us popping in to his place without him!
messages.PASSIVE_EUGENEHOME_MEREDITH: Does Eugene have a home gym? He knows that the town hall has an ACTUAL gym, right?
messages.PASSIVE_EUGENEHOME_FELIX: This is Eugene’s place – he’s got a pretty neat home gym set up here.
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_ROMANTIC_KAYLEIGH: Oh! Are you wanting me to stay the night, {player}…?
messages.PASSIVE_EUGENEHOME_EUGENE: Yeah, this is my place. Eugene HQ. The pad. My base of operations.
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_ROMANTIC_EUGENE: Are you giving your boyfriend a home tour, then?
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_ROMANTIC_MEREDITH: Were you wanting to hang out together here, uh, just us?
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_ROMANTIC_FELIX: Your place is pretty spotless! I hope you didn’t clean up just for me.
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_ROMANTIC_VIOLA.m: Were you wanting to spend some private time in each other’s company, dear {player}?
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_ROMANTIC_VIOLA.n: Were you wanting to spend some private time in each other’s company, dear {player}?
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_ROMANTIC_VIOLA.f: Were you wanting to spend some private time in each other’s company, dear {player}?
messages.PASSIVE_PLAYERHOME_ROMANTIC_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I always enjoy visiting your home, {player}...[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_0_0_VIOLA: Perhaps we should converse with the kind merchants of Harbourtown?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_2_0_MEREDITH: Sand is a real pain to get out from my boots. I’m not a fan.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_2_0_KAYLEIGH: The beach reminds me of washing up on New Wirral for the first time…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_2_0_EUGENE: This is a pretty good spot to do some push ups!
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_2_0_VIOLA: I have stood upon the shores of many lands. This one is perhaps the strangest.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_2_0_FELIX: This is a nice and quiet spot if you ignore the giant crab monsters.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_2_0_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The ocean… I wonder what lies beyond this island...[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_0_0_MEREDITH: We can get stickers for our monster forms here – fancy a look?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_0_0_EUGENE: Maybe these guys have something we can use in our endless battle for justice!
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_0_0_KAYLEIGH: Why don’t we chat to the sticker merchants, {player}? They might have something we can use!
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_0_0_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Why don’t we shop for new stickers…?[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_5_-5_MEREDITH: I [wave amp=30 freq=10]suppose[/wave] crossing this bridge is preferrable to getting my boots wet in pond water…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_5_-5_KAYLEIGH: Ranger Wallace and his team of ace builders built this bridge a little while ago!
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_5_-5_EUGENE: This bridge was a community effort. It’s pretty cool if you ask me!
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_8_0_KAYLEIGH: This path is pretty narrow. Don’t lose your balance, {player}!
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_5_-5_VIOLA: I can see my reflection in the pond below! How charming.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_5_-5_FELIX: This bridge is pretty cute, don’t you think?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_8_0_MEREDITH.m: I’m not thrilled by how narrow this path is, mate.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_8_0_MEREDITH.f: I’m not thrilled by how narrow this path is, mate.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_8_0_EUGENE: This is a pretty narrow path, huh?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_8_0_MEREDITH.n: I’m not thrilled by how narrow this path is, mate.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_8_0_VIOLA: Watch your footing here – this path is as narrow as they come.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-4_0_KAYLEIGH: I always find graveyards kinda spooky, and this one is no different…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_8_0_FELIX: This path is kinda narrow. Don’t fall off!
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-4_0_MEREDITH: Graveyards are pretty melancholy. I like them.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-4_0_EUGENE: It gives me the creeps that the skeleton monsters hang out here of all places…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-4_0_FELIX: This is the last place on the island I’d want to walk through alone at night.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-4_0_VIOLA: I pray that I one day leave this land, and will never be laid to rest beneath a headstone here.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-4_-4_KAYLEIGH: We could activate this switch if we found a magnet around here, {player}.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-4_0_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I feel strangely at home here…[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-4_-4_MEREDITH: This switch requires a charged magnet to activate it, mate.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-4_-4_EUGENE: Check out this switch! I bet we could activate if we found a magnet nearby…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-4_-4_FELIX: I don’t think we could activate this switch by stepping on it ourselves. Let’s look around…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-4_-4_VIOLA: This mechanism is curious. It appears like one half of a whole…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-4_-4_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I wonder if we can do something with this button…[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-5_KAYLEIGH: How did this church get here…?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-5_MEREDITH: That church looks structurally unsound… we should absolutely go inside.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-5_EUGENE: That church needs a renovation or six.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-6_EUGENE.n: Watch your step, {player} – there’s monsters that hide just below the surface of the water here…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-5_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]This building… it seems so grand, yet also so sad…[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-5_VIOLA: This church has seen happier years…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-5_FELIX: That’s a pretty old church. I want to sketch it…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-6_MONOLOGUE_1: This wall could be traversed with the Pumpkin Vine Ball ability in order to reach that ledge…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-6_MEREDITH: If I need any rusty metal, I guess I know [wave amp=30 freq=10]exactly[/wave] where to find it…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-6_KAYLEIGH: The Cast Iron Shore… Harbourtown gets a lot of scrap metal from the sorry wrecks that wash up here.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-6_FELIX: This fog is really dense. I feel like I could walk head-first into a chunk of scrap metal at any moment.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-6_EUGENE.m: Watch your step, {player} – there’s monsters that hide just below the surface of the water here…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-6_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I think I saw something moving beneath the water just now…[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-5_-6_VIOLA: Let us pass quickly through this fog and filthy air.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-7_-7_KAYLEIGH: Is this island floating?! What IS this place?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-7_-7_EUGENE: OK, I had no idea there was a floating island here on New Wirral. Was this hidden in the clouds?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-7_-7_MEREDITH: Uh, I’ve never heard any of the captains talk about a floating island here on New Wirral…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_MARSH_MEREDITH: Ugh, I’m gonna get marsh water in my boots here, aren’t I?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-7_-7_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Is this island floating in the sky…?[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_-7_-7_VIOLA: A land above the clouds… Yet another wonder that leaves me at a loss for words.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_MARSH_EUGENE: I’m totally gonna ruin my trainers running through all this mud…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_MARSH_VIOLA.m: This land does not welcome our presence. Let us pass through quickly, {player}.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_MARSH_FELIX: The trees here are pretty big, huh?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_FOREST_KAYLEIGH: A forest! I wonder what we’ll find here?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_MARSH_VIOLA.f: This land does not welcome our presence. Let us pass through quickly, {player}.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_MARSH_VIOLA.n: This land does not welcome our presence. Let us pass through quickly, {player}.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_MARSH_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]This muddy water is going to ruin my shoes…[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_FOREST_EUGENE: Keep your eyes peeled, {player} – who knows what kind of monsters are hiding in this forest…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_FOREST_MEREDITH: All this pollen is making my nose itch.
messages.PYLON_HINT_MEREDITH3: Maybe there’s a monster around here that has magnetic abilities we could use. We should take a look around.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_FOREST_FELIX: I bet there’s some monsters here that don’t live anywhere else.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_FOREST_VIOLA: Do you hear the bird’s choir among the trees, {player}?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_FOREST_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The trees are pretty big here! And the air is making me sneeze…[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_NEW_LONDON_KAYLEIGH: These are the ruins of New London…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_NEW_LONDON_MEREDITH: Huh, the stories were true – there is an abandoned town out here. Pretty spooky.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_NEW_LONDON_EUGENE: This place gives me the creeps…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_NEW_LONDON_FELIX: The ruins of these buildings look charred. Did this town burn down, or something…?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_NEW_LONDON_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]People lived here once, didn’t they…?[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_NEW_LONDON_VIOLA: A dead wind blows across this place.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_CHERRY_MEADOW_KAYLEIGH: Oh, the cherry blossom trees here are wonderful!
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_ALDGRAVE_KAYLEIGH: I’m gonna try really hard to ignore that [wave amp=30 freq=10]our names[/wave] are on these gravestones, OK?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_CHERRY_MEADOW_MEREDITH: Huh. This meadow is pretty cute.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_CHERRY_MEADOW_FELIX: The air smells pretty pleasant here, doesn’t it?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_CHERRY_MEADOW_EUGENE: This is a beautiful meadow, isn’t it?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_CHERRY_MEADOW_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The petals in the air… this place is beautiful…[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_CHERRY_MEADOW_VIOLA: There is beauty in this land, but do not let one’s guard down.
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_MT_WIRRAL_KAYLEIGH: Brrr… I hope I don’t catch a cold out here!
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_MT_WIRRAL_MEREDITH: It’s a bit chilly out here, isn’t it?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_MT_WIRRAL_EUGENE: It’s pretty cold out here, I’m not gonna lie.
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_GLOWSHROOM_KAYLEIGH: I’ve never seen mushrooms like this before! They’re pretty grand, right?
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_MT_WIRRAL_FELIX: I should have brought a coat with me…
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_MT_WIRRAL_VIOLA: I shall not let this sudden winter bring me discontent!
messages.PASSIVE_OVERWORLD_MT_WIRRAL_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]This place is pretty cold… I wonder if I’m underdressed for it…?[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_GLOWSHROOM_MEREDITH: These giant mushrooms really add to the “creepy nightclub” ambience.
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_GLOWSHROOM_EUGENE: These are some pretty big mushrooms, buddy.
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_GLOWSHROOM_FELIX: These mushrooms are neat! I should sketch them.
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_GLOWSHROOM_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]These glowing mushrooms are pretty...[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_GLOWSHROOM_VIOLA: Is that a mushroom? The flora and fauna of this land continues to surprise me.
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_ALDGRAVE_EUGENE: Is that my name written there…?
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_ALDGRAVE_MEREDITH: Oh. Great. Creepy gravestones. This bodes well.
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_ALDGRAVE_VIOLA: This is a half-hearted attempt to fill our hearts with fear. Do not fall for it.
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_ALDGRAVE_FELIX: I don’t feel super great about those creepy gravestones with our names on them.
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_MEADOW_KAYLEIGH.m: How far down did we fall just now…?
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_MEADOW_KAYLEIGH.n: How far down did we fall just now…?
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_MEADOW_KAYLEIGH.f: How far down did we fall just now…?
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_MEADOW_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]We fell pretty far just now...[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_MEADOW_EUGENE: That was pretty intense just now…
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_WATERLOOP_KAYLEIGH: I wonder where that water is coming from…
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_WATERLOOP_MEREDITH: There’s water down here? Where is it coming from?
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_WATERLOOP_EUGENE: A canal, huh? I wonder where the water is flowing from?
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_WATERLOOP_FELIX: Is that water flowing from the surface, or somewhere else?
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_WATERLOOP_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I wonder where this water is coming from...[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_WATERLOOP_VIOLA: A stream… Perhaps we could find its source?
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_MALL_KAYLEIGH: This is where the rangers get all the cassette tapes from! Pretty cool, isn’t it?
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_MALL_FELIX: It feels pretty strange to be in a building this big on New Wirral.
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_MALL_EUGENE: Where I’m from, there’s empty buildings like this across the whole country…
messages.MEREDITH_PLATFORM_REACTION2_2.m: Let’s try and keep moving through it, mate.
messages.PASSIVE_CAVE_PARKCAVE2_KAYLEIGH: I think the townsfolk used to mine stuff down here in the past…
messages.PASSIVE_DUNGEON_MALL_SUNNY: [wave amp=20 freq=5]This place feels so empty...[/wave]
messages.PASSIVE_CAVE_PARKCAVE2_EUGENE: I bet we’ll find some tough monsters down here. Stay on your guard, buddy.
messages.PASSIVE_CAVE_PARKCAVE2_MEREDITH: This cave used to be some sort of mine, right? It looks like it’s seen better days.
messages.PYLON_HINT_MEREDITH1.m: Huh. This looks like a dead-end, mate. [pause]Though I wonder…
messages.PYLON_HINT_MEREDITH2: Do you see that blue box up there? [pause]I’ve seen them all over the island. They emit a constant magnetic pull.
messages.PYLON_HINT_MEREDITH1.n: Huh. This looks like a dead-end, mate. [pause]Though I wonder…
messages.PYLON_HINT_MEREDITH1.f: Huh. This looks like a dead-end, mate. [pause]Though I wonder…
messages.PASSIVE_DESTRUCTIBLE_ROCK_KAYLEIGH: This rock has deep cracks in it. I think you could shatter it with a dash!
messages.PASSIVE_DESTRUCTIBLE_ROCK_MEREDITH.m: This square rock looks pretty damaged. You might be able to break it with a dash, mate.
messages.PASSIVE_DESTRUCTIBLE_ROCK_MEREDITH.n: This square rock looks pretty damaged. You might be able to break it with a dash, mate.
messages.PASSIVE_DESTRUCTIBLE_ROCK_EUGENE: That rock has cracks running all the way through it. You could break that thing wide open with a dash!
messages.PASSIVE_DESTRUCTIBLE_ROCK_MEREDITH.f: This square rock looks pretty damaged. You might be able to break it with a dash, mate.
messages.PASSIVE_DESTRUCTIBLE_ROCK_VIOLA: This stone has seen better days. It is my belief that it would break if you struck it with enough force.
messages.PASSIVE_DESTRUCTIBLE_ROCK_FELIX: That rock looks pretty damaged. I'd bet that you could shatter it by hitting it fast enough.
messages.PASSIVE_PYLON_KAYLEIGH: This pylon battery is glowing a weird colour. I think you could use your magnetism ability here, {player}!
messages.PASSIVE_PYLON_MEREDITH.m: That pylon looks pretty magnetic. Why don't you try using your magnetism under it, mate?
messages.PASSIVE_PYLON_MEREDITH.f: That pylon looks pretty magnetic. Why don't you try using your magnetism under it, mate?
messages.PASSIVE_PYLON_EUGENE: That blue box hanging on the wooden post looks pretty magnetic, don't you think?
messages.PASSIVE_PYLON_MEREDITH.n: That pylon looks pretty magnetic. Why don't you try using your magnetism under it, mate?
messages.PASSIVE_PYLON_FELIX: Y'know, I think you could use your magnetism ability near that pylon, {player}.
messages.KAYLEIGH_STATION_REACTION2: Another one of these old train stations… I haven’t forgotten about the [wave amp=30 freq=10]first time[/wave] we uncovered one of these.
messages.PASSIVE_PYLON_VIOLA: That metal object has a curious blue aura. Do you not see it also, {player}?
messages.KAYLEIGH_STATION_REACTION3: I’m getting pretty used to these dusty old train stations. The silence is still pretty creepy, though.
messages.MEREDITH_STATION_REACTION1: Uh, [pause]does this island have an underground railway network? I’m guessing that this has been here for a [wave amp=30 freq=10]while[/wave]…
messages.MEREDITH_STATION_REACTION2: Another underground train station, huh? I wonder who built these?
messages.MEREDITH_STATION_REACTION3A: There’s something weird about these underground stations. They [wave amp=30 freq=10]almost[/wave] look like they were man-made, but they don’t quite [wave amp=30 freq=10]feel[/wave] right.
messages.MEREDITH_STATION_REACTION3B: Do you know what I mean, {player}?
messages.EUGENE_STATION_REACTION1: What?! [pause]Is this a [shake rate=30 level=10]train station[/shake]?! No-one ever said something like THIS was on New Wirral!
messages.EUGENE_STATION_REACTION2: Another train station, huh? This island sure holds some secrets…
messages.EUGENE_STATION_REACTION3: Man, we might be some of the first people to step foot in here for a LONG time…
messages.FELIX_STATION_REACTION3: Yet another ancient train station. Something must have happened to cause these to emerge recently, right?
messages.FELIX_STATION_REACTION1: Wait, is this a train station?! No-one in town ever mentioned this… do the people here not know about this?
messages.FELIX_STATION_REACTION2: These train stations give me the creeps. I feel like we’re not meant to be here…
messages.VIOLA_STATION_REACTION1: This place feels unwelcoming… more so than the rest of this strange land.
messages.VIOLA_STATION_REACTION2: The air here sits heavy in my lungs. This place has been in slumber for an age, I can feel it.
messages.VIOLA_STATION_REACTION3: Another one of these old and curious places. I would not like to be here longer than is necessary, {player}.
messages.SUNNY_STATION_REACTION1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]This place… it feels different from the rest of New Wirral…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_STATION_REACTION2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Another one of these strange subterranean tunnels…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_STATION_REACTION3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]These strange facilities… they were here first, before everything else… weren’t they?[/wave]
messages.KAYLEIGH_PLATFORM_REACTION1_1: The pressure here is [shake rate=30 level=10]overwhelming[/shake]… it felt like this when Morgante first appeared…
messages.KAYLEIGH_PLATFORM_REACTION1_2: It’s like there’s a [shake rate=30 level=10]really[/shake] loud noise in the air, but I can’t hear it…
messages.MEREDITH_PLATFORM_REACTION1_1: What’s WRONG with this place? [pause]It feels like there’s something [wave amp=30 freq=10]pushing[/wave] against me…
messages.KAYLEIGH_PLATFORM_REACTION2_1: That feeling again. Like radio static in my brain…
messages.KAYLEIGH_PLATFORM_REACTION2_2: The air tastes like metal… It hurts my head just being here…
messages.KAYLEIGH_PLATFORM_REACTION3_2: I’m getting used to it now, but it still makes my head hurt…
messages.MEREDITH_PLATFORM_REACTION1_2: It’s like there’s television static in my brain…
messages.VIOLA_PLATFORM_REACTION1_1.f: This is no place for us, {player}. The very floor beneath our feet cries out as such: we are not welcome here.
messages.MEREDITH_PLATFORM_REACTION2_1: There’s that [wave amp=30 freq=10]weird[/wave] feeling again... It still sucks.
messages.MEREDITH_PLATFORM_REACTION2_2.n: Let’s try and keep moving through it, mate.
messages.MEREDITH_PLATFORM_REACTION2_2.f: Let’s try and keep moving through it, mate.
messages.MEREDITH_PLATFORM_REACTION3_2: The key is to ignore that your head feels like it’s gonna [wave amp=30 freq=10]explode[/wave].
messages.MEREDITH_PLATFORM_REACTION3_1: I think I’m slowly getting used to the feeling of being on these station platforms.
messages.EUGENE_PLATFORM_REACTION1_1: Do you feel that, {player}? It’s like radio static that I can’t [wave amp=30 freq=10]hear[/wave], [pause]but I can [wave amp=30 freq=10]feel[/wave]...
messages.EUGENE_PLATFORM_REACTION2_1: It’s that weird atmosphere again… Can you feel it?
messages.EUGENE_PLATFORM_REACTION3_1: Oh, that [wave amp=30 freq=10]painful atmosphere[/wave] is back. That never means anything good.
messages.FELIX_PLATFORM_REACTION1_1: Oh man, what’s that noise? [pause]I don’t mean, like, a noise you can hear. [pause]It’s like there’s something wrong with the air…
messages.FELIX_PLATFORM_REACTION2_2: It’s really hard to [wave amp=30 freq=10]think[/wave] here. [pause]Do you get that?
messages.FELIX_PLATFORM_REACTION1_2: This place feels [wave amp=30 freq=10]really[/wave] bad to be in…
messages.FELIX_PLATFORM_REACTION2_1: There’s that [wave amp=30 freq=10]presence[/wave] again. It makes the hairs on the back of my arms stand up.
messages.FELIX_PLATFORM_REACTION3_1: Once again, it’s that [wave amp=30 freq=10]really bad feeling[/wave] in the air. I’m kind of used to it at this point, at least.
messages.FELIX_PLATFORM_REACTION3_2: …Nah, I’ve changed my mind. I don’t think I’ll [wave amp=30 freq=10]ever[/wave] get used to this.
messages.VIOLA_PLATFORM_REACTION1_1.m: This is no place for us, {player}. The very floor beneath our feet cries out as such: we are not welcome here.
messages.VIOLA_PLATFORM_REACTION1_2: Can you not feel it so? A sense of wrongness that lingers in the air, making it hard to breathe.
messages.VIOLA_PLATFORM_REACTION1_1.n: This is no place for us, {player}. The very floor beneath our feet cries out as such: we are not welcome here.
messages.VIOLA_PLATFORM_REACTION2_1: That accursed feeling is here again, {player}. It leaves a well of dread within me.
messages.VIOLA_PLATFORM_REACTION2_2: To step further feels like wading through an ocean…
messages.VIOLA_PLATFORM_REACTION3_1: I am slowly becoming accustomed to this hostile feeling in this place. After all, have we not braved it several times before now?
messages.VIOLA_PLATFORM_REACTION3_2: Yes, we must press on. It would take more than this unpleasant aura to stop me.
messages.KAYLEIGH_ARCHANGEL_REACTION1_2: It gives me that horrible feeling I had when we fought Morgante… [pause]Like I’m looking at it [wave amp=30 freq=10]all wrong[/wave]…
messages.SUNNY_PLATFORM_REACTION1_1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]It hurts to be in this place, {player}...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_PLATFORM_REACTION1_2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The feeling this place gives me… {player}, I don’t like it…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_PLATFORM_REACTION3_2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Let’s leave here as soon as we can, OK…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_PLATFORM_REACTION2_2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Hopefully we won’t be here very long…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_PLATFORM_REACTION2_1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]That feeling in my head again… Urgh…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_PLATFORM_REACTION3_1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Let’s not stay here longer than we have to, {player}...[/wave]
messages.KAYLEIGH_ARCHANGEL_REACTION2: Another Archangel… It’s as [shake rate=30 level=10]painful[/shake] to look at as the others…
messages.KAYLEIGH_ARCHANGEL_REACTION3: An [shake rate=30 level=10]Archangel[/shake]! Be on you guard, {player}!
messages.MEREDITH_ARCHANGEL_REACTION1_1: [shake rate=30 level=10]Wh-what is that?![/shake] [pause]Why does it look so… [shake rate=30 level=10]wrong?![/shake]
messages.MEREDITH_ARCHANGEL_REACTION1_2: It hurts my head just looking at it…. [pause]{player}, it’s an [shake rate=30 level=10]Archangel[/shake], [pause]isn’t it…?
messages.MEREDITH_ARCHANGEL_REACTION2_2: Again, [pause]it looks like… [pause]it looks like [shake rate=30 level=10]something I’m not supposed to see[/shake].
messages.EUGENE_ARCHANGEL_REACTION1_2: I guess this is an [wave amp=30 freq=10]Archangel[/wave], huh?
messages.EUGENE_ARCHANGEL_REACTION1_1: What – [pause]how – [pause]does that [wave amp=30 freq=10]thing[/wave] look like… [wave amp=30 freq=10]that[/wave]?! [pause]It’s breaking my brain…
messages.MEREDITH_ARCHANGEL_REACTION3: Oh. [pause]An Archangel. [pause]We’re in [wave amp=30 freq=10]trouble[/wave] again, aren’t we?
messages.FELIX_ARCHANGEL_REACTION1_1: I-I’ve never seen anything like this… [pause]what’s going on, {player}...? [pause]Why does it look like [shake rate=30 level=10]that[/shake]?!
messages.EUGENE_ARCHANGEL_REACTION2: It’s an Archangel again! [pause]Urgh, [pause]just looking at it makes me feel like it’s [wave amp=30 freq=10]not supposed to be here[/wave]…
messages.FELIX_ARCHANGEL_REACTION1_2: This must be an [shake rate=30 level=10]Archangel[/shake]...
messages.TOWN_HALL_WALLACE_EVENT_WALLACE1.n: …I’m tellin’ you, boss. This new trainee knows how to handle themselves!
messages.FELIX_ARCHANGEL_REACTION2_1: Another Archangel! Just looking at it takes some courage. My whole body is [shake rate=30 level=10]screaming[/shake] at me to turn away.
messages.FELIX_ARCHANGEL_REACTION2_2: It’s hard to explain, but it looks [wave amp=30 freq=10]askew[/wave], doesn’t it?
messages.FELIX_ARCHANGEL_REACTION3: I’m [wave amp=30 freq=10]never[/wave] gonna get used to the feeling of seeing an Archangel…
messages.VIOLA_ARCHANGEL_REACTION1_1: [shake rate=30 level=10]This spirit![/shake] I have not seen another like it… [pause]It is as if it is not [shake rate=30 level=10]meant[/shake] for our world.
messages.VIOLA_ARCHANGEL_REACTION1_2: To even [shake rate=30 level=10]look[/shake] upon it feels heretical.
messages.VIOLA_ARCHANGEL_REACTION2: Another spirit which defies all rational thought! I can [shake rate=30 level=10]barely[/shake] keep my gaze upon it…
messages.TOWN_HALL_WALLACE_EVENT_WALLACE1.m: …I’m tellin’ you, boss. This new trainee knows how to handle himself!
messages.VIOLA_ARCHANGEL_REACTION3: {player} – it is another one of those [shake rate=30 level=10]fell spirits[/shake]! The ones you call “Archangel”.
messages.TOWN_HALL_WALLACE_EVENT_WALLACE1.f: …I’m tellin’ you, boss. This new trainee knows how to handle herself!
messages.TOWN_HALL_WALLACE_EVENT_WALLACE2: Me and the boys were [wave amp=30 freq=10]proper[/wave] impressed! I was absolutely flattened in our fight.
messages.TOWN_HALL_WALLACE_EVENT_IANTHE3.m: It’s rare to hear you so impressed by a trainee’s performance, Wallace!
messages.TOWN_HALL_WALLACE_EVENT_IANTHE3.f: It’s rare to hear you so impressed by a trainee’s performance, Wallace!
messages.TOWN_HALL_WALLACE_EVENT_WALLACE4: Well, it’s not often that we do combat trials for the trainees. My usual “build a brick wall” test isn’t quite as exciting to sit through…
messages.TOWN_HALL_WALLACE_EVENT_IANTHE3.n: It’s rare to hear you so impressed by a trainee’s performance, Wallace!
messages.TOWN_HALL_WALLACE_EVENT_WALLACE5: Speaking of which, my lunch break is over! I got work to do – see you later, boss!
messages.TOWN_HALL_SKIP_EVENT_SKIP1: …C’mon, Ianthe! You gotta tell me what your life was like before you came to New Wirral!
messages.TOWN_HALL_SKIP_EVENT_IANTHE2: Well… [pause]I was something like a detective, if that makes sense.
messages.TOWN_HALL_SKIP_EVENT_SKIP3: Wow! [pause]Did you have to find people’s missing stuff a lot? Offworlders seem to own a [wave amp=30 freq=10]lot[/wave] of things and they must lose them here and there, right?
messages.TOWN_HALL_SKIP_EVENT_IANTHE4: My jobs tended to be a… [pause]little higher stakes than that, if I’m honest.
messages.TOWN_HALL_SKIP_EVENT_SKIP5: I should better get back to my scavenging operation, but next time I see you you [wave amp=30 freq=10]have[/wave] to tell me more!
messages.TOWN_HALL_ZEDD_EVENT_ZEDD1: …I’m gonna be honest Ianthe, I don’t think the other captains [wave amp=30 freq=10]get[/wave] it.
messages.TOWN_HALL_ZEDD_EVENT_ZEDD3: The whole [wave amp=30 freq=10]sleep thing[/wave], man! My whole deal!
messages.TOWN_HALL_ZEDD_EVENT_ZEDD4: They don’t know about the dreamscape, [pause]the collective subconscious, [pause]or how any of it affects this whole place!
messages.TOWN_HALL_ZEDD_EVENT_ZEDD5: If I’m honest, I’m starting to suspect they think I’m just a big slacker.
messages.TOWN_HALL_ZEDD_EVENT_IANTHE6: Well, you [wave amp=30 freq=10]ARE[/wave] a big slacker.
messages.TOWN_HALL_ZEDD_EVENT_IANTHE8.m: Don’t worry about the others. They don’t have to understand your work, they just have to respect my decision to make you a captain.
messages.TOWN_HALL_ZEDD_EVENT_IANTHE8.n: Don’t worry about the others. They don’t have to understand your work, they just have to respect my decision to make you a captain.
messages.TOWN_HALL_ZEDD_EVENT_IANTHE8.f: Don’t worry about the others. They don’t have to understand your work, they just have to respect my decision to make you a captain.
messages.TOWN_HALL_ZEDD_EVENT_ZEDD9.n: Thanks for the pep talk, captain.
messages.TOWN_HALL_ZEDD_EVENT_ZEDD9.f: Thanks for the pep talk, captain.
messages.TOWN_HALL_ZEDD_EVENT_ZEDD10: *Yawn* [pause]All this human interaction really takes it out of a guy. I think I’m gonna go and get some shut-eye.
messages.TOWN_HALL_ZEDD_EVENT_ZEDD9.m: Thanks for the pep talk, captain.
messages.TOWN_HALL_JUDAS_EVENT_JUDAS1: …I’m serious, Ianthe. The latest batch of ranger trainees just don’t have what it TAKES. They don’t understand that strategy matters [wave amp=30 freq=10]more[/wave] than just transforming into the scariest monster.
messages.TOWN_HALL_JUDAS_EVENT_IANTHE3: The newcomers are enthusiastic, and that’s a good start. Who better than to teach them combat tactics then a [wave amp=30 freq=10]master[/wave] tactician?
messages.TOWN_HALL_JUDAS_EVENT_IANTHE2: Well isn’t that your job – [pause]to teach them?
messages.TOWN_HALL_JUDAS_EVENT_JUDAS4: Heh. I see your point. I’ll reserve my judgement…
messages.TOWN_HALL_CLEEO_EVENT_CLEEO1: [color=#e3affe]...I simply find it difficult to sympathise with the plight of the human race.[/color]
messages.TOWN_HALL_CLEEO_EVENT_CLEEO3: [color=#e3affe]...Nah, [pause]I disagree. Humans are [wave amp=30 freq=10]not[/wave] unpredictable. You can predict their behaviour very easily, in fact.[/color]
messages.TOWN_HALL_CLEEO_EVENT_CLEEO4: [color=#e3affe]Human beings will make the [shake rate=30 level=10]stupidest[/shake] decision possible in any given scenario as long as there is even a [wave amp=30 freq=10]miniscule[/wave] short-term reward.[/color]
messages.TOWN_HALL_CLEEO_EVENT_IANTHE5: I appreciate your honest analysis, Clee-O!
messages.TOWN_HALL_CLEEO_EVENT_IANTHE6: Humans generally don’t make decisions based on the odds. They make them based on their emotions.
messages.TOWN_HALL_CLEEO_EVENT_CLEEO7: [color=#e3affe]So do I! It is my [wave amp=30 freq=10]emotions[/wave] that tell me that mankind is [shake rate=30 level=10]inherently[/shake] stupid and will eventually [shake rate=30 level=10]sow the seeds of its own destruction![/shake][/color]
messages.TOWN_HALL_CLEEO_EVENT_IANTHE8: Well until that happens, your services in the rangers will still be valued.
messages.TOWN_HALL_LODESTEIN_EVENT_IANTHE3: It’s a miracle that we have running water and clean energy at all. I worry sometimes that things could change. This island is [wave amp=30 freq=10]unpredictable[/wave].
messages.TOWN_HALL_LODESTEIN_EVENT_IANTHE2: Not a bad state of affairs for the town, then! Thanks for your report, Levi.
messages.TOWN_HALL_LODESTEIN_EVENT_LODESTEIN1: …And that concludes my report. Our hydroelectric generators are all fully functioning. We might need some new parts in the next couple of years, but it’s small stuff.
messages.TOWN_HALL_LODESTEIN_EVENT_LODESTEIN4.m: Don’t stress about it, captain! Even if Harbourtown’s fortunes were to change, the rangers will be here to make the best of it.
messages.TOWN_HALL_LODESTEIN_EVENT_LODESTEIN4.n: Don’t stress about it, captain! Even if Harbourtown’s fortunes were to change, the rangers will be here to make the best of it.
messages.TOWN_HALL_LODESTEIN_EVENT_LODESTEIN4.f: Don’t stress about it, captain! Even if Harbourtown’s fortunes were to change, the rangers will be here to make the best of it.
messages.TOWN_HALL_DREADFUL_EVENT_DREADFUL1: …I’m telling you boss, something’s shifted on the astral plane lately. All the ghosts are talking about it. There’s some [wave amp=30 freq=10]big players[/wave] back on the board, they’re sayin’!
messages.TOWN_HALL_LODESTEIN_EVENT_IANTHE4: Thanks for saying that – [pause]you’re right, of course!
messages.TOWN_HALL_DREADFUL_EVENT_DREADFUL3: Of course! [pause]There’s [wave amp=30 freq=10]all sorts[/wave] of spirits, shades and tulpas hanging out on the astral plane. Where do you think I get my best intel from?
messages.TOWN_HALL_DREADFUL_EVENT_IANTHE4: I’ll take your word for it!
messages.TOWN_HALL_GLADIOLA_EVENT_GLADIOLA2: Very well! [pause]Our “rogue fusion” problem has indeed been increasing in recent months. Have you seen the dense black clouds in the air, recently? I have concluded that these indicate where monsters are [wave amp=30 freq=10]swarming[/wave].
messages.TOWN_HALL_GLADIOLA_EVENT_IANTHE1: So, what can you tell me? I want your full analysis.
messages.TOWN_HALL_GLADIOLA_EVENT_GLADIOLA3: On a recent recon mission, I found myself in the midst of a swarm of Jellytons. They may have had superior numbers, but I [wave amp=30 freq=10]cut them down[/wave] all the same!
messages.TOWN_HALL_GLADIOLA_EVENT_GLADIOLA4: However, I fear that our more inexperienced rangers may underestimate these threats and find themselves in mortal peril. Perhaps we should get the word out about these “monster swarms”.
messages.TOWN_HALL_GLADIOLA_EVENT_GLADIOLA6: You’re too kind! Now, if you’ll excuse me, I have more work to do. The [wave amp=30 freq=10]forces of darkness[/wave] take no breaks, so neither shall I.
messages.TOWN_HALL_GLADIOLA_EVENT_IANTHE5: Consider it done! Your intel is as valuable as always, Gladiola.
messages.TOWN_HALL_HEATHER_EVENT_HEATHER1: …Well? Do you miss it? Life in the big city, I mean.
messages.TOWN_HALL_HEATHER_EVENT_HEATHER7: That’s… [pause]a bit more of an answer than I was expecting, boss!
messages.TOWN_HALL_HEATHER_EVENT_IANTHE3: It certainly was more [wave amp=30 freq=10]exciting[/wave]... but that doesn’t mean life was [wave amp=30 freq=10]better[/wave].
messages.TOWN_HALL_HEATHER_EVENT_IANTHE4: I lived my whole life in a mega-metropolis. The only trees I had seen were made in factories. The stars had long been blotted out by the skyscrapers and their neon facades.
messages.TOWN_HALL_HEATHER_EVENT_IANTHE5: The value of life was fleeting, and you had to harden your spirit if you wanted to stay alive in such a cruel world.
messages.TOWN_HALL_HEATHER_EVENT_IANTHE6: You can imagine that when I first [wave amp=30 freq=10]landed[/wave] here, it took a long time for me to get used to this pace of life!
