messages.TOWN_HALL_BUFFY_EVENT_BUFFY4: No sweat! I used to run a cardio class every week for five years. If anyone’s up to the job, it’s [wave amp=30 freq=10]me[/wave]!
messages.TOWN_HALL_BUFFY_EVENT_BUFFY2: We could even make it fun! [pause]How about [wave amp=30 freq=10]dance aerobics[/wave]? Cybil could provide a music playlist!
messages.TOWN_HALL_BUFFY_EVENT_BUFFY1: …I’m thinking that the rangers would benefit from some physical fitness classes.
messages.TOWN_HALL_BUFFY_EVENT_IANTHE3: Yeah, that sounds like a cute idea! If you think you can manage it, of course.
messages.TOWN_HALL_CYBIL_EVENT_CYBIL2: Think about it! You’re always talking about [wave amp=30 freq=10]community spirit[/wave] – what would unite our wonderful townsfolk more than a [shake rate=30 level=10]shared aural experience[/shake] every day?
messages.TOWN_HALL_CYBIL_EVENT_CYBIL1: …And if we installed speakers throughout Harbourtown, I could broadcast music to the [wave amp=30 freq=10]entire town[/wave] at once!
messages.TOWN_HALL_CYBIL_EVENT_IANTHE3: I don’t know, Cybil. I suspect the folks around here have quite a diverse taste in music. I could see it being a controversial decision.
messages.TOWN_HALL_CODEY_EVENT_CODEY1: …If I knew that people would be calling me “Codey” forever, I would have picked a cooler nickname. [pause]Like “Killswitch”, [pause]or “Omegabyte”.
messages.TOWN_HALL_CYBIL_EVENT_IANTHE5: Hey, I never said it was off the table entirely! [pause]I’ll tell you what: if Skip manages to dig up some intact hi-fi speakers one day, I’ll propose the idea at the following town hall meeting.
messages.TOWN_HALL_CODEY_EVENT_IANTHE2: I mean, you can just pick your own name. I did.
messages.TOWN_HALL_CODEY_EVENT_CODEY3: Wait... Your name wasn’t always Ianthe?!
messages.TOWN_HALL_CODEY_EVENT_IANTHE4: Nope! In my former line of work, it was safer to pick an alias – I’m sure you can relate.
messages.TOWN_HALL_CODEY_EVENT_IANTHE5: “Ianthe” is the name of a water goddess in Greek mythology. I needed to choose a name in a pinch and thought it sounded good.
messages.TOWN_HALL_CODEY_EVENT_CODEY6: Huh. You sure do have a lot of secrets of your own, don’t you?
messages.TOWN_HALL_CODEY_EVENT_IANTHE7: Don’t expect me to tell you any more than that!
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA1.n: You – [pause]do you call yourself a hero? That role is a heavy crown to wear. Are you truly ready for it?
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA1.f: You – [pause]do you call yourself a hero? That role is a heavy crown to wear. Are you truly ready for it?
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA1.m: You – [pause]do you call yourself a hero? That role is a heavy crown to wear. Are you truly ready for it?
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_KAYLEIGH2.m: Uh, are you speaking to {player}? I’d say they’re [wave amp=30 freq=10]pretty[/wave] heroic!
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_MEREDITH2.m: Uh, what do you mean “ready for it”?
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_KAYLEIGH2.n: Uh, are you speaking to {player}? I’d say they’re [wave amp=30 freq=10]pretty[/wave] heroic!
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_KAYLEIGH2.f: Uh, are you speaking to {player}? I’d say they’re [wave amp=30 freq=10]pretty[/wave] heroic!
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_MEREDITH2.f: Uh, what do you mean “ready for it”?
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_FELIX2: This conversation’s off to an enigmatic start. Please continue.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_EUGENE2: I think it’s fair to say {player} and I both share the role of “hero” [wave amp=30 freq=10]pretty[/wave] equally.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_MEREDITH2.n: Uh, what do you mean “ready for it”?
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]{player}, I think they are talking to you…[/wave]
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA2.m: No, I do not sense that you are a hero.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA3.n: Let us test your mettle [wave amp=30 freq=10]and[/wave] your metal!
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA2.f: No, I do not sense that you are a hero.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA3.m: Let us test your mettle [wave amp=30 freq=10]and[/wave] your metal!
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA2.n: No, I do not sense that you are a hero.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA3.f: Let us test your mettle [wave amp=30 freq=10]and[/wave] your metal!
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA5.m: My name is Lenna. C’mon hero, [shake rate=30 level=10]show me what you’ve got[/shake]!
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA6.m: OK, I admit defeat. Nice work, stranger.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA5.f: My name is Lenna. C’mon hero, [shake rate=30 level=10]show me what you’ve got[/shake]!
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA5.n: My name is Lenna. C’mon hero, [shake rate=30 level=10]show me what you’ve got[/shake]!
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA6.f: OK, I admit defeat. Nice work, stranger.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_KAYLEIGH7: Please don’t take this the wrong way, but you seemed [wave amp=30 freq=10]pretty[/wave] tough for a human. You’re not an… Archangel, are you?
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA6.n: OK, I admit defeat. Nice work, stranger.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_MEREDITH7: I don’t think human beings can fight [wave amp=30 freq=10]that[/wave] well. Spills the beans – you’re an Archangel, aren’t you?
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_EUGENE7: Hey, [pause]don’t play dumb with us – you’re an Archangel, right? No regular human is that strong!
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_FELIX7: I’m just going to come out and say it – you’re an Archangel, aren’t you? I got “Archangel” vibes from that fight just now.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_VIOLA7: I think you are not being truthful with us, “Lenna”.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA8: I am. Well, I used to be. I guess I still am. [pause]It’s a long story.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA9: I’m living as a human now, though.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA10: Why not? [pause]We’re not bound by our origins – it doesn’t matter who we [wave amp=30 freq=10]used[/wave] to be, it only matters who we choose to be in the present.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_MEREDITH16: Oh, OK. You’re just here on New Wirral for a brief visit, then?
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_MEREDITH11: Huh. I guess that checks out.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_KAYLEIGH11: Right! I’m [wave amp=30 freq=10]totally[/wave] with you on that!
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_EUGENE11: That makes sense. I can’t fault you for who you are.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA12: You wouldn’t believe it, but I’m actually a [wave amp=30 freq=10]school teacher[/wave]. My assignment here was to test you, and you just passed your examination with flying colours!
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_VIOLA11: Yes – I am inclined to agree.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA13: Oh, I forgot to ask you your name…
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA14.m: It was a pleasure sparring with you, {player}! You are certainly “hero” material.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA13_OPTION2: There are some who call me {player}.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA15: Well, I should go now. Ms. Amber promised me a ride home once I was done here, and I told Paige I wouldn’t be gone [wave amp=30 freq=10]too[/wave] long.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_KAYLEIGH18: A lot of interesting people seem to find their way to this island, don’t they?
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA14.n: It was a pleasure sparring with you, {player}! You are certainly “hero” material.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_LENNA14.f: It was a pleasure sparring with you, {player}! You are certainly “hero” material.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_KAYLEIGH16: Oh! Ms. Amber sure seems to know a lot of people, huh…?
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_EUGENE16: What?! You’re just here on New Wirral on an [wave amp=30 freq=10]errand[/wave]?
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_VIOLA16: I can see you long to return to your loved ones also! Do not let us keep you.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_FELIX16: You came to New Wirral purely on an assignment? That’s really something.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_MEREDITH18: Damn, I didn’t get time to ask her if those were real horns on her head or just her hair.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_FELIX18: There’s never a dull moment on this island, is there?
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_EUGENE18: I bet she thought I was “hero material” too… she just forgot to say it out loud.
messages.LENNA_ENCOUNTER_VIOLA18: Farewell, Lenna of the Unknown Realm.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_FLORIST1: Pardon me, but are you involved with the rangers?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_FLORIST2: OK! Wonderful! I’m a [wave amp=30 freq=10]fellow ranger[/wave] – well, a trainee at least. Perhaps you could lend me a hand?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_KAYLEIGH9: Yep! I’d say the town is looking a wee bit prettier now!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_FLORIST3: I’ve got some plant saplings grown by the Pipers over on their farm. They’re for prettying up the town.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_FLORIST4: However, I’m… not great at decision making. Which plants would look best? It’s too much!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_FLORIST5: Would you help a fellow ranger out and put some saplings in the planters I’ve left around town?
messages.HARBOURTOWN_FLORIST5_NO: That’s fine! No problem. Just… if you ever change your mind, you know where to find me!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_FLORIST11: There were so many choices to make that I was practically frozen!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_FLORIST7: There are 14 planters I’ve placed around town. Let me know when you’ve filled them all!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_MEREDITH9: Yeah, we successfully raised the town’s “twee” rating by a few points.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_EUGENE9.m: Yeah! I provided moral support, but {player} handled the dirty work.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_EUGENE9.n: Yeah! I provided moral support, but {player} handled the dirty work.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_EUGENE9.f: Yeah! I provided moral support, but {player} handled the dirty work.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_FELIX9: I think it’s fair to say that the town is looking a little nicer now.
messages.HARBOURTOWN_SUNNY9: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Job done! Harbourtown is cuter than ever…![/wave]
messages.HARBOURTOWN_FLORIST10: [shake rate=30 level=10]Thank you so much![/shake] There were so many choices to make that I was practically frozen! Here, take this in return for your help!
messages.HARBOURTOWN_VIOLA9: Indeed, the task is done - and the town is all the better for it.
messages.GAUNTLET_INTRO_MAGIKRAB1.m: Ah. {player} - just the human I was hoping to see! I have… an opportunity for you!
messages.GAUNTLET_INTRO_MAGIKRAB1.f: Ah. {player} - just the human I was hoping to see! I have… an opportunity for you!
messages.GAUNTLET_INTRO_MAGIKRAB2: You see, the Mer-Line does not exist solely under this island. Their trains pass through the many as-yet unactualised [wave amp=30 freq=10]potential[/wave] worlds as they journey endlessly through the Connected Human Cosmos!
messages.GAUNTLET_INTRO_MAGIKRAB1.n: Ah. {player} - just the human I was hoping to see! I have… an opportunity for you!
messages.GAUNTLET_INTRO_MAGIKRAB4: Despite such beings’ appearances as familiar-looking humans and monsters, they are not like anything you’ve met so far. As they exist only [wave amp=30 freq=10]in potential[/wave], they lack any true claim to reality or canon.
messages.GAUNTLET_INTRO_MAGIKRAB3: Of course, these [wave amp=30 freq=10]potential[/wave] worlds are populated by their own [wave amp=30 freq=10]potential[/wave] beings, and some try to hitch a ride aboard Their trains!
messages.GAUNTLET_INTRO_MAGIKRAB5: However, just as one’s potential may exceed one’s capability, these potential beings often far exceed the power of the real individuals that you have met.
messages.GAUNTLET_INTRO_MAGIKRAB6: Whilst this is of no concern to the magnificent Mer-Line, it is rather inconvenient to [wave amp=30 freq=10]me[/wave], as I would prefer to commute in peace.
messages.GAUNTLET_INTRO_MAGIKRAB7: My crystal eye tells me that the rangers are looking for more \"Fused Material\". Is this the case?
messages.GAUNTLET_INTRO_MAGIKRAB8: I shall make you a deal then: if you can clear out just a few train carriages of these [wave amp=30 freq=10]aggravating[/wave] potential beings, I will trade you some “Fused Material”. Do we have a deal?
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v1.f: Here’s a tip: if you get stuck on one carriage, I can shuffle the gauntlet for you - just exit the gauntlet and ask me! It’ll re-randomise your opponents, and change any modifiers in that carriage.
messages.GAUNTLET_INTRO_MAGIKRAB9: Excellent! If it helps, why not consider it [wave amp=30 freq=10]special training[/wave]? We’ll make it fun!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_GAME_OVER_MAGIKRAB1.m: Please do try to be careful, {player}!
messages.GAUNTLET_NEW_OPPONENTS_MAGIKRAB1: I can see in your eyes that you’ve encountered some new opponents. If you wish, I can shuffle the gauntlet to add your new foes into the mix!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_GAME_OVER_MAGIKRAB1.n: Please do try to be careful, {player}!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_GAME_OVER_MAGIKRAB1.f: Please do try to be careful, {player}!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_MAGIKRAB1: I’ve recorded your progress, {player}. If you decide to exit the gauntlet, you’ll be able to start from here next time!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_MAGIKRAB2: What can I do for you {player}?
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_MAGIKRAB2_OPTION2_NOTHING: I’m afraid there’s nothing to claim yet. You’ll need to win a few battles first!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_MAGIKRAB2_OPTION1_MAGIKRAB: If you have enough, I’ll take payment from your unclaimed rewards.

messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v2.m: Here’s a tip: pay attention to the modifiers that are active in the next carriage. Buff modifiers make your opponents stronger, and debuff modifiers make your party weaker. Always have a plan before charging into the next battle!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v2.n: Here’s a tip: pay attention to the modifiers that are active in the next carriage. Buff modifiers make your opponents stronger, and debuff modifiers make your party weaker. Always have a plan before charging into the next battle!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v1.n: Here’s a tip: if you get stuck on one carriage, I can shuffle the gauntlet for you - just exit the gauntlet and ask me! It’ll re-randomise your opponents, and change any modifiers in that carriage.
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v3.m: Here’s a tip: stock up on items! You never know what you might face in the next carriage, so it’s best not to be caught unprepared. Items like cures can help you work around bad modifiers too!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v5: Here’s a tip: winning consecutive battles without claiming rewards, or exiting the gauntlet, increases your streak. The higher your streak is, the higher the rewards you get for each battle. Try to get your streak as high as you can for the biggest payout!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v4: Here’s a tip: don’t forget to claim your rewards! If you are defeated, or you exit the gauntlet, any rewards you haven’t claimed will be permanently lost.
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v6: Here’s a tip: time is an engine that turns many potential futures to one actual present, the past is simply a memory of what the present was, and history is a story made up by human scholars. Take a break outside of time every once in a while! You humans get so wrapped up in it sometimes.
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v3.f: Here’s a tip: stock up on items! You never know what you might face in the next carriage, so it’s best not to be caught unprepared. Items like cures can help you work around bad modifiers too!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v3.n: Here’s a tip: stock up on items! You never know what you might face in the next carriage, so it’s best not to be caught unprepared. Items like cures can help you work around bad modifiers too!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v9: Here’s a tip: using rare and uncommon stickers can give you a significant edge over your opponents. Take a break from the gauntlet to spend your rewards on stickers if you need to.[pause] Oh,[pause] by the way,[pause] I’ve heard Ranger Wilma provides a new service to combine the best attributes of rare and uncommon stickers…
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v7: Here’s a tip: watch out for [img=38]res://ui/icons/map_markers/miniboss.png[/img] boss carriages. These are much harder than the ones that preceed them. It might take you a few tries to clear these!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v6: Here’s a tip: if you’re finding the gauntlet too easy, I can increase the difficulty for you - just exit the gauntlet and ask me! Winning battles on higher difficulties gives more rewards.
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v8: Here’s a tip: optimise your party. Sometimes selecting new tapes and stickers is all you need to do to win a battle you’ve been struggling with.
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v10: Here’s a tip: after carriage #50, the gauntlet cycles through the same pool of encounters again - with some new ones thrown into the mix - on a higher difficulty. Your human opponents will have more tapes, archangel opponents will have more moves, and more modifiers will be in effect at once!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v11: Here’s a tip: if you’ve met new opponents outside the gauntlet, ask me to shuffle the gauntlet to add these opponents into the mix!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v13.m: Here’s a tip: certain opponents can [i]only[/i] be found in the gauntlet. No, I won’t spoil who, or how many. You’ll just have to find out for yourself!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v12: Here’s a tip: go online and bring a friend with you into the gauntlet. You’ll have a lot more tapes at your disposal, which can make all the difference!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v2: Here’s a tip: this particular train you’re on right now is infinitely long. That means that - since the train’s engine is at the front - you’ll never reach the engine room!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v13.n: Here’s a tip: certain opponents can [i]only[/i] be found in the gauntlet. No, I won’t spoil who, or how many. You’ll just have to find out for yourself!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_HINT.v13.f: Here’s a tip: certain opponents can [i]only[/i] be found in the gauntlet. No, I won’t spoil who, or how many. You’ll just have to find out for yourself!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v1: Here’s a tip: watch out if your opponent starts to show signs of self-awareness. Potential beings self-actualising is dangerous, and can throw the canon off-kilter.
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v3: Here’s a tip: try to brush your teeth twice a day. Humans only get two sets of teeth, and most adult humans have already gone through one whole set. That means your remaining teeth have to last you the rest of your life!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v4.m: Here’s a tip: do you ever wonder if you’re real? This train is after all filled with beings who exist only in potential, so why should we assume that you and I are exceptions? Stop that train of thought. If you’re real it’s pointless, and if you’re not real, then asking that is dangerous.
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v4.f: Here’s a tip: do you ever wonder if you’re real? This train is after all filled with beings who exist only in potential, so why should we assume that you and I are exceptions? Stop that train of thought. If you’re real it’s pointless, and if you’re not real, then asking that is dangerous.
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v8.f: Here’s a tip: should an ‘archangel’ manifest in your world, {player}, when you go home, I would advise caution. Even well-intentioned advice from such an entity could cause unbelievable harm, simply because you humans are… [pause]wired differently.[pause] What? You [i]do[/i] have a tendency to worship things you don’t understand.
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v4.n: Here’s a tip: do you ever wonder if you’re real? This train is after all filled with beings who exist only in potential, so why should we assume that you and I are exceptions? Stop that train of thought. If you’re real it’s pointless, and if you’re not real, then asking that is dangerous.
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v5: Here’s a tip: the arrow of time only moves forward. Try not to dwell on past mistakes, and instead focus on making better decisions in future.
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v7: Here’s a tip: mankind is [i]barely[/i] in its infancy, so try not to dwell too much on the evil of others who have failed to learn their lessons. You’re a species of apes who live in tribes of billions, who largely live and work peacefully alongside each other! It’s true that nature has dealt you a second-class set of base instincts, but just look how far you’ve come!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v8.m: Here’s a tip: should an ‘archangel’ manifest in your world, {player}, when you go home, I would advise caution. Even well-intentioned advice from such an entity could cause unbelievable harm, simply because you humans are… [pause]wired differently.[pause] What? You [i]do[/i] have a tendency to worship things you don’t understand.
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v9: Here’s a tip: never give yourself over to an ‘archangel’. They may promise things, they may have power, glamour, and the appearance of authority, but they are just as deeply flawed as your own species. Even more flawed, in many cases.
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v8.n: Here’s a tip: should an ‘archangel’ manifest in your world, {player}, when you go home, I would advise caution. Even well-intentioned advice from such an entity could cause unbelievable harm, simply because you humans are… [pause]wired differently.[pause] What? You [i]do[/i] have a tendency to worship things you don’t understand.
messages.GAUNTLET_CULTIST_DEFAULT.v1: Our savior, [wave amp=30 freq=10]Brother Dorian Cooper[/wave], smiles upon me this day!
messages.GAUNTLET_CAFE_FLAVOR.v10: Here’s a tip: there will eventually come a day when your species’ ability to plan and create is needed to ensure the continued survival and diversity of life. It is true that the human presence on Earth is responsible for destruction, but your absence would guarantee [i]even more[/i]![pause] Eventually, I mean.
messages.GAUNTLET_CULTIST_QUESTION.v1.m: Shall we show this nonbeliever what true strength means?
messages.GAUNTLET_CULTIST_DEFAULT.v2: I will make the mournchildren proud!
messages.GAUNTLET_CULTIST_QUESTION.v1.f: Shall we show this nonbeliever what true strength means?
messages.GAUNTLET_CULTIST_QUESTION.v2.m: I propose that we show this [wave amp=30 freq=10]nonbeliever[/wave] the light of battle!
messages.GAUNTLET_CULTIST_ANSWER.v1: Your plan is righteous. [wave amp=30 freq=10]Praise Brother Cooper[/wave]!
messages.GAUNTLET_CULTIST_QUESTION.v1.n: Shall we show this nonbeliever what true strength means?
messages.GAUNTLET_CULTIST_QUESTION.v2.f: I propose that we show this [wave amp=30 freq=10]nonbeliever[/wave] the light of battle!
messages.GAUNTLET_CULTIST_QUESTION.v2.n: I propose that we show this [wave amp=30 freq=10]nonbeliever[/wave] the light of battle!
messages.GAUNTLET_CULTIST_ANSWER.v2: This is a fine plan indeed!
messages.GAUNTLET_LANDKEEPER_DEFAULT.v2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]I'm shorting your stocks - prepare for insolvency![/wave]
messages.GAUNTLET_LANDKEEPER_ANSWER.v1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]Very well... I shall invest in your strategy![/wave]
messages.GAUNTLET_LANDKEEPER_QUESTION.v1: [wave amp=30 freq=5]A strong offensive front is worth its weight in gold. What do you say?[/wave]
messages.GAUNTLET_LANDKEEPER_QUESTION.v2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]I suggest we invest in a full-frontal offense![/wave]
messages.GAUNTLET_LANDKEEPER_ANSWER.v2: [wave amp=30 freq=5]A sound business plan indeed...[/wave]
messages.GAUNTLET_RANGER_DEFAULT.v1: I'm here to make the rangers proud!
messages.GAUNTLET_KAYLEIGH_DEFAULT: I'm not the kind of girl who\'ll go down without a fight!
messages.GAUNTLET_RANGER_DEFAULT.v2: I'll give it all I\'ve got!
messages.GAUNTLET_RANGER_QUESTION.v2: I'm going to utilise the [wave amp=30 freq=5]chemistry system[/wave] to maximise our offensive power, OK?
messages.GAUNTLET_RANGER_QUESTION.v1: I'll use the battle strategies suggested by the ranger handbook, OK?
messages.GAUNTLET_ARISTOTLE_DEFAULT: Defeat is bitter, but its fruit is sweet. Learn well from your impending loss!
messages.GAUNTLET_RANGER_ANSWER.v1: Alright, let's go with your plan!
messages.GAUNTLET_DARWIN_DEFAULT: The strongest live and the weakest die - this is the order of all things!
messages.GAUNTLET_ARISTOTLE_QUESTION: To be a good leader you must be a good follower. Ergo, I shall follow your example in this fight!
messages.GAUNTLET_ARISTOTLE_ANSWER: I shall follow in your example!
messages.GAUNTLET_DARWIN_QUESTION: Those most adaptable to change are the ones who survive - thus our strategy must be [wave amp=30 freq=10]ever-changing[/wave]! Do you understand?
messages.GAUNTLET_DARWIN_ANSWER: I am not apt to follow blindly the lead of others, but in this case I'll make an exception.
messages.GAUNTLET_DECARTES_DEFAULT.m: Are you real? I suppose that all things I see are illusions... I believe that nothing has ever existed of everything my lying memory tells me.
messages.GAUNTLET_DECARTES_DEFAULT.n: Are you real? I suppose that all things I see are illusions... I believe that nothing has ever existed of everything my lying memory tells me.
messages.GAUNTLET_DECARTES_DEFAULT.f: Are you real? I suppose that all things I see are illusions... I believe that nothing has ever existed of everything my lying memory tells me.
messages.GAUNTLET_DECARTES_QUESTION: It is not enough to have a good mind - the main thing is to use it well! Come, let us out-think our opponents!
messages.GAUNTLET_DIOGENES_QUESTION: I shall fight alongside you - for what use in battle is a philosopher who doesn't hurt anybody?
messages.GAUNTLET_DECARTES_ANSWER: I have doubts in your plan - but doubt is the origin of wisdom.
messages.GAUNTLET_DIOGENES_DEFAULT: Battle? Conflict? No, no man is hurt but by himself!
messages.GAUNTLET_DIOGENES_ANSWER: I shall follow in your lead, for I know nothing! Nothing, except for the fact of my own ignorance.
messages.GAUNTLET_EPICURUS_DEFAULT: Justice is a kind of pact not to harm or be harmed. There is no justice here today.
messages.GAUNTLET_EPICURUS_ANSWER: Very well. Remember only that the art of living well and the art of dying well are one!
messages.GAUNTLET_EPICURUS_QUESTION.n: Courage is developed by surviving difficult times and challenging adversity - so find courage in yourself!
messages.GAUNTLET_EPICURUS_QUESTION.m: Courage is developed by surviving difficult times and challenging adversity - so find courage in yourself!
messages.GAUNTLET_EPICURUS_QUESTION.f: Courage is developed by surviving difficult times and challenging adversity - so find courage in yourself!
messages.GAUNTLET_KARL_QUESTION: Come, we have a world to win! Let's grasp victory by the root!
messages.GAUNTLET_KARL_DEFAULT: We have no compassion, and we ask no compassion from you.
messages.GAUNTLET_KARL_ANSWER: Agreed! Last words are for fools who haven't said enough!
messages.GAUNTLET_PLATO_QUESTION: Courage is knowing what not to fear - and we shall fight with courage!
messages.GAUNTLET_PLATO_DEFAULT: The measure of a man is what he does with power. Tell me, what have you done with yours?
messages.GAUNTLET_SOCRATES_DEFAULT: The only good is knowledge and the only evil is ignorance... remember this.
messages.GAUNTLET_SOCRATES_QUESTION: Every action has its pleasures and its price - remember this before every move you make!
messages.GAUNTLET_PLATO_ANSWER: Very well - let us fight to the death! For only the dead have seen the end of war.
messages.GAUNTLET_SOCRATES_ANSWER: I trust in your wisdom - and yet the only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
messages.GAUNTLET_ZHUANGZI_DEFAULT: Your life has a limit, but knowledge has none.
messages.GAUNTLET_ZHUANGZI_ANSWER: Great wisdom is generous, and petty wisdom is contentious.
messages.GAUNTLET_ZHUANGZI_QUESTION: Cease striving - then, there will be transformation.
messages.GAUNTLET_MISS_MIMIC_DEFAULT: YOU LOOK LIKE A TASTY SNACK.
messages.GAUNTLET_KAYLEIGH_QUESTION: These two look tough - I'll provide backup, so don\'t hold back, OK?
messages.GAUNTLET_MISS_MIMIC_QUESTION: [shake rate=30 level=10]YOU SHOULD LET ME DEVOUR THEM ONCE WE'RE DONE PLAYING WITH THEM![/shake]
messages.GAUNTLET_KAYLEIGH_PARTNER_REACTION: It's [wave amp=30 freq=5]another[/wave] me... at least my hair looks good from this angle!
messages.GAUNTLET_MEREDITH_QUESTION: Alright, I've got a strategy in mind. Here goes: we hit them harder than they hit us. What do you reckon?
messages.GAUNTLET_MEREDITH_DEFAULT: Oh, [shake rate=30 level=10]great[/shake]. What have I gotten myself into here?
messages.GAUNTLET_MEREDITH_PARTNER_REACTION: Well, this is an odd feeling. Time to face myself, I guess.
messages.GAUNTLET_MEREDITH_ANSWER: Urgh, we're going to lose, aren\'t we?
messages.GAUNTLET_EUGENE_DEFAULT: Another obstacle to knock down? [shake rate=30 level=10]Momentous![/shake]
messages.GAUNTLET_EUGENE_PARTNER_REACTION: Another me, huh? Or is it like, a future me? [pause]A past me? [pause]Who cares, he's going down!
messages.GAUNTLET_FELIX_QUESTION: Alright, I guess we gotta fight them. How about you take the lead on this one?
messages.GAUNTLET_FELIX_DEFAULT: What've I gotten myself into now?
messages.GAUNTLET_FELIX_ANSWER: Sure, let's go with your plan.
messages.GAUNTLET_FELIX_PARTNER_REACTION: This is getting weirder by the second...
messages.GAUNTLET_VIOLA_DEFAULT: There are more things in heaven and earth, my opponent, than are dreamt of in our philosophy.
messages.GAUNTLET_VIOLA_PARTNER_REACTION: To face oneself like this is a test of one's character... Come, let us fight shadows!
messages.GAUNTLET_VIOLA_QUESTION: Come, let us match our foes in number!
messages.GAUNTLET_CLEMENCE_DEFAULT: Bonjour! Have we met? Non... I think I'd remember a face like yours!
messages.GAUNTLET_CLEMENCE_QUESTION: Shall we show our [wave amp=30 freq=10]guests[/wave] a good time?
messages.GAUNTLET_CLEMENCE_ANSWER: A fine plan! Now, let us see if we can see it through, oui?
messages.GAUNTLET_DORIAN_QUESTION: OK, I've [shake rate=30 level=10]formed a plan[/shake]! You distract our enemies so they don\'t try and hit [shake rate=30 level=10]me[/shake], and I\'ll figure something out along the way! What do you think?
messages.GAUNTLET_DORIAN_DEFAULT: You look like you don't want to talk this one out, do you? Too bad!
messages.GAUNTLET_DORIAN_KAYLEIGH_REACTION: Urgh. It's like seeing a ghost...
messages.GAUNTLET_DORIAN_ANSWER: Sure, why not! Let's rock and roll, [shake rate=30 level=10]baby![/shake]
messages.GAUNTLET_HOYLAKE_DEFAULT: Monster transformation... how grotesque! It pains me to stoop to such barbarism…
messages.GAUNTLET_FRANKIE_QUESTION: Alright, [wave amp=30 freq=10]partner[/wave]! I'll take charge and you assist me - we\'ll win, no problem!
messages.GAUNTLET_FRANKIE_DEFAULT: [wave amp=30 freq=10]What's going on[/wave]? Maybe I shouldn\'t overthink it - time for an [shake rate=30 level=10]awesome fight[/shake]!
messages.GAUNTLET_FRANKIE_ANSWER: Gotcha! Oh man, I'm [shake rate=30 level=10]so excited[/shake]!
messages.GAUNTLET_HOYLAKE_ANSWER: A fine strategy indeed! Come, let us show our opponents a sportly bout of combat!
messages.GAUNTLET_HOYLAKE_QUESTION: Analyse their approach, hypothesise a counter-strategy and strike without hesitation! What do you say, chum?
messages.GAUNTLET_JACQUELINE_DEFAULT: You will go [shake rate=30 level=10]no[/shake] further than this!
messages.GAUNTLET_KIRBY_DEFAULT: This will make for a rather peculiar experiment!
messages.GAUNTLET_JACQUELINE_QUESTION: Show these interlopers no mercy, understand?!
messages.GAUNTLET_JACQUELINE_ANSWER: Understood. Don't let them out of our sights!
messages.GAUNTLET_KIRBY_QUESTION: I am going to analyse our foe's strategies and devise a cunning plan. Please attack them at full strength, if possible.
messages.GAUNTLET_MERCHANT_DEFAULT: Where am I [wave amp=30 freq=5]this[/wave] time? I suppose it doesn't matter!
messages.GAUNTLET_KIRBY_ANSWER: A fine plan. Now, shall we begin the experiment?
messages.GAUNTLET_PENSBY_QUESTION: I am not much of a fighter but I can back you up with healing techniques, if that's alright!
messages.GAUNTLET_MERCHANT_QUESTION: I don't really know [wave amp=30 freq=10]what\'s[/wave] going on - why don\'t you take the lead here, partner?
messages.GAUNTLET_MERCHANT_ANSWER: Sure thing! By the way, do you have a spare shirt? It's getting a little chilly.
messages.GAUNTLET_PENSBY_DEFAULT: This probably violates the Hippocratic Oath, but I'll make an exception just this once.
messages.GAUNTLET_SUNNY_DEFAULT: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I'm sorry, but I have to stop you right now.[/wave]
messages.GAUNTLET_PENSBY_ANSWER: Well, I don't have a [wave amp=30 freq=10]better[/wave] plan!
messages.GAUNTLET_SUNNY_QUESTION: [wave amp=20 freq=5]We need to move perfectly in sync if we are to win this...[/wave]
messages.GAUNTLET_VIN_QUESTION: Let's hit them with a [shake rate=30 level=10]killing blow[/shake]!
messages.GAUNTLET_VIN_DEFAULT: Face me, coward! [shake rate=30 level=10]Don't hold back[/shake]!
messages.GAUNTLET_KUNEKO_DEFAULT: Light and darkness unite, forming a pleasant shade! [pause]The battle for good and evil [wave amp=30 freq=10]commences[/wave]!
messages.GAUNTLET_VIN_ANSWER: I'll follow your lead. [shake rate=30 level=10]Let\'s crush them[/shake]!
messages.GAUNTLET_KUNEKO_QUESTION: Let's show these villains the [wave amp=30 freq=10]unstoppable power of co-operation[/wave]!
messages.GAUNTLET_BUFFY_DEFAULT: How's your form? If we\'re fighting, try not to pull a muscle, OK?
messages.GAUNTLET_KUNEKO_ANSWER: Gotcha! Let's fan them with the [wave amp=30 freq=10]winds of battle[/wave]!
messages.GAUNTLET_CODEY_QUESTION: I'm turning off my [wave amp=30 freq=10]power limiters[/wave] and going all out - OK?
messages.GAUNTLET_BUFFY_ANSWER: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Let's do it[/wave]! I\'m hoping for a heavy workout!
messages.GAUNTLET_BUFFY_QUESTION: Here's my plan - I [wave amp=30 freq=10]tire them out[/wave], and you finish them off! What do you think?
messages.GAUNTLET_CLEEO_QUESTION: [color=#e3affe][shake rate=30 level=10]I'm gonna take these punks out myself - you do what you want,OK?[/shake][/color]
messages.GAUNTLET_CODEY_DEFAULT: A new foe, huh? Setting my power to [shake rate=30 level=10]MAXIMUM![/shake]
messages.GAUNTLET_CODEY_ANSWER: So the plan is \"win the fight\"? Yeah, I can handle that.
messages.GAUNTLET_DREADFUL_DEFAULT: Ooh, I've drifted [wave amp=30 freq=5]right[/wave] off course in the astral planes and missed my stop... where am I now, I wonder?
messages.GAUNTLET_CYBIL_DEFAULT: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Hey-hey[/wave]! You're listening to Cybil Radio: broadcasting live from somewhere outside of [wave amp=30 freq=10]space and time![/wave]
messages.GAUNTLET_CYBIL_QUESTION: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Hey-hey[/wave]! Why don't we show our special guests what we can do on the battlefield?
messages.GAUNTLET_CYBIL_ANSWER: I hear you loud and clear! Let's [wave amp=30 freq=10]party[/wave]!
messages.GAUNTLET_DREADFUL_QUESTION: [shake rate=30 level=10]Flamin' Nora[/shake], we\'ve got our work cut out for us alright! I suggest we just go right in for a proper scrap - what do you reckon?
messages.GAUNTLET_GLADIOLA_DEFAULT: No matter [wave amp=30 freq=10]when[/wave] or [wave amp=30 freq=10]where[/wave] I am, I'll always stand firm against the shadows! [pause]Come, face me!
messages.GAUNTLET_GLADIOLA_QUESTION: Our foe is unknowable - [pause]strike without hesitation, do you understand?
messages.GAUNTLET_HEATHER_DEFAULT: [wave amp=30 freq=10]This is Heather, with the weather[/wave]! [pause]Today’s forecast: I'm... not sure…
messages.GAUNTLET_GLADIOLA_ANSWER: Copy that. Let our enemies [shake rate=30 level=10]face my blades[/shake]!
messages.GAUNTLET_HEATHER_ANSWER: Good plan! Let's [wave amp=30 freq=10]bring the thunder![/wave]
messages.GAUNTLET_HEATHER_QUESTION: OK, here's the plan! I [wave amp=30 freq=10]rock[/wave] them like a hurricane, and you follow up with [wave amp=30 freq=10]heavy[/wave] turbulence! What do you think?
messages.GAUNTLET_JUDAS_DEFAULT: I have the targets in my sights…
messages.GAUNTLET_JUDAS_QUESTION: Listen here, rookie - I'll target their vital organs while you run recon. Do you copy?
messages.GAUNTLET_LODESTEIN_DEFAULT: I'm pretty [wave amp=30 freq=10]charged[/wave] up for a fight - shall we start?
messages.GAUNTLET_LODESTEIN_QUESTION: Here's the plan - I\'ll [wave amp=30 freq=10]charge[/wave] in with lightning attacks, and you follow up the rear with more hits. What do you think?
messages.GAUNTLET_LODESTEIN_ANSWER: Roger that - let's give \'em a shock or two!
messages.GAUNTLET_SKIP_DEFAULT: It's time to [shake rate=30 level=10]take out the trash![/shake]
messages.GAUNTLET_SKIP_QUESTION: I got a strategy! We [wave amp=30 freq=10]take them out[/wave] like the [wave amp=30 freq=10]trash[/wave] they are! What do you say?
messages.GAUNTLET_WALLACE_DEFAULT: I have time in my day for some [wave amp=30 freq=10]unscheduled demolitions[/wave] - right, who's first?
messages.GAUNTLET_SKIP_ANSWER: Good plan - let's [wave amp=30 freq=10]take out the trash[/wave]!
messages.GAUNTLET_WALLACE_QUESTION: I'm gonna [wave amp=30 freq=10]bring their walls down[/wave] - then you hit \'em, alright?
messages.GAUNTLET_WALLACE_ANSWER: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Alright[/wave]! Let's show \'em what we\'re made of!
messages.GAUNTLET_ZEDD_DEFAULT: I just woke up... are we fighting, or something?
messages.GAUNTLET_ZEDD_QUESTION: I'm pretty tired. I might just doze off and let you take the lead, OK?
messages.GAUNTLET_CLOWN_DEFAULT: ILLUSIONS, ILLUSIONS! AH, WE'RE ALL ILLUSIONS ON OUR OWN WAY, AREN\'T WE?
messages.GAUNTLET_IANTHE_IANTHE1: I don't know [wave amp=30 freq=10]who[/wave] you are... [pause]but if you think you can take us on, you might want to reconsider.
messages.GAUNTLET_ZEDD_ANSWER: Uh, yeah, sure. Let's go with your plan.
messages.GAUNTLET_IANTHE_WILMA2: I think we might have to show them we mean [wave amp=30 freq=10]business[/wave], dear!
messages.GAUNTLET_ALEPH_DEFAULT: HAVE WE MET BEFORE? I DON'T THINK SO... AND YET YOUR FACE SEEMS SO FAMILIAR. CURIOUS.
messages.GAUNTLET_ALEPH_QUESTION: THIS ONE LOOKS FRAIL. BE A DARLING AND KILL THEM FOR ME QUICK, WOULD YOU?
messages.GAUNTLET_ALEPH_ANSWER: YOU CAN DO WHAT YOU LIKE - I'M JUST GOING TO KILL THEM AND GET ON OUT OF HERE.
messages.GAUNTLET_ALICE_DEFAULT: WE'RE ALL MAD HERE. I\'M MAD. YOU\'RE MAD. IF WE WEREN\'T, WE WOULDN\'T BE HERE, WOULD WE?
messages.GAUNTLET_ALICE_QUESTION: CURIOUSER AND CURIOUSER! A BUG STANDS IN OUR WAY. PERHAPS I SHOULD CRUSH IT?
messages.GAUNTLET_ALICE_ANSWER: I ACCEPT YOUR PLAN! OFF WITH THEIR HEADS!
messages.GAUNTLET_HELIA_QUESTION: LET THESE TWO FEEL THE LIGHT OF THE SUN UPON THEM.
messages.GAUNTLET_CUBE_DEFAULT: THE IMPERFECT ANGLE IN ALL THINGS. I PERCEIVE IT WITHIN YOU, TOO. IT IS AN ABOMINATION.
messages.GAUNTLET_CLOWN_QUESTION: I'LL MAKE \'EM LAUGH, AND THEN YOU MAKE \'EM CRY, DO YOU FOLLOW?
messages.GAUNTLET_CLOWN_ANSWER: A WONDERFUL PLAN! LET'S PUT SOME SMILES ON THEIR FACES!
messages.GAUNTLET_CUBE_QUESTION: RIGHT THEIR WRONG ANGLES, RIGHT THEIR WRONG ANGLES, RIGHT THEIR WRONG ANGLES!
messages.GAUNTLET_CUBE_ANSWER: YES. LET US FIX THEIR IMPERFECTIONS.
messages.GAUNTLET_HELIA_DEFAULT.m: WHEREVER THERE IS FUSION, I AM FOUND. SHALL WE FIGHT, {player.to_upper}?
messages.GAUNTLET_HELIA_DEFAULT.f: WHEREVER THERE IS FUSION, I AM FOUND. SHALL WE FIGHT, {player.to_upper}?
messages.GAUNTLET_HELIA_DEFAULT.n: WHEREVER THERE IS FUSION, I AM FOUND. SHALL WE FIGHT, {player.to_upper}?
messages.GAUNTLET_LAMENTO_MORI_DEFAULT: DARE YOU QUESTION YOUR OWN MORTALITY? \nDARE YOU COMPREHEND HOW FRAGILE YOU ARE?\nNO, YOU ARE AFRAID.
messages.GAUNTLET_LENNA_DEFAULT: What world seed is this? What timeline? [pause]I guess it doesn't matter - if a foe stands before me, I fight!
messages.GAUNTLET_LAMENTO_MORI_ANSWER: YES! LET US SHOW THEM A TRUE DEATH!
messages.GAUNTLET_LAMENTO_MORI_QUESTION: LET US INSTILL THE OFT-FORGOTTEN FEAR OF DEATH IN THESE MORTALS.
messages.GAUNTLET_LENNA_ANSWER: I hear you - come, let us clash swords!
messages.GAUNTLET_LENNA_PAIGE_LENNA1: It's been a while since we fought together - are you sure you\'re up for it, Paige?
messages.GAUNTLET_LENNA_QUESTION: Everyone has a weak point - we just need to strike it at the right moment - understand?
messages.GAUNTLET_LENNA_PAIGE_PAIGE2: Aww, don't worry about me! Besides, I want to try out this [wave amp=30 freq=10]curious cassette player[/wave] you\'ve been talking about!
messages.GAUNTLET_SHADOW_LENNA_DEFAULT: Am I destined to be just an obstacle to overcome, no matter when and where I am? [pause]Nah, I don't think so!
messages.GAUNTLET_SHADOW_LENNA_QUESTION: Unbound from fate, from time, from everything. Who [shake rate=30 level=10]cares[/shake] where we are? Why not have some [shake rate=30 level=10]fun[/shake]?!
messages.GAUNTLET_MAMMON_DEFAULT: I can read your heart. You wish to progress, to expand. I am in your way.
messages.GAUNTLET_SHADOW_LENNA_DELVIN_DELVIN2: Very well - let's show these two a true [shake rate=30 level=10]game over[/shake]!
messages.GAUNTLET_SHADOW_LENNA_DELVIN_SHADOW_LENN: Unbound from fate, from time, from everything. Who [shake rate=30 level=10]cares[/shake] where we are? Why not have some [shake rate=30 level=10]fun[/shake]?!
messages.GAUNTLET_SHADOW_LENNA_ANSWER: Sure, why not? Let's have some [shake rate=30 level=10]fun[/shake]!
messages.GAUNTLET_MAMMON_QUESTION.n: This human wishes to progress. We stand in their way. Therefore it is our role here to stop them with force.
messages.GAUNTLET_MAMMON_QUESTION.m: This human wishes to progress. We stand in their way. Therefore it is our role here to stop them with force.
messages.GAUNTLET_MAMMON_QUESTION.f: This human wishes to progress. We stand in their way. Therefore it is our role here to stop them with force.
messages.GAUNTLET_MAMMON_ANSWER: I agree to your strategem. Let us see if our enemies can overcome it.
messages.GAUNTLET_MORGANTE_DEFAULT: WHETHER YOU COME FOR ME SWORD IN HAND, OR INSTEAD WIELDING A CASSETTE PLAYER, YOU HUMANS NEVER CHANGE.
messages.GAUNTLET_MAMMON_EUGENE_REACTION: A rematch, huh? [shake rate=30 level=10]Bring it on![/shake]
messages.GAUNTLET_MORGANTE_QUESTION: I DON'T NEED THE AID OF ANOTHER TO UNLEASH THE TRUE POWER OF REBELLION. STAND BACK.
messages.GAUNTLET_PUPPET_DEFAULT: ARE YOU MY PUPPETS? NO, JUST SOME LOST HUMANS. \nPERHAPS I'LL PLAY WITH YOU ANYWAY.
messages.GAUNTLET_MOURNINGSTAR_DEFAULT: ARE YOU HERE TO BURN FOR ME?
messages.GAUNTLET_MOURNINGSTAR_ANSWER: VERY WELL. MAY THESE HUMANS SEE THE LIGHT.
messages.GAUNTLET_MOURNINGSTAR_QUESTION: LET US BURN THEM IN HEAVENLY LIGHT.
messages.GAUNTLET_MONARCH_DEFAULT: COME, LET ME CONSUME YOUR EMPTY SOULS.
messages.GAUNTLET_ROBIN_QUESTION: I SHALL BRING AN OPERA HOUSE OF NIGHT HAUNTS TO OUR EAGER AUDIENCE - WHAT SAY YOU?
messages.GAUNTLET_ROBIN_DEFAULT: UP AND DOWN, UP AND DOWN.\nI AM FEARED IN FIELD AND TOWN!
messages.GAUNTLET_MAGIKRAB_POSTBATTLE_MAGIKRAB1: Whew, that was [wave amp=30 freq=10]quite[/wave] the workout for my little old carapace.
messages.GAUNTLET_ROBIN_ANSWER: VERY WELL! LET THE SHOW BEGIN!
messages.GAUNTLET_TOWER_DEFAULT: MY TRUTH IS SUPERIOR TO YOUR TRUTH! EMBRACE IT!
messages.GAUNTLET_TOWER_QUESTION: LET US ILLUMINATE THESE HUMANS WITH THE LIGHT OF IGNORANCE!
messages.GAUNTLET_MAGIKRAB_PREBATTLE_MAGIKRAB2: But now is my turn to take part in the fun!
messages.GAUNTLET_MAGIKRAB_PREBATTLE_MAGIKRAB1: The Mer-Line and I have observed your progress through the gauntlet with great pleasure.
messages.GAUNTLET_MAGIKRAB_PREBATTLE_MAGIKRAB3: Defeat me if you can, {player}. And don’t hold back - the Mer-Line lends me Their power!
messages.GAUNTLET_MAGIKRAB_POSTBATTLE_MAGIKRAB3: It was getting a bit small for me, but you can have it! I’ve already moved into a larger one. What do you think?
messages.GAUNTLET_MAGIKRAB_POSTBATTLE_MAGIKRAB4: Your opponents from here on will only get stronger. I follow your progress with great anticipation!
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_MEREDITH1: Our opponent this time is a… Traffikrab?
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_KAYLEIGH1: Our opponent this time is a… Traffikrab?
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_FELIX1: Our opponent this time is a… Traffikrab?
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_EUGENE1: Our opponent this time is a… Traffikrab?
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_VIOLA1: Our opponent this time is a… Traffikrab?
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB9.n: [shake rate=30 level=10]You created a monster![pause] Today, the creation destroys its creator!
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB4: [shake rate=30 level=10]Do you remember me - the [wave amp=30 freq=10]lowly[/wave] Traffikrab you so cruelly crushed into the sand on your first day in New Wirral?
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_PREBATTLE_JAY1.f: Thanks for playing our game! Have you enjoyed it?
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB5.m: [shake rate=30 level=10]In the moment we made contact, your shadow - all the worst parts of you that you deny exist - imprinted upon me and gave me mind.
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB5.f: [shake rate=30 level=10]In the moment we made contact, your shadow - all the worst parts of you that you deny exist - imprinted upon me and gave me mind.
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB6.m: [shake rate=30 level=10]For a while, I followed behind you, watching from the shadows of Harbourtown as you and your co-conspirators plotted to destroy all monsterkind. Since then, I’ve been training in preparation for this moment, our final confrontation!
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB5.n: [shake rate=30 level=10]In the moment we made contact, your shadow - all the worst parts of you that you deny exist - imprinted upon me and gave me mind.
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB9.m: [shake rate=30 level=10]You created a monster![pause] Today, the creation destroys its creator!
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB6.f: [shake rate=30 level=10]For a while, I followed behind you, watching from the shadows of Harbourtown as you and your co-conspirators plotted to destroy all monsterkind. Since then, I’ve been training in preparation for this moment, our final confrontation!
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB6.n: [shake rate=30 level=10]For a while, I followed behind you, watching from the shadows of Harbourtown as you and your co-conspirators plotted to destroy all monsterkind. Since then, I’ve been training in preparation for this moment, our final confrontation!
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB8: [shake rate=30 level=10]My strategy?[pause] [wave amp=30 freq=10]It’s simple![pause] Indiscriminate slaughter without mercy!
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB7: [shake rate=30 level=10]I’ve travelled all over New Wirral, and to several other worlds beyond. I’ve fought all manner of beasts, archangels, and humans - my kills number in the [wave amp=30 freq=10]millions[/wave]!
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB9.f: [shake rate=30 level=10]You created a monster![pause] Today, the creation destroys its creator!
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB10: [shake rate=30 level=10]The Red King lends me his power![/shake]
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB12: [shake rate=30 level=10]I may only exist in potential, but I know that the rage in my heart is real![/shake]
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB11: [shake rate=30 level=10]I’ve studied your tactics, {player}. Don’t think I’ll be so easily overcome this time!
messages.GAUNTLET_ROGUE_TRAFFIKRAB_TRAFFIKRAB13: [shake rate=30 level=10]I [wave amp=30 freq=10]will[/wave] kill you, {player}, just not today…
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_PREBATTLE_JAY1.n: Thanks for playing our game! Have you enjoyed it?
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_PREBATTLE_JAY1.m: Thanks for playing our game! Have you enjoyed it?
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_PREBATTLE_JAY1_OPTION3: Wait, why can’t I say no?
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_PREBATTLE_JAY2: Rad! Go leave us a review, it helps a ton! Resume this dialogue when you’re done for a surprise.
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_PREBATTLE_TOM3: Great, now prepare for your enjoyment to be ruined - I’ve added bugs and hacked moves just for this battle. I hope you weren’t expecting a fair fight!
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_PREBATTLE_JOEL4: Let’s get some sick tunes going!
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_PREFUSION_JAY2: We work best when we’re working together…
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_PREFUSION_JOEL3: God this music is annoying. Let’s change it up!
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_POSTFUSION_BYTTEN1: EVERY MOMENT OF FRUSTRATION,[pause] EVERY INCONVENIENCE,[pause] IT’S ALL INTENTIONAL!\n\nWE’RE HERE TO RUIN YOUR FUN!
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_ANGELIC_ATTACK_BYTTEN1: WE HAVEN’T TESTED THIS NEXT MOVE YET.\n\nLET’S SEE HOW IT GOES!
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_SUNNY1_OPTION1: Sunny! I didn’t expect to see you here!
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_DEFEAT_BYTTEN1:
W-WHAT!?[pause]

UH,[pause] WE MEAN,[pause] WELL DONE!
YOU PASSED OUR TEST!
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY1.f: [wave amp=20 freq=5]{player}, you came! Thank you…[/wave]
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_POSTBATTLE_TOM1: Don’t let it go to your head - everything that just happened was completely according to our plan.
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_POSTBATTLE_TOM3: Actually…[pause] lemme just raise it for you.
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_POSTBATTLE_TOM2: By the way, if you continue with the gauntlet from here, your opponents will hit the level cap.
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_POSTBATTLE_TOM5: Don’t forget about the level scaling setting if combat outside of the gauntlet gets too easy!
messages.GAUNTLET_BYTTEN_POSTBATTLE_TOM4: There we go! Now the cap’s at 999, and you can keep playing.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v1: If you see something, it’s probably not there. See it. Slay it. Thwarted.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v3: Help us stop the spread of psychic contagion. Mind sanitiser dispensers can be found at every exit.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v2: Please keep your belongings with you at all times. Any baggage left unattended will be treated to a nice dinner.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v4: Calling at: Crewe, Elmwich, Jekyll & Hyde Park, ?????, Camberlot, Ur-Wirral, Anywhere, Nowhere, AAAAAAAAAA-
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v5: Due to especially busy services at our next stop, our arrival into Crewe has been delayed by approximately 12,361 years.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v7: If a countably infinite number of elderly, disabled, or pregnant passengers board the train, please make your seat available to them by moving to the seat numbered twice that of your current seat.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v6: Our next stop is: Crewe. If you intend to disembark here, please respect local custom and assume human form.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v9: In the event of unplanned depressurisation, oxygen masks will be automatically provided. If you require Sulphur Dioxide, please communicate telepathically with a member of staff.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v8: If the train makes an unexpected stop at a dead world DO NOT DISEMBARK. Keep all arms, legs, and other limbs within the vehicle until the train has begun to move again.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v10: In the event of an emergency, activate the emergency alarm:\n(1) Lift the flap; (2) Pull the lever; (3) Await death.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v11: Please avoid eye contact with other passengers. Do not attempt communication. Violation of this rule is punishable with time loop imprisonment, and a £2000 fine.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v12: If you are feeling unwell, please communicate telepathically with a member of staff, who will assist you to the nearest quarantine world.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v13: By riding this train, you agree to the collection of your intrapersonal data.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v15: CTCTV is in operation in this carriage. For your security, closed timelike curves may be monitored for the purpose of causal violation prevention.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v14: Beware: pickpockets and potential beings operate in this train. Keep your actuality safely with you at all times.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v17: Please refrain from questioning your existence while aboard this train.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v16: Smoking is not permitted on this train. Spontaneous combustion is punishable with a £2000 fine.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v21: Mirrors must be kept covered at all times while on this train.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v18: If you see a shadowy red-eyed doppelganger of yourself, report it to a member of staff IMMEDIATELY.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v19: Due to the increasing scale of the ########, this service will be diverted via Crewe station. We apologise for the unpleasantness that this will no doubt cause passengers.
messages.GAUNTLET_TRAIN_ANNOUNCEMENT.v20: Tulpas must be kept on a leash at all times.
messages.RANGER_TRADER_STICKER_FUSION2: You’re already a dab hand at monster fusion, so how would you like to [wave amp=30 freq=10]fuse your stickers[/wave] as well?
messages.RANGER_TRADER_STICKER_FUSION1: Hello sweetie, I’m providing a new service today that you might be interested in.
messages.RANGER_TRADER_STICKER_FUSION3: You choose one sticker to take the main effect from, and a second sticker to take extra rare and uncommon attributes from. The two stickers get combined to produce one with the best bits of both!
messages.RANGER_TRADER_STICKER_FUSION4: Sticker fusion is permanent, so you won’t get the original stickers back. But, if you choose well, fused stickers can turn even the weakest tape into an unstoppable beast!
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]There’s something I need to do, {player}... [pause]to tie up loose ends…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]There’s something about being a “Landkeeper” that I didn’t tell you…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The “Mammon” beast that gave us orders… it was connected to us, and we were all connected to each other… like invisible telephone wire…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]But the Archangel… Mammon… is gone now. I don’t hear its orders in my head anymore. [pause]But I can still hear the thoughts of the other Landkeepers…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_EUGENE6: I think I get you. You had a network that linked you all, and that link is still there, even though you aren’t [wave amp=20 freq=5]one of them[/wave] anymore.
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_MEREDITH6: You lot are all connected? Like a telepathic link or something? Alright, I’m following you so far.
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_FELIX6: Oh, so you and the other Landkeepers have some sort of telepathetic connection?
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_SUNNY7: [wave amp=20 freq=5]{player}... the others - [pause]the Landkeepers - [pause]are planning something. [pause]They don’t have a reason to continue being Landkeepers, but don’t know how to change…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_SUNNY8: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Their voices are discussing Mt. Wirral… I think they’re organising up there. [pause]I need to find out what they are planning… {player}, can you meet me there?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_MEREDITH9: OK. [pause]I suppose we should probably help the zombie girl out, right?
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_KAYLEIGH9: I’m glad that Sunny is striking out on her own. Good for her!
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_EUGENE9: Alright, let’s help out Sunny! She’s really changed a lot, huh?
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_VIOLA9: I hope our friend Sunny is well. Perhaps our aid would be welcome?
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_INTRO_FELIX9: Helping her out sounds like it might be interesting, right?
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY1.m: [wave amp=20 freq=5]{player}, you came! Thank you…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_LK2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Oh, you brought some customers along? What a curious investment you have made…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY1.n: [wave amp=20 freq=5]{player}, you came! Thank you…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]And you don’t need to act this way anymore… you’re free now. [pause]We’re ALL free now...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]No… you don’t understand! People aren’t “investments”… [pause]People are people...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I don’t know what you’re planning, but we can all choose to be whatever we want to be, instead of being “Landkeepers”![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_EUGENE6: That’s the spirit, Sunny! You’re totally right.
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_VIOLA6: You’ve really found your own resolve, dear Sunny!
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY9: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I won’t stay on the sidelines, {player}... This is my fight, too![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_LK8: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Why don’t we give you a CRASH COURSE in economics…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_LK7: [wave amp=20 freq=5]You’ve lost your enterprising spirit, Landkeeper![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_LK10: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Hngh… we’re done here. [pause]It’s time that we clocked out - we have places to be…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_VIOLA11: A wonderful performance from our dear Sunny!
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_EUGENE11: That was [shake rate=30 level=10]awesome[/shake], Sunny! You really kicked some ass, there!
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_PLAYER12_OPTION2: Where’d you get that monster tape?
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY13: [wave amp=20 freq=5]It was a gift from Ianthe, once I told her about my plan to confront the Landkeepers…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The wheel… [pause]it really is just a big wheel… I don’t understand…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY15: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Wuh…? “The wheel beneath the old headquarters”... [pause]What does that mean…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY14: [wave amp=20 freq=5]They were having meetings out here… there must be some clue about what they’re doing…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY16: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Oh! The old headquarters in the marsh… There’s something underneath it![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY17: [wave amp=20 freq=5]{player}... please go with me to the Landkeeper’s old base that you and Eugene destroyed… I think the Landkeepers are there…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY18: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I have to do this… I have to stop them, and put that life behind me once and for all…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART1_SUNNY19: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Truth be told, I’m kind of… excited…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART2_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Wuh…? This door has some sort of device on it. Is it to prevent intruders? Let me see...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART2_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I think we should go deeper…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART2_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]It seems to think I’m a Landkeeper! Let’s go inside, {player}.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART2_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The remaining Landkeepers are all here… They must be here for a reason. [pause]Something about a “wheel”...?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_NPC1_PREBATTLE: [wave amp=20 freq=5]You - [pause]Landkeeper - [pause]you aren’t wearing the correct uniform! I’m reporting you to HR![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_NPC1_POSTBATTLE: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Maybe you’re wearing standard work attire after all…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_NPC2_PREBATTLE: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Are you here to stop our plans for corporate expansion? I DESPISE whistleblowers![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_NPC3_PREBATTLE: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The wheel provides such an exciting opportunity for our business ventures! I think our stock value is about to go up![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_NPC4_PREBATTLE: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Are you here doing some corporate espionage right now? That’s against company policy![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART2C_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The voices… the Landkeepers are excited about something up ahead… I can FEEL them…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_NPC4_POSTBATTLE: [wave amp=20 freq=5]It’s… still against company policy…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_LK2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Isn’t it beautiful? Behold: The future of the Landkeeper’s Association… the Wheel![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_LK3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]When our previous CEO was… [pause]displaced… [pause]the Landkeeper HQ collapsed into the depths of the island, along with many of us employees…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_LK4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]But down here in the dark, we found it. A new opportunity for us all…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_LK4_OPTION2: What use do you have for this?
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_LK5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The wheel is a forgotten part of a greater whole, something of great power that lies beneath this island… [pause]a power that weaves through many worlds…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_LK5_OPTION2: So it’s from one of the Mer-Line’s trains?
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY6: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The “link” between Landkeepers that connects us… could this wheel extend that…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY8: [wave amp=20 freq=5]We are vessels, created to serve by the Archangel Mammon, [pause]are we not…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_LK7: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Tell me, ex-colleague - [pause]do you know what we Landkeepers REALLY are?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_LK9: [wave amp=20 freq=5]No… an Archangel cannot “create” things! It can only take, and reshape… The wheel will show you your truth![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY10: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Then… where did we come from…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_LK11: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The wheel can connect us to other times, other places… other Landkeepers. [pause]With it… we can establish communication… arrange mergers…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY12: [wave amp=20 freq=5]{player}, they mean to reach out to other worlds and bring new Landkeepers here![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_LK13: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Yes! [pause]We’re expanding our business operations! [pause]Mass recruitment! Aggressive expansion![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY14: [wave amp=20 freq=5]No you won’t! I won’t let you![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_LK15: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I AM RECRUITING REINFORCEMENTS FROM ACROSS THE COSMOS![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY26_OPTION2: This might be bad for you…
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_LK17: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Ah yes, a brazen bull to defend our capital… [pause]How fitting! This will do nicely![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY20: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I won’t let anyone tell me what I have to be…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY21: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I only have to be ME![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY23: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The wheel can show me my “truth”...? What did he mean…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY24: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Just what AM I, exactly…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY25: [wave amp=10 freq=5]I see… [pause]the threads… connecting us, so close to my fingers I can almost grasp them…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY26: [wave amp=10 freq=5]I saw her, for a moment… Was that me? Was that who I was?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY27: [wave amp=10 freq=5]I’m so close… I just have to go further…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY29: [wave amp=10 freq=5]She focused so much on her work that she lost herself. She was miserable…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY28: [wave amp=10 freq=5]This body… my body was someone else, once. She had her own life, but it was not her own…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY30: [wave amp=10 freq=5]It made her an easy target for Mammon. She was taken... taken, and made into a vessel.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY32: [wave amp=10 freq=5]There has to be more… more meaning, more answers across the cosmos… I just need to look deeper…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY35: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Uhh, I think I looked a bit too far into the cosmos. I lost myself for a moment there… [pause]Sorry.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY44: [wave amp=20 freq=5]{player}, we should leave. I think we’re done here…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY35_OPTION2: Did you find what you were looking for?
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_LK38: [wave amp=20 freq=5]You saw it, didn’t you? [pause]Your genesis? [pause]The moment you were chosen for a higher purpose? [pause]The moment you became what you were MEANT to be?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY40: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I’m Sunny. I am nothing else. It doesn’t matter what people say I must be.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3C_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Please, {player}, show me things. New things! There’s so much to see! [pause]I know you intend to leave New Wirral, but…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3_SUNNY42: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Maybe you should stop being a Landkeeper just because you’ve been told that’s what you are, and try being yourself sometime.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3C_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I think… knowing that this… [pause]body… [pause]was someone else even before I was a Landkeeper…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO14_SUNNY1_OPTION2: I think that’s just a New Wirral thing.
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3C_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]It doesn’t make me feel any different. I want to continue learning what it means to be me, as I am now.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_QUEST_PART3C_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I’m sure that “other me” would understand.[/wave]
messages.RESTING_SUNNY_PLATONIC_1: Sunny asks you various questions about life back on your world.
messages.RESTING_SUNNY_PLATONIC_2: Sunny tells you about a dream she had recently.
messages.RESTING_SUNNY_DATING_1: Sunny has an earnest discussion with you about her thoughts on life.
messages.RESTING_SUNNY_PLATONIC_5: Sunny eagerly tells you about new things she learned about Harbourtown recently.
messages.RESTING_SUNNY_PLATONIC_4: You and Sunny have a light-hearted conversation.
messages.RESTING_SUNNY_DATING_2: Sunny enquires about your clothing choices (for personal research).
messages.SUNNY_CONVO1_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]People seem to enjoy eating food a lot, don’t they…?[/wave]
messages.RESTING_SUNNY_DATING_3: Sunny sits quietly - but contently - with you.
messages.RESTING_SUNNY_DATING_4: Sunny doesn’t say much, but she seems happy to be with you.
messages.SUNNY_CONVO1_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]You seem to do it at least once a day![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO1_SUNNY2_OPTION2: You have to eat to stay alive!
messages.SUNNY_CONVO1_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I seem to be OK if I don’t eat anything at all![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO1_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Maybe I am less like other people than I thought…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO2_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Is the sky as beautiful on your world as it is here, {player}?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO2_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]In the day, the sun glides across the sky, together with the pitch-black moon… At night, that same moon consumes the swirling lights that dance together...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO2_SUNNY1_OPTION2: It doesn’t quite look the same.
messages.SUNNY_CONVO2_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]It’s wonderful, don’t you think…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO2_SUNNY3_OPTION2: I find it kind of eerie.
messages.SUNNY_CONVO2_SUNNY4A.f: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Heh… I thought you’d agree. Very “cool”...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO2_SUNNY4A.m: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Heh… I thought you’d agree. Very “cool”...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO2_SUNNY4B.m: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Heh… maybe it’s quite different to what you’re used to…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO2_SUNNY4A.n: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Heh… I thought you’d agree. Very “cool”...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO2_SUNNY4B.f: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Heh… maybe it’s quite different to what you’re used to…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO2_SUNNY4B.n: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Heh… maybe it’s quite different to what you’re used to…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO3_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Tell me, {player}... does your world also have a café…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO3_SUNNY2A: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Many cafés…? That’s difficult for me to imagine…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO3_SUNNY1_OPTION2: Nope - this is the only one I’ve ever seen!
messages.SUNNY_CONVO3_SUNNY2B: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Wow! [pause]This place must be very exciting for you, then…![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO4_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]You and Kayleigh… you have a sort of connection, don’t you…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO4_SUNNY2.m: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I thought so. It makes me happy to know two of my friends are so close…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO4_SUNNY1_OPTION2: I guess you could phrase it like that.
messages.SUNNY_CONVO4_SUNNY2.f: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I thought so. It makes me happy to know two of my friends are so close…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO4_SUNNY2.n: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I thought so. It makes me happy to know two of my friends are so close…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO4_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Whilst I do not share a bond with anyone like this, I think it would be nice…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO5_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]You and Eugene are close, aren’t you?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO5_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I thought so. Eugene is sure of himself in many ways, and not so much in others… I think you are someone who would help bring out the best in him.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO5_SUNNY1_OPTION2: I guess you could phrase it like that.
messages.SUNNY_CONVO5_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The two of you are a good pair, I believe…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO6_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]When I feel the wind like this…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO6_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I feel like… the woman whose body this was, she didn’t get to feel the wind in her hair like this…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO6_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Maybe I’m making up for lost time, in a way...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO7_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]It is a strange thing to think that many people on this island are lost here…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO9_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]They are made by people, I understand…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO7_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]After all, I’m not lost here. Here is where I found myself…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO8_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]That’s what Kayleigh said everyone on New Wirral gets, right…? Do you think EVERYONE deserves a second chance at life…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO7_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]New Wirral… a place where you can be forever lost, [pause]and forever found…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO8_SUNNY3A: [wave amp=20 freq=5]So do I, I think…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO8_SUNNY3B: [wave amp=20 freq=5]To be undeserving of a second chance in life… I don’t think I want to meet someone like that…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO9_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]An Archangel seems so much stronger than a human… but that’s the wrong way to look at it, I think…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO9_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]When I see people in Harbourtown working together, they are like one whole…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO9_SUNNY6: [wave amp=20 freq=5]An Archangel might be strong, but I can’t imagine any Archangel is a match for all people, together![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO11_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Something I’ve been thinking about…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO10_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I wonder if you built a ship and sailed away from here you’d find more islands like it…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO10_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The ocean surrounding New Wirral…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO10_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Maybe I’ll do that one day, when my heart yearns to see new lands![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO11_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]If someone else lived in my body once, did I inherit their likes and dislikes also…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO12_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I… like the way you look when I see you lit by the fire, {player}...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO11_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Or are those my own? [pause]I wonder…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO12_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The embers reflected in your eyes - it may sound silly, but I feel like I see a whole world in you…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO12_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Maybe that’s the world you came from… Like you’ve harboured a piece of it inside you, all this time, guiding you home…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO13_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The past me… the person who lived in my body once…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO13_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]She seemed so unhappy… [pause]It seems so sad to live an unhappy life and not be able to change it…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO13_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Promise me, {player}, to always live as happily as you can…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO14_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]What are the monsters on your world like, {player}...?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO13_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Don’t let your world change you, or make you into someone you’re not… OK?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO14_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I didn’t realise… [pause]I guess that explains a lot…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO15_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Does your world have more clothes than this one, {player}...?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO16_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]So if I understand correctly… this island was made and maintained by an Archangel that goes by the name “Mer-Line”... correct?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO15_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Though… [pause]I only just discovered how I like to dress… Maybe I’m not ready for a new look…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY13: [wave amp=20 freq=5]OK, I’ll try and think of some better questions for you for next time![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO16_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]This Archangel must have had a reason to do all this…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO16_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]But also… maybe their reasons are beyond our understanding?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO16_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Either way, I don’t think it’s something we should worry about! Whatever the future may hold, we’ll be ready for it…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO17_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Our new friend Gwen… I’ve never seen someone that dresses like her![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO18_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]So Gwen is an Archangel…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO17_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I wonder if she’d like to be friends with me…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO18_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]She must have been so alone here, on this pier… I hope she can find happiness…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_CONVO18_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]No one deserves to feel that way…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]OK, {player}. Tell me something. Something about your world.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Yeah! Your world is old, right…? New Wirral is young. I was told Harbourtown has only existed for a few generations…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_NARRATION4: You give Sunny a brief rundown on the history of Earth. [pause]You skip a lot of the details, but that’s OK.
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Please, tell me about the history of your world![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]That’s… a lot to take in.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY6: [wave amp=20 freq=5]When I think about this island, and where I came from… from the person I once was on another world, to being a Landkeeper, to finding you here…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY7: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I can almost see the thread of history that led to me being me, [pause]here, [pause]now.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY8.m: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Does that make sense? Do you… see the threads of your world’s history that lead you to be who you are now…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY8.n: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Does that make sense? Do you… see the threads of your world’s history that lead you to be who you are now…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY8.f: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Does that make sense? Do you… see the threads of your world’s history that lead you to be who you are now…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY9A: [wave amp=20 freq=5]OK! I’m glad! I wasn’t sure if it was a silly question.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY9B: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Don’t worry about it… it was a silly question anyway![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY10: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I am still learning what it means to be oneself. Some part of that lies in our history, but only so much…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY11: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I wonder about the human I once was… [pause]the woman who lived in my body first… I wonder how her history shaped her…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL1_SUNNY12: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Maybe I am asking the wrong questions… Maybe I need to ask you more about the present, not the past![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL2_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]There are a lot of people on your world… aren’t there? I mean… a lot more than here on this island.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL2_SUNNY6: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Don’t worry, I do understand that much. The other Landkeepers and I… are not friends.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL2_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]You must meet more people than you could even get to know![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL2_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Don’t you feel sad about that? That there’s friendships you might miss out on…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL2_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Though… I suppose they might not really end up as friends. Not all people can connect with each other…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL2_SUNNY7: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The roles given to them are so rigid… so impossible to change, that they can’t imagine life any other way…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL2_SUNNY9: [wave amp=20 freq=5]But knowing that people might not connect with you, or even despise you… this isn’t enough to stop me reaching out to others.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL2_SUNNY8: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Maybe me choosing to be “Sunny” instead of a “Landkeeper” is an insult to them.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL2_SUNNY10: [wave amp=20 freq=5]People are interesting to me! It’s fun to talk to them, I think...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL3_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Being hungry is pretty funny, isn’t it…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL3_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Is that such a strange statement?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL3_SUNNY1_OPTION2: Being hungry is no laughing matter!
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL3_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]It’s a feeling we have that changes our behaviour, even if we don’t want it to…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL3_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]The things we desire in our bodies overrule us, pushing us to make decisions…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL3_SUNNY4_OPTION2: Do you have many of these bodily desires?
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL3_BRANCH1_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]See? It wasn’t a strange statement after all![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL3_BRANCH1_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I bet your world has a lot of really good food that isn’t on New Wirral, {player}![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL3_BRANCH1_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Some food makes me feel this way more than others. I guess that’s “preference”...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL3_BRANCH2_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]You- [pause][pause]Buh- [pause][pause]I’m not… [pause]I’m talking about food![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL3_BRANCH1_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Please… tell me about these foods. I want to know about them, OK?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL3_BRANCH2_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]A lot of human desires are… [pause]interesting, but food is easier to talk about…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL3_BRANCH2_NARRATION3: The conversation awkwardly trailed off after that.
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]There’s something I’m curious about… People’s homes. They are reflections of them, I’m told.[/wave]
