messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Can you show me your home..?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_SUNNY7: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I’ve been thinking so much on what it means to be me, and to be a person…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_SUNNY8: [wave amp=20 freq=5]And I think I understand now.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_SUNNY9: [wave amp=20 freq=5]What makes people… [pause]is other people.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_SUNNY10: [wave amp=20 freq=5]If I didn’t have you in my life, and Kayleigh, and Eugene, I wouldn’t BE Sunny…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_SUNNY11: [wave amp=20 freq=5]After all, you were the ones to give me that name. The first gift I ever received - and I’ll treasure it forever.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_SUNNY13.m: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Even you, {player}. At first, I saw you as a stranger, someone I feared, or didn’t trust. But now, I see you as...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_SUNNY12: [wave amp=20 freq=5]It feels like so long since then… I feel so differently about everything now.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_SUNNY13.f: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Even you, {player}. At first, I saw you as a stranger, someone I feared, or didn’t trust. But now, I see you as...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_SUNNY13.n: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Even you, {player}. At first, I saw you as a stranger, someone I feared, or didn’t trust. But now, I see you as...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_BRANCH1_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Those connections with one another? This is what it means to live. To be human, I think…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_BRANCH1_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Of course! We’ve travelled together… fought monsters together… even fused together…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_BRANCH1_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]One day I know you’ll move on from this place… but those connections will always be there between us. Making us who we are.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_BRANCH1_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]At least, that’s what I think.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_BRANCH2_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Do you mean that how I think you mean it…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_BRANCH2_SUNNY2_OPTION2: I mean I have feelings for you.
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_BRANCH2_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]So it’s… not just me.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_BRANCH2_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]If I am honest, I’ve had some… [pause]complicated feelings inside me for some time.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_BRANCH2_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]It’s so hard for me to know what’s normal, and what’s not…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_BRANCH2_SUNNY6: [wave amp=20 freq=5]But if you feel the same, then I’ll try to be direct:[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_SOCIAL4_BRANCH2_SUNNY7: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I want to be close to you, [pause]very close to you, right now… [pause]if that’s OK…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_ROMANCE_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]You look like you have something you want to say, {player}, I think…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_ROMANCE_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I think I understand what it is you’re asking.[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_E1_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]It’s OK, Eugene. We weren’t friends when we first met, but we are now… That’s better, don’t you think…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_ROMANCE_SUNNY7: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Of course I want that… I want nothing more…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_ROMANCE_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]It’s not just about being close to each other physically, it’s something more…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_ROMANCE_SUNNY6: [wave amp=20 freq=5]A validation of the connection between us, as people…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_ROMANCE_SUNNY6_OPTION2: That’s one way to put it.
messages.SUNNY_ROMANCE_SUNNY8: [wave amp=20 freq=5]But… we can still be close physically too, right…?[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_ROMANCE_SUNNY9: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Because when I see you, there are a lot of feelings I have. I want to be physically close to you, and also want to be connected to you, connected to your heart…[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_ROMANCE_SUNNY10: [wave amp=20 freq=5]These feelings all blend into one and I can’t tell where they begin or end. It makes me feel like I don’t understand myself as much as I want to...[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_ROMANCE_SUNNY11: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I need to be close to you, I think.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_ROMANCE_SUNNY12: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I need to feel your hands on mine, [pause]a-and other things like that, too![/wave]
messages.SUNNY_ROMANCE_SUNNY14: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I know you have to go home eventually… but this connection will always be there between us. Making us who we are.[/wave]
messages.SUNNY_ROMANCE_SUNNY13: [wave amp=20 freq=5]So… yes. I want to be with you. Until you go.[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_K1_KAYLEIGH4: Oh, they don’t live there - it’s just for the day! Think of it as a role you play in the daytime, before you come home and become yourself again.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_K1_KAYLEIGH2: Well I wouldn’t phrase it like [wave amp=30 freq=10]that[/wave], exactly - it’s more that you need money to live, so an office job is a way to get money.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_K1_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]...So you mean to say that, where you’re from, some people CHOOSE to live like Landkeepers…?[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_K1_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]So people choose to live in an office to survive…?[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_K1_KAYLEIGH6: Uh, I’m not qualified for that kind of work.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_K1_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I see… did you have an “office job” before coming to New Wirral, Kayleigh…?[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_M1_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]...No, I never had to “drink blood” as a Landkeeper…[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_M1_MEREDITH4: I guess not. I’m just curious about you.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_M1_MEREDITH2: So you’re not, like, a vampire. [pause]But are you sure you aren’t maybe a [wave amp=30 freq=10]little[/wave] bit undead? You look pretty pale.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_M1_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]”Undead”? I’m not familiar with the word… Is it bad..?[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_M1_MEREDITH6: Don’t take it the wrong way! [pause]You’re like, a [wave amp=30 freq=10]living dead girl[/wave]. Or maybe you’re not. Either way, it’s cool.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_M1_SUNNY7: [wave amp=20 freq=5]So you’re saying you don’t quite understand me, and that interests you…?[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_E1_EUGENE2: You mean when you first walked into this café? Yeah, I guess it’s been a little bit since then.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_E1_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]...It feels so long ago when we first met, Eugene…[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_E1_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]No, I mean when I was a Landkeeper and first came into Harbourtown. You confronted me and my colleague and told us to leave, remember…?[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_E1_EUGENE4: Wait, [pause]that was YOU? Sunny, I never realised…
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_F1_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]...You want to draw me…?[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_F1_FELIX2: Yeah! Your story is pretty inspiring, after all. You escaped your previous life as a corporate drone to be your own person. I could totally base a character on you for the story I’m writing.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_F1_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]Though I must request that my clothes stay on for the drawing process.[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_F1_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I… that’s very kind of you. I would be honoured for you to draw me, Felix…[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_F1_FELIX5: Don’t worry, I’m not [wave amp=30 freq=10]that[/wave] kind of artist.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_V1_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]...Do you have fond memories from your times travelling, Viola…?[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_V1_VIOLA2: …Fond memories? The finest! The wind in my hair one night, and the warm bed of a tavern the following moon. Upon one night I may be found dining with friends of my father; the next I may be performing poetry in fair Verona.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_V1_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]”Fair Verona”... that sounds like a nice place…[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_V1_VIOLA4: It… may be so, yet I must confess: [pause]I happened to have stolen the heart of a maiden of high standing in Verona and caused a local feud, the likes of which escalated most devilishly. [pause]I do not intend to return.
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_D1_SUNNY1: [wave amp=20 freq=5]...I guess you’re a “dog”, is that right…?[/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_V1_SUNNY5: [wave amp=20 freq=5]...You do have a lot of stories, it seems![/wave]
messages.PARTNER_INTERACT_S_D1_SUNNY3: [wave amp=20 freq=5]You are the first “dog” I’ve met. I would like to meet more, if given the chance…[/wave]
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_K1_KAYLEIGH2: Yeah! [pause]It’s not super uncommon to have ginger hair, at least in my neck of the woods.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_K1_FRANKIE1: ...I have to ask, Kayleigh. Is your hair naturally that colour?
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_K1_FRANKIE4: Well, [pause]no, [pause]but it's STAYED this colour ever since I washed up here.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_K1_KAYLEIGH3: I’m guessing you weren’t born with pink hair, though.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_K1_FRANKIE6: It certainly saves me money on hair dye!
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_K1_KAYLEIGH5: If you’re happy with that then it’s not so bad, right?
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_M1_FRANKIE1: …I just don’t know, Meredith. If I [wave amp=30 freq=10]leave[/wave] New Wirral, I’m going to have to get a job and all that boring stuff.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_K1_FRANKIE7: …Not that money exists here. Or hair dye.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_V1_VIOLA3: I see what troubles you, dear Frankie. You ask if there is a contradiction in your passion for romantic and lustful prose, despite your own reluctance to partake in such dramas yourself?
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_M1_MEREDITH2: You’re just a kid, right? You’ve got some time left before you hit the mundanities of adulthood.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_M1_FRANKIE3: I’m [wave amp=30 freq=10]eighteen[/wave]! I don’t think you’re [wave amp=30 freq=10]that[/wave] much older than me!
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_M1_MEREDITH4: Oh. [pause]I didn’t realise. I guess you have such a… [pause]youthful energy that I mistook you for younger.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_E1_FRANKIE1: …I just think that maybe I’m not the person my parents [wave amp=30 freq=10]thought[/wave] I’d be growing up. They’re [wave amp=30 freq=10]supportive[/wave] of me, but maybe I’m not the kid they thought I’d be.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_E1_EUGENE2: I get that. I had a pretty momentous childhood - but my parents spent a lot of theirs fighting in the trenches of a guerilla war for the fate of a burning world, y’know?
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_E1_EUGENE4: I mean like, they raised me as best they could… [pause]but growing up I played in the ruins of the death machines that their generation felled, right?
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_E1_EUGENE5: There’s gonna be some distance between us when they’ve experienced something like that.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_E1_FRANKIE6: …[pause]Maybe my life is pretty easy, all things considered.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_F1_FRANKIE1: …So if I provide you with a character description, do you think you could draw them for me?
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_F1_FELIX2: Sure! Just tell me what your character looks like, and I’ll get back to you with it.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_F1_FRANKIE3: OK, [pause]they’re like, [pause]imagine a werewolf, but wearing a business suit. No wait, it’s more like a tuxedo… And his fur colour is-
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_F1_FELIX4: Uh, how about you write down some notes for me instead?
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_V1_FRANKIE1: …I guess I read a lot about romance for someone who has no interest in it myself.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_V1_VIOLA5: If you wish to know my thoughts; I would say that you need not worry. Perhaps your heart’s desires shall change as you age, perhaps not.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_V1_VIOLA6: Enjoy the things you love, and love those around you in the way that pleases you most. This is a fine way to live one’s life, I believe.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_V1_FRANKIE7: Viola you are [wave amp=30 freq=10]SO[/wave] cool, do you know that?!
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_S1_FRANKIE1: …So even though I didn’t know New Wirral [wave amp=30 freq=10]existed[/wave] before coming here, in some way I’ve been preparing for this kind of thing happening to me my [wave amp=30 freq=10]whole life[/wave]!
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_V1_VIOLA8: I’m hearing such reports as of late!
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_S1_SUNNY2: [wave amp=20 freq=5]I see… because you read many fantasy stories… and write your own, if I am understanding right…?[/wave]
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_S1_FRANKIE3: Yes! [pause]Though the specific details with cassette tapes is a new twist, people [wave amp=30 freq=10]love[/wave] stories about friendships between monsters and humans - especially if there’s romance, too.
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_S1_SUNNY4: [wave amp=20 freq=5]They do…? Is that why you are excited to be here - to be romanced by a monster?[/wave]
messages.FRANKIE_INTERACT_S1_FRANKIE5: What, m-me? [pause]No, I’m strictly an observer.
messages.STATUS_DESCRIPTION_BOOBY_TRAPPED: Characters with Booby Trapped have some of their moves replaced.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STATUS_TARGET_TEAM: Gives the target team {status_effect} status for {duration} turn(s).
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BRACE_FOR_IMPACT: Hits one target. Uses the user’s Melee Defence stat instead of Melee Attack. Also damages the user.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CARNIVORE: Increases the amount of HP restored by Bite.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BUTTERFLY_EFFECT: Consumes all the user’s AP. The power of this attack is increased by 15 times the AP consumed. The type of the attack, and any extra status effects, are determined by the current weather.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_MACHINE_CURSE: Reflects all damage and statuses dealt by moves triggered by other passive moves back onto the user.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_LIFTOFF: Gives the user AP Boost and Speed Up at the end of their third turn.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ENERGY_RESERVES: Chance to give 1 AP to a random ally at the end of the user’s turn.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STICKER_TRICK: Replaces the last move the target used with Booby Trap. Booby Trap damages the user.
messages.STATUS_DESCRIPTION_FLAMMABLE: Flammable characters receive the Burned status whenever they are hit by Fire-type attacks. In addition, the damage received from Burned is increased.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HARDBACK: Reduces incoming damage from all but critical and Fire-type attacks. Fire-type attacks received are always critical, and do not provide buffs.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BAD_FORECAST: Gives the target Evasion Nullified status for {duration} turn(s). Also randomises the weather. Automatically used at the start of battle.
messages.FRAGLIACCI_LORE_2: “Pagliacci” is the name of an Italian opera written by Ruggero Leoncavallo that first debuted in 1892. It tells the story of an actor who leads a commedia dell'arte theatre troupe.
messages.LAPACITOR_LORE_2: The first electric battery was invented by the physicist Alessandro Volta in 1800. At the time he did not understand the nature of his invention, and believed it to be a source of unlimited power.
messages.AMPHARE_LORE_1: The Amphare is little more than a living battery, having formed “limbs” by suspending scrap iron in the air around its body. It is not clear what first caused it to gain sentience.
messages.PIER_MACHINE_GLITTER_LORE_2: When humanity has been stripped away, all that remains is chaos.
messages.ITEM_PIER_TICKET_DESCRIPTION: A ticket that can be exchanged for ride passes at Brightside Pier. The paper feels crisp and delicate, like dead leaves.
messages.DLC_PIER_FELIX_CONVO2_FELIX2: It sounds like Archangels are envious of us humans. That one you first met on another world - Ms. Amber - also seemed to prefer taking the form of a human too, right?
messages.DLC_PIER_VIOLA_CONVO1_VIOLA1: That woman wears the guise of a fool, but I shall not let her trick me.
messages.DLC_PIER_FELIX_CONVO2_FELIX4: They are powerful… [pause]but power isn’t everything, is it?
messages.DLC_PIER_VIOLA_CONVO1_VIOLA3: Do not let the kindly face of Gwen ease your guard, {player}. A jester may offer you a smile one moment, then in another a knife in the back.
messages.DLC_PIER_FELIX_CONVO2_FELIX3: It’d be easy to think of them as [wave amp=30 freq=10]god-like[/wave] beings, but I think that misses the point.
messages.UMBRAHELLA_LORE_1: The enigmatic Umbrahella is said to be a bad omen – riding fell winds like a kite on an updraft, it appears only where disaster and misery is soon to strike.
messages.UMBRAHELLA_LORE_2: Depictions of man-made collapsible umbrellas have been found in sculptures dating back to ancient Assyria. Umbrellas of many kinds have appeared across all cultures throughout human history.
messages.DLC_PIER_KAYLEIGH_CONVO2_KAYLEIGH1: So “Gwen” was an Archangel after all, and also knew Aleph…
messages.DLC_PIER_KAYLEIGH_CONVO1_KAYLEIGH1: This creepy pier raises so many questions.
messages.DLC_PIER_KAYLEIGH_CONVO1_KAYLEIGH3: And Gwen… has she been here the whole time? [pause]Does she do her own makeup? [pause]Is she single?
messages.DLC_PIER_KAYLEIGH_CONVO1_KAYLEIGH2: Was it here the whole time people have lived on New Wirral? Where did it even [wave amp=30 freq=10]come[/wave] from?
messages.CHARLEQUIN_LORE_1: The Charlequin uses its oversized sleeves to store items used for public performances. This includes fireworks, flammable materials, incendiary devices, and more.
messages.BLUNDERBUSK_LORE_2: Whilst the “clown” has existed as a role since ancient Egypt, the recogniseable clown look was developed by English performer Joseph Grimaldi in the early 1800s.
messages.PIER_MACHINE_BEAST_LORE_2: Depending on who you ask, ferality is either the absence of humanity or an acceptance of our true selves.
messages.PIER_MACHINE_BEAST_LORE_1: Whatever it once was, it now exists between two states of being. An incomplete monstrosity that can express itself only in animal rage.
messages.FRAGLIACCI_DESCRIPTION: a clown with a cannon head
messages.REGION_NAME_HAUNTEDHOUSE_PHRASE: in the Witch House on Brightside Pier
messages.REGION_NAME_SPACEWORLD_PHRASE: at Cosmic Zone on Brightside Pier
messages.PIER_MACHINE_GLITTER_LORE_1: A thing that knows only that it should not be. With no sense of rationality left, this pitiful entity cannot make decisions with any sense of logic or reasoning.
messages.ITEM_PIER_PASS_HAUNTEDHOUSE_DESCRIPTION: A pass that allows access to an attraction at Brightside Pier.
messages.ITEM_PIER_PASS_FUNHOUSE_DESCRIPTION: A pass that allows access to an attraction at Brightside Pier.
messages.ROSEHOOD_LORE_2: The story of “Little Red Riding Hood” has a long history. It is known to have been told as far back as the 10th century in Europe, and has its roots in folk stories from ancient Greece.
messages.REGION_NAME_PIER_WAREHOUSE_PHRASE: in the warehouse on Brightside Pier
messages.FRAGLIACCI_LORE_1: The Fragliacci’s whole body is something akin to a ballistic cannon – it’s “face” is merely a cover to the cannon’s barrel, which is able to fire objects with a terrifying velocity.
messages.LAPACITOR_DESCRIPTION: a battery-shaped rabbit with a giant claw arm
messages.MAJORTOM_LORE_2: The first manned space flight was successfully completed in 1961 by Soviet cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin. Lasting 108 minutes, the flight was inarguably a milestone in the history of the human race.
messages.ROSEHOOD_DESCRIPTION: a hooded figure with a flower basket
messages.MINORTOM_LORE_1: Minortoms were once novelty automatons, designed to entertain guests at a theme park on some unremarkable parallel Earth. Long outliving their creators, they have since gained a mechanical sentience of sorts, and now look to sail the stars like the space rockets they resemble.
messages.DLC_PIER_MEREDITH_CONVO1_PLAYER2_OPTION2: [shake rate=30 level=10]What?![/shake] No! That’s not where I was going with that [wave amp=30 freq=10]at all[/wave]!
messages.DLC_PIER_MEREDITH_CONVO1_PLAYER2_OPTION1: Nah, I think it’s the whole “sole resident of an abandoned pier” thing. That tends to give me the creeps.
You mean you’re scared of her?
messages.DLC_PIER_MEREDITH_CONVO1_PLAYER2_OPTION2: You mean you have a crush on her?
You’re really [wave amp=30 freq=10]telling[/wave] on yourself by asking that, {player}.
You’re really [wave amp=30 freq=10]telling[/wave] on yourself by asking that, {player}.
messages.HAUNTOME_LORE_2: The history of the book is as long as the history of writing. Before the invention of paper, people would use various mediums for recording text including clay tablets.
messages.DLC_PIER_MEREDITH_CONVO1_PLAYER2_OPTION2: You’re really [wave amp=30 freq=10]telling[/wave] on yourself by asking that, {player}.
messages.DLC_PIER_EUGENE_CONVO1_EUGENE1: This new mission of ours to save this pier…
messages.DLC_PIER_EUGENE_CONVO2_EUGENE3: Man, I don’t know what to make about [wave amp=30 freq=10]any[/wave] of that stuff. It’s above my paygrade.
messages.DLC_PIER_MEREDITH_CONVO2_MEREDITH2: That figures. You can’t trust anyone who’s in a costume full-time. [pause]I’ve always thought this.
messages.DLC_PIER_EUGENE_CONVO1_EUGENE2_OPTION1: I think we can trust her!
messages.DLC_PIER_EUGENE_CONVO1_EUGENE2: It’s pretty weird, right? Like, I guess we’re helping someone out, but I also don’t know what to think about Gwen.
messages.DLC_PIER_EUGENE_CONVO1_EUGENE3: Whatever the case: stay on your guard, buddy. Who knows what we’ll find out here…
messages.DLC_PIER_EUGENE_CONVO1_EUGENE2_OPTION2: I don’t know if we can trust her.
messages.DLC_PIER_VIOLA_CONVO1_VIOLA2: Something is amiss in this place – [pause]we both know this much.
messages.DLC_PIER_VIOLA_CONVO2_VIOLA1: So it seems that “Gwen the fool” was an otherworldly spirit herself, yes?
messages.DLC_PIER_VIOLA_CONVO2_VIOLA2: There is much of mankind that is envious to the fae beings of other worlds, it would appear.
messages.DLC_PIER_VIOLA_CONVO2_VIOLA3: To live so long, yet live that life as a shadow…
messages.DLC_PIER_VIOLA_CONVO2_VIOLA4: Such a pitiable thing she turned out to be, in the end.
messages.ITEM_PIER_PASS_SPACEWORLD_DESCRIPTION: A pass that allows access to an attraction at Brightside Pier.
messages.ITEM_KEY_HAUNTEDHOUSE_1_DESCRIPTION: A crude gemstone, shaped to fit into a particular socket.
messages.ITEM_KEY_HAUNTEDHOUSE_2_DESCRIPTION: A rusted key used to access the library in the Witch House.
messages.SCARLETEETH_LORE_2: “Little Red Riding Hood” has many variations – the most popular being the Brothers Grimm version of the story. Some early versions explicitly describe the wolf in the story as a werewolf.
messages.SCARLETEETH_LORE_1: A Littlered that turns feral can grow into this form: the Scarleteeth, a hulking clawed beast with a taste for flesh. For a person to take this form in battle is to lose oneself to pure animal bloodlust.
messages.DLC_PIER_EUGENE_CONVO2_EUGENE1: So “Gwen” was an Archangel the whole time?
messages.DLC_PIER_EUGENE_CONVO2_EUGENE2: But it still sounds like helping her out was a good thing… [pause]I think…?
messages.DLC_PIER_EUGENE_CONVO2_EUGENE4: [wave amp=30 freq=10]Whatever[/wave] it all means, it still sounds like a job well done. Nice work, {player}.
messages.DLC_PIER_FELIX_CONVO2_FELIX1: So “Gwen the clown” is actually “Gwenivar the Archangel”, huh?
messages.DLC_PIER_FELIX_CONVO1_FELIX4: I guess I could also just be overthinking it.
messages.DLC_PIER_FELIX_CONVO1_FELIX3: The way that places like these [wave amp=30 freq=10]slowly decay[/wave] adds so much character. Every patch of rust tells a story.
messages.LAPACITOR_LORE_1: If the electrical energy within an Amphare grows strong enough, it is able to extend its own body and form proper limbs. It still relies on magnetised scrap metal for self-defense, however.
messages.CLOWN_LORE_1: Gwenivar is an ancient Archangel who has always held a childlike fascination with human culture. She has spent many years attempting to replicate mankind’s natural ability to create new things.
messages.CLOWN_LORE_2: The incarnation of illusion, Gwenivar was once a member of Aleph’s troupe, the “Round Table”. After the troupe split following a tragedy, she isolated herself on the remote Brightside Pier.
messages.MINORTOM_LORE_2: The first depiction of a “space rocket” in fiction was in Jules Verne’s “From the Earth to the Moon”, a novel about a manned flight to the Moon. It was a direct inspiration for the first ever science fiction movie, “A Trip to the Moon” by Georges Méliès.
messages.HAUNTOME_LORE_1: The Hauntome may appear like a book possessed by a restless spirit, but its “eye” is an organic creature that has taken root inside a large tome. It flaps its pages to create powerful winds.
messages.CHARLEQUIN_LORE_2: The “Harlequin” is a comedic character role originating in the traditional commedia dell'arte, a form of Italian theatre popular between the 16th and 18th centuries.
messages.LITTLERED_LORE_2: “Little Red Riding Hood” is a European folk tale. Whilst there are many versions of it, the story is generally described as the tale of a girl who is followed by a wolf on her travels to visit her grandmother.
messages.LITTLERED_DESCRIPTION: a cat-like creature with a cloak and bow
messages.DLC_POPUP_PIER_2:
The following cosmetic options are also now available:

- Ringmaster #1 Hair option
- Ringmaster #2 Hair option

- Two-tone Hair option
- Clown Nose Head option
messages.PIER_MACHINE_ASTRAL_LORE_2: The void is the absense of meaning, of heart, and of self.
messages.PIER_MACHINE_ASTRAL_LORE_1: A half formed thing. The warmth it once possessed in a previous life has flickered out like a dying spark, leaving only a dark emptiness.
messages.QUEST_DLC_PIER_DESCRIPTION1: Disable the 3 Infernal Engines at Brightside Pier.
messages.QUEST_DLC_PIER_PROGRESS1: Exchange 4 prize tickets for an attraction pass.
messages.ITEM_KEY_SPACEWORLD_3_DESCRIPTION: A heavy iron key used to open the door to the engine room in the Cosmic Zone.
messages.RUMOR_DLC_PIER_BOAT: A patron of this fine establishment told me of a peculiar sighting they saw earlier. An abandoned rowing boat, sailing itself to shore not too long ago.
messages.ITEM_KEY_WAREHOUSE_DESCRIPTION: An old rusty key used to open the locked room in the Brightside Pier warehouse.
messages.RUMOR_PASSIVE_QUEST_UMBRAHELLA: Believe it or not, I saw a living umbrella {location_0_phrase}! It seemed to be doing something with the weather!
messages.AMPHARE_LORE_2: The term “battery” is believed to have been coined by inventor Benjamin Franklin in the 18th century, a word borrowed from a military terminology.
messages.LITTLERED_LORE_1: Littlereds, in their immature states, have the potential to maintain their civil and friendly personas into adulthood, or give in to their inner beasts. What would drive such a courteous creature to such bloodlust?
messages.DLC_POPUP_PIER_1: Thank you for purchasing Pier of the Unknown!\n\nA new story quest can now be accessed by speaking to Clémence after you have had your first proper meeting with the Triangle Man.
messages.BLUNDERBUSK_DESCRIPTION: a clown with a bouncy ball body
messages.MAJORTOM_LORE_1: Minortoms that upgrade their space rocket bodies can eventually advance to become Majortoms. Their large fuel tanks are filled with a powerful liquid propellant that can launch them into low orbit, finally realising their dream of space travel.
messages.BLUNDERBUSK_LORE_1: The Blunderbusk is able to “fire” projectiles with its hand by pointing their hands like guns. It has a very accurate aim, too, despite the fact that its always rocking back and forth, and also lacks eyes.
messages.ROSEHOOD_LORE_1: A Littlered that grows to adulthood without losing itself to its animal instincts. The Rosehood is often seen in wooded areas, arranging bouqets of fresh flowers to hand out to those passing by.
messages.DLC_PIER_KAYLEIGH_CONVO1_KAYLEIGH4: I’m just kidding with that last one – [pause]honest!
messages.DLC_PIER_KAYLEIGH_CONVO2_KAYLEIGH2: It’s so strange to me that these beings who seem so [wave amp=30 freq=10]beyond[/wave] us could be so [wave amp=30 freq=10]preoccupied[/wave] with us - [pause]us human beings.
messages.DLC_PIER_MEREDITH_CONVO1_MEREDITH1: That [wave amp=30 freq=10]Gwen[/wave] lady really makes the hair on the back of my neck stand up, if you know what I mean.
messages.DLC_PIER_KAYLEIGH_CONVO2_KAYLEIGH3: It’s just a lot for this [wave amp=30 freq=10]small-town Irish lass[/wave] to wrap her head around, OK?

messages.ITEM_KEY_SPACEWORLD_1_DESCRIPTION: A silver key with a moon motif found in the Cosmic Zone.
messages.ITEM_KEY_SPACEWORLD_2_DESCRIPTION: A golden key with a sun motif found in the Cosmic Zone.

messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_ALREADY_MET1.f: We meet again, {player}. Looks like you’ve been busy, huh?
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_CM_CODEY2: I’ve been picking up some [wave amp=30 freq=10]cyber waves[/wave] on my scanner, and I guess you’re the reason why.
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_ALREADY_MET1.m: We meet again, {player}. Looks like you’ve been busy, huh?
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_ALREADY_MET1.n: We meet again, {player}. Looks like you’ve been busy, huh?
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_CM_CODEY4: It’s like, connected to the [wave amp=30 freq=10]space between all our worlds[/wave] or something. I don’t really care where it comes from…
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_CM_CODEY3: Cyber waves! [pause]Y’know, from [wave amp=30 freq=10]Cyber Material[/wave]! [pause]It’s what I call that glowing orange stuff you must have picked up recently.
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_CM_CODEY5: But those rogue fusions are pretty sensitive to it - you can use it to turn them into bootlegs. It’s biohacking on a [shake rate=30 level=10]cosmic[/shake] level!
messages.CAPTAIN_CODEY_CM_CODEY7: Now you’re playing with [shake rate=30 level=10]power[/shake]! [pause]This will harness the Cyber Material and make it usable on rogue fusions. Not to [wave amp=30 freq=10]brag[/wave], but It’s my own invention.
