messages.REACTION_FIRE_ON_AIR_TUTORIAL: Landing a Fire-type attack on an Air-type target creates an updraft – an Air Wall – that can absorb a number of incoming attacks.
messages.REACTION_FIRE_ON_METAL_TUTORIAL: Metal types can be melted with Fire-type attacks, which causes lasting damage to the target.
messages.REACTION_PLASTIC_ON_FIRE_TUTORIAL: Landing a Plastic-type attack on a Fire-type target releases black smoke that can hide the position of the target.
messages.REACTION_PLASTIC_ON_LIGHTNING_TUTORIAL: Plastic is an insulator, and as such, Plastic-type attacks can limit the scope of Lightning-type attackers.
messages.REACTION_PLASTIC_ON_ASTRAL_TUTORIAL: The internal harmony of Astral-types can be thrown into disarray by exposure to the impure elements: Plastic, Poison, and Metal.
messages.REACTION_PLANT_ON_FIRE_TUTORIAL: Landing a Plant-type attack on a Fire-type target releases black smoke that can hide the position of the target.
messages.REACTION_PLANT_ON_WATER_TUTORIAL: Plant-type attacks sap – and leech – the strength of Water-type targets.
messages.REACTION_PLANT_ON_LIGHTNING_TUTORIAL: Plant-type attacks ground the electricity of Lightning-type targets, reducing the scope of their attacks.
messages.REACTION_PLANT_ON_POISON_TUTORIAL: Poisons require specific nutrients to make. Plant-type attacks provide these nutrients, which empowers the target’s future Poison-type attacks.
messages.REACTION_WATER_ON_FIRE_TUTORIAL: Water-type attacks douse Fire-type targets, reducing the power of their attacks.
messages.REACTION_PLANT_ON_EARTH_TUTORIAL: Plant-type attacks carry seeds with them that are implanted in Earth-type targets to drain energy.
messages.REACTION_WATER_ON_PLANT_TUTORIAL: The water left over from Water-type attacks is absorbed by the roots of Plant-type targets, healing them over time.
messages.REACTION_WATER_ON_ASTRAL_TUTORIAL: Astral-types draw their power from the four elements: Fire, Earth, Air, and Water.
messages.REACTION_WATER_ON_ICE_TUTORIAL: The water left over from Water-type attacks is immediately frozen by Ice-type targets, providing additional bulk.
messages.REACTION_WATER_ON_LIGHTNING_TUTORIAL: Water conducts electricity, increasing the scope and range of Lightning-types’ attacks.
messages.REACTION_WATER_ON_EARTH_TUTORIAL: Water-type attacks gradually erode Earth-type targets, chipping away at their defences.
messages.REACTION_WATER_ON_METAL_TUTORIAL: Water-type attacks corrode (or cause to rust) Metal-type targets, which makes them brittle.
messages.REACTION_POISON_ON_FIRE_TUTORIAL: Fire-type targets can burn excess poison left over from Poison-type attacks as a fuel, empowering them.
messages.REACTION_POISON_ON_PLANT_TUTORIAL: Plant-type targets absorb poisons left over from Poison-type attacks and take damage from this over time.
messages.REACTION_POISON_ON_EARTH_TUTORIAL: The poison left over from Poison-type attacks can be used by Earth-types to coat sharp points, allowing them to deliver extra damage to opponents.
messages.REACTION_POISON_ON_ASTRAL_TUTORIAL: The internal harmony of Astral-types can be thrown into disarray by exposure to the impure elements: Plastic, Poison, and Metal.
messages.REACTION_POISON_ON_METAL_TUTORIAL: The poison left over from Poison-type attacks can be used by Metal-types to coat sharp points, allowing them to deliver extra damage to opponents.
messages.REACTION_ASTRAL_ON_FIRE_TUTORIAL: Astral-type attacks drain power from targets of the four elements: Fire, Earth, Air, and Water.
messages.REACTION_ASTRAL_ON_WATER_TUTORIAL: Astral-type attacks drain power from targets of the four elements: Fire, Earth, Air, and Water.
messages.REACTION_ASTRAL_ON_ASTRAL_TUTORIAL: When hit with Astral-type attacks, Astral-type monsters can absorb and make use of the astral energy left over.
messages.REACTION_ASTRAL_ON_AIR_TUTORIAL: Astral-type attacks drain power from targets of the four elements: Fire, Earth, Air, and Water.
messages.REACTION_ICE_ON_WATER_TUTORIAL: When hit with Ice-type attacks, Water-types immediately freeze over.
messages.REACTION_ASTRAL_ON_EARTH_TUTORIAL: Astral-type attacks drain power from targets of the four elements: Fire, Earth, Air, and Water.
messages.REACTION_ICE_ON_LIGHTNING_TUTORIAL: Ice and water conduct electricity, increasing the scope and range of Lightning-types’ attacks.
messages.REACTION_ICE_ON_AIR_TUTORIAL: Ice-type attacks cool down Air-type targets, making them shiver.
messages.REACTION_LIGHTNING_ON_ICE_TUTORIAL: Ice and water conduct electricity, leaving them weak to future Lightning-type attacks.
messages.REACTION_LIGHTNING_ON_WATER_TUTORIAL: Water conducts electricity, leaving it weak to future Lightning-type attacks.
messages.REACTION_LIGHTNING_ON_PLASTIC_TUTORIAL: Due to plastic’s insulating nature, Lightning-type attacks on Plastic-type targets leave an electric charge behind, which the target can use to give an extra shock to its opponents.
messages.REACTION_LIGHTNING_ON_AIR_TUTORIAL: In New Wirral, air conducts electricity abnormally well, leaving Air-type targets weak to future Lightning-type attacks.
messages.REACTION_AIR_ON_FIRE_TUTORIAL: Air-type attacks “blow out” Fire-type targets, reducing the strength of their future attacks.
messages.REACTION_LIGHTNING_ON_METAL_TUTORIAL: Metal conducts electricity, leaving it weak to future Lightning-type attacks.
messages.REACTION_LIGHTNING_ON_EARTH_TUTORIAL: When lightning strikes sand it creates fulgurites – natural glass. Earth-type targets of Lightning-type attacks change type to become Glass.
messages.REACTION_AIR_ON_PLANT_TUTORIAL: Air-type attacks can “uproot” Plant-type targets, disconnecting them from the source of their nutrients – the ground.
messages.REACTION_AIR_ON_ASTRAL_TUTORIAL: Astral-types draw their power from the four elements: Fire, Earth, Air, and Water.
messages.REACTION_AIR_ON_LIGHTNING_TUTORIAL: In New Wirral, air conducts electricity, increasing the scope and range of Lightning-types’ attacks.
messages.REACTION_AIR_ON_GLASS_TUTORIAL: Loud sounds and Air-type attacks can cause Glass-type targets to resonate, and start vibrating. If the resonance becomes strong enough it can cause the glass to break.
messages.REACTION_EARTH_ON_FIRE_TUTORIAL: Earth-type attacks smother Fire-type targets, reducing the power of their attacks.
messages.REACTION_EARTH_ON_LIGHTNING_TUTORIAL: Earth-type attacks ground the electricity of Lightning-type targets, reducing the scope of their attacks.
messages.REACTION_EARTH_ON_PLASTIC_TUTORIAL: Just as the life-cycle of plastic products is often, unfortunately, to be buried in a landfill, Earth-type attacks bury Plastic-types. This limits their movement.
messages.REACTION_METAL_ON_ASTRAL_TUTORIAL: The internal harmony of Astral-types can be thrown into disarray by exposure to the impure elements: Plastic, Poison, and Metal.
messages.REACTION_EARTH_ON_ASTRAL_TUTORIAL: Astral-types draw their power from the four elements: Fire, Earth, Air, and Water.
messages.REACTION_METAL_ON_ICE_TUTORIAL: The sharp point on a Metal-type attack penetrates an Ice-type target like a pick, lowering its overall defence.
messages.REACTION_METAL_ON_LIGHTNING_TUTORIAL: Metal conducts electricity, increasing the scope and range of Lightning-types’ attacks.
messages.REACTION_METAL_ON_GLASS_TUTORIAL: Brittle Glass-types are easily shattered by the hard Metal-type attacks. This scatters sharp obstacles across the battlefield.
messages.REACTION_METAL_ON_EARTH_TUTORIAL: The sharp point on a Metal-type attack penetrates an Earth-type target like a shovel, lowering its overall defence.
messages.REACTION_GLASS_ON_LIGHTNING_TUTORIAL: Glass is an insulator, and as such, Glass-type attacks can limit the scope of Lightning-type attackers.
messages.WINGS_OBTAINED: {0} wings are now available in your wardrobe.
messages.ITEM_DROP_INVENTORY_FULL_STICKERS_2: You’ve reached the limit of the number of stickers you can carry. Any further stickers you find will be dropped.
messages.ITEM_CURE_BURNED_DESCRIPTION: A cooling cream that removes the ‘Burned’ status effect from one party member. Doesn’t use up your turn.
messages.ITEM_CURE_COATING_DESCRIPTION: Removes type-changing ‘Coating’ status effects from one party member. Uses up a turn during combat.
messages.ITEM_CURE_CONFUSED_DESCRIPTION: A hypodermic needle containing an enzyme that immediately neutralises excess intoxicants, removing the ‘Confused’ status effect from one party member. Doesn’t use up your turn.
messages.ITEM_CURE_CONDUCTIVE_DESCRIPTION: An insulating cream that removes the ‘Conductive’ status effect from one party member. Doesn’t use up your turn.
messages.ITEM_CURE_LEECHED_DESCRIPTION: A herbicidal cream that removes the ‘Leeched’ status effect from one party member. Doesn’t use up your turn.
messages.ITEM_CURE_POISONED_DESCRIPTION: An antidote to the most common monster poisons. Removes the ‘Poisoned’ status effect from one party member. Doesn’t use up your turn.
messages.ITEM_CURE_RESONANCE_DESCRIPTION: A substance that dampens vibrations, removing the ‘Resonance’ status effect from one party member. Uses up a turn during combat.
messages.ITEM_CURE_SLEEP_DESCRIPTION: A little bottle of foul-smelling salts, sure to wake one party member from their sleep. Doesn’t use up your turn.
messages.ITEM_CURE_BERSERK_DESCRIPTION: A calming sedative that removes the ‘Berserk’ status effect from one party member. Doesn’t use up your turn.
messages.ITEM_CURE_PETRIFIED_DESCRIPTION: A little spray-bottle of an oily substance that eases movement, and removes the ‘Petrified’ status effect from one party member. Uses up a turn during combat.
messages.ITEM_CURE_STAT_DESCRIPTION: A powder that when inhaled removes all stat-modifying status effects from one party member, including the positive ones! Uses up a turn during combat.
messages.ITEM_CURE_ALL_DESCRIPTION: A miracle panacea that claims to cure all afflictions. Removes all status effects from one party member, including the positive ones! Uses up a turn during combat.
messages.ITEM_REWIND_DESCRIPTION: Fully restores the HP of one tape. Uses up a turn when used in combat.
messages.ITEM_RESPOOL_DESCRIPTION: Fixes and rewinds a broken tape. Uses up a turn when used in combat.
messages.ITEM_OLIVE_UP_DESCRIPTION: A strange olive-flavoured soft drink that instantly levels up one character.
messages.ITEM_PEAR_FUSILLI_DESCRIPTION: A pre-peared meal for a pair that instantly fills your fusion meter! Doesn’t use up your turn if eaten during combat.
messages.ITEM_UPGRAPE_DESCRIPTION: A curious bunch of upside-down grapes said to grow from seeds planted on Backwards Day. Eating a bunch instantly upgrades a tape by one star.
messages.ITEM_REODORANT_DESCRIPTION: A spray-can of “unisex perspirant anti-deodorant”. The label says it’ll make you smell strong enough to repel monsters for one minute.
messages.ITEM_FULL_ENGLISH_DESCRIPTION: Fully heals one party member. Uses up a turn when used in combat.
messages.ITEM_COFFEE2_DESCRIPTION: Strong tinned coffee that provides 4 additional AP. Uses up a turn during combat.
messages.ITEM_COFFEE1_DESCRIPTION: Tinned coffee that provides 2 additional AP. Uses up a turn during combat.
messages.ITEM_COFFEE3_DESCRIPTION: A small can packed with a shot of instant energy that provides 6 additional AP. Uses up a turn during combat.
messages.ITEM_COFFEE4_DESCRIPTION: Two shots of espresso in a tin that provide 8 additional AP. Uses up a turn during combat.
messages.ITEM_METAL_DESCRIPTION: A basic recycled resource that can be exchanged for items and services.
messages.ITEM_SMOKE_BOMB_DESCRIPTION: Guarantees a successful escape from a wild monster. Won’t fool humans and other sentient creatures though.
messages.ITEM_FUSED_MATERIAL_DESCRIPTION: It smells strongly of rotten eggs, but rangers seem to regard it as valuable!
messages.ITEM_TUTORIAL_NO_TUTS: Go meet Kayleigh east of Harbourtown first!
messages.ITEM_TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION: A handbook that Kayleigh left for you. You can read this to review what you’ve learned about life on the island of New Wirral.
messages.ITEM_TUTORIAL_GIVE_TYPE_CHART: Oh – a card fell out of the back of the handbook!
messages.ITEM_PLASTIC_DESCRIPTION: A basic recycled resource that can be exchanged for items and services.
messages.ITEM_TYPE_CHART_DESCRIPTION: A diagram on a card that fell out of the Ranger Handbook Kayleigh left for you. It details the elemental types of the monsters of New Wirral and how to use them to your advantage.
messages.ITEM_OLD_BOOK_DESCRIPTION: It’s an old book with a lot of strange words in it.
messages.ITEM_WHEAT_DESCRIPTION: A basic resource that can be turned into food by certain people.
messages.ITEM_PULP_DESCRIPTION: Mulched paper. A basic recycled resource that can be exchanged for items and services.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIT_ONE_STATUS_TARGET: Hits one target. Gives the target {status_effect} status.
messages.ITEM_WOOD_DESCRIPTION: A basic recycled resource that can be exchanged for items and services.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_BASIC_DESCRIPTION: Records monster forms with a normal efficiency rate.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_CHROME_DESCRIPTION: Records monster forms with a high efficiency rate.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_BLACK_SHUCK_DESCRIPTION: A mysterious black tape left behind by Black Shuck.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_OPTICAL_LASER_DESCRIPTION: Uses futuristic laser-based technology to store monster forms efficiently. Guarantees a successful recording.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_BEAST_DESCRIPTION: A tape covered in faux fur material. Has a very high efficiency rate when used to record Beast-type monsters. Popular with children.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_FIRE_DESCRIPTION: The label says it’s safe to heat in a toaster. This strange promotional tape was once distributed with breakfast pastries, until the inevitable burned palms and housefires caused a raft of complaints. Has a very high efficiency rate when used to record Fire-type monsters though.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_PLASTIC_DESCRIPTION: A tape apparently made from “100% recycled plastic”. Has a very high efficiency rate when used to record Plastic-type monsters.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_PLANT_DESCRIPTION: A tape with a shell made of actual treebark. Has a very high efficiency rate when used to record Plant-type monsters.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_WATER_DESCRIPTION: A tape made of transparent plastic, sealed and filled with water. There are two buttons on the side that allow you to play a ring-toss game while you’re not using it. Has a very high efficiency rate when used to record Water-type monsters.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_ASTRAL_DESCRIPTION: An immaterial tape that has an annoying habit of sometimes passing through other objects. Tiny pinpricks of light like far-off stars can be seen through its surface. Has a very high efficiency rate when used to record Astral-type monsters.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_POISON_DESCRIPTION: A fashionable tape made of faux snakeskin. Has a very high efficiency rate when used to record Poison-type monsters.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_ICE_DESCRIPTION: A frigid tape made of ice that never seems to melt. The label warns the user to keep it out of water. Has a very high efficiency rate when used to record Ice-type monsters.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_LIGHTNING_DESCRIPTION: A tape with a label that boasts “Bose-Einstein Condensate Inside!” Has a very high efficiency rate when used to record Lightning-type monsters.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_AIR_DESCRIPTION: A tape with a very high efficiency rate when used to record Air-type monsters. In a pinch, it can also be used as hair spray.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_METAL_DESCRIPTION: Has a very high efficiency rate when used to record Metal-type monsters.
messages.ITEM_TAPE_EARTH_DESCRIPTION: A tape with a hardened ceramic shell. Has a very high efficiency rate when used to record Earth-type monsters.
messages.BOOSTER_PACK_DESCRIPTION: A themed booster pack of 4 stickers including one guaranteed uncommon or rare!
messages.REGION_NAME_TOWN_OUTSKIRTS_CAVES_PHRASE: in the caves in the outskirts
messages.REGION_NAME_NEW_WIRRAL_PARK_CAVES_PHRASE: in the caves in the park
messages.REGION_NAME_DEADLANDS_CAVES_PHRASE: in the caves in the Deadlands
messages.REGION_NAME_LAKE_CAVES_PHRASE: in the caves under the lake
messages.REGION_NAME_MT_WIRRAL_CAVES_PHRASE: in the caves on Mt. Wirral
messages.REGION_NAME_EASTHAM_WOODS_CAVES_PHRASE: in the caves in Eastham Woods
messages.REGION_NAME_MEADOW_CAVES_PHRASE: in the caves in Cherry Meadow
messages.REGION_NAME_MARSH_CAVES_PHRASE: in the caves in the marsh
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIT_TEAM_DESTROY_WALL: Hits a whole team. Destroys walls.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIT_ONE_UNAVOIDABLE: Hits one target. Cannot be evaded.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIT_ONE_PRIORITY: Hits one target. Takes priority over other moves.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIT_ONE_RETURN_DAMAGE: Hits one target. Also damages the user a little.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIT_ONE_MULTI_PRIORITY: Hits one target multiple times, with priority over other moves.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIT_ONE_MULTI_LOW_PRIOR: Hits one target multiple times, with reduced priority compared with other moves.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIT_TEAM_MULTI: Hits each member of a team multiple times.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIT_ALL_NOT_SELF: Hits everyone on the battlefield except the user.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIT_ONE_STATUS_USER: Hits one target. Gives the user {status_effect} status.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIT_TEAM_STATUS_USER: Hits a whole team. Gives the user {status_effect} status.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIT_TEAM_STATUS_TARGET: Hits a whole team. Gives the target {status_effect} status.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STARTER1_ATTACK: Hits one target. Lowers the target’s Evasion.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STARTER2_ATTACK: Hits one target. Lowers the target’s Accuracy.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STARTER1_PASSIVE: The user’s Speed is passively raised in proportion to the amount of HP lost.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STARTER2_PASSIVE: The user’s Evasion is passively raised in proportion to the amount of HP lost.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ELEMENTAL_RESISTANCE: Passively reduces incoming {type}-type damage by {percent}%, and negates any reactions that would occur. Does not affect critical hits.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_NURSE: Heals one target for 50% of their Max HP.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_METAL_RIFF: Hits a whole team. Becomes an Air-type attack when equipped to a Metal-type tape.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_REVOLVING_DOOR: Steals the target’s wall and transfers it to the user.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BLOOD_DONATION: Reduces the user’s HP by half, giving it to the target.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FAIR_FIGHT: Prevents new status effects from being applied for 3 turns.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_NEW_LEAF: Removes status effects from the target.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BUSHFIRE: Changes the user’s type to Fire, and makes them deal additional Fire damage on contact. Also burns the user.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_UNDERTOW: Hits the last fighter to take their turn before this move.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_PUMPKIN_PIE: Raises the user’s Speed and AP generation.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_COPY_THAT: Transforms the user into a copy of the target.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FROZEN_GROUND: Massively raises the user’s Speed, but lowers their accuracy.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ICICLE_DART: Hits one target. Uses the user’s Speed stat instead of Ranged Attack.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SHIELD_BASH: Hits one target. Uses the user’s Melee Defence stat instead of Melee Attack.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_DAMAGE_ROLL: The user rolls a 20-sided die. Damage is multiplied by the number of the die. Special effects take place on rolls of 1 or 20.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CHANGE_THE_RECORD: Forces the target to randomly switch to another of their tapes.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_AP_DONATE: Shifts all remaining AP from the user to the target.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_AVALANCHE: All melee attacks fail this round.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CLOSE_ENCOUNTER: The target’s ranged attacks become melee attacks.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_AP_FACTORY: Automatically shifts all the user’s AP to its allies at the start of each round.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_WALL: Sacrifice 20% of HP to create a wall that will absorb up to 3 hits for up to 3 turns.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SPRING_LOAD: Automatically gives the user the Spring-Loaded status if they don’t already have it. This turns the user’s melee attack into ranged attacks.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FOG: Reduces accuracy of ranged attacks that aren’t Water, Air or Ice-type to 0% for 3 turns.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_TAKE_FLIGHT: The user takes flight and can only be hit by ranged attacks, Air-types and other flying characters.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_COATING: Changes the type of the user or an ally.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ABRAMACABRA: Sacrifice 20% of HP to create a wall that will absorb up to 3 hits for up to 3 turns. This wall will also damage one opponent each turn.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STATUS_TARGET: Gives the target {status_effect} status for {duration} turn(s).
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STATUS_USER: Gives the user {status_effect} status for {duration} turn(s).
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CLAY_FIRED: Activates when the user takes Fire-type damage from an attack. Raises the user’s defence stats.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_MIND_MELD: The user shares its moves with its allies.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_TRAFFIC_JAM: Lowers all other fighters’ Speed stats.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FLINCH_ONE: Chance to cause the target to flinch.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STICKY_TONGUE: Hits one target. Lowers the target’s Evasion.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ICE_BREAKER: Hits one target. Lowers the target’s Speed.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_YULE_REGRET_THAT: Hits one target. Lands a critical hit if the target has already taken damage this turn.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_AP_STEAL: Steals 1 AP from the target and gives it to the user.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_PREEMPTIVE_STRIKE: Automatically hits one opponent at the start of battle.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_REVENGE_STRIKE: Chance to be used automatically when hit with a melee attack.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SPLINTER: Chance to hurt an opponent automatically upon melee contact. Damage is based on the user’s Melee Defence.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ACID_REFLEX: Chance to poison an opponent automatically upon melee contact.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SELF_DESTRUCT: Causes the user to explode upon defeat, damaging all of those around it.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_RADIOACTIVE: Chance to burn an opponent automatically upon melee contact.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_AP_REFUND: Chance to automatically refund AP after a move is used.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_AP_STARTER: Grants 1 extra AP at the start of battle.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ROLL_AGAIN: Chance to automatically use another move at random, at the end of the turn.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SUIT_UP: Raises the user’s Melee Defence and Ranged Defence.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_PARRY_STANCE: Reflects the first melee attack received this round.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HP_ABSORB: Recovers an amount of HP equal to the damage dealt.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HOT_POTATO: Places a bomb on the target that will explode if not immediately passed on by melee contact.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SURE_FIRE: Guarantees the target’s next move won’t miss.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_COTTON_ON: Reduces the accuracy of moves that can be evaded that target the user to 0% for the next round.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_TAUNT: Sends the target berserk, forcing it to use only damaging moves for its next 2 turns.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_DOG_YEARS: Extends the duration of the target’s status effects.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BE_RANDOM: Uses a random move that you have enough AP for.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_COPYCAT: Copies the last move the target used, if you have the AP.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_PROVOKE: Prevents opponents from directly targeting the user’s allies for 3 turns.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIBERNATE: Puts the user to sleep. The user recovers HP every turn it’s asleep.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SUMMON_TULPA: Calls for help from the astral plane.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_MEDITATE: Puts the user to sleep. Increases the user’s attack and defence stats every turn it’s asleep.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BINVITATION: Calls for help from the mothership.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CALL_FOR_HELP: Chance to summon a temporary ally.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FUSION_POWER: Has an effect unique to this fusion pairing.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FISSION_POWER: The user undergoes fission, dividing itself into two copies.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CROSSFADE: Switches the user’s form but applies a coating that keeps its type the same.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_DESPERATION: Does more damage if the user is low on health.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_DELEGATE: Transfers the user’s status effects onto its ally.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BITE: Hits one target. Heals the user a little bit afterwards.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BATTERY: Hits one target twice. Lands critical hits if used after Charge.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BOIL: Hits one target. Chance to burn the target.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_DJINNTOXICATE: Hits one target. Inflicts the Confused status on the target.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_COAL_STORY: Hits one target. Inflicts Burned on the target.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_TOXIC_STAB: Hits one target. Poisons the target.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SANDSTORM: Hits a whole team. Reduces the targets’ remaining status effect durations by 1.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_PUSTULE_BOMB: Hits a whole team. Poisons the targets.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_WONDERFUL_7: Hits one target. Inflicts a random debuff.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_THROW: Uses a wall as a projectile. Remaining duration multiplies damage.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_RECYCLE: Destroys the user’s wall and gives them an amount of AP equal to its remaining duration.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_MAGNET: Used automatically at the start of battle for 0 AP. Prevents opponents targeting user’s allies for {duration} turn(s).
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_RETRIBUTION: Activates when an ally is defeated. Raises the user’s attack stats.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STATUS_STARTER: Used automatically at the start of battle for 0 AP. Gives the user {status_effect} status for {duration} turn(s).
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_TOWER_DEFENSE: Changes the user’s type to Earth, and raises their Defence stats. Takes effect the first time the user’s health falls below half.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_THUNDER_BLAST: Hits one target. The target is hit by an additional 30 Air-type damage.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_GAMBIT: Raises all the user’s stats by a lot. After 3 turns, the tape breaks.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HAUNT: The user becomes a ghost and cannot be hit by attacks. After 3 turns, the tape breaks.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BINVASION: Hits one target as many times as there are Binvaders on the user’s team.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_COPPER_CHOP: Hits one target. Inflicts Resonance on Glass- and Metal-type targets.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_WINDOW: Allows Ranged Attacks to hit the target through walls.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_DAMAGE_ON_TRANSFORM: Damages the target each time it transforms.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SHARP_EDGES: Gives the user a Contact Damage status for {duration} turn(s).
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_JAGGED_EDGE: Automatically inflicts damage when a melee attack misses the user.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BLIZZARD: Hits a whole team. Lowers the targets’ Accuracy.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_MOUNTAIN_SMASH: Hits one target. Lowers the target’s Melee Defence.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_TRICK: Gives the target a random debuff.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_TREAT: Gives the target a random buff.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CRUMBLE: Destroys every wall, inflicting damage to each fighter with a wall proportional to the remaining duration of their wall.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_PRISMATIC: Randomises the user’s type at the end of each round.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BAD_JOKE: The user tells a random joke. This has no effect.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_WATER_DANCE: Hits one target. Uses the user’s Speed stat instead of Melee Attack.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_RITUAL: Brings the user back to life at 25% HP upon defeat.
messages.MOVE_ATTRIBUTE_SPECIALIZATION_HEAL: Heals {stat_value}% of Max HP per empty slot
messages.MOVE_ATTRIBUTE_AP_REFUND: {chance}% Chance to refund {amount} AP after use
messages.MOVE_ATTRIBUTE_AP_REFUND_ALL: {chance}% Chance to refund all AP after use
messages.MOVE_ATTRIBUTE_AUTO_USE_round_ending: {chance}% Chance to use at the end of a round
messages.MOVE_ATTRIBUTE_AUTO_USE_battle_start: {chance}% Chance to use at the start of battles
messages.MOVE_ATTRIBUTE_USE_RANDOM: {chance}% Chance to use a random move
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE3: Why don’t Traffikrabs share their food? Because they’re shellfish!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE2: What does Traffikrab put on its traffic toast? Traffic jam!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE1: Why did the Traffikrab NOT cross the road? It could only do the side walk!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE5: Why do Skelevangelists always play the xylophone? They don’t have organs!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE4: Why did Traffikrab’s friends ghost him? His puns were clawful!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE7: What do Bulletinos eat? Nothing, they fast!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE6: How does Icepeck build its home? Igloos it together!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE8: What does Sanzatime do after eating if it’s still hungry? It goes back four seconds!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE11: Did you hear about Stardigrade’s claustrophobia? He just really needs some space.
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE10: Why should you never eat Sanzatime? It’s too time-consuming!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE9: How much does a pile of bones covered in purple slime weigh? One jelly-ton!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE12: What do Sparktan wear under their armour? Thunderpants!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE13: What do you call a Liligator in a vest? An investigator!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE16: Why did the Twirligig get promoted? She was outstanding in her field!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE15: I have a joke about elemental chemistry, but I doubt it’ll get a reaction...
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE14: Why did the Jumpkin couple have a big wedding? Because they cantaloupe!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE18: Why did the Landkeeper seek a psychiatrist? He had an apartment complex!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE17: Where do Busheye go to learn? Elementree school!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE19: What’s a Landkeeper’s favourite hot drink? Proper-tea!
messages.MOVE_BAD_JOKE_JOKE20: What kind of clothing will a Landkeeper try to sell you? An ad-dress!
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_INSOMNIA: Prevents the user from falling asleep.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ELDRITCH: Prevents the user’s stats from being lowered.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STATUS_RESISTANCE: The user takes reduced damage from the Burned, Poisoned, and Leeched status effects.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_LIQUID_BODY: Prevents the user from being inflicted with Burned, but makes all incoming Ice and Lightning-type attacks critical.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_NEUTRALISE: Automatically removes the user’s debuffs when their HP falls below 50%.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_PHASE SHIFT: The user’s attacks can hit ghosts.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CAMOUFLAGE: Changes the type of the user. Automatically used at the start of battle for 0 AP.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_RICOCHET: The user’s ranged attacks have a 50% chance to ignore opponents’ walls.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BREATHING_TECHNIQUE: Prevents the user from being inflicted with Berserk.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SELF_ASSURED: Prevents the user from being inflicted with Confused.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CRITICAL_AP: The user gains 1 AP each time they land a critical hit.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_PITY_AP: The user gains 1 AP each time an attack of theirs misses.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_UNSHAKEABLE: Prevents the user from being inflicted with Flinched.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_VAMPIRE: The user gains half the benefit of opponents’ healing moves and status effects.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_MULTICOPY: If an opponent gains multitarget or multistrike, the user does so too.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FOSSIL: Automatically restores the user to full health if they become Petrified.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BLOODLUST: Automatically raises the user’s Melee and Ranged Attack stats when an opponent is defeated.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STURDY_ARMOUR: Prevents the user’s Melee and Ranged Defence stats from being lowered.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_RETURN_FIRE: Chance to be used automatically when hit with a ranged attack.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BURNING_PASSION: Automatically raises the user’s Ranged and Melee Attack whenever the user gains the Burned status effect.
messages.SPRINGHEEL_LORE_2: For a time in Victorian England, a mysterious creature known as “Spring-heeled Jack” was said to stalk the streets at night. “Jack” was never captured, and his sighting soon become a thing of folkloric legend.
messages.SPRINGHEEL_LORE_1: Springheels get their kicks by hiding behind corners under the cover of night, before leaping out to surprise their victims. It appears that they make their “wings” out of old discarded rags.
messages.SPRINGHEEL_EVOLUTION_SPECIALIZATION_QUES: What path of night do you wish to walk?
messages.HOPSKIN_LORE_1: The Hopskin will entice its prey to approach with its unblinking amber eyes and a big smile. However, any creature that is lured in by this charade will be swiftly cut down by the razor sharp claws it conceals beneath a dirty coat.
messages.HOPSKIN_DESCRIPTION: a shifty imp in a coat
messages.HOPSKIN_LORE_2: In 1955, a family reported being attacked by strange creatures at their farmhouse in Hopkinsville, Kentucky. They described these creatures as having pointy ears, clawed hands and large eyes that glowed yellow.
messages.RIPTERRA_LORE_2: In 19th century Britain, tales of gothic horrors and vicious cutthroats published and sold in the form of “penny dreadfuls”. This cheaply produced literature was often accompanied by shocking and violent illustrations.
messages.RIPTERRA_LORE_1: The anatomy of the Ripterra is not easily described. It barely has a body to speak of, instead more a tangled web of claw-tipped limbs haphazardly bound together beneath a stained trench coat and hat.
messages.SNOOPIN_LORE_1: Snoopins are master thieves, and will often adorn themselves with their stolen treasures. As such, you can judge a Snoopin’s skill in thievery by the amount of trinkets it is wearing.
messages.SNOOPIN_LORE_2: Arséne Lupin is a fictional “gentleman thief” from the works of writer Maurice Leblanc. The character has remained popular even to the present day, appearing in dozens of stories and many adaptations.
messages.SCAMPIRE_LORE_1: Scampires create lairs of countless stolen riches and goods before waiting for potential prey to wander in. In recent years they have also gained the ability to fly, though it is unclear whether they use their wings to do it.
messages.SCAMPIRE_LORE_2: Vampires have appeared as a concept in folklore throughout human history. One modern interpretation of the vampire myth frames them as representing the elites in society who literally feed off those below their class.
messages.ACHIEVEMENT_NAME_quest_kayleigh_complete: I Ran So Far Away, pt. II
messages.ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_met_npc_magikrab: Meet the one who dutily attends the stations.
messages.ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_met_npc_amber: Find a helping hand in a place far away.
messages.ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_met_npc_merline: Come face-to-face with a faceless being.
messages.ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_preemptive_win: Win a battle before it starts.
messages.ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_ending: Open a door long since thought lost.
messages.ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_gambit_win: Win a battle while Gambit is active.
messages.ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_head_skip: Try to sneak past a battler by jumping over their head.
messages.ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_defeat_black_shuck: Overcome your own self in battle.
messages.ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_obtain_magikrab: Obtain a monster form thought impossible to find.
messages.ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_aa_lenna: Prove your worth to a certain warrior.
messages.PUPPERCUT_LORE_2: Boxing is a competitive sport where two participants punch each other using protective gloves. Archaeological evidence shows that humans have been boxing in at least some form since ancient civilisation.
messages.PUPPERCUT_DESCRIPTION: a squat wolf with rusted metal boxing gear
messages.SOUTHPAW_LORE_2: Modern boxing finds its origin in “Queensbury rules”, a formalised set of rules first drafted in Victorian England. It defined a twelve round limit, large protective gloves and the 24 foot square boxing arena that are recognisable in modern boxing today.
messages.SOUTHPAW_LORE_1: Southpaws are the final stage of a Puppercut’s life cycle, having shed their rusty armour. Their bodies are now coated with a lightweight and flexible metal that allow them to withstand attacks and deliver swift blows with their spiked fists.
messages.SOUTHPAW_DESCRIPTION: a tall wolf with shiny metal boxing gear
messages.BURNACE_LORE_1: Burnaces have no legs, and can only move by sliding their heavy concrete bodies along the ground with their hands. Their endlessly burning internal furnaces allow them to emit flames and toxic smogs from their “chimneys” at a moment’s notice.
messages.BURNACE_LORE_2: The Industrial Revolution was a period of time beginning in the 1700s where production in the western world shifted towards machines, and technology began to advance rapidly. The image of the factory with smoke pouring from its chimneys is heavily associated with this time.
messages.SMOGMAGOG_LORE_1: Smogmagog’s “bodies” are actually outer shells made of steel and concrete that house a purely elemental fire being within. As long as a single ember still remains alight within its shell, the Smogmagog will continue to fight.
messages.SMOGMAGOG_LORE_2: Gogmagog is the name of a giant in British mythology. A denizen of Albion (the precursor to modern day Great Britain), he was slain by the warrior Corineus, who later founded the land of Cornwall.
messages.CANDEVIL_LORE_2: Devils, or Demons, are evil spirits or beings depicted in folklore and religions across all of human culture and history. Their depictions vary greatly, from being benign nuisances to dangerous manifestations of evil.
messages.CANDEVIL_LORE_1: Candevils possess the peculiar ability to generate sugary sweets from their bodies, which can be used as gifts or as ballistic projectiles. Some find this quite charming, whereas others argue that it’s actually very weird and gross.
messages.CANDEVIL_EVOLUTION_SPECIALIZATION_QUESTI: In which field do you wish to study?
messages.MALCHEMY_LORE_1: A series of strange internal chemical changes can cause a Candevil to mature into a Malchemy. This also causes the Malchemy to become fixated on the esoteric art of potion making, which often ends up badly for the Malchemy.
messages.MALCHEMY_LORE_2: Alchemy is a field of study that was a precursor to modern scientific chemistry, and is concerned with magical or spiritual transformation and creation of elements.
messages.MALCHEMY_DESCRIPTION: a smiling devil holding a glass vial
messages.MIASMODEUS_DESCRIPTION: a witch demon riding a lollipop
messages.MIASMODEUS_LORE_2: In medieval Europe, “witches” were women who were accused of practicing witchcraft within their communities. These witches were portrayed in art as brewing potions, having animal familiars and riding broomsticks to attain flight.
messages.MIASMODEUS_LORE_1: Packs of Miasmodeus are said to soar through the skies on their flying lollipops on a full moon. They use their many alchemical concoctions in battle, unleashing poisonous potions and deadly elements to lay waste to their opponents.
messages.VENDEMON_LORE_1: A Candevil that has built itself a suit of protective armour out of metal and glass. It has been theorised that their strange attire is an attempt to resemble astronauts, but no-one knows for sure.
messages.VENDEMON_LORE_2: The first gumball machines appeared in early 20th Century America. A clockwork mechanism ensures that when a coin is inserted, the machine can dispense a single gumball or piece of candy with a turn of its handle.
messages.VENDEMON_DESCRIPTION: a devil wearing a gumball machine
messages.GUMBAAL_LORE_1: Gumbaals have fused with their metal armour and have morphed into a towering being. The glass dome that forms its head is filled with various elemental spheres, which the Gumbaal can spit up as an offensive measure.
messages.GUMBAAL_LORE_2: “Candy” is a broad term that encompasses a range of edible treats that usually use sugar as a main ingredient. Candy is often made to be visually appealing, coming in a range of shapes, sizes and flavours.
messages.BANSHEEP_LORE_2: Ghosts commonly appear in folklore across all of human history and civilisation as manifestations of spirits of the deceased. Whether they are harmless or malevolent varies on the depiction, or often the personality of the departed.
messages.BANSHEEP_LORE_1: The eerie moans of the wild Bansheep at night have led many to believe that they are restless undead spirits, but this is untrue: they are very much alive, they just like to have a bit of a whine. Who doesn’t?
messages.BANSHEEP_EVOLUTION_SPECIALIZATION_QUESTI: A spirit cannot remain in limbo forever.
messages.WOOLTERGEIST_LORE_2: It is said that there are many types of ghosts – one such example is the poltergeist. The poltergeist is unique in its ability to interact extensively with the physical world, and is able to move and propel objects as it wishes.
messages.WOOLTERGEIST_LORE_1: Unlike the Bansheep, the Wooltergeist is an undead spirit that only partially manifests on the physical plane. It is said that when it is in proximity to a place where a death recently took place, the horns on its head grow sharper.
messages.WOOLTERGEIST_DESCRIPTION: a sheep-like ghost with a tired expression
messages.RAMTASM_LORE_2: In some iterations of ghost folklore, a restless spirit that lingers on earth cannot pass on to the afterlife unless it has had its final wishes fulfilled. Until then, they are destined to linger eternally.
messages.RAMTASM_LORE_1: The Ramtasm has honed its connection between the spiritual and physical realms, and is able to fully manifest itself across both simultaneously. This gives it access to an untapped well of tremendous astral energy.
messages.ZOMBLEAT_LORE_2: A “zombie” is a mythical being; typically a dead body that has been reanimated as a mindless and dangerous creature. Zombies are commonplace in popular culture, appearing in many horror books and movies.
messages.ZOMBLEAT_LORE_1: The Zombleat is a spirit that has refused to ascend to the afterlife. It clings to the grave and earth where it was buried, and may perhaps leave the mortal plane forever if it were to let go of its own headstone.
messages.ZOMBLEAT_DESCRIPTION: a ghostly sheep carrying a gravestone
messages.CAPRICORPSE_LORE_2: Gravestones are used as part of traditional burial ceremonies to mark the place where a body has been placed beneath the earth. Typically, they are made of stone and feature incriptions indicating the name of the deceased.
messages.CAPRICORPSE_LORE_1: The Capricorpse’s spirit has merged entirely with its own remains, forming a body of bone, soil and stone. They are hulking beasts, and can grow larger over centuries as more earth slowly adds to their mass.
messages.CAPRICORPSE_DESCRIPTION: a skeletal sheep with a gravestone on its back
messages.OLDGANTE_LORE_2: Her body had been shattered – it is hard to imagine what kind of strength could have done such a thing.
messages.OLDGANTE_LORE_1: A wounded Archangel who was once a great power. Morgante’s voice carries a force that can tear the fabric of reality itself, but this power is weakened in this state.
messages.MAIN_CREDITS_THANK_YOU: Thank you so much for playing!
messages.REACTION_GLITTER_ON_ANY_TUTORIAL: Landing a Glitter-type attack covers the target with a layer of glitter, causing them to become Glitter-type themselves.
messages.REACTION_ANY_ON_GLITTER_TUTORIAL: Hitting a Glitter-type monster with any type of elemental attack causes the Glitter monster to change type to match the attack.
messages.REACTION_BEAST_ON_GLASS_TUTORIAL: Like a bull in a china shop, landing a Beast-type attack on a Glass-type opponent scatters sharp obstacles across the battlefield.
messages.REACTION_FIRE_ON_PLASTIC_TUTORIAL: Melting a Plastic-type monster with a Fire-type attack releases noxious fumes, changing it to Poison type.
messages.REACTION_FIRE_ON_PLANT_TUTORIAL: Plant-types are easily Burned by Fire-type attacks, and suffer lasting damage.
messages.REACTION_FIRE_ON_WATER_TUTORIAL: Heating a Water-type with a Fire-type attack releases a hot steam that heals the Water-type as it recondenses.
messages.REACTION_FIRE_ON_POISON_TUTORIAL: Poisons found in New Wirral tend to be flammable, and can be ignited with a Fire-type attack.
messages.REACTION_FIRE_ON_ICE_TUTORIAL: Landing a Fire-type attack on an Ice-type target causes it to melt, becoming Water-type.
messages.REACTION_FIRE_ON_ASTRAL_TUTORIAL: Astral-types draw their power from the four elements: Fire, Earth, Air, and Water.
messages.LOBSTACLE_LORE_2: Roadside barriers come in many variations depending on their needs. As well as barriers built into roadsides, recycled tires or plastic barrels filled with sand have been used as mobile barriers for traffic protection.
messages.LOBSTACLE_LORE_1: Lobstacles are docile and patient creatures. When retracted into their plastic “shells”, the heavy Lobstacle is almost impossible to move or overturn.
messages.DANDYLION_LORE_2: Guardian lions are traditional Chinese ornaments commonly seen outside buildings. In the past, they were thought to ward off harm, and were placed outside places of importance such as tombs or imperial palaces.
messages.DANDYLION_LORE_1: Dandylions are loyal, defensive guardians. They’re typically found standing at the entrances to important caves in the grassy plains of New Wirral. If you find one with no cave nearby, it may be a hint that something is hidden!
messages.BLOSSOMAW_LORE_2: Contrasting with the winged European depictions, dragons in Chinese mythology have long serpentine bodies with four legs and no wings. They are traditional symbols of strength and good luck.
messages.BLOSSOMAW_LORE_1: Dandylions that enter a long hibernation period are said to emerge as elegant Blossomaws in spring, just as the first flowers begin to bloom. They can breathe fierce clouds of pollen in the way a dragon might breathe fire.
messages.BLOSSOMAW_DESCRIPTION: a long dragon with a mane of petals
messages.DOMINOTH_LORE_1: Dominoths see themselves as defenders of peace, and spend their days patrolling the skies of woodland areas. The only thing that can distract them from their noble duties are bright lights, such as lamps.
messages.DOMINOTH_LORE_2: Whereas the butterfly often has symbolic and folkloric associations with life and rebirth, the moth is commonly associated with death and ill tidings.
messages.TOKUSECT_LORE_2: “Tokusatsu” is the name given to Japanese movies and television shows that feature distinct special effects and costumes. Tokusatsu media often features giant monsters, giant robots and superheroes doing battle.
messages.TOKUSECT_LORE_1: Tokusects have extremely aerodynamic bodies, aiding a fighting style that is focused around using their pointed legs to strike opponents and channel powerful currents of air.
messages.WINGLOOM_LORE_1: The lightbulbs in a Wingloom’s head channel an electric current that runs through the creature’s entire body. The lights generated by them are reflected out its eyes, allowing them perfect vision at night.
messages.WINGLOOM_LORE_2: It isn’t entirely known what causes moths to be drawn to artificial lights. One theory for this behaviour is that moths orient themselves using the moon when travelling.
messages.MOTHMANIC_LORE_2: “Mothman” is a folkloric creature from West Virginia. Various sightings from the 1960’s described it as a large winged humanoid being with striking red eyes. Since the initial sightings, it has since become a popular urban legend.
messages.MOTHMANIC_LORE_1: The Mothmanic’s whole body surges with powerful currents of electricity. It can wield this power offensively, and is able to dispense devastating bolts of lightning towards its targets with a beat of its wings.
messages.STARDIGRADE_LORE_1: Stardigrades are curious creatures, spending much of their time asleep in the lower atmosphere of New Wirral. Occasionally they will float down to ground-level to feed, before ascending once more using the rockets on their backs.
messages.STARDIGRADE_LORE_2: Tardigrades, also called Water Bears, are microscopic beings found all over earth. They are perhaps most well known in popular culture for their extreme durability – their resilience is such that they can even survive in the vacuum of space.
messages.GALAGOR_LORE_1: A Stardigrade that has evolved super intelligence. Its outer armour almost entirely covers its pink worm-like core, which is partially visible through the glass dome on its helmet.
messages.GALAGOR_LORE_2: Astrobiology is the study and research of theoretical extraterrestrial life. Astrobiologists research the origins of life on Earth, and whether a similar process could potentially have occurred on other planets within the known universe.
messages.GALAGOR_DESCRIPTION: a floating space bug with a cape
messages.FAUCETEAR_LORE_2: Taps, or faucets, are valves that control the dispensing of liquid and have shown to have existed as far back as the Roman empire. Early plumbing taps and valves have been discovered in the ruins of the destroyed Roman city Pompeii.
messages.FAUCETEAR_LORE_1: The Faucetear’s ability to project powerful streams of pressurised water is tied directly to their emotional state. They are very easily startled and upset, which leads them to often unexpectedly use their water attacks without intending to.
messages.FOUNTESS_LORE_2: Whilst humans have been “showering” in some form as long as civilisation has existed, the first mechanical shower was invented in the 1700s by English inventor William Feetham. This shower pumped cold water into a basin, which the user could release over them with a chain.
messages.FOUNTESS_LORE_1: Fountess’ take a lot of pride in the manners and etiquette of their own behaviour, and that of others. If they perceive someone acting uncouth, they are immediately distressed – which drastically increases the pressure in the streams of water pouring from their heads.
messages.TERRACOOKA_LORE_1: Terracookas are aspiring chefs, and will attempt to cook with whatever ingredients they can find in their subterranean cave habitats. Unfortunately this means that most of their practiced recipes include lichen, moss, or both lichen and moss.
messages.TERRACOOKA_LORE_2: Dogu are clay figurines that have been found across Japan. They date back to a prehistoric era of civilisation, and are often depictions of humanoid figures or animals.
messages.COALDRON_LORE_1: Coaldrons are living cooking pots, constantly brewing a delicious broth in their basin bodies. Whilst not very mobile, they are able to turn their bodies in order to shoot streams of this steaming hot broth at anyone who may approach for a taste without invitation.
messages.COALDRON_DESCRIPTION: a tall ceramic figure with a cauldron body
messages.COALDRON_LORE_2: Cauldrons are large pots, generally metal or ceramic, used for cooking food or medicine over a fire. Cauldrons have been found all over the world dating back to prehistoric times, and thus appear in the folklore of many cultures in various ways.
messages.PUPPERCUT_LORE_1: The Puppercut is an aspiring boxer. Although they are born with an iron coating over various parts of their bodies, this outer layer is prone to rust. The rusty layer sheds as they mature to their adult forms.
messages.SIRENADE_DESCRIPTION: a winged beast with a microphone tail
messages.DECIBELLE_LORE_1: Very few Decibelles have been seen in the wild. Early denizens of New Wirral whispered of seeing white dragons in the clouds, but it is unclear whether they were seeing Decibelles, or just losing their minds.
messages.DECIBELLE_DESCRIPTION: a winged beast with ribbon wings
messages.DECIBELLE_LORE_2: Harpies appear in Greek mythology as mythological creatures that manifested winds and storms. Like Sirens, they are described as half-bird and half-human beings.
messages.CARNIVIPER_LORE_2: The “tsuchinoko” is a creature of Japanese folklore. Similar to a snake, it is described as having the venomous fangs of a viper, but with a somewhat flat body.
messages.CARNIVIPER_LORE_1: Despite its grinning visage, the Carniviper isn’t actually a friendly creature. It is very territorial, and will attack anyone who approaches that it deems a threat… which tends to be everything and everyone.
messages.MASQUERATTLE_LORE_2: Snakes and serpents hold significance in almost all world mythology and folklore. Why is that? Perhaps it is their unblinking eyes? Their limbless forms? Their deadly bite?
messages.MASQUERATTLE_LORE_1: It is often presumed that Masquerattles use the face-like armour plates on their heads to lure in unsuspecting prey. This is a myth – the faces on their heads are actually very creepy, and couldn’t possibly convince anyone to approach them.
messages.MASQUERATTLE_EVOLUTION_SPECIALIZATION_QU: Which aspect of the serpent do you embody?
messages.MARDIUSA_LORE_2: In Greek Mythology, Medusa is one of the Gorgons, a trio of women who had snakes for hair, who could turn anyone who looked into their eyes to stone.
messages.MARDIUSA_LORE_1: The Mardiusa isn’t an individual, but a hive-mind – a collection of tiny serpentile creatures with a singular unified goal. In this case, that goal is for the Mardiusa to dress like it is on its way to a fancy ball – and to have a good time doing it.
messages.JORMUNGOLD_LORE_2: In Norse Mythology, the great serpent Jörmungandr is prophesied to end the world.
messages.JORMUNGOLD_LORE_1: Curiously, the Jormungold’s wings aren’t actually capable of making the huge serpent airborne. Instead they help it slither along the ground at great speeds, each wingbeat sending the beast hurtling forwards.
messages.AEROBOROS_LORE_1: The Aeroboros is able to cycle winds through the inner ring of its circular body. Those swirling winds can then be projected out at great speed to sweep its foes off their feet.
messages.AEROBOROS_LORE_2: The ouroboros is an ancient symbol that represents the cycle of life, death and rebirth. The symbol is of a snake eating its own tail, forming a circle.
messages.TRAFFIKRAB_LORE_2: The traffic cone was invented by Charles D. Scanlon in the 1940’s as a low-maintenance way to signal road repairs. Commonly made of orange or yellow plastic, they can also feature a white reflective stripe to increase visibility at night.
messages.TRAFFIKRAB_LORE_1: The Traffikrab’s cone isn’t actually part of its body – it is merely a traffic cone that has washed up on the shores of New Wirral and been occupied by the creature. It is said that in the past, they would instead find other objects to live inside.
messages.WEEVILITE_LORE_1: The Weevilite’s long necks allow them to spot weaker monsters from afar, and by alternating flashes of their red and green eyes they can paralyse their prey with dizziness and mild migraines.
messages.WEEVILITE_LORE_2: The first traffic lights were placed in London in the mid-1800’s. These early traffic signals used gas lights, but the electric traffic light became commonplace from the early 20th century onwards.
messages.MUSKRATEER_LORE_2: “The Three Musketeers” is a famous French adventure novel written by Alexandre Dumas. It tells the story of a group of swashbuckling adventurers in Paris in the 1600’s.
messages.RATCOUSEL_LORE_2: A “rat king” is a name given to a group of rats whose tails have become tied or stuck together.
messages.RATCOUSEL_LORE_1: Ratcousels are towering creatures that somewhat resemble fairground carousel rides. The smaller “rats” that constantly rotate around the base of their bodies are said only to open their eyes at the moment the creature dies.
messages.POMBOMB_LORE_1: Pombombs are universally considered to be one of the friendliest creatures of New Wirral. If it weren’t for their habits of accidentally setting anything and everything on fire, they would make quite good pets.
messages.POMBOMB_LORE_2: Pomeranians are a popular breed of domesticated dog. Identifiable for their small size and fluffy coat, they are named for a historical region of Europe south of the Baltic Sea.
messages.SPITZFYRE_LORE_2: The Spitz is a type of dog, with various sub-breeds. Spitz breeds can be identified by their fluffy coats and pointed ears.
messages.SPITZFYRE_LORE_1: The Spitzfyre’s fire-breathing abilities have developed to such an extent that they must wear goggles to protect their eyes from the smoke they unwittingly cause by setting things on fire.
messages.ELFLESS_LORE_2: In European superstition, the “elf” is a small impish creature that appear in various incarnations depending on the time and place in history. Similar to fairies, they can be portrayed as helpful, mischievous or even malevolent.
messages.ELFLESS_LORE_1: In order to hide their true emotions, Elfless fashion crude smiling masks out of tree bark. Unsubstantiated rumours claim that there is one day a year where all Elfless will assemble together to replace their old masks with new ones.
messages.GRAMPUS_LORE_2: Contrasting with the benevolent Saint Nicholas, the “Krampus” is a folkloric being that wishes to punish naughty children over the Christmas season. He is commonly depicted as having goat legs and a frightening expression.
messages.GRAMPUS_LORE_1: Grampus is the fully matured form of Elfless. Having spent many years suppressing its emotions, the Grampus is a hulking brute with a desire to impart its own misery onto others, particularly during festive seasons.
messages.FAERIOUS_LORE_2: In contemporary fantasy fiction, elves are often depicted as elegant, swift-footed warriors. Like the elves of folklore, the fantasy elf may be an ally of humans, or a hindrance.
messages.FAERIOUS_LORE_1: An Elfless who has channelled their surpressed fury into honing their combat skills. They strike down their foes with swords made of ice, and block incoming blows with a shield of tree bark.
messages.SIRENADE_LORE_1: Sirenades are particularly loud creatures, and can amplify their own singing voices through their microphone tails and wings. They don’t seem to have much awareness as to whether or not their singing is too loud for those around them.
messages.SIRENADE_LORE_2: Sirens are creatures from Greek mythology, most prominently appearing in Homer’s Odyssey. They are described as winged bird-like women, who would lure men to their doom with their beautiful and haunting song.
messages.MACABRA_LORE_1: The Macabra cannot see, but instead has the ability to “taste” the air around it for potential prey. It prefers to do so from a higher vantage point, and will often find a rock or animal skull to perch on whilst hunting.
messages.MACABRA_DESCRIPTION: a fanged creature perched on a skull
messages.MACABRA_LORE_2: The “chupacabra” is a somewhat recent folkloric creation. Reports of livestock drained of blood in South America gave rise to the concept of a nocturnal blood-sucking creature of unknown origin.
messages.FOLKLORD_LORE_1: A fully mature Macabra, the Folklord wears a skull like the kind it used to perch upon, which has now molded to its head. Its arms and upper body are so dense with muscle that it cannot support itself on its legs for very long.
messages.FOLKLORD_DESCRIPTION: a giant with a skull head
messages.FOLKLORD_LORE_2: There are several cryptids, or unidentified creatures, associated with North America that are described as giant humanoids that live in the forests. These include the ape-like Bigfoot and Sasquatch.
messages.SQUIREY_LORE_1: The common Squirey is often seen roaming the plains of New Wirral, searching for opponents to battle. Despite their cute appearances, they are dedicated warriors and driven by an innate desire for self-improvement.
messages.SQUIREY_EVOLUTION_SPECIALIZATION_QUESTIO: In the heat of battle, which is more important to you?
messages.SQUIREY_LORE_2: A “squire” was, in the Middle Ages, a knight’s apprentice. They would assist their knight with various duties such as carrying their weapons, and could become a knight themselves if they proved their skill.
messages.PALANGOLIN_LORE_1: The Palangolin is the mature form of a Squirey who has remained true to their principles, and has become a knight of great virtue. Palangolins wield striking golden halberds, which they use to defend their allies in the heat of battle.
messages.PALANGOLIN_LORE_2: In European history, a knight was an individual granted a knighthood for services to their country. The popularity of Arthurian mythology influenced the depictions of knights, who are now associated heavily with chivalry and heroism.
messages.MANISPEAR_LORE_2: The “black knight” is a recurring fictional character archetype, commonly portrayed as a masked knight who has strayed from the path of chivalry. The black knight is often a hurdle or obstacle for a story’s protagonist to overcome.
messages.MANISPEAR_LORE_1: If a Squirey gives in to their dark impulses whilst training, it is destined to become a Manispear. Hiding its face beneath a black helmet, the Manispear fights without restraint or self-control.
messages.MUSKRATEER_DESCRIPTION: a mouse with a sword and hat
messages.MUSKRATEER_LORE_1: Muskrateers can often be found sharpening their swords on stones in the underground caves where they dwell. It is not uncommon to find them duelling any Squireys that happen to cross their paths.
messages.MANISPEAR_DESCRIPTION: a dark-armoured knight with an enormous spear

messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BERSERKER: Automatically raises the user’s Melee Attack and inflicts them with Berserk when the user’s HP falls below 50%.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_VENGEFUL_CURSE: Automatically inflicts 3 random debuffs on the last opponent to hit the user upon defeat.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CUSTOM_STARTER: Chance to automatically use the next move in the list, for 0 AP, at the start of battle. The chance is reduced in proportion to the move’s normal AP cost.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_RANDOM_STARTER: Chance to automatically use another move at random, for 0 AP, at the start of battle.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_AUTOMATION: Chance to use the next move in the list, for 0 AP, at the end of the turn.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CHEMICAL_IMBALANCE: Chance to automatically use the next move in the list, for 0 AP, when the user lands a type-advantaged hit. The chance is reduced in proportion to the move’s normal AP cost.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CRITICAL_MASS: Chance to use the next move in the list, for 0 AP, when the user lands a critical hit.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_PAINT_SWIPE: Can only be used if the user has a coating active. Hits one target, and transfers the coating onto the target. Always goes last.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_DUAL_WIELD: Uses the next move in the list twice in succession, if you have enough AP.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BEAR_HUG: Transfers one debuff at random from the user onto the target.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ROYAL_FLUSH: Removes all status effects from the user. Damage is multiplied by the number of statuses removed.
messages.MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FUEL_INJECTION: Automatically used after Guzzle Fuel. Raises the user’s Speed and AP generation.
messages.TUTORIAL_INTRO_1: Hi {player}, glad you could make it!\nPress {control.ui_accept} to continue.
messages.TUTORIAL_INTRO_2: I need your help dealing with a rogue fusion. Feeling up to it?
messages.TUTORIAL_INTRO_3: Let's get moving then! There are some cliffs up ahead. Lead the way with {control.move_up} {control.move_left} {control.move_down} {control.move_right}.
messages.TUTORIAL_TARGET_MENU_1: This is the target menu. You can see what sort of effect your attacks will have on your target here.
messages.TUTORIAL_BATTLE_START_1: Things are gonna get rough from here on in… But don't worry, I\'ll be right here with you!
messages.TUTORIAL_TARGET_MENU_2: Check out the glowing ring! Green means it will give some beneficial effects to the target, red means detrimental, and yellow is mixed.
messages.TUTORIAL_CLIFFS_1: We'll need to get up this cliff. Just jumping ({control.jump}) won\'t help in this case.
messages.TUTORIAL_CLIFFS_2: OK, let's get creative! There are a few ways we could get up there.
messages.TUTORIAL_CLIFFS_4: Or... Do you see that pylon? You can use your magnetism ability (hold {control.magnetism}) here to levitate.
messages.TUTORIAL_CLIFFS_3: For starters, you could try looking for something you can pick up and put down here to give us a boost.
messages.TUTORIAL_CLIFFS_5: You can also shoot vines, right? If you face the cliff and press {control.interact}, you can use a vine to climb up it!
messages.TUTORIAL_BOSS_1.m: This is it. This is the rogue fusion! I hope you're ready for a tough fight, {player}.
messages.TUTORIAL_GLIDE_2: It's easy! When you jump off, just keep {control.jump} held down and you won\'t fall!
messages.TUTORIAL_GLIDE_3: Come on, it's not far now!
messages.TUTORIAL_BOSS_2: If you need to heal up, check your inventory (press {control.pause_menu}) for some cake.
messages.TUTORIAL_BOSS_3: Or we can glide back down to the tent near the start to rest if you like.
messages.TUTORIAL_BOSS_1.n: This is it. This is the rogue fusion! I hope you're ready for a tough fight, {player}.
messages.TUTORIAL_BOSS_1.f: This is it. This is the rogue fusion! I hope you're ready for a tough fight, {player}.
messages.TUTORIAL_BOSS_5: Are you feeling up to it?
messages.TUTORIAL_BOSS_4: If we get caught in a tight spot, check the Battle Items tab in your inventory.
messages.TUTORIAL_DIED: Are you OK? You had me worried there for a moment!
messages.TUTORIAL_WON_2: We make a great team, don't you think, {player}?
messages.TUTORIAL_WON_1: Whoa, we actually, uh, did it?

messages.STATUS_POISONED_DESCRIPTION: Poisoned characters take damage at the end of their turn.
messages.STATUS_WINDOW_DESCRIPTION: Walls owned by characters with the Window status no longer block ranged attacks.
messages.STATUS_LEECHED_DESCRIPTION: Leeched characters take damage at the end of their turn. Opponents are healed by the amount of health taken off.
messages.STATUS_COATING_DESCRIPTION: Coatings change the elemental type of a character for a certain number of turns.
messages.STATUS_HEALING_STEAM_DESCRIPTION: Characters with Healing Steam regain some health at the start of each turn.
messages.STATUS_GLASS_BONDS_DESCRIPTION: Characters with Glass Bonds take damage each time they transform.
messages.STATUS_HEALING_LEAF_DESCRIPTION: Characters with Healing Leaf regain some health at the start of each turn.
messages.STATUS_MULTISTRIKE_DESCRIPTION: Characters with Multistrike will use each move twice if they have enough AP for it.
messages.STATUS_MULTITARGET_DESCRIPTION: Attacks from characters with Multitarget target the whole team.
messages.STATUS_SHRAPNEL_DESCRIPTION: Characters with Shrapnel take damage each time they transform.
messages.STATUS_UNITARGET_DESCRIPTION: Attacks from characters with Unitarget that normally target a whole team only affect a single target, and attacks that are normally single-target have reduced accuracy.
messages.STATUS_PARRY_STANCE_DESCRIPTION: Characters with Parry Stance reflect damage from the next melee attack they receive back onto the attacker.
messages.STATUS_SLEEP_DESCRIPTION: Sleeping characters can’t use the moves they normally have.
messages.STATUS_FLINCH_DESCRIPTION: A character that flinches skips its next turn.
messages.STATUS_BOMB_DESCRIPTION: A character with Bomb will blow up at the end of their next turn if it’s not passed on by a melee attack.
messages.STATUS_LOCKED_ON_DESCRIPTION: Characters with Locked On cannot miss.
messages.STATUS_BERSERK_DESCRIPTION: Characters with Berserk can only use damaging moves.
messages.STATUS_INTERCEPTING_DESCRIPTION: Characters with Intercepting intercept all attacks directed at their allies.
messages.STATUS_HIBERNATING_DESCRIPTION: Hibernating characters heal each turn that they’re asleep.
messages.STATUS_MEDITATING_DESCRIPTION: Meditating characters raise their stats each turn that they’re asleep.
messages.STATUS_TOWER_DEFENSE_DESCRIPTION: Characters with Tower Defence become Earth-type and have raised defence stats.
messages.STATUS_SUMMONED_DESCRIPTION: Summoned characters are called away from combat after a certain number of turns.
messages.STATUS_GHOSTLY_DESCRIPTION: Ghostly characters cannot be hit by attacks, but are defeated when the timer on the Ghostly status runs out.
messages.STATUS_GAMBIT_DESCRIPTION: Characters with Gambit have massively increased stats, but are defeated when the timer on the Gambit status runs out.
messages.STATUS_UNDYING_DESCRIPTION: Characters with Ritual are brought back at 25% health when defeated.
messages.STATUS_RESONANCE_DESCRIPTION: Each time Resonance is inflicted on a character it adds to a counter. When the counter reaches 3, the character is shaken apart and instantly defeated.
messages.STATUS_CLOSE_ENCOUNTER_DESCRIPTION: Close Encounter reduces the range of a character’s ranged attacks, turning them into melee attacks.
messages.STATUS_SPRING_LOADED_DESCRIPTION: Spring-Loaded extends the range of a character’s melee attacks, turning them into ranged attacks.
messages.STATUS_CONDUCTIVE_DESCRIPTION: Conductive characters take damage whenever any Lightning-type attack is used.
messages.STATUS_CONFUSED_DESCRIPTION: Confused characters may use the wrong move or target the wrong character.
messages.STATUS_RESURRECTED_DESCRIPTION: Resurrected characters can no longer be brought back by effects such as Ritual.
messages.STATUS_SNOWED_IN_DESCRIPTION: Snowed In characters are stuck in place and cannot use melee attacks.
messages.STATUS_FOG_DESCRIPTION: Fog reduces the accuracy of ranged attacks that aren’t Water, Air, or Ice-type to 0%.
messages.STATUS_PETRIFIED_DESCRIPTION: Petrified characters become Earth type and can only use Defend and Raise Shields.
messages.STATUS_COTTONED_ON_DESCRIPTION: For the next round, moves that target a character who has Cottoned On are guaranteed to miss.
messages.STATUS_MIND_MELD_DESCRIPTION: Characters with Mind-Meld share their moves with allies.
messages.STATUS_FAIR_FIGHT_DESCRIPTION: While it is in effect, Fair Fight prevents new status effects from being applied.
messages.BATTLE_FLEE_FAILED_FAST_TRAVEL_GAUNTLET: Can’t get away!\nFast travel back to the most recent cafe carriage? You will lose any unclaimed rewards and your streak will be reset.
messages.STATUS_GLASS_SHARDS_DESCRIPTION: While it is in effect, any characters that use a melee attack will take damage from the Glass Shards on the battlefield.
messages.STATUS_ABRAMACABRA_DESCRIPTION: Walls absorb a certain number of incoming hits. Type-advantaged attacks immediately break walls. In addition to standard Wall behavior, Abramacabra automatically attacks one opponent each turn.
messages.STATUS_INFLATED_DESCRIPTION: Inflated characters have increased Attack and Defence stats, but significantly reduced Evasion.
messages.STATUS_DEFLATED_DESCRIPTION: Deflated characters have significantly increased Evasion, but reduced Attack and Defence stats.

messages.TUTORIAL_REMASTER:
Certain tapes can be ‘remastered’ when they reach 5 stars.

Remastering a tape evolves it into a more powerful form. Its stats will grow, and it’ll learn new moves.

Some monster forms can only be obtained through remastering, and in some cases, the remastered tape can be different depending on various conditions.

Remaster tapes whenever you can!
messages.TUTORIAL_FUSION1.f:
When your goals are aligned with those of your companion, you can fuse to become a singular, more powerful beast.

The closer you are to your companion, the more powerful you are as a fusion.

Keep an eye on your fusion meter, though! You can only fuse when this is full.
